o: Publicly traded stock at FMV ($100,000, qualified appreciated stock) and closely held stock at basis ($20,000); both are subject to the 20%-of-AGI limit ($80,000), so $80,000 is deductible this year and $40,000 carries forward 5 years.
Publicly traded stock $100,000; closely held stock $100,000, both limited to 30% of AGI.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】想把闭锁公司股票捐出且按 FMV 扣除，应捐给公共慈善（含 DAF）而非私人基金会。

【捐给私人非运营基金会的长期资本利得财产】

  • 一般：扣除额 = Basis（170(e)(1)(B)(ii)）→ 闭锁公司股票 $20,000
  • 例外：合格增值股票（有市场报价的上市股票，且捐赠人家族合计不超过该公司 10%）→ 按 FMV
【AGI 限额】资本利得财产捐给私人基金会 → 20% × $400,000 = $80,000
  • 两项合计 $100,000 + $20,000 = $120,000 → 当年可计入 $80,000，超额 $40,000 结转 5 年（2026 年起逐项扣除者另须扣除 0.5% AGI 下限）
【对比】现金给私人基金会 → 30%；给公共慈善：现金 60%、资本利得财产 30%（FMV）
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：上市股票按 FMV $100,000、闭锁公司股票按 Basis $20,000 计入，两者受 20% AGI 限额 $80,000，超额 $40,000 结转。
qs.tp: T01.8.2 用途与私人基金会 Related-Use-Foundations

qs.s: Gus donates his car (FMV per a used-car guide $8,000; basis $15,000) to a public charity, which promptly sells it at auction for $3,000 without using or improving it, and issues Form 1098-C. What is his charitable deduction?
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】捐车前应确认慈善机构是否会实际使用该车，否则扣除额往往远低于二手车指南价。

【Sec.170(f)(12) 汽车、船、飞机】申报价值 > $500 时：

  • 慈善机构未做重大使用或实质改良即出售 → 扣除限于出售总收入（Form 1098-C 所示）→ $3,000
  • 例外（可按 FMV）：慈善机构①重大中间使用 ②实质改良 ③以远低于 FMV 的价格给予/出售给贫困者
  • 出售收入 ≤ $500 → 可扣 Lesser of（$500，FMV）
  • 须附 Form 1098-C；超过 $5,000 的非现金捐赠还需合格评估（车辆适用 1098-C 时例外）
【干扰项】选项A 按 FMV；选项B 按 Basis；选项D 误用 $500 规则
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：慈善机构未使用即出售汽车，扣除限于 1098-C 上的出售收入 $3,000。
qs.tp: T01.8.4 慈善下限与凭证 Charity-Floors-Documentation

qs.s: An employee receives 1,000 stock-settled stock appreciation rights (SARs) with a base price equal to the stock's $20 FMV at grant, and separately 500 units of phantom stock payable in cash at the end of 4 years. The SARs are exercised 3 years later when the stock is worth $50. Which statement is correct?
o: The employee is taxed at grant on the value of both awards.
SAR exercise produces $30,000 of long-term capital gain.
The phantom stock is taxed each year as its value increases.

No income arises at grant; on SAR exercise the employee has $30,000 of ordinary compensation income (the employer deducts the same amount), and the phantom stock is taxed as ordinary income when paid; SARs granted with a base price at least equal to FMV on service-recipient stock are generally exempt from Sec. 409A, while phantom stock must be structured to comply with Sec. 409A.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】SAR 与 NQSO 税务结果基本相同，但员工不必出资行权——常用于 S 公司（避免新增股东影响一类股票或股东资格）。

【SAR（股票增值权）】授予时不课税；行权时按增值额 ($50 − $20) × 1,000 = $30,000 确认普通薪酬收入（股票结算时取得股票 Basis = FMV）→ 雇主同时同额扣除

【Phantom Stock（虚拟股票）】实质是递延现金薪酬：支付时按普通收入课税（选项C错；无推定收款时不按年课税）
【409A】
  • 以授予日 FMV 为基准价、标的为雇主普通股的 SAR → 一般豁免 409A（与 NQSO 相同）
  • Phantom Stock 属递延薪酬 → 须满足 409A 的支付时点规则
【对比】ISO 才可能享受资本利得；SAR/NQSO 行权价差一律为普通收入（选项B错）
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：授予时均不课税；SAR 行权按增值 $30,000 确认普通收入、雇主对称扣除；虚拟股票支付时按普通收入课税；合规基准价的 SAR 通常豁免 409A，虚拟股票需符合 409A。
qs.tp: T01.2.5 增值权与虚拟股票 Stock-Appreciation-Rights

qs.s: In 2026 the Lees pay their unrelated full-time nanny, age 30, $25,000 in cash wages. Which statement is correct?
o: No employment taxes are due because a nanny is an independent contractor.
They must withhold income tax from her wages.

Because cash wages are $3,000 or more for 2026, they owe the employer share and must withhold the employee share of Social Security and Medicare taxes; because they paid $1,000 or more in a calendar quarter, FUTA applies; they report these taxes on Schedule H with Form 1040, file Form W-2 for her, and may increase their own withholding or estimated payments to cover them.
Household employment taxes are paid only on Form 941 each quarter.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】家政税不能在 Schedule C 或 E 扣除；雇主可通过增加工资预扣来避免 Schedule H 税款造成的预估税罚款。

【家政雇员税（Pub. 926，2026）】

  • 保姆通常是雇员（选项A错）
  • FICA：年度现金工资 ≥ $3,000（2026）→ 雇主 7.65% + 预扣员工 7.65%
  • FUTA：任一日历季度支付现金工资 ≥ $1,000 → 适用
  • 所得税预扣：只有在员工要求且雇主同意时才预扣（选项B错）
  • 申报：Schedule H 随 Form 1040（不必每季度提交 941，选项D错）；W-2/W-3 于 1 月 31 日前
  • 例外：配偶、21 岁以下的子女、父母（特定情形）、18 岁以下且非主要职业的雇员
  • 支付的保姆费可计入受养人照护抵免或 DCAP 的合格支出
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：2026 年现金工资达到 $3,000 须缴 FICA，季度工资达到 $1,000 适用 FUTA，通过 Schedule H 随 1040 申报并出具 W-2。
qs.tp: T01.19.6 家政雇员税 Household-Employment-Taxes

qs.s: Kim receives advance premium tax credit (APTC) payments for 2026 marketplace coverage based on projected income. A large Roth conversion late in the year raises her household income well above her projection. Which statement about reconciling the APTC on Form 8962 is correct?
o: Repayment of excess APTC is capped at a few hundred to a few thousand dollars depending on income.
No repayment is required because the payments were made to the insurer.
Beginning with 2026, she must repay the entire excess of the advance payments over her allowable premium tax credit — the income-based repayment caps no longer apply.
She may choose to spread repayment over 3 years.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】对退休后依赖 ACA 保险的客户，Roth 转换、资本利得实现的 MAGI 管理比以往更重要。

【Sec.36B(f)】全年结束后用 Form 8962 核对：实际可得 PTC vs 已预付 APTC

  • 2025 年及以前：超额预付的偿还额按收入分档有上限（收入 ≥ 400% FPL 则全额偿还）
  • OBBBA：2026 年起取消偿还上限 → 所有纳税人须全额偿还超额部分（选项A错）
  • 预付款支付给保险公司，但属于纳税人的抵免，须在申报表上核对（选项B错）；没有分期偿还选择（选项D错）
【筹划】年内收入大幅变化（Roth 转换、出售资产、领取奖金）时应及时向 marketplace 更新收入估计
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：2026 年起取消超额 APTC 的偿还上限，Kim 须全额偿还。
qs.tp: T01.19.7 保费抵免与儿童抵免 Premium-Child-Tax-Credits

qs.s: The Parks (MFJ; AGI $180,000) have two qualifying children under 17 with SSNs; both parents have SSNs. What is their 2026 child tax credit, and which requirement did OBBBA add?
o: $4,400 ($2,200 per child, indexed after 2025, with up to $1,700 per child refundable based on earned income); OBBBA requires a valid SSN for the child and for at least one parent (and the credit phases out above $400,000 of MAGI for joint filers).
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】CTC 以"年末未满 17 岁"判断；17–18 岁的受养子女只能适用 $500 的其他受养人抵免。

【OBBBA 后的 CTC】

  • 每名 17 岁以下合格子女 $2,200（2025 年起，之后按通胀调整）→ 2 × 2,200 = $4,400
  • 可退部分（ACTC）每名最多约 $1,700，与劳动收入挂钩（选项A错）
  • 递减门槛 MAGI $400,000（MFJ）/ $200,000（其他），每超过 $1,000 减 $50 → 本题未触及（选项D错）
  • SSN 要求：子女须有 SSN；纳税人（MFJ 至少一方）须有 SSN
  • 其他受养人抵免 $500（不可退）
【干扰项】选项C 是 2021 年临时加强版
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：每名子女 $2,200，合计 $4,400（每名最多约 $1,700 可退）；OBBBA 要求子女及至少一名父母有 SSN，MFJ 递减门槛 $400,000。
qs.tp: T01.19.7 保费抵免与儿童抵免 Premium-Child-Tax-Credits

qs.s: In 2026 the Wus (MFJ; AGI $180,000) pay $14,000 of day care for their two children and exclude $7,500 through their employer's dependent care assistance program. What child and dependent care credit can they claim?
o: $0 — the $6,000 expense limit for two or more qualifying individuals is reduced dollar-for-dollar by the $7,500 excluded, leaving no creditable expenses.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】2026 年起 DCAP 上限 $7,500 已超过 2 人支出上限 $6,000——用满 DCAP 的家庭基本拿不到照护抵免。

【2026 年变化（OBBBA）】

  • DCAP 排除上限由 $5,000 提高到 $7,500（MFS $3,750）
  • 抵免比例提高：AGI ≤ $15,000 为 50%，逐步降至 35%；AGI 超过 $75,000（MFJ $150,000）后每 $2,000（MFJ $4,000）降 1 个百分点，最低 20%（MFJ 约 $206,000 起）
  • 本题 AGI $180,000：35% − 8 = 27%（但可抵免支出为 0，比例无意义）
【协调（Sec.21(c)）】抵免支出上限（1 人 $3,000 / 2 人及以上 $6,000）须减去 DCAP 排除额
  • 6,000 − 7,500 < 0 → 可抵免支出 $0 → 抵免 $0
【筹划】高收入家庭：DCAP 排除（省所得税 + FICA）通常优于 20%–27% 的抵免；用满 $7,500 后便不再有抵免空间
【干扰项】选项A 忽略协调；选项B 用剩余支出计算；选项D 用了低收入比例
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：两名子女的支出上限 $6,000 须减去 $7,500 的 DCAP 排除额，可抵免支出为 $0。
qs.tp: T01.19.5 照护福利与抵免 Dependent-Care-Benefits-Credit

qs.s: Nate, age 24, is no longer anyone's dependent. His parents pay $3,000 of interest on a student loan on which only Nate is legally obligated. His MAGI is below the phase-out range. Which statement is correct?
o: His parents may deduct the $3,000 because they paid it.

Nate may deduct $2,500 — interest paid by another person on a loan for which he is legally obligated is treated as paid to Nate and then by Nate; the deduction is capped at $2,500, is above the line, and is not available to married taxpayers filing separately.
No one may deduct the interest because Nate did not pay it.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】若 Nate 仍是父母的受养人，则无人能扣除这笔利息——受养人身份会"浪费"扣除。

【Sec.221 学贷利息扣除】

  • 只有法律上负有偿还义务的人可扣（父母不是借款人 → 不可扣，选项A错）
  • 第三方代付：视为先赠与借款人、再由借款人支付（Reg. §1.221-1(b)(4)）→ Nate 可扣（选项D错）
  • 上限 $2,500（选项C错）；above-the-line；有 MAGI 递减；MFS 不可扣；本人若被他人申报为受养人则不可扣
  • 与 §127 雇主代还学贷（最多 $5,250 免税）协调：已被排除的部分不能再扣
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：第三方代付视同 Nate 支付，Nate 可扣除，但每年上限 $2,500。
qs.tp: T01.19.8 学生贷款利息 Student-Loan-Interest

qs.s: Business land (FMV $200,000; adjusted basis $100,000) securing a $250,000 loan is transferred to the lender in foreclosure, and the lender cancels the remaining debt. The owner is solvent and not in bankruptcy. Compare the results if the loan is (1) recourse or (2) nonrecourse.
o: Both: $150,000 gain and no COD income.
(1) $100,000 gain and $50,000 COD income; (2) $150,000 gain and no COD income.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】追索负债产生的 COD 是普通收入但可用 108 排除；无追索负债的全部差额都是处置利得，不能用 108 排除。

【追索负债（Recourse）】两步：
① 按财产 FMV 视同出售：200,000 − 100,000 = 100,000 利得（1231/资本）
② 负债超过 FMV 的部分被免除：250,000 − 200,000 = 50,000 普通 COD 收入（可适用 108 排除，如资不抵债、破产、合格不动产营业负债）

【无追索负债（Nonrecourse）】Amount Realized = 全部负债（即使超过 FMV，Tufts 案）→ 250,000 − 100,000 = 150,000 利得，无 COD 收入
【干扰项】选项A 把追索负债也当作无追索；选项C 把处置利得误作 COD；选项D 把无追索负债也拆成两部分
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：追索负债：按 FMV 计算 $100,000 利得，另有 $50,000 COD 收入；无追索负债：全部负债为实现额，$150,000 利得，无 COD 收入。
qs.tp: T01.18.2 购价调减与止赎 Purchase-Adjustments-Foreclosure

qs.s: Nadia owns 40% of Coral LLC (taxed as a partnership). Her outside basis at the beginning of the year is $60,000, which includes $35,000 of her share of the LLC's recourse bank debt that she has personally guaranteed. None of the LLC's debt is qualified nonrecourse financing. During the year, Coral LLC passes through an ordinary loss of $95,000 to Nadia (her 40% share). Nadia does not materially participate in Coral LLC's business. She has $12,000 of passive income from an unrelated limited partnership this year. How much of the $95,000 loss can Nadia deduct on her Form 1040 this year, and what happens to the rest?
o: The full $95,000 is deductible because Nadia personally guaranteed the recourse debt, which makes her at-risk amount unlimited.

$60,000 clears basis and at-risk, and because Nadia is a passive investor the entire $60,000 loss allowed at at-risk offsets her $12,000 passive income with no limitation from PAL, leaving $35,000 suspended at basis.
Only $12,000 is deductible; the remaining $83,000 is permanently disallowed because Nadia does not materially participate.

$60,000 is allowed at the basis and at-risk levels, but only $12,000 is currently deductible after the PAL test; $48,000 is suspended as a passive loss carryforward and $35,000 is suspended at the basis level.
qs.x:
【🚨 高频陷阱】"个人担保追索负债"只解决 At-Risk 层的问题，并不能豁免 PAL 层的被动性认定——很多考生看到"担保"两个字就误以为亏损可以直接顶格抵扣，忽略了 Material Participation 才是决定 PAL 层的关键，与债务担保与否无关（选项A的错误正在于此）。

【第一步：Tier 1 — Tax Basis 测试】

  • Nadia 的 Outside Basis = $60,000（已含分摊到的 $35,000 追索负债）。
  • 分摊亏损 $95,000 > Basis $60,000 → 通过 Basis 层的部分 = $60,000；超出的 $35,000 在 Basis 层挂起，结转到未来 Basis 增加时释放。
【第二步：Tier 2 — At-Risk 测试】
  • 追索负债（Recourse Debt）由 Nadia 个人担保，属于她实际承担经济风险的金额，因此同时计入 At-Risk 金额。
  • At-Risk 金额 = $60,000（与 Basis 相同，因为这笔负债追索且被担保，两个层级口径一致）。
  • 通过 Basis 层的 $60,000，再测 At-Risk：$60,000 ≤ At-Risk 额度 $60,000 → 全额 $60,000 通过 At-Risk 层，无新增挂起。
【第三步：Tier 3 — Passive Activity Loss (PAL) 测试】
  • Nadia 不实质参与（Not Material Participation）→ 该 $60,000 亏损定性为被动活动亏损。
  • 被动亏损只能抵消被动活动收入：Nadia 本年有 $12,000 被动收入（来自无关联的有限合伙）。
  • 通过 PAL 层的金额 = Min($60,000, $12,000) = $12,000；剩余 $60,000 − $12,000 = $48,000 在 PAL 层挂起，结转至以后年度，待有更多被动收入或完全处置该活动时释放。
【第四步：本年最终可扣除金额汇总】
  • 当年实际可在 Form 1040 上扣除 = $12,000（唯一通过全部三层测试的部分）。
  • 挂起明细：Basis 层挂起 $35,000（性质仍是"合伙亏损"，Basis恢复后可用）+ PAL 层挂起 $48,000（性质是"被动活动亏损"，需被动收入或处置该活动才能释放）。两笔挂起互相独立，不可混淆归类。
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：$60,000 通过 Basis 和 At-Risk 测试，经 PAL 限额后当年仅可扣除 $12,000，$48,000 挂起于 PAL 层，$35,000 挂起于 Basis 层。
qs.tp: T02.2.1 担保与无追索债 Guarantees-Nonrecourse-Debt

qs.s: Same facts as Nadia's Coral LLC case (outside basis $60,000 including $35,000 share of LLC debt; $95,000 loss passed through), EXCEPT: the $35,000 of LLC debt is general nonrecourse debt (not qualified nonrecourse financing), and Nadia materially participates in the business. How much of the loss is deductible this year?
o: $25,000 deductible; the other $70,000 is permanently disallowed.
$60,000 deductible, because material participation removes the PAL limit.
$95,000 deductible, because material participation overrides all limits.
$25,000 deductible; $35,000 suspended at the basis level and $35,000 suspended at the at-risk level.
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题负债为个人担保的追索负债 → At-Risk 与 Basis 相同，卡在 PAL；本题负债为一般非追索 → 卡在 At-Risk。考点：同一个 Basis 数字，负债性质决定卡在哪一层。

【Tier 1 Basis】$95,000 vs Basis $60,000 → 通过 $60,000，挂起 $35,000

【Tier 2 At-Risk】At-Risk = $60,000 − 一般非追索负债 $35,000 = $25,000 → 通过 $25,000，挂起 $35,000
【Tier 3 PAL】实质参与 → 非被动，不受限
【Tier 4 EBL】$25,000 远低于门槛

→ 当年可扣 $25,000；两笔挂起各自独立结转（非永久丧失，选项A错）

【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：$25,000 deductible; $35,000 suspended at the basis level and $35,000 suspended at the at-risk level.
qs.tp: T02.2.1 担保与无追索债 Guarantees-Nonrecourse-Debt

qs.s: Owen has $140,000 of suspended passive losses accumulated over several years from a rental real estate limited partnership interest (he does not qualify as a real estate professional). This year, Owen sells his entire interest in the partnership to an unrelated third party in a fully taxable transaction for a price that produces a $30,000 taxable gain on the sale itself. Owen has no other passive income or loss this year. What is the net effect on Owen's current-year taxable income from the sale and the release of the suspended losses?
o: The suspended losses can only be used to reduce the basis of the partnership interest for gain computation purposes; they cannot be deducted separately from other income.
The $30,000 gain is fully taxable, and the $140,000 suspended loss remains suspended indefinitely since Owen never achieved material participation.
Only $30,000 of the suspended losses can offset the $30,000 gain; the remaining $110,000 stays suspended because Owen has no other passive income.

A fully taxable disposition to an unrelated party releases all $140,000 of suspended passive losses as nonpassive ordinary losses; together with the $30,000 gain on the sale, Owen's taxable income decreases by a net $110,000, deductible against his other income (wages, portfolio income, etc.) this year.
qs.x:
【🚨 高频陷阱】① 只有卖给无关联方才触发（卖给自己控制的另一实体或关联方不算，仍是关联方交易，规则不同）；② 必须是应税处置（如改用 1031 免税置换掉这个活动，则不触发悬挂 PAL 的释放，Loss 结转到新资产上）；③ 赠与该权益给子女不触发释放，而是并入受赠人取得资产的税基（考生极易把"赠与"和"应税出售"混淆）。

【第一步：明确"完全处置"这一释放全部悬挂 PAL 的例外规则】

  • Sec.469(g) 规定：纳税人将其在某被动活动中的全部权益，通过完全应税交易（Fully Taxable Transaction）转让给非关联方（Unrelated Party）时，该活动历年累积的全部悬挂被动亏损，无论当年有没有其他被动收入，一次性全额释放。
  • 本题三个条件同时满足：① 卖掉全部权益（不是部分）；② 卖给无关联第三方；③ 全额应税交易（非1031等免税处置）→ 触发完全处置释放规则。
【第二步：释放金额与本年处置利得如何加总】
  • 悬挂 PAL $140,000 全部释放，不再受"仅能抵被动收入"的限制——这是完全处置例外的核心价值：释放后的亏损可以自由冲抵任何性质的收入（工资、组合投资收入等），不再局限于被动收入。
  • 出售本身产生的 $30,000 Gain，与释放的 $140,000 Loss 在同一处置交易的税务结果里合并计算：$30,000（Gain） − $140,000（释放的悬挂Loss） = 对应税所得净影响 −$110,000（其中 $140,000 为非被动普通亏损，$30,000 出售利得一般为资本利得，§751 部分除外）。
【第三步：该净亏损的最终去向】
  • 这笔 $110,000 净亏损不再是被动性质——完全处置后释放的悬挂损失，加上处置本身的损益，合并后可直接抵减 Owen 当年的任何应税所得（工资、利息股息等），无需再有被动收入配对。
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：完全应税处置为 PAL 规则下的彻底释放例外，历年悬挂被动亏损全额释放且不受当年被动收入限制。
qs.tp: T02.5 处置与亏损释放 Dispositions-Suspended-Losses

qs.s: Same facts as Owen's case ($140,000 suspended passive losses; he sells his entire interest in a fully taxable sale producing a $30,000 gain), EXCEPT the buyer is Owen's brother. What is the result this year?
o: The $30,000 gain is passive income and can be offset by $30,000 of the suspended losses; the remaining $110,000 stays suspended (usable against other passive income) until the brother disposes of the interest to an unrelated party.
All $140,000 of suspended losses are released, producing a $110,000 net loss against any income.
The suspended losses are permanently lost because the sale was to a related party.
The suspended losses transfer to the brother and increase his basis.
qs.x:
【🚨 三种处置对比】
  • 卖给非关联方（应税）→ 全额释放
  • 卖给关联方 → 仅可抵处置 Gain，其余等待
  • 赠与 → 挂起亏损加入受赠人 Basis，赠与人永不扣除（选项D描述的正是赠与规则，不适用于出售；选项C"永久丧失"亦错）
  • 死亡 → 释放金额以超过继承 Step-up 的部分为限

【规则】Sec.469(g)(1)(B)：处置给关联方（Sec.267(b)/707(b)）不触发全额释放

  • 处置本身的 $30,000 Gain 属被动收入 → 可用 $30,000 挂起亏损抵消 → 净额 $0
  • 剩余 $110,000 继续挂起，Owen 仍可用其抵消其他被动收入；待兄弟将该权益出售给非关联方时，Owen 才能全额释放
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：The $30,000 gain is passive income and can be offset by $30,000 of the suspended losses; the remaining $110,000 stays suspended (usable against other passive income) until the brother disposes of the interest to an unrelated party.
qs.tp: T02.5.1 关联与其他处置 Related-Partial-Installment-Dispositions

qs.s: In Year 1, Marcus (single, no dependents) has $700,000 of net business losses from his active trade or business, and $900,000 of other taxable income (wages and investment income combined, before considering the business loss). Assume the Sec. 461(l) Excess Business Loss threshold for a single filer in Year 1 is $305,000. In Year 2, Marcus's business rebounds and produces $250,000 of net taxable income before any NOL deduction, and he has no other income or loss items. How should Marcus treat the Year 1 excess business loss carryforward when computing Year 2 taxable income?
o: The full $395,000 excess business loss is deductible in Year 2 without limitation because it originated as a business loss, not an investment loss.

The Year 1 excess business loss of $395,000 becomes a Year 2 net operating loss carryforward, deductible in Year 2 up to 80% of Year 2 taxable income computed before the NOL deduction, i.e., limited to $200,000, leaving $50,000 of Year 2 taxable income and $195,000 of unused NOL carried forward again.
The $395,000 must be carried back two years under the general NOL carryback rules before any carryforward is permitted.
The excess business loss is permanently lost once the Sec. 461(l) threshold is exceeded in the year it arises; nothing carries forward to Year 2.
qs.x:
【🚨 高频陷阱】EBL 和 NOL 是两套不同的限制机制，很多考生误以为 EBL 结转到下一年还是按"商业亏损"性质、继续套用 461(l) 门槛去测——实际上 EBL 一旦跨年，身份直接转换为 NOL，下一年只看 80% 应税所得限制，与 $305,000/$610,000（或当年实际门槛）这类 EBL 专属数字完全无关。这是 TCP 关于损失结转链条设计得最精巧、也最容易失分的一个"身份转换"考点。

【第一步：Year 1 —— 计算 Sec.461(l) 超额商业亏损（EBL）】

  • Marcus 当年净商业亏损 $700,000，Single 门槛 $305,000（题目给定）。
  • Year 1 可冲抵其他收入的商业亏损上限 = $305,000；超出部分 = $700,000 − $305,000 = $395,000，即为 Year 1 的 Excess Business Loss（EBL）。
  • Year 1 应纳税所得 = $900,000（其他收入）− $305,000（允许冲抵的商业亏损）= $595,000。
【第二步：EBL 的法定去向 —— 强制转为下一年度 NOL】
  • 根据 Sec.461(l)(2)：当年被卡住不能扣除的 EBL（本题 $395,000），不是直接结转到 Year 2 继续按"商业亏损"身份使用，而是被强制重新定性为 Year 2 的净经营亏损（NOL）结转，自动并入 NOL 结转池。
  • 这意味着进入 Year 2 后，这笔 $395,000 不再受 461(l) 门槛限制，而是改为适用普通 NOL 规则（Sec.172）。
【第三步：Year 2 —— 适用 NOL 的 80% 应税所得限制】
  • Year 2 taxable income（未扣 NOL 前）= $250,000。
  • 2017年后产生的 NOL，扣除限额 = Year 2 应税所得（扣除NOL前）× 80% = $250,000 × 80% = $200,000。
  • Year 2 实际可用的 NOL 扣除 = Min($395,000 可用余额, $200,000 限额) = $200,000。
【第四步：Year 2 最终应税所得与剩余结转】
  • Year 2 应纳税所得 = $250,000 − $200,000 = $50,000。
  • 剩余未用 NOL = $395,000 − $200,000 = $195,000，继续无限期结转至 Year 3 及以后（NOL 结转不设年限，但每年仍受 80% 限制，且 2018年后的NOL不可结转回以前年度）。
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：当年超额业务亏损（EBL）次年自动转为 NOL，受 80% 限制并可无限期向后结转。
qs.tp: T02.6.1 净损失八成限额 NOL-Eighty-Percent-Limit

qs.s: Marcus and his spouse file MFJ. In Year 1 they have $600,000 of net business losses and $900,000 of wages and investment income. Assume the Sec. 461(l) threshold for MFJ is $512,000. In Year 2, their taxable income before any NOL deduction is $50,000. What is their Year 2 taxable income and remaining NOL carryforward?
o: Year 2 taxable income $50,000; the EBL is permanently lost.
Year 2 taxable income $0; NOL carryforward remaining $38,000.
Year 2 taxable income $0; NOL carryforward $0 because the EBL is fully deductible in Year 2.
Year 2 taxable income $10,000; NOL carryforward remaining $48,000.
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】门槛换成 MFJ，且 Year 2 收入远小于 NOL → 80% 上限成为约束，应税所得不可能被 NOL 压到 0（选项B、C错）。

【Year 1】EBL = $600,000 − $512,000 = $88,000 → 自动转为 Year 2 NOL

【Year 2】NOL 扣除上限 = 80% × $50,000 = $40,000
  • 应税所得 = $50,000 − $40,000 = $10,000
  • 剩余 NOL = $88,000 − $40,000 = $48,000，无限期结转
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：Year 2 taxable income $10,000; NOL carryforward remaining $48,000.
qs.tp: T02.6.1 净损失八成限额 NOL-Eighty-Percent-Limit

qs.s: Gus owns a building that he rents to his S corporation, in whose business he materially participates. The rental produces $40,000 of net income. Gus also has a $30,000 loss from a limited partnership in which he does not participate. Can the LP loss offset the rental income?
o: No — under the self-rental rule, net rental income from property rented to a business in which the taxpayer materially participates is recharacterized as nonpassive; the $30,000 LP loss remains suspended. (A net loss from the self-rental would remain passive.)
No, because S corporation income can never be combined with partnership items.
Yes — rental income is always passive, so the $30,000 passive loss offsets $30,000 of it.
qs.x:
【🚨 类似的重新定性规则】显著参与活动（100–500 小时）的净收入、租给他人使用的开发中不动产、平均租期 ≤7 天的出租（视为营业活动而非出租）。

【Reg. §1.469-2(f)(6) Self-Rental 规则】

  • 把自有财产出租给自己实质参与的企业 → 净租金收入重新定性为非被动
  • 若产生净亏损 → 仍为被动（"单向不利"：收入不能用来吸收被动亏损，亏损仍受限）
  • 目的：防止纳税人人为制造"被动收入"来吸收其他被动亏损
【本题】$40,000 为非被动收入 → LP 的 $30,000 被动亏损继续挂起
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：No — under the self-rental rule, net rental income from property rented to a business in which the taxpayer materially participates is recharacterized as nonpassive; the $30,000 LP loss remains suspended. (A net loss from the self-rental would remain passive.)
qs.tp: T02.3.4 自租收入重分类 Self-Rental-Recharacterization

qs.s: In prior years Liam deducted $50,000 of losses from an activity, reducing his at-risk amount to exactly $0. This year the activity has no income or loss, but a $30,000 loan on which Liam was personally liable (previously counted as at-risk) is converted to general nonrecourse debt. What is the consequence?
o: He must amend the prior-year returns to disallow $30,000 of losses.

His at-risk amount becomes $(30,000); under Sec. 465(e), he must recapture $30,000 into income this year (limited to losses previously deducted), and that amount becomes a suspended loss carried forward until his at-risk amount increases.
Nothing happens until he sells the activity.
His basis is reduced by $30,000, but no income is recognized.
qs.x:
【🚨 对比】Basis 不会因此变为负数（负债性质变化不影响 Basis，只影响 At-Risk）——这正是两层测试需要分开追踪的原因。

【Sec.465(e) At-Risk 回收】年末 At-Risk 金额低于零时 → 负数部分计入当年收入

  • 触发原因：追索负债转为非追索负债、担保解除、超额分配等
  • 回收上限：以前年度已扣除的亏损（减去已回收额）→ $50,000 ≥ $30,000 → 回收 $30,000
  • 被回收的 $30,000 转为挂起亏损，待 At-Risk 金额日后增加时再扣除
  • 不修改以前年度申报（选项A错）
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：His at-risk amount becomes $(30,000); under Sec. 465(e), he must recapture $30,000 into income this year (limited to losses previously deducted), and that amount becomes a suspended loss carried forward until his at-risk amount increases.
qs.tp: T02.2.3 风险负数回收 At-Risk-Recapture

qs.s:
• Nora, a full-time W-2 employee (not a real estate professional), owns a vacation property that she rents through an online platform. The average guest stay is 4 days. She spends 150 hours managing it
  • her cleaning contractor spends 110 hours
  • no one else spends more time. The property produces a $25,000 loss (her MAGI is $250,000). Can Nora deduct the loss against her wages?
o: No — all rental real estate losses are passive unless the owner is a real estate professional.
Only $25,000 under the active participation allowance, reduced by her MAGI to $0.
No — she must spend at least 500 hours to materially participate.

Yes — because the average customer use is 7 days or less, the activity is not a 'rental activity'; she materially participates by spending more than 100 hours and at least as much time as any other individual, so the loss is nonpassive (subject to basis, at-risk, and excess business loss limits).
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】短租（Airbnb）亏损是高收入雇员常用的筹划，但要注意：须有工时记录；个人使用天数过多时还会触发度假屋（Sec.280A）限制。

【Reg. §1.469-1T(e)(3)：以下情形不属于"出租活动"】平均客户使用期 ≤ 7 天（或 ≤ 30 天且提供重大个人服务）等
→ 不适用"出租活动一律被动"的推定，按一般营业活动测试实质参与

【实质参与 7 项测试（满足其一）】

① 全年 > 500 小时
② 纳税人的参与构成该活动几乎全部参与
③ > 100 小时，且不少于任何其他个人 → Nora 150 > 110 ✔
④ 多项"显著参与活动"（各 > 100 小时）合计 > 500 小时
⑤ 过去 10 年中任意 5 年实质参与
⑥ 个人服务活动：过去任意 3 年实质参与
⑦ 事实与情况测试（> 100 小时）
→ 亏损为非被动，可抵工资，不需要 REP 身份（选项A、C错）；$25,000 宽免额与此无关（选项B错）

【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：平均租期不超过 7 天不属于出租活动，Nora 超过 100 小时且不少于任何其他人，构成实质参与，亏损为非被动。
qs.tp: T02.3.2 短租与度假屋 Short-Rentals-Vacation-Homes

qs.s: Olga buys a rental building for $100,000 cash plus a $900,000 nonrecourse loan from an unrelated commercial bank, secured only by the building. What is Olga's initial amount at risk?
o: $100,000 — nonrecourse debt is never at risk.
$900,000 — only the borrowed amount is at risk.
$1,000,000 — qualified nonrecourse financing for real property from a qualified lender is treated as an amount at risk.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】不动产无追索贷款多数可计入 At-Risk；但卖方融资或发起人贷款不是 QNF。

【Sec.465 At-Risk】一般只包括现金、财产 Basis 与个人负有责任的借款

【例外 Sec.465(b)(6) 合格无追索融资（QNF）】计入 At-Risk，条件：
  • 用于持有不动产活动
  • 借自"合格人士"（商业贷款机构等，非卖方或发起人）或政府
  • 无人负个人责任、不可转换
【本题】银行无追索贷款以建筑担保 → QNF → At-Risk = 100,000 + 900,000 = 1,000,000
【干扰项】选项A 忽略不动产例外；选项BC 编造比例
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：来自无关商业银行、用于不动产的无追索贷款是合格无追索融资，At-Risk 为 $1,000,000。

qs.s: Pete has $30,000 of suspended passive losses from a rental activity. In 2026 he becomes a real estate professional and materially participates, so the rental is no longer passive. The rental produces $10,000 of net income in 2026. How much of the suspended loss can Pete deduct in 2026, and what happens to the rest?
o: $10,000 against the rental's own income; the remaining $20,000 stays suspended and can offset future income from that activity or other passive income, or is freed on a full taxable disposition.
All $30,000, because the activity is now nonpassive.
None, until the activity is disposed of.
All $30,000, but only against his other passive income.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】身份改变（成为不动产专业人士或实质参与）不会一次性释放以前的挂起亏损。

【Sec.469(f)"原被动活动"】活动变为非被动后：

  • 以前年度挂起的被动亏损可抵该活动本身的当年所得
  • 剩余部分仍按被动亏损处理（可抵其他被动收入），直至完全处置
【本题】抵本活动所得 10,000 → 剩余 20,000 继续挂起
【干扰项】选项B 误以为身份改变释放全部亏损；选项C 忽略 469(f)；选项D 性质与额度都不对
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：原被动活动的挂起亏损可先抵该活动本身的 $10,000 所得，剩余 $20,000 继续挂起。
qs.tp: T02.3.5 原被动活动与专篮 Former-Passive-Activities

qs.s: Maple Inc. is a closely held C corporation (not a personal service corporation). In 2026 it has $100,000 of net active business income, $50,000 of portfolio income, and a $120,000 loss from a passive rental activity. How much of the passive loss is deductible?
o: $120,000 — the passive loss rules do not apply to C corporations.
$0 — the corporation is treated like an individual.
$100,000 — a closely held C corporation may offset passive losses against net active income, but not against portfolio income; $20,000 is suspended.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】区分三类：PSC（最严）→ 封闭持股 C 公司（可抵主动收入）→ 其他 C 公司（不适用）。

【Sec.469 对 C 公司的适用】

  • 个人服务公司（PSC）：与个人相同，被动亏损只能抵被动收入
  • 封闭持股 C 公司（5 人或以下在后半年持有 >50%）：被动亏损可抵净主动收入，但不能抵组合收入（469(e)(2)）
  • 其他 C 公司：不受 469 限制
【本题】可扣 Min(120,000, 净主动收入 100,000) = 100,000；挂起 20,000
【干扰项】选项A 忽略封闭持股公司规则；选项B 是 PSC 规则；选项D 恰好相反
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：封闭持股 C 公司的被动亏损可抵 $100,000 净主动收入，不能抵组合收入，$20,000 挂起。

qs.s: Rita dies in 2026 owning a rental property with $50,000 of suspended passive losses. The property's basis is stepped up from $200,000 to $230,000 at her death. How much of the suspended loss is deductible on her final return?
o: $20,000 — suspended losses are allowed only to the extent they exceed the $30,000 basis step-up; the other $30,000 is permanently lost.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】死亡：亏损 − Step-up；赠与：亏损加入受赠人 Basis；完全应税出售：全部释放。

【Sec.469(g)(2) 因死亡处置】

  • 挂起亏损在死者最后一个申报表上扣除，但须减去继承人取得的 Basis 增加额
  • 50,000 − (230,000 − 200,000) = 20,000 可扣；30,000 永久丧失
【对比赠与 469(j)(6)】挂起亏损不能扣，而是加到受赠人 Basis（见下一题）
【干扰项】选项A 忽略 Step-up 抵减；选项C 过度；选项D 算反
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：死亡时挂起亏损须减去 Basis 增加额 $30,000，最后申报表可扣 $20,000。
qs.tp: T02.5.2 死亡时暂停亏损 Death-Suspended-Losses

qs.s: Sam gives his daughter a rental property (basis $150,000; FMV $300,000) that has $40,000 of suspended passive losses. What happens to the suspended losses?
o: Sam deducts them in full because the gift is a disposition of his entire interest.
The daughter carries them over and deducts them against her passive income.
They are not deductible by anyone; they are added to the daughter's basis, which becomes $190,000.
They are permanently lost with no basis effect.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】赠与带挂起亏损的活动，亏损只能通过日后出售时降低利得"间接"受益。

【Sec.469(j)(6) 赠与处置】

  • 赠与不是"完全应税处置" → 赠与人不能扣
  • 挂起亏损加到受赠人 Basis：150,000 + 40,000 = 190,000
  • 若 FMV < 调整后 Basis，计算亏损时受赠人 Basis 仍受 FMV 限制
【干扰项】选项A 当作应税处置；选项B 亏损不能转移给受赠人扣除；选项D 忽略 Basis 调整
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：赠与时挂起亏损不能扣除，而是加入受赠人 Basis，变为 $190,000。
qs.tp: T02.5.3 赠与时暂停亏损 Gifts-Suspended-Losses

qs.s: In 2026 Tom breeds dogs as a hobby (not engaged in for profit). He has $8,000 of gross income (no cost of goods sold) and $15,000 of expenses. How does this affect his taxable income?
o: $8,000 of income is included; none of the $15,000 of expenses is deductible.
A $7,000 net loss is deductible against other income.
Expenses are deductible up to the $8,000 of income, so there is no net effect.
Expenses are deductible as itemized deductions subject to the 2% of AGI floor.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】爱好活动现在"只有收入没有扣除"——认定为营利活动（Schedule C）差别巨大。

【Sec.183 爱好活动】

  • 收入全额计入
  • 费用属于杂项逐项扣除，TCJA 暂停、OBBBA 永久取消 → 不可扣（销货成本除外，因其减少毛收入）
  • 旧规则（2017 年前）：费用可在收入范围内扣除，受 2% AGI 下限——选项CD
【盈利推定】5 年中 3 年盈利（养马 7 年中 2 年）→ 推定为营利活动
【干扰项】选项B 把爱好当作营业
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：爱好收入 $8,000 全额计入，费用因杂项逐项扣除已被永久取消而不可扣。
qs.tp: T02.7.2 爱好收入与费用 Hobby-Income-Expenses

qs.s: Harold, a widower who remarried this year, wants to gift $140,000 in cash to his adult daughter from his first marriage. Harold's new spouse, Denise, has never met the daughter but agrees to consent to gift-splitting to help minimize gift tax. Assume the annual per-donee gift tax exclusion is $19,000 per donor. If Harold and Denise elect gift-splitting on Form 709, what is the result?
o: Because Denise has no relationship with the daughter, only Harold's half qualifies for gift-splitting treatment; Denise's deemed half is fully taxable with no exclusion available to her.
Gift-splitting automatically applies without any election or additional filing as long as the couple is legally married on the date of the gift.

The entire $140,000 gift is treated as made one-half by Harold ($70,000) and one-half by Denise ($70,000); each spouse applies their own $19,000 annual exclusion against their $70,000 half, leaving each with $51,000 of taxable gifts applied against their own lifetime unified credit, and BOTH spouses must file Form 709 consenting to the election.
Gift-splitting is not available because Denise is not the biological or adoptive parent of the daughter receiving the gift.
qs.x:
【🚨 高频陷阱】① Gift-Splitting 必须双方共同在 Form 709 上同意，任何一方不同意则整个选举无效（不能只分摊一半而另一半不分摊）；② 分摊后消耗的是两个人各自独立的终身统一抵免额度，而不是"借用"配偶的免税额度后仍算在Harold一个人的额度上——这是常见的概念混淆点。

【第一步：Gift-Splitting 的资格条件 —— 与受赠人关系无关，只看赠与人婚姻状态】

  • Gift-Splitting（配偶赠与分摊选举）的唯一硬性条件是：赠与发生时，赠与人夫妻双方均为美国公民/居民且合法有效婚姻关系存续（不要求受赠人与非亲生父母一方有任何关系）。
  • 选项A、D的错误在于误以为"配偶与受赠人的亲属关系"会影响分摊资格——实际上这与 Gift-Splitting 完全无关，Denise 即使从未见过继女，只要她本人同意在 Form 709 上做出该选举，分摊照样有效。
【第二步：Gift-Splitting 的操作机制】
  • 一旦选举生效，无论实际现金是谁出的（本题现金可能全部来自 Harold 一人名下账户），税法上视同这笔 $140,000 赠与是夫妻双方各自赠与了一半，即 Harold 视为赠与 $70,000，Denise 视为赠与 $70,000。
  • 该选举不是自动生效的（选项B错误）——必须双方都在 Form 709 上签字同意，即使 Denise 自己名下没有任何实际赠与行为，只要选择split，她也必须提交（或至少共同签署）Form 709。
【第三步：分别适用各自的年度免税额与统一抵免】
  • Harold 一半：$70,000 − 年度免税额 $19,000 = $51,000 应税赠与，需消耗 Harold 自己的终身统一抵免额度（对应2026年 $15,000,000 exemption）。
  • Denise 一半：同样 $70,000 − $19,000 = $51,000 应税赠与，消耗 Denise 自己的终身统一抵免额度（与 Harold 的额度是各自独立的两套"账户"）。
  • 两人合计免税额度（$19,000×2=$38,000）恰好等于把单人年度免税额"翻倍"的效果——这正是 Gift-Splitting 最核心的筹划价值：让一方名下的赠与，能够"借用"配偶的年度免税额和终身抵免额度，翻倍降低应税赠与基数。
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：拆分赠与需夫妻双方共同签署 Form 709，各自扣除 $19,000 年免税额后独立消耗统一抵免额。
qs.tp: T03.3 配偶赠与分摊 Spousal-Gift-Splitting

qs.s: Harold gives $38,000 cash to his daughter this year (his only gift). Assume the annual exclusion is $19,000. He and his spouse want to use gift-splitting. Which is correct?
o: After splitting, each spouse is treated as giving $19,000, fully covered by each one's annual exclusion (no taxable gift), but Form 709 must still be filed to make the gift-splitting election, with the spouse's consent.
Without splitting, Harold owes gift tax on $19,000 immediately.
Gift-splitting is only allowed when the total gift exceeds $1,000,000.
No Form 709 is needed because the split gifts are fully covered by exclusions.
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题有应税赠与；本题展示"分摊恰好把应税赠与压到 $0"，但申报义务不消失。

【分摊后】每人 $19,000 − 年度免税额 $19,000 = $0 应税赠与

【但】选举 Gift-Splitting 本身必须通过 Form 709 完成（配偶同意）→ 即使没有应税赠与也要申报
【若不分摊】Harold 应税赠与 $19,000 → 消耗其终身统一抵免，不会立即缴税（选项B错）；选项D错在忽略了分摊选举本身必须通过 Form 709 完成

qs.s: Grandmother Ruth wants to help pay for her grandson's private university tuition of $58,000 for the year, on top of also giving him $19,000 in cash as an ordinary birthday gift (assume $19,000 is the current annual exclusion amount). Which payment structure allows Ruth to make BOTH transfers without using any of her lifetime unified credit or filing a taxable gift on Form 709 for either amount?
o: Ruth should pay the $58,000 tuition amount directly to the university (not reimbursing the grandson or paying him first), which qualifies for the unlimited educational exclusion regardless of amount, and separately give the $19,000 cash directly to the grandson, which is fully covered by the annual per-donee exclusion — neither payment uses any lifetime exemption.
The unlimited tuition exclusion only applies to graduate school tuition, not undergraduate tuition, so the $58,000 would be a taxable gift regardless of payment method.
Ruth should write a single combined check for $77,000 directly to her grandson, who will then forward the tuition portion to the university himself.
Both amounts must be gift-split with Ruth's spouse to avoid any taxable gift, regardless of how the tuition is paid.
qs.x:
【🚨 高频陷阱】"必须直接付给机构/医疗提供方"这一形式要件是本考点被设陷阱的核心——TCP 常在题干里安排"祖父母先把钱给了孩子，孩子再转付学费"这种看似无害、实则完全丧失免税资格的操作流程，一定要逐字核对资金流转路径中间是否"经过"了受赠人本人的账户。

【第一步：无限额学费排除（Unlimited Educational Exclusion, Sec.2503(e)）的关键操作要求】

  • 该排除额没有金额上限（不像年度免税额那样每年有固定数字封顶），但有一个极其严格的形式要求：款项必须由赠与人直接支付给教育机构（Directly to the Institution），不能先把钱给受赠人本人、再由受赠人自己去缴学费——哪怕受赠人拿到钱后100%如实转付给学校，只要资金流"经过"了受赠人的手，该笔款项就丧失无限额排除资格，转而需要正常计入年度赠与免税额度测算（选项C的操作方式正是这个致命错误）。
  • 且该排除仅限学费本身（Tuition），不含食宿、书本、杂费等其他教育相关支出（这些仍需正常计入年度免税额）。
  • 选项B错误：无限额学费排除不区分本科/研究生，只要是付给"合格教育机构"的学费即可，两者待遇相同。
【第二步：Ruth 应采用的正确操作路径】
  • 学费 $58,000：Ruth 应亲自开支票/转账直接付给大学财务处，指明用于孙子的学费——这样处理，无论金额多大，完全不占用任何年度免税额度，也不消耗Ruth的终身统一抵免额度，甚至不需要在 Form 709 上申报。
  • 现金礼物 $19,000：这是一笔独立的普通赠与，直接给孙子本人，恰好等于年度免税额度（题目假设值），同样不产生应税赠与、不需要动用终身抵免、也不需要申报 Form 709。
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：学费直接支付给高校可享无上限排除，另给孙子的 $19,000 现金完全由年度免税额覆盖，均不消耗终身免税额。

qs.s: Ruth pays her grandson's university directly: $58,000 tuition plus $16,000 for dormitory room and board. She also gives him $19,000 cash. Assume a $19,000 annual exclusion. What is Ruth's taxable gift?
o: $16,000 — tuition paid directly is excluded without limit, but room and board is not; the $16,000 plus $19,000 cash = $35,000 to the grandson, less one $19,000 annual exclusion.
$0 — all payments made directly to the school are excluded.

【Sec.2503(e) 范围】仅学费（Tuition）直付学校；食宿、书本、杂费不含

  • 学费 $58,000 → 无限额排除
  • 食宿 $16,000 + 现金 $19,000 = $35,000 → 共享一个年度免税额 $19,000
  • 应税赠与 = $16,000（消耗终身抵免，需申报 Form 709）
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：$16,000 — tuition paid directly is excluded without limit, but room and board is not; the $16,000 plus $19,000 cash = $35,000 to the grandson, less one $19,000 annual exclusion.

qs.s: Setting up a 5-year GRAT (Grantor Retained Annuity Trust), a grantor contributes $2,000,000 of appreciating stock and retains an annuity payable back to himself over the 5-year term, structured so that the present value of the retained annuity stream (calculated using the Sec. 7520 rate in effect at funding) equals approximately $1,998,000. Which statement correctly describes the gift tax consequence at the time the GRAT is funded, and the intended planning outcome?
o: The annuity payments received by the grantor during the term are taxed to the grantor as capital gain distributions from the trust, separate from any gift tax consequence.

This is a 'zeroed-out' GRAT: the taxable gift at funding is only about $2,000 (the small excess of the $2,000,000 funding value over the ~$1,998,000 present value of the retained annuity), and if the trust assets outperform the Sec. 7520 rate over the term, all of that excess appreciation passes to the remainder beneficiaries completely gift-tax-free when the annuity term ends.
GRATs eliminate estate tax exposure only if the grantor survives the annuity term by at least 10 additional years after the trust terminates.
The full $2,000,000 contributed to the trust is an immediate taxable gift to the remainder beneficiaries, since GRATs do not allow for any retained-interest valuation offset.
qs.x:
【🚨 高频陷阱】GRAT 的赠与税风险点在于：如果委托人在年金支付期结束之前身故，信托剩余资产通常会被拉回委托人的应税遗产（丧失原本想要实现的免税转移效果）——这是 TCP 筹划题里常见的"GRAT失败情形"考点，与本题"正常存续到期"的情形要区分开。

【第一步：GRAT 赠与税价值的计算原理】

  • 设立 GRAT 时的应税赠与金额 = 转入信托资产的价值 − 委托人保留的年金流的现值（Present Value of Retained Annuity，用当月 IRS 公布的 Sec.7520 利率 折现计算）。
  • "Zeroed-out GRAT"（归零型GRAT）是一种精算设计技巧：刻意把每年应付给委托人自己的年金金额设定得足够高，使得整个年金流的现值几乎等于转入信托的资产总额，从而使设立当下的应税赠与金额被压缩到接近于零（本题为约 $2,000，而非 $2,000,000）。
【第二步：GRAT 的套利逻辑 —— 与 Sec.7520 利率的赛跑】
  • 只要信托资产在存续期内的实际年化增值率跑赢了设立时锁定的 Sec.7520 利率，超出部分的增值就会在年金全部付完之后，作为剩余权益（Remainder Interest），100% 免赠与税地传给下一代受益人。
  • 本质上这是一种"押注资产跑赢法定折现率"的财富转移工具——委托人几乎不用花赠与税成本（因为设立时应税赠与已被压缩到接近$0），就能把资产未来的超额增值部分低成本甚至零成本地传给继承人。
【第三步：为什么选项A、C是错误的干扰项（选项D忽略了保留年金现值的扣减，见第一步）】
  • GRAT 与"委托人是否在信托终止后还能再多活10年"没有关系（选项C把 GRAT 和另一种遗产筹划工具——终身保单信托ILIT里"3年内死亡人寿保险仍计入遗产"的规则混淆了，两者是不同工具的不同规则）。
  • 委托人在存续期内收到的年金支付，本质上是他自己作为 Grantor Trust 的委托人，从自己控制的信托里"拿回"自己出资的本金和法定利息，不产生独立于赠与税分析之外的"资本利得分配"税务处理（Grantor Trust 在存续期内通常整体归属委托人本人申报，年金进出不构成新的应税事件）。
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：准确概括了 Zeroed-out GRAT 的赠与税压缩机制及其"跑赢7520利率即可免税转移超额增值"的核心套利逻辑。
qs.tp: T03.11.1 保留年金信托 Grantor-Retained-Annuity-Trust

qs.s: The grantor of the zeroed-out 5-year GRAT dies in Year 3, before the annuity term ends. What is the most likely estate tax consequence, and what technique reduces this risk?
o: The GRAT converts into a charitable remainder trust at death.
Only the Year 3 annuity payment is included in the estate.
Nothing is included in the estate, because the gift was already reported at funding.

All or a large portion of the GRAT assets (the amount needed to produce the retained annuity) is included in the grantor's gross estate under Sec. 2036, largely defeating the transfer; using shorter-term 'rolling' GRATs (e.g., 2-year GRATs) reduces mortality risk.
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题考"成功情形"；本题考"失败情形"与筹划补救。

【GRAT 的"死亡风险"】委托人在年金期内去世 → 保留年金权益 → Sec.2036 将信托资产（产生年金所需的部分，常常接近全部）拉回遗产

  • 设立时 GRAT 赠与额接近 $0，因此失败的"成本"仅为设立费用，没有额外赠与税损失（这是 GRAT 被称为"heads I win, tails I tie"的原因）
【对策】Rolling GRATs：连续设立短期（2 年）GRAT，把每期到期返还的年金再注入新 GRAT，降低"期内死亡"概率
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：All or a large portion of the GRAT assets (the amount needed to produce the retained annuity) is included in the grantor's gross estate under Sec. 2036, largely defeating the transfer; using shorter-term 'rolling' GRATs (e.g., 2-year GRATs) reduces mortality risk.
qs.tp: T03.11.1 保留年金信托 Grantor-Retained-Annuity-Trust

qs.s: Husband and wife (U.S. citizens, common-law state) own stock as joint tenants with right of survivorship. The husband paid the entire $100,000 cost. At his death the stock is worth $200,000. How much is included in his gross estate, and what is the widow's basis?
o: $0 included because joint property passes by operation of law.
$100,000 included (a qualified joint interest between spouses is 50% included regardless of who paid); widow's basis $150,000 ($50,000 carryover on her half + $100,000 stepped-up half).

【🚨 对比】共同财产州：两半都 Step-up（见 OWN-03）；非配偶 JTWROS：按出资比例计入（见 OWN-02）。

【Sec.2040(b) 夫妻 JTWROS（Qualified Joint Interest）】不论谁出资，一律按 50% 计入先死亡配偶的遗产

  • 计入 = $200,000 × 50% = $100,000（婚姻扣除抵消，通常无遗产税）
【在世配偶 Basis】
  • 死者一半：Step-up 至 $100,000
  • 自己一半：原 Basis $100,000 × 50% = $50,000（不变）
  • 合计 $150,000
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：$100,000 included (a qualified joint interest between spouses is 50% included regardless of who paid); widow's basis $150,000 ($50,000 carryover on her half + $100,000 stepped-up half).

qs.s: A father and his adult son own land as joint tenants with right of survivorship. The father paid 60% and the son paid 40% of the $100,000 cost. At the father's death the land is worth $200,000. How much is included in the father's gross estate, and what is the son's basis?
o: $120,000 included (60%, based on contribution); son's basis $160,000 ($40,000 own cost + $120,000 stepped-up portion).
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】"夫妻 50/50"规则只适用于配偶。

【Sec.2040(a) 非配偶 JTWROS】推定 100% 计入先死亡者遗产，除非在世者能证明其出资

  • 儿子证明出资 40% → 父亲遗产计入 60% × $200,000 = $120,000
  • 儿子 Basis = 自己出资 $40,000 + 计入遗产部分 $120,000 = $160,000
  • 若无法举证 → 100% 计入，Basis $200,000（遗产税更高，但 Basis 也更高）
【赠与问题】父亲出资 100% 设立与儿子的 JTWROS 银行账户，赠与在儿子提款时才成立；证券/不动产则在设立时即构成对另一半的赠与
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：$120,000 included (60%, based on contribution); son's basis $160,000 ($40,000 own cost + $120,000 stepped-up portion).

qs.s: Same stock (cost $100,000; FMV $200,000 at the husband's death), but the couple lives in a community property state and holds it as community property. What is the widow's basis in the entire stock position?
o: $200,000 — under Sec. 1014(b)(6), both halves of community property receive a basis adjustment to FMV at the first spouse's death, even though only half is included in the decedent's estate.
$150,000 — only the decedent's half is stepped up.

所有权形式计入遗产在世配偶 Basis

共同财产50%$200,000

qs.s: Paula wants her $3,000,000 of life insurance excluded from her estate. Option 1: transfer her existing policy to an irrevocable life insurance trust (ILIT). Option 2: have the ILIT trustee apply for and own a new policy from the outset. She will give the trust $57,000 per year for premiums; three beneficiaries hold Crummey withdrawal powers. Assume a $19,000 annual exclusion. Which statement is correct?
o: Option 1 is included in her estate if she dies within 3 years of the transfer (Sec. 2035); Option 2 avoids the 3-year rule because she never owned the policy. With three Crummey powers, the $57,000 annual premium gift qualifies for $57,000 of annual exclusions, so there is no taxable gift.
Both options exclude the proceeds immediately.
The proceeds are included in her estate under either option if she is the insured.
Premium gifts to a trust are future interests, so all $57,000 is a taxable gift regardless of Crummey powers.

【Sec.2035 三年规则】死者在死亡前 3 年内转让其所有的人寿保单（或放弃保单权利）→ 理赔金计入遗产

With three Crummey powers, the $57,000 annual premium gift qualifies for $57,000 of annual exclusions, so there is no taxable gift.

Trust B: income and principal may be spent for the grandson before age 21, and any remaining property passes to him at 21 (or to his estate if he dies earlier). Which transfer qualifies for the annual exclusion?

qs.t: 婚姻净值与合格终身权益
qs.s: Ed wants his surviving (second) wife to be supported for life, but wants the remaining property to pass to his children from his first marriage. His will leaves $5,000,000 to a trust paying all income to his wife at least annually for life, with no one able to appoint property to anyone other than her during her life; the remainder passes to his children. What is required for a marital deduction, and what are the consequences at her later death?
o: The marital deduction is automatic, and the property is never taxed in either estate.

Ed's executor must make a QTIP election on Ed's estate tax return; the $5,000,000 then qualifies for the marital deduction. At the wife's death, the trust property (at its then FMV) is included in HER gross estate under Sec. 2044, even though she cannot control where it goes.
No marital deduction is available because the wife's interest terminates at her death.
Only 50% of the trust qualifies for the marital deduction.

② 配偶生前任何人不得将财产指定给配偶以外的人
③ 死者遗嘱执行人在 Form 706 上选择 QTIP
→ 获得婚姻扣除（可部分选择）

Transfers to Luis qualify for the unlimited marital deduction like any other spouse.

【非美国公民配偶】防止财产免税转给配偶后离开美国税收管辖

  • 遗产：无限婚姻扣除须通过 QDOT（至少一名美国受托人；本金分配时征收递延的遗产税）
  • 赠与：无无限婚姻扣除 → 适用加强版年度免税额（远高于一般的年度免税额，按年调整，题目会给出）
  • QDOT 只是递延遗产税，本金分配或在世配偶死亡时仍需课征
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：The unlimited estate tax marital deduction is available only if property passes to a Qualified Domestic Trust (QDOT) (or Luis becomes a citizen before the return is filed); lifetime gifts to Luis are not eligible for the unlimited gift tax marital deduction but qualify for an enhanced annual exclusion that is much higher than the regular per-donee exclusion.

qs.s: Under his mother's will, Sam inherits $1,000,000; if Sam disclaims, it passes to Sam's children. Sam has a large estate and would prefer the property go directly to his children. He has not accepted any benefits from it. What must Sam do so that his refusal is NOT treated as a taxable gift?
o: Simply direct the executor to give the property to his children at any time.

Make a qualified disclaimer: an irrevocable, written refusal delivered within 9 months of the transfer (the mother's death), before accepting any benefits, with the property passing without any direction by Sam to someone else. The property is then treated as passing directly from his mother (note: a transfer to grandchildren may have GST consequences in the mother's estate).
Accept the inheritance and then gift it; the annual exclusion covers the entire amount.
Disclaimers are never effective for federal tax purposes.
qs.x:
【🚨 筹划】"事后调整"工具：例如让部分遗产通过放弃流入 Credit Shelter Trust；但转给孙辈会被视为母亲对跳代人的转移 → 需在母亲遗产中分配 GST 免除额。

【Sec.2518 合格放弃继承要件】
① 书面、不可撤销
② 在转让发生（本题为母亲死亡）后 9 个月内送达（或受让人满 21 岁后 9 个月内）
③ 未接受任何利益（含收取收入）
④ 财产不经放弃人指示，转给放弃人以外的人（配偶放弃例外：可转入配偶仍受益的信托）
→ 视为放弃人从未取得 → 不构成赠与

【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：Make a qualified disclaimer: an irrevocable, written refusal delivered within 9 months of the transfer (the mother's death), before accepting any benefits, with the property passing without any direction by Sam to someone else. The property is then treated as passing directly from his mother (note: a transfer to grandchildren may have GST consequences in the mother's estate).
qs.tp: T03.10.3 合格放弃继承 Qualified-Disclaimer-Requirements

qs.s: Grandma gives $1,000,000 outright to her grandson. Case 1: the grandson's parent (Grandma's child) is alive. Case 2: the grandson's parent died before the gift. Assume Grandma has fully used her GST exemption and has already used her annual exclusion for the grandson this year and the GST rate is 40%. What are the GST consequences?
o: Case 1 and Case 2: $400,000 of GST tax each.
Case 1: the grandson pays the GST tax out of the $1,000,000.
No GST tax in either case, because the gift tax already applies.

Case 1: a direct skip; Grandma owes GST tax of $400,000 (40% of the amount received — tax-exclusive), and the GST tax she pays is itself treated as an additional taxable gift. Case 2: the predeceased parent rule moves the grandson up a generation, so there is no skip and no GST tax.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】GST 与赠与税同时适用、不互相替代；直接转给孙辈的学费/医疗费直付（2503(e)）同样免 GST。

【GST 三类应税事件】

类型情形纳税人计税方式
Direct Skip直接转给跳代人转让人Tax-exclusive（按受让人实际收到额）
Taxable Distribution信托向跳代人分配受让人Tax-inclusive
Taxable Termination非跳代人权益终止，信托全归跳代人受托人Tax-inclusive
【Case 1】GST 税 = 40% × $1,000,000 = $400,000（本题假设年度免税额已用完；否则 $19,000 部分 inclusion ratio 为 0，GST = 40% × $981,000 = $392,400）；Grandma 缴纳的 GST 税另视为额外赠与（Sec.2515）
【Case 2：已故父母例外（Sec.2651(e)）】孙子的父母在转让时已去世 → 孙子"上移一代" → 不是跳代人 → 无 GST
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：Case 1: a direct skip; Grandma owes GST tax of $400,000 (40% of the amount received — tax-exclusive), and the GST tax she pays is itself treated as an additional taxable gift. Case 2: the predeceased parent rule moves the grandson up a generation, so there is no skip and no GST tax.
qs.tp: T03.13.1 跳代事件与税率 GST-Events-Inclusion-Ratio

qs.s: Dad funds a dynasty trust for his children and grandchildren with $2,000,000 and allocates $1,000,000 of GST exemption to it. Years later, the trust distributes $100,000 to a grandchild (a taxable distribution). Assume the maximum estate tax rate is 40%. What is the GST tax?
o: $0 — any allocation of exemption makes the trust fully exempt.

$20,000 — applicable fraction $1,000,000/$2,000,000 = 0.5; inclusion ratio 1 − 0.5 = 0.5; applicable rate 40% × 0.5 = 20%; tax on a taxable distribution is computed on the amount distributed and is paid by the transferee.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】Inclusion Ratio 在设立时锁定——之后信托增值不会稀释免税比例（这正是尽早足额分配的价值）。

【公式】

  • Applicable Fraction = 分配的 GST 免除额 ÷ 转入信托的价值 = 1,000,000 ÷ 2,000,000 = 0.5
  • Inclusion Ratio = 1 − 0.5 = 0.5
  • 适用税率 = 最高遗产税率 40% × 0.5 = 20%
  • Taxable Distribution：$100,000 × 20% = $20,000，由受让人承担（Tax-inclusive）
【筹划】Dynasty Trust 设立时分配足额免除额 → Inclusion Ratio = 0 → 未来所有增值与分配永久免 GST；混合比例的信托可在设立时拆分为 0 和 1 两个信托，便于管理
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：$20,000 — applicable fraction $1,000,000/$2,000,000 = 0.5; inclusion ratio 1 − 0.5 = 0.5; applicable rate 40% × 0.5 = 20%; tax on a taxable distribution is computed on the amount distributed and is paid by the transferee.
qs.tp: T03.13.1 跳代事件与税率 GST-Events-Inclusion-Ratio

qs.s: Ines transfers her $1,000,000 vacation home to a 10-year QPRT, retaining the right to live there for 10 years, after which it passes to her children. The actuarial value of her retained interest is $400,000. Which statement is correct?
o: The children receive a stepped-up basis at the end of the term.

The taxable gift is $600,000 (the remainder). If she survives the 10-year term, the home and all its future appreciation are excluded from her estate; if she dies during the term, the home is included under Sec. 2036. After the term, she must pay fair rent to keep using it, and the children take a carryover basis (no step-up).
The taxable gift is $1,000,000, and the home is excluded from her estate whether or not she survives the term.
qs.x:
【🚨 权衡】期限越长 → 赠与额越小，但期内死亡风险越高；与 GRAT 相同的"须存活至期满"逻辑。

【QPRT 机制】赠与额 = FMV − 保留权益现值 = $1,000,000 − $400,000 = $600,000（Sec.2702 允许以保留权益抵减）

  • 存活至期满 → 房屋及增值移出遗产（冻结价值于 $600,000）
  • 期内死亡 → 全部计入遗产（2036），已使用的免除额恢复
  • 期满后继续居住 → 须按市场租金支付（租金又进一步转移财富）
  • 子女 Basis 为 Carryover（放弃了 Step-up）
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：The taxable gift is $600,000 (the remainder). If she survives the 10-year term, the home and all its future appreciation are excluded from her estate; if she dies during the term, the home is included under Sec. 2036. After the term, she must pay fair rent to keep using it, and the children take a carryover basis (no step-up).

qs.s: Jon sells stock (FMV $200,000, basis $100,000) to an intentionally defective grantor trust (IDGT) for a $200,000 note bearing interest at the AFR. What are the income tax and estate planning results?
o: The stock is included in Jon's estate at its date-of-death value.
Jon recognizes $100,000 gain; the trust's basis is $200,000.
The sale is a taxable gift of $200,000.

Jon recognizes no gain and no interest income, because a sale to his own grantor trust is disregarded for income tax purposes; the trust takes a $100,000 carryover basis. For estate purposes, the note ($200,000 plus unpaid interest) stays in his estate, but appreciation above the AFR shifts to the trust beneficiaries, and his paying the trust's income tax further reduces his estate.
qs.x:
【🚨 对比 GRAT】IDGT 出售可做 GST 免税（可分配 GST 免除额到种子赠与），GRAT 在期满前不能有效分配 GST 免除额。

【所得税】IDGT 在所得税上视为委托人本人 → 自己与自己交易 → 不确认 Gain、不确认利息（Rev. Rul. 85-13）

  • 信托 Basis = Carryover $100,000（无 Step-up，是主要代价）
【遗产税】信托为不可撤销、委托人未保留 2036/2038 权利 → 资产在遗产外；遗产中仅有本票（价值冻结在 $200,000 + 利息）
  • 资产收益率 > AFR 的部分 → 免税转移
  • 委托人代缴信托所得税 → 额外"免税赠与"
【实务】通常先赠与信托约 10% 的"种子资金"，以支持信托的偿债能力
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：Jon recognizes no gain and no interest income, because a sale to his own grantor trust is disregarded for income tax purposes; the trust takes a $100,000 carryover basis. For estate purposes, the note ($200,000 plus unpaid interest) stays in his estate, but appreciation above the AFR shifts to the trust beneficiaries, and his paying the trust's income tax further reduces his estate.

qs.s: Kim contributes $1,000,000 of marketable securities to a family limited partnership and gifts a 40% limited partnership interest to her children. An appraiser applies a combined 30% discount for lack of control and lack of marketability. What is the value of the gift, and what is the principal risk?
o: $400,000, because discounts apply only to operating businesses.
$400,000; there is no risk because the partnership is respected.

$280,000 ($400,000 pro rata × (1 − 30%)); the principal risk is that the IRS includes the FLP assets in Kim's estate under Sec. 2036 if she retains enjoyment (e.g., uses partnership funds personally, commingles assets, or contributes nearly all her assets without a legitimate non-tax business purpose).
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】折价只影响估值，不是"免税"；仅持有可交易证券的 FLP 更容易受到质疑。

【折价计算】

  • 按比例价值 = 40% × $1,000,000 = $400,000
  • 缺乏控制权（LP 无管理权）+ 缺乏流通性 → 合计折价 30%
  • 赠与价值 = $400,000 × 70% = $280,000
【Sec.2036 风险（Strangi 等案例）】保留资产的享用或控制 → 转出的资产按未折价全额拉回遗产
  • 防范：合法的非税目的（集中管理、债权人保护）、保留足够的个人资产、按合伙协议分配、严格遵守合伙形式
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：$280,000 ($400,000 pro rata × (1 − 30%)); the principal risk is that the IRS includes the FLP assets in Kim's estate under Sec. 2036 if she retains enjoyment (e.g., uses partnership funds personally, commingles assets, or contributes nearly all her assets without a legitimate non-tax business purpose).
