qs.s: Tia is a sole proprietor with no employees. Her net Schedule C profit is $200,000, and assume her deduction for one-half of self-employment tax is $14,000. What is her maximum SEP-IRA contribution (assume it is below the overall annual limit)?
o: $37,200 (20% of $186,000 net earnings after the half-SE-tax deduction)
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】直接用 25% × 净利润（选项B、C）是最常见的错误。

【自雇者的 SEP 上限】计划文件的 25% 是以"扣除供款后的净收益"为基数 → 换算为扣除供款前的有效比例 20%

  • 净自雇收益 = $200,000 − 半数 SE 税 $14,000 = $186,000
  • 上限 = 20% × $186,000 = $37,200（不超过当年总供款上限）
  • 验算：$37,200 ÷ ($186,000 − $37,200) = 25% ✔
【员工】若有合格员工，雇主须为其按相同比例供款（按 W-2 工资的 25%）
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：$37,200 (20% of $186,000 net earnings after the half-SE-tax deduction)
qs.tp: T04.1.6 小企业退休计划 Small-Business-Retirement-Plans

qs.s: Uma, age 45, is self-employed with no employees. Her net earnings from self-employment after the half-SE-tax deduction are $100,000. Assume an elective deferral limit of $24,500 and an overall defined contribution limit of $72,000. Which plan permits the largest contribution, and how much?
o: Solo 401(k): $44,500 — $24,500 employee elective deferral plus $20,000 employer profit-sharing contribution (20% × $100,000)
qs.x:
【🚨 筹划】有员工时，Solo 401(k) 不再适用；SEP 需为员工按同一比例供款，SIMPLE 只需 3% 配比 → 员工多、老板想多存时常选普通 401(k) + Safe Harbor。
计划构成Uma 上限
SEP仅雇主部分 20%$20,000
Solo 401(k)员工递延 $24,500（可 Roth）+ 雇主 20%$44,500
SIMPLE IRA员工递延（上限较低）+ 雇主 3% 配比或 2% 非选择性供款远低于 Solo 401(k)
  • 收入越低，Solo 401(k) 的"员工递延"部分相对优势越大
  • SIMPLE：雇员 ≤100 人、不得同时维持其他计划；参加前 2 年提取罚金为 25%
  • SEP：必须覆盖满足条件的员工，管理最简单，可在申报截止日（含延期）前设立并供款
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：Solo 401(k): $44,500 — $24,500 employee elective deferral plus $20,000 employer profit-sharing contribution (20% × $100,000)
qs.tp: T04.1.6 小企业退休计划 Small-Business-Retirement-Plans

qs.s: Kay (age 45, not disabled or chronically ill) inherits her father's Traditional IRA. Her father died at age 80, after his required beginning date. Which distribution rule applies to Kay?
o: The 10-year rule applies: the account must be fully distributed by the end of the 10th year after death, AND because her father died after his required beginning date, she must also take annual RMDs in years 1–9.
She must take the entire balance within 5 years.
She may stretch distributions over her own life expectancy.
No distributions are required until year 10.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】死者在 RBD 之前去世 → 10 年内任意时间领取均可（第 1–9 年无年度 RMD 要求）。继承 IRA 提取无 10% 罚金（死亡例外）。

【SECURE Act 受益人分类】

  • 合格指定受益人（EDB）：配偶、死者未成年子女（至 21 岁）、残疾、慢性病、年龄比死者小不超过 10 岁 → 可按寿命期分期
  • 非 EDB 指定受益人（如成年子女 Kay）→ 10 年规则
  • 非指定受益人（遗产、部分信托）→ 死者在 RBD 前去世为 5 年规则；RBD 后按死者剩余寿命期
【最终法规】死者在 RBD 之后去世 → 10 年规则受益人在第 1–9 年还须每年领取 RMD，第 10 年领完
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：The 10-year rule applies: the account must be fully distributed by the end of the 10th year after death, AND because her father died after his required beginning date, she must also take annual RMDs in years 1–9.
qs.tp: T04.1.13 继承退休账户 Inherited-IRA-Beneficiaries

qs.s: Lin, age 40, inherits her late husband's $300,000 Traditional IRA. She will need about $30,000 per year from it for the next several years. Which choice is generally better, and why?
o: There is no difference between the two options.
Roll it into her own IRA, because spousal rollovers always minimize taxes.
Cash out the IRA immediately to avoid future RMDs.

Keep it as an inherited (beneficiary) IRA for now: distributions to a beneficiary are exempt from the 10% early-distribution tax, whereas if she treats it as her own IRA, withdrawals before age 59½ are subject to the 10% additional tax. She can still elect to treat it as her own later.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】配偶是 EDB，不受 10 年规则限制。

【配偶受益人的选择】

视为自己的 IRA（Rollover）保留为继承 IRA
59½ 前提取10% 罚金无罚金（死亡例外）
RMD 起始按自己的年龄（73/75 岁）可推迟到死者本应开始 RMD 之时
适合年龄较大、不需要资金年轻、需要现金
  • 可以先保留为继承 IRA，满 59½ 后再转为自己的 IRA
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：Keep it as an inherited (beneficiary) IRA for now: distributions to a beneficiary are exempt from the 10% early-distribution tax, whereas if she treats it as her own IRA, withdrawals before age 59½ are subject to the 10% additional tax. She can still elect to treat it as her own later.
qs.tp: T04.1.14 配偶继承选择 Spousal-IRA-Inheritance-Choices

qs.s: Which statement about the 10% additional tax on early distributions is correct?
o: The 'separation from service at age 55' exception applies to both IRAs and 401(k)s.

The first-time homebuyer ($10,000 lifetime) and higher-education exceptions apply only to IRAs; the age-55 separation exception applies only to qualified plans; and if a taxpayer modifies a Sec. 72(t) series of substantially equal periodic payments before the later of 5 years or age 59½, the 10% tax is recaptured on all prior payments, plus interest.
The first-time homebuyer exception applies to 401(k) plans with no dollar limit.
Substantially equal periodic payments can be stopped at any time without consequence.
qs.x:
【🚨 筹划】离职时 55–59 岁的员工，若需现金，应从 401(k) 直接取，先不要转入 IRA。

【10% 罚金例外——IRA 与合格计划不对称】

例外IRA401(k) 等合格计划
55 岁（公共安全人员 50 岁）后离职✘✔
首次购房（终身 $10,000）✔✘
高等教育费用✔✘
失业期间的健康保险费✔✘
QDRO✘✔
死亡、残疾、超过 7.5% AGI 的医疗费、生育/领养（$5,000）、72(t) SEPP✔✔
【72(t) SEPP】需持续至 5 年与 59½ 孰晚；提前修改 → 回溯对全部已领取额征收 10% + 利息
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：The first-time homebuyer ($10,000 lifetime) and higher-education exceptions apply only to IRAs; the age-55 separation exception applies only to qualified plans; and if a taxpayer modifies a Sec. 72(t) series of substantially equal periodic payments before the later of 5 years or age 59½, the 10% tax is recaptured on all prior payments, plus interest.
qs.tp: T04.1.9 提前提取例外 Early-Distribution-Exceptions

qs.s: Max (age 45) leaves his job and has his $100,000 401(k) balance paid directly to him. The plan withholds 20%, so he receives $80,000. Within 60 days he deposits the $80,000 into an IRA. What are the consequences?
o: $100,000 is taxable because he took possession of the funds.

$20,000 is a taxable distribution (the withheld amount he did not replace), subject to the 10% additional tax; the $20,000 withheld is credited against his tax. To avoid this, he would have had to deposit $100,000 (using other funds) or use a direct trustee-to-trustee rollover.
No tax — he rolled over everything he received.
$80,000 is taxable because indirect rollovers are not allowed from 401(k) plans.
qs.x:
【🚨 筹划】永远优先选直接 Rollover（Direct Rollover），避免 20% 预扣与 60 天风险。
  • 合格计划支付给个人的可 Rollover 分配 → 强制预扣 20%
  • 60 天内须存入全额 $100,000 才能完全免税；只存 $80,000 → $20,000 视为分配：计入收入 + 10% 罚金（45 岁、非 55 岁后离职）
  • 预扣的 $20,000 可抵减当年税款
【IRA 间接 Rollover】IRA→IRA 的 60 天间接 Rollover 每 12 个月限一次（按人计算，跨所有 IRA）；受托人对受托人直接转账不受限、不预扣
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：$20,000 is a taxable distribution (the withheld amount he did not replace), subject to the 10% additional tax; the $20,000 withheld is credited against his tax. To avoid this, he would have had to deposit $100,000 (using other funds) or use a direct trustee-to-trustee rollover.
qs.tp: T04.1.11 滚存预扣与期限 Rollover-Withholding-Deadline

qs.s: Ned paid $100,000 for a nonqualified single-life annuity that pays $10,000 per year. His expected return (payments × life expectancy) is $200,000. What portion of each payment is taxable, and what happens after he has recovered his investment?
o: $5,000 taxable each year for life, even after full recovery.

$5,000 taxable each year (exclusion ratio 50%) until he has recovered his $100,000 investment; after that, each full payment is taxable. If he dies before full recovery, the unrecovered investment is deductible on his final return.
$10,000 taxable each year from the start.
$0 taxable until he has recovered $100,000, then fully taxable.
qs.x:
【🚨 对比】年金化之前的部分提取：递延年金适用 LIFO（收益先出、应税），59½ 前另加 10% 罚金。

【Sec.72 排除比例】= 投资额 ÷ 预期回报 = $100,000 ÷ $200,000 = 50%

  • 每年 $10,000 × 50% = $5,000 免税（Basis 回收），$5,000 应税
  • 1986 年后开始的年金：免税总额以投资额为限 → 超过预期寿命继续领取时全额应税
  • 提前死亡：未回收的投资额在最终申报表上扣除
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：$5,000 taxable each year (exclusion ratio 50%) until he has recovered his $100,000 investment; after that, each full payment is taxable. If he dies before full recovery, the unrecovered investment is deductible on his final return.
qs.tp: T04.1.17 年金排除比例 Annuity-Exclusion-Ratio

qs.s: Oscar (age 50) paid $100,000 of premiums into a life insurance policy that failed the 7-pay test (a MEC). Its cash value is $200,000. He borrows $30,000 against it. What are the tax consequences, and which 1035 exchange would NOT be tax-free?
o: MEC status affects only the death benefit's taxability.
The loan is tax-free, as with any life insurance policy; all 1035 exchanges are tax-free.

Because the policy is a MEC, loans and withdrawals come out gain-first (LIFO): the $30,000 loan is taxable ordinary income and, since he is under 59½, also subject to a 10% additional tax. Under Sec. 1035, life-to-life, life-to-annuity, and annuity-to-annuity exchanges are tax-free, but an annuity-to-life exchange is not.
The loan is taxable only to the extent it exceeds his $100,000 basis.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】1035 交换中收到现金 Boot → 在 Gain 范围内应税。

【MEC（修正的储蓄保险合同）】保费缴得太快、未通过 7-pay 测试

  • 保单贷款/提取按 LIFO：先出收益（$100,000 收益 > $30,000）→ $30,000 应税 + 10% 罚金（<59½）
  • 死亡理赔仍免税
  • 普通（非 MEC）保单：提取按 FIFO（先回收 Basis），贷款不应税
【Sec.1035 免税交换】

✔ 人寿 → 人寿 ✔ 人寿 → 年金 ✔ 年金 → 年金 ✔ 人寿/年金 → 合格长期护理保险
✘ 年金 → 人寿（否则可把递延收益转成免税理赔）

【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：Because the policy is a MEC, loans and withdrawals come out gain-first (LIFO): the $30,000 loan is taxable ordinary income and, since he is under 59½, also subject to a 10% additional tax. Under Sec. 1035, life-to-life, life-to-annuity, and annuity-to-annuity exchanges are tax-free, but an annuity-to-life exchange is not.
qs.tp: T04.4.3 保单贷款与免税交换 MEC-Loans-Insurance-Exchanges

qs.s: Ivy (single, itemizes) paid $30,000 of margin interest to buy growth stocks. Her investment income: taxable interest $8,000, nonqualified dividends $4,000, qualified dividends $10,000, and net long-term capital gain $20,000. She also paid $2,000 of investment advisory fees. How much investment interest can she deduct without any election, and what is the minimum amount of qualified dividends/net capital gain she must elect to treat as investment income to deduct all $30,000?
o: Deduct $42,000; the excess creates a deductible loss.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】"投资费用减少 NII"的旧规则只在该费用可扣除时适用——TCJA/OBBBA 后投资顾问费不可扣，因此不再减少 NII。

【Sec.163(d)】投资利息扣除以净投资收益（NII）为限

  • NII = 利息 $8,000 + 非合格股息 $4,000 = $12,000
  • 投资顾问费属于杂项逐项扣除，已不可扣除 → 不减少 NII（选项B错）
  • 合格股息与净资本利得默认不计入 NII
  • 无选择：扣除 $12,000，其余 $18,000 无限期结转
  • 若选择把 $18,000 的合格股息/LTCG 计入 NII → 可扣满 $30,000，但这 $18,000 失去优惠税率
【干扰项】选项A 忽略限制；选项D 投资利息不能产生亏损
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：NII 只有 $12,000，可直接扣 $12,000；需选择把 $18,000 合格股息/LTCG 计入投资收益才能扣满。
qs.tp: T04.3.5 投资利息与选择 Investment-Interest-Election

qs.s: Which interest expense is investment interest subject to the Sec. 163(d) limitation?
o: Interest on a loan used to buy tax-exempt municipal bonds.
Margin interest on a loan used to buy publicly traded stock held for investment.
Interest on a loan used to buy a limited partnership interest in a rental real estate activity (a passive activity).
Interest on acquisition debt secured by the taxpayer's principal residence.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】看的是借款用途而不是抵押品——用房屋做抵押借款买股票，利息仍是投资利息。

【利息按资金用途追踪（Reg. §1.163-8T）】

  • B：买入投资用股票 → 投资利息，受 163(d) 限制
  • A：购买免税债券的借款利息 → Sec.265 永久不可扣除
  • C：用于被动活动 → 计入该被动活动的损益，受 PAL 规则约束
  • D：合格住宅利息 → Schedule A 住宅利息规则
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：只有用于购买投资资产（如股票）的借款利息属于 163(d) 投资利息。
qs.tp: T04.3.5 投资利息与选择 Investment-Interest-Election

qs.s: Which statement about the Sec. 163(d) election to treat qualified dividends and net capital gain as investment income is correct?
o: The election applies automatically whenever investment interest exceeds net investment income.
Elected amounts continue to be taxed at the 0%/15%/20% preferential rates.
Disallowed investment interest expires after 5 years, so the election should always be made.

The election is made annually on Form 4952; elected qualified dividends and net capital gain lose preferential rates and are taxed at ordinary rates; disallowed investment interest carries forward indefinitely, so electing is usually worthwhile only if the current ordinary-rate deduction outweighs the lost preferential rate and the carryforward is unlikely to be used soon.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】投资利息属于逐项扣除；使用标准扣除的年度无法从中受益。

【选择的性质】

  • 每年在 Form 4952 上主动选择（选项A错）
  • 被选择的部分按普通税率课税（选项B错）
  • 未扣除的投资利息无限期结转（选项C错）
【权衡】32% 税率者：多扣 $1 投资利息省 $0.32，但 $1 合格股息从 15% 变 32% 多缴 $0.17 → 当期净省 $0.15；若未来几年有足够的普通投资收入吸收结转，则不选择、保留结转往往更优
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：选择每年在 Form 4952 上做出，被选择的股息/利得改按普通税率，而未扣除部分可无限期结转——需比较税率差决定是否选择。
qs.tp: T04.3.5 投资利息与选择 Investment-Interest-Election

qs.s: Which statement about Trump Accounts under Sec. 530A is correct?
o: Parents may deduct up to $5,000 of contributions each year.

Contributions are limited to $5,000 per child per year (indexed after 2027), of which an employer may contribute up to $2,500 excludable from the employee's income; a one-time $1,000 federal pilot contribution is available for eligible U.S.-citizen children born in 2025 through 2028 and does not count toward the limit; the account is generally invested in low-cost U.S. equity index funds, and after the child reaches age 18 it is treated much like a traditional IRA.
Account balances may be withdrawn tax-free at any age to pay for college.
The $1,000 pilot contribution is available to any child under 18.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】Trump Account 与 529 不同：不是教育专用，提取也不免税；家长供款没有扣除，但账户内增值递延。

【Sec.530A 要点（OBBBA 新设，2026/7/4 起可供款）】

  • 对象：未满 18 岁的儿童（须有 SSN）；账户以儿童名义设立，由父母/监护人管理
  • 年度供款上限 $5,000/每名儿童（2027 年后按通胀调整）；家长、亲友供款不可扣除（选项A错）
  • 雇主供款每名员工最多 $2,500 可从员工收入中排除（Sec.128）
  • $1,000 联邦试点供款：2025–2028 年出生、符合条件的美国公民儿童（选项D错），不计入 $5,000 上限
  • 投资：低成本美国股票指数基金等合格投资
  • 儿童满 18 岁当年之前一般不得提取；之后基本按传统 IRA 规则（收益部分提取时应税，不是免税，选项C错）
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：年度 $5,000 上限（其中雇主可免税供款 $2,500），2025–2028 年出生儿童另有 $1,000 联邦试点供款，满 18 岁后基本按传统 IRA 规则。
qs.tp: T04.6.1 儿童长期投资账户 Trump-Account-Planning

qs.s: Beginning in 2026, which arrangement does NOT prevent an individual from contributing to an HSA?
o: Coverage under a general-purpose health FSA.
Coverage under a bronze-level or catastrophic plan purchased on an ACA exchange, or a direct primary care arrangement with fees of no more than $150 per month for individual coverage.
Being claimed as a dependent on another person's return.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】65 岁领取社保会自动加入 Medicare Part A，且可追溯至多 6 个月——临近 65 岁的人要提前停止 HSA 供款。

【OBBBA 自 2026 年起的 HSA 扩展】

  • ACA 交易所的 bronze 与 catastrophic 计划视为 HSA 兼容的 HDHP
  • 直接初级医疗（DPC）安排：月费 ≤ $150（个人）/ $300（家庭）→ 不影响 HSA 资格，且可用 HSA 支付月费
  • 远程医疗（telehealth）免于影响资格的安全港永久化
【仍然导致不能供款】
  • A：通用型医疗 FSA（属于"其他非 HDHP 保障"）
  • B：参加 Medicare（包括 Part A）
  • D：可被他人申报为受养人
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：2026 年起 bronze/catastrophic 计划与月费不超过 $150 的 DPC 安排不影响 HSA 资格。
qs.tp: T04.6.2 医疗储蓄资格变化 HSA-Eligibility-Expansion

qs.s: Dr. Chen, age 58, is the sole owner and only employee of a profitable professional corporation and wants to shelter as much income as possible for retirement over the next 7 years. Which statement is correct?
o: A defined contribution plan allows unlimited employer contributions if the owner is over 50.

A defined benefit (or cash balance) plan limits the annual BENEFIT at retirement (the Sec. 415(b) limit, $290,000 for 2026) rather than the annual contribution, so for an older owner the actuarially required deductible contributions can far exceed the $72,000 Sec. 415(c) defined contribution limit; in exchange, the employer bears the investment risk and must make minimum required contributions.
Defined benefit plans shift investment risk to the employee.
Defined benefit plans cannot be combined with a 401(k) plan.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】现金余额计划是 DB 的一种，按"假想个人账户"表述，对年长高收入业主是最大化税前储蓄的常用工具。

【DB vs DC】

固定收益（DB）/ 现金余额计划固定供款（DC，如 401(k)、利润分享）
限制对象退休时的年给付（415(b)：2026 年 $290,000）年度供款（415(c)：2026 年 $72,000，不含追加供款）
年长业主的供款空间精算决定，距退休越近越大 → 可远超 $72,000固定上限
投资风险雇主员工
强制最低供款有（资金不足须补缴）无（利润分享可自由决定）
管理成本精算、PBGC（部分专业服务公司豁免）较低
  • DB/现金余额计划可与 401(k) 并存（常见组合），须满足扣除与非歧视测试（选项D错）
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：DB/现金余额计划限制的是退休给付而非年度供款，年长业主的精算供款可远超 DC 的 $72,000 上限，但雇主承担投资风险与强制供款义务。
qs.tp: T04.1.7 确定给付与现金余额 Defined-Benefit-Cash-Balance

qs.s: Nia, age 52, works for a state university that offers both a 403(b) plan and a governmental 457(b) plan. Which statement is correct?
o: Her 403(b) and 457(b) deferrals share a single $24,500 limit.
Distributions from the governmental 457(b) plan before age 59½ after separation from service are subject to the 10% additional tax.
A non-governmental (top-hat) 457(b) plan's assets are held in trust for employees and may be rolled over to an IRA.

She may defer up to $24,500 to EACH plan (plus age-50 catch-ups), because the 457(b) limit is separate from the 402(g) limit; distributions from the governmental 457(b) after separation are not subject to the 10% early-distribution tax (except amounts rolled in from other plans); and in the last 3 years before normal retirement age she may use the special 457(b) catch-up instead of the age-50 catch-up.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】政府雇员提前退休时，政府 457(b) 是 59½ 岁前取钱最灵活的账户——不应轻易转入 IRA（转入后会受 10% 罚金约束）。

【457(b) 特点】

  • 限额独立于 401(k)/403(b) 的 402(g) 限额 → 可同时各存 $24,500（"double up"），各自加 50+ 追加（选项A错）
  • 政府 457(b)：离职后提取不适用 10% 提前提取罚金（从其他计划转入的部分除外）（选项B错）
  • 特别追加：正常退休年龄前 3 年可补存以前未用额度，最多 2 × 年度限额；与 50+ 追加二选一取较大
  • 非政府（免税组织的 top-hat）457(b)：资产属雇主、受雇主债权人追索；不能 rollover 到 IRA（选项C错）
【2026 年】50+ 追加：政府 457(b) 与 403(b) 均为 $8,000；上年 FICA 工资 > $150,000 者追加须为 Roth
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：457(b) 限额独立，可与 403(b) 各存 $24,500；政府 457(b) 离职后提取不受 10% 罚金，且有退休前 3 年的特别追加。
qs.tp: T04.1.15 政府递延补偿计划 Governmental-Deferred-Compensation-Plans

qs.s: Which statement about designated Roth accounts in a 401(k) plan is correct beginning in 2024?
o: Roth 401(k) accounts are subject to lifetime RMDs starting at age 73, while Roth IRAs are not.
Roth 401(k) contributions are subject to the same income limits as Roth IRA contributions.

Designated Roth accounts are no longer subject to lifetime (pre-death) RMDs, matching Roth IRAs; a qualified distribution still requires 5 taxable years since the first Roth contribution to that plan and age 59½, death, or disability; and a Roth 401(k) may be rolled to a Roth IRA, where the Roth IRA's own 5-year clock applies.
Employer matching contributions can never be made as Roth contributions.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】即使暂不需要，也可以早早开一个小额 Roth IRA 启动其 5 年时钟，便于日后 Roth 401(k) 转入后立即取得合格分配。

【SECURE 2.0】

  • 自 2024 年起，401(k)/403(b)/政府 457(b) 中的指定 Roth 账户不再有生前 RMD（选项A错）；死后受益人规则仍适用
  • 自 2023 年起，雇主可允许员工选择把配比/非选择性供款作为 Roth（计入员工当年收入）（选项D错）
【其他】
  • Roth 401(k) 没有收入限制（选项B错）；限额与税前 401(k) 共享 $24,500
  • 合格分配：该计划首次 Roth 供款起满 5 个纳税年度 + 59½/死亡/残疾
  • 转入 Roth IRA 后，适用 Roth IRA 自身的 5 年时钟（若从未有 Roth IRA，会从头起算）
  • 上年 FICA 工资 > $150,000（2026 年适用于 2025 年工资）者，追加供款必须为 Roth
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：2024 年起 Roth 401(k) 不再有生前 RMD；合格分配仍需满 5 年并满 59½ 等条件；可转入 Roth IRA，适用 Roth IRA 自身的 5 年时钟。
qs.tp: T04.1.16 指定罗斯计划账户 Designated-Roth-Plan-Accounts

qs.s: Leo, age 61, earned $200,000 of FICA wages from his employer in 2025. His employer's 401(k) plan offers both pre-tax and Roth deferrals. What is the maximum he may defer for 2026, and how must the catch-up portion be made?
o: $24,500 pre-tax plus an $8,000 catch-up, which may be pre-tax.

$24,500 (pre-tax or Roth) plus an $11,250 catch-up that must be designated Roth, because his prior-year FICA wages exceeded $150,000; if the plan did not offer Roth, he could not make catch-up contributions.
$35,750, all of which must be Roth.
$24,500; catch-up contributions are not allowed for employees earning over $150,000.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】判断看的是上一年度"从该雇主取得"的 FICA 工资，不是总收入；自雇收入不计入。

【SECURE 2.0 §603（Sec.414(v)(7)）】上一年度从该雇主取得的 FICA 工资 > $150,000（2026 年适用 2025 年工资，按通胀调整）→ 追加供款必须为 Roth（最终法规自 2026 年起全面适用）

  • 基本递延 $24,500 仍可选税前或 Roth（选项C错）
  • 61 岁 → 60–63 岁超级追加 $11,250（替代 $8,000）（选项A错）
  • 若计划不提供 Roth 选项 → 高收入者不能做追加供款（而不是完全禁止追加，选项D错）
  • 自雇者（无 FICA 工资，如合伙人）不受此规则约束
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：基本递延 $24,500 可选税前或 Roth，60–63 岁超级追加 $11,250 因上年 FICA 工资超过 $150,000 必须为 Roth。
qs.tp: T04.1.5 追加供款与工资门槛 Catch-Up-Contribution-Limits

qs.s: The Parks (MFJ; MAGI well below all phase-outs) pay qualified tuition of $8,000 for their daughter, a college freshman, and $12,000 for their son, who is in his fifth year of undergraduate study (he claimed the AOTC for 4 prior years). What is their maximum total education credit?
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】AOTC 按"学生"计算上限，LLC 按"申报表"计算上限——多子女家庭 AOTC 优势明显。

【AOTC】每名学生最多 $2,500（前 $2,000 × 100% + 次 $2,000 × 25%）；只限前 4 个学年、至少半时就读；40% 可退

  • 女儿（新生）→ $2,500
【LLC（Lifetime Learning Credit）】每份申报表：20% × 最多 $10,000 支出 = 最多 $2,000；不限年数、不要求半时；不可退
  • 儿子已用满 4 年 AOTC → 用 LLC：20% × Min($12,000, $10,000) = $2,000
  • 同一学生同一年只能选一种
  • 合计 $4,500
【MAGI 递减】LLC 与 AOTC 同为 $80,000–$90,000（MFJ $160,000–$180,000），不按通胀调整
【干扰项】选项B 两人都按 AOTC；选项C 只算一人；选项D LLC 计算错误
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：女儿用 AOTC $2,500，已用满 4 年的儿子用 LLC $2,000（20% × $10,000），合计 $4,500。
qs.tp: T04.2.6 教育抵免计算 Education-Tax-Credit-Calculation

qs.s: Paul (age 50, MFJ, MAGI below the phase-out) redeems Series EE bonds he bought in his own name in 2010, receiving $20,000 ($12,000 principal and $8,000 interest). He pays $15,000 of qualified tuition and fees for his dependent son this year. How much of the interest is excludable?
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】债券登记在孩子名下不符合 135 条件——须由父母（≥24 岁）持有。

【Sec.135 要件】1989 年后发行的 Series EE / I 债券；购买时持有人 ≥ 24 岁；用于纳税人、配偶或受养人的学费与杂费（不含食宿）；MFS 不适用；有 MAGI 递减

【比例排除】赎回总额（本金 + 利息）$20,000 > 合格支出 $15,000 → 按比例
  • 可排除利息 = $8,000 × $15,000 / $20,000 = $6,000
  • 合格支出须先扣除免税奖学金、以及用于 AOTC/LLC 与 529 免税分配的支出
  • 也可把赎回款直接转入 529 或 Coverdell（视为合格支出）
【干扰项】选项B 忽略比例；选项C 误以为不合格；选项D 比例计算错误
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：赎回总额 $20,000 大于合格支出 $15,000，利息按 15/20 比例排除 $6,000。
qs.tp: T04.2.9 教育储蓄债券 Education-Savings-Bond-Exclusion

qs.s: Tess's employer maintains a qualified Sec. 127 educational assistance program. In 2026 it pays $3,000 of her graduate tuition and $4,000 of principal and interest on her qualified student loans. How much is excluded from her income?
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】与工作直接相关的教育费用可另按 Sec.132(d) 工作条件附加福利全额排除，不受 $5,250 限制。

【Sec.127】合格教育资助计划：每名员工每年最多 $5,250 免税（2026 年后按通胀调整）

  • 涵盖学费、书本等（不限于与工作相关、本科或研究生均可）
  • 学生贷款还款：原为 2020–2025 年临时规定，OBBBA 已永久化
  • 合计支付 $7,000 → 排除 $5,250；超额 $1,750 计入 W-2（除非另符合 Sec.132 与工作相关的教育附加福利）
  • 被排除部分的学贷利息不能再按 Sec.221 扣除
【干扰项】选项A 忽略上限；选项B 以为学贷还款不适用；选项D 误以为计划资助应税
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：Sec.127 计划每年最多排除 $5,250，学费和学贷还款（OBBBA 永久化）合计 $7,000，只能排除 $5,250。
qs.tp: T04.2.8 雇主援助与学贷 Employer-Assistance-Student-Loans

qs.s: Uri, a degree candidate, receives a $30,000 university scholarship allocated $20,000 to tuition and required fees and books and $10,000 to room and board. He also receives $6,000 for serving as a teaching assistant, which is required as a condition of the award. How much is included in his gross income?
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】非学位候选人（如短期访学）的奖学金全部应税；被计入收入的奖学金属于"已赚收入"可影响受养人标准扣除。

【Sec.117 合格奖学金】仅限学位候选人，用于：学费、注册费、课程必需的书本、用品、设备 → 排除 $20,000

  • 食宿部分 → 应税 $10,000
  • 作为获奖条件而提供服务（助教、研究助理）的报酬 → 应税 $6,000（例外：NHSC、军队健康奖学金、部分工读计划）
  • 合计 $16,000
【筹划】家长申报 AOTC 时可让学生把部分奖学金"分配"为应税（用于食宿），腾出学费以取得 AOTC——需逐年测算
【干扰项】选项A 全部排除；选项B 漏了食宿；选项C 漏了服务报酬
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：食宿部分 $10,000 与作为获奖条件的助教报酬 $6,000 都应税，合计 $16,000。
qs.tp: T04.2.7 奖学金税务与优化 Scholarship-Tax-Credit-Planning

qs.s: Which statement about qualified long-term care insurance is correct?
o: Premiums are fully deductible as an above-the-line deduction for all taxpayers.
All long-term care benefits received are taxable income.
Qualified long-term care premiums may be paid tax-free through a health FSA.

Premiums for a qualified long-term care contract are medical expenses up to age-based dollar limits (subject to the 7.5%-of-AGI floor for itemizers, or deductible above the line by self-employed individuals); indemnity-type benefits are excluded, and per diem benefits are excluded up to the indexed daily limit; and a life insurance or annuity contract may be exchanged tax-free for a qualified long-term care contract under Sec. 1035.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】用旧年金（有大量未实现收益）通过 1035 换成年金/LTC 组合产品，可以让收益部分免税地用于支付护理费用。

【合格长期护理保险（Sec.7702B）】

  • 保费：视为医疗费，但每人按年龄分档有扣除上限；逐项扣除受 7.5% AGI 门槛；自雇者可按 162(l) above-the-line 扣除（选项A错）
  • 给付：报销型（indemnity）全额免税；按日给付型（per diem）在按年调整的日限额内免税（选项B错）
  • 雇主提供的 LTC 保险免税，但不能通过 cafeteria 计划或 FSA 提供（选项C错）
  • Sec.1035：人寿、年金可免税交换为合格 LTC 合同；年金/人寿与 LTC 结合的产品中，从现金价值扣收的 LTC 费用不计收入（减少 Basis）
  • HSA 可支付合格 LTC 保费（受年龄上限）
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：合格 LTC 保费属受年龄上限约束的医疗费，给付在限额内免税，人寿或年金可按 1035 免税交换为 LTC 合同。
qs.tp: T04.4.5 长期护理保险 Qualified-Long-Term-Care

qs.s: Bea, age 70, uses part of her traditional IRA to buy a qualified longevity annuity contract (QLAC) within the indexed dollar limit, with payments to begin at age 85. What is the main tax effect?
o: The amount used to buy the QLAC is excluded from the IRA balance used to compute her RMDs until payments begin (no later than age 85), deferring tax on that amount; payments are taxable as ordinary income when received.
The QLAC purchase is a taxable distribution in the year of purchase.
QLAC payments are tax-free because they are annuity payments.
A QLAC may be purchased only with Roth IRA funds.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】QLAC 的价值在于"长寿保险 + RMD 递延"，但放弃了流动性；须注意 IRS 对 QLAC 保费的年度美元上限。

【QLAC】用合格计划或传统 IRA 资金购买的延迟年金（受按年调整的美元上限；SECURE 2.0 取消了原 25% 比例限制）

  • 购买金额从计算 RMD 的账户余额中剔除，直到给付开始（最迟 85 岁）→ 递延 RMD 与所得税
  • 购买本身不是分配（选项B错）；给付时按普通收入课税（选项C错）
  • 用于传统 IRA/合格计划（Roth IRA 本无生前 RMD，不需要 QLAC → 选项D错）
  • 目的：对冲长寿风险 + 减少 73–85 岁期间的 RMD
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：购买 QLAC 的金额在给付开始（最迟 85 岁）前不计入 RMD 余额，递延所得税；给付时按普通收入课税。
qs.tp: T04.1.18 合格长寿年金 Qualified-Longevity-Annuity-Contracts

qs.s: An investor in the 35% federal bracket who is also subject to the 3.8% NIIT (ignore state taxes) compares a municipal bond yielding 3.5% with a corporate bond yielding 5.5%. Which statement is correct?
o: The corporate bond is better because 5.5% exceeds 3.5%.
The municipal bond's taxable-equivalent yield is about 5.72% (3.5% ÷ (1 − 0.388)), so it is better than the 5.5% corporate bond on an after-tax basis.
Municipal interest is subject to NIIT, so the bonds are equivalent.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】计算 TEY 时要把 NIIT 与州税一并考虑；免税收益率越接近、税率越高，市政债优势越大——也影响资产摆放位置决策。

【应税等值收益率（TEY）】= 免税收益率 ÷ (1 − 边际税率)

  • 市政债利息免联邦所得税且不属 NII → 相关边际税率 = 35% + 3.8% = 38.8%
  • TEY = 3.5% ÷ 0.612 ≈ 5.72% > 5.5% → 市政债税后更优
  • 反向：公司债税后收益 = 5.5% × (1 − 0.388) ≈ 3.37% < 3.5% ✔
【干扰项】选项A 比较税前收益；选项C 公式错误（应除以 (1 − t)）；选项D 市政债利息不属于 NII
【提醒】私人活动债券利息可能是 AMT 优先项目；市政债利息计入社保 provisional income
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：TEY = 3.5% ÷ (1 − 38.8%) ≈ 5.72%，高于 5.5% 的公司债，市政债税后更优。
qs.tp: T04.3.2 证券税性与等值收益 Security-Taxation-Equivalent-Yield

qs.s: Which statement about ABLE accounts is correct for 2026?
o: ABLE accounts are available only to individuals whose disability began before age 18.
Contributions to an ABLE account are deductible for federal income tax purposes.
Distributions for any purpose are tax-free.

Beginning in 2026, individuals whose disability began before age 46 are eligible; total annual contributions from all sources are generally limited to the annual gift tax exclusion (plus an additional amount for an employed beneficiary); distributions for qualified disability expenses are tax-free; and rollovers from a 529 plan to the beneficiary's (or a family member's) ABLE account are permitted within the annual limit, a provision OBBBA made permanent.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】为残疾子女规划时，ABLE 与特殊需求信托（SNT）常同时使用：ABLE 有年度上限，SNT 可承接大额遗产。

【ABLE 账户（Sec.529A）】

  • 2026 年起：残疾发生年龄上限由 26 岁提高到 46 岁（SECURE 2.0）→ 选项A错
  • 年度供款上限：合计不超过年度赠与免税额（2026 年 $19,000）；有工作的受益人另可在限额外追加（ABLE-to-work，OBBBA 永久化）
  • 联邦层面供款不可扣除（选项B错）；受益人的 ABLE 供款可适用储蓄者抵免（OBBBA 永久化）
  • 合格残疾支出的分配免税；非合格分配的收益部分应税 + 10%（选项C错）
  • 529 → ABLE 滚存（计入当年上限）：OBBBA 永久化
  • 余额一般不影响 SSI 资格（有上限）；受益人死亡后可能被 Medicaid 追偿
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：2026 年起残疾发生年龄上限提高到 46 岁；供款上限一般为年度赠与免税额；合格支出分配免税；529 转 ABLE 已被 OBBBA 永久化。
qs.tp: T04.6.3 残疾储蓄账户 ABLE-Disability-Savings-Accounts

qs.s: In 2026 parents withdraw $23,000 from a 529 plan for their 10-year-old: $18,000 of private school tuition, $2,000 for a qualified outside tutor, $1,000 for standardized testing fees, and $2,000 for the child's summer camp. How much is a qualified distribution?
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】州税处理可能与联邦不同——部分州不承认 K-12 分配为合格支出，会回收以前的州税扣除。

【OBBBA 对 529 K-12 的变化】

  • K-12 年度上限：2026 年起 $20,000（此前 $10,000）
  • 合格 K-12 支出扩大到学费以外：课程材料、教科书、线上教材；外部辅导（导师与学生无亲属关系且具资质）；标准化考试、AP、大学入学考试费用；双学籍费用；残疾学生的教育治疗
  • 夏令营 → 不合格
【本题】合格支出 18,000 + 2,000 + 1,000 = 21,000，受 K-12 上限 → $20,000；其余 $3,000 为非合格分配（收益部分应税 + 10%）
  • 高等教育方面：另扩大至合格的职业资格/认证课程费用
【干扰项】选项A 用旧上限；选项B 全部当合格；选项C 只算学费
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：合格 K-12 支出 $21,000（学费、辅导、考试费；夏令营不合格），受 2026 年 $20,000 上限，合格分配 $20,000。

qs.s: Tara, age 40, takes several distributions from her 401(k) in 2026. Which is exempt from the 10% additional tax?
o: A $1,000 emergency personal expense distribution (one per calendar year), which she may repay within 3 years.
A $20,000 distribution to pay her daughter's private high school tuition.
A $15,000 distribution to buy her first home.
A distribution to pay off credit card debt because of financial hardship.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】"可以提取"（计划允许的 hardship 分配）不等于"免罚金"——两者是不同的规则。

【SECURE 2.0 新增的 10% 罚金例外（72(t)(2)）】

  • 紧急个人支出：每年一次，最多 $1,000，3 年内可偿还（未偿还前不得再次提取）→ 选项A ✔
  • 家暴受害者：Lesser of（按年调整的上限，账户 50%）
  • 绝症（医生认定 84 个月内）；联邦宣告灾区（最多 $22,000）；出生/领养（每名子女 $5,000）；长期护理保险费（有上限，自 2026 年起）
【仍无例外】
  • K-12 学费（选项B）；首次购房 $10,000 例外只适用于 IRA，不适用 401(k)（选项C）；一般困难提取（hardship）可以取款但仍有 10% 罚金（选项D）
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：SECURE 2.0 的紧急个人支出分配（每年一次最多 $1,000）免 10% 罚金。
qs.tp: T04.1.10 新增提取例外 SECURE-Emergency-Distribution-Exceptions

qs.s: Parent Corp owns 100% of Sub Corp, and they file a consolidated federal income tax return. During the year, Parent sells equipment to Sub for $200,000 (Parent's adjusted basis in the equipment was $100,000, so Parent's realized gain is $100,000). Sub will depreciate the equipment for its own use going forward. Under the consolidated return intercompany transaction regulations, when does the consolidated group recognize the $100,000 gain from this intercompany sale?
o: The $100,000 gain is recognized immediately by Parent in the year of sale, exactly as if Sub were an unrelated third party, because the consolidated return regulations only apply to intercompany LOANS, not asset sales.
The gain is permanently excluded from the group's income and never recognized, since transactions between group members are eliminated entirely, similar to GAAP consolidation.

The $100,000 intercompany gain is deferred at the consolidated group level (not permanently eliminated) and is taken into income by the group over time in a manner that generally matches Sub's depreciation of the asset (effectively as Sub 'uses up' the asset), or is fully recognized immediately if Sub later sells the asset outside the group or the group ceases to file consolidated returns.
The gain is taxed at the time of the intercompany sale, but only at 50% of the amount, with the other 50% permanently excluded under the dividends-received deduction framework.
qs.x:
【🚨 高频陷阱】① 不要把合并申报的税务处理和 GAAP 合并报表的"抵销分录"逻辑混为一谈——两者目标不同：GAAP 是为了避免集团内部交易虚增收入/资产，是永久性抵销；税法则是承认这笔交易终究会被课税，只是选择"递延到经济实质真正对外部实现的时点"才确认，这是完全不同的两套逻辑（选项B的错误正源于此）；② 合并申报涉及的公司间交易远不止本题的资产买卖，还包括公司间贷款利息、公司间股息（通常100%排除，因为集团内部持股≥80%）、公司间劳务费等，各自有细分规则，但"递延匹配买方经济实质"是资产买卖类交易的核心主线。

【第一步：合并申报下的公司间交易（Intercompany Transaction）处理原则】

  • 与财务会计上合并报表"直接抵销、永久消失"不同（选项B的错误认知），税法上的合并申报集团（Consolidated Group）对公司间交易采用的是 "递延（Deferral）"而非"永久消除（Elimination）"的处理方式——这笔利得终究要被确认，只是推迟确认的时点。
【第二步：递延利得的释放节奏 —— 与买方后续如何处置资产挂钩】
  • 本题 Parent 卖给 Sub 的是可折旧设备：这笔 $100,000 的公司间利得，会按照 Sub 对该设备的折旧进度逐年"释放"进入集团的合并应税所得——即随着 Sub 每年计提折旧、"消耗"这项资产的经济价值，对应比例的递延利得就同步在集团层面确认，大致对应于"资产在买方手中被使用/消耗的节奏"。
  • 若 Sub 未来把该设备卖给集团外部的第三方，或者该集团不再以合并方式申报，则剩余全部尚未释放的递延利得会在该事件发生时一次性全额加速确认。
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：准确刻画了合并申报下公司间交易"递延而非消除、按买方后续使用节奏释放、特殊事件触发加速确认"的核心机制。
qs.tp: T05.10.2 内部交易匹配递延 Intercompany-Transaction-Matching

qs.s: Parent sold equipment to Sub for $200,000 (Parent's basis $100,000), creating a $100,000 deferred intercompany gain. Sub depreciates the equipment straight-line over 5 years, and $40,000 of the deferred gain has been taken into consolidated income after 2 years. At the start of Year 3, Sub sells the equipment to an unrelated buyer. How much of Parent's remaining deferred gain is recognized?
o: The remaining $60,000 is taken into income immediately in Year 3 (in addition to Sub's own gain or loss on the sale).
$12,000 per year for the next 3 years.
$0 — deferred gains remain deferred until the group dissolves.
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题考"递延而非消除"；本题考"加速确认触发事件"（出售给集团外、成员离开集团、不再合并申报）。

【公司间递延利得的释放】

  • 正常：随买方（Sub）折旧节奏释放 → 2 年 × $20,000 = $40,000 已确认
  • 资产离开集团（卖给外部）→ 剩余 $60,000 立即全额确认
  • Sub 另行计算自己的出售损益（Basis = $200,000 − 已提折旧）
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：The remaining $60,000 is taken into income immediately in Year 3 (in addition to Sub's own gain or loss on the sale).
qs.tp: T05.10.2 内部交易匹配递延 Intercompany-Transaction-Matching

qs.s: Apex Corp owns 75% of the voting stock and 75% of the total value of Nova Corp's only class of stock. The remaining 25% of Nova is owned by unrelated outside investors. Apex also owns 90% of the voting stock and 90% of the value of Zenith Corp. Can Apex, Nova, and Zenith file a single consolidated federal income tax return together?
o: Yes, all three corporations can join the consolidated return, because Apex is the common parent of both subsidiaries and any level of majority ownership above 50% qualifies.

Apex and Zenith CAN file a consolidated return together (Zenith meets the 80% vote and value affiliated group test), but Nova CANNOT be included in the consolidated group because it fails the 80% test (only 75% owned); Nova must file its own separate corporate return.
All three can consolidate, but only if Apex first acquires 100% of both subsidiaries; partial ownership above 50% is never sufficient for consolidation under any structure.
None of the three corporations can consolidate because a consolidated group is limited to exactly two corporations under current law.
qs.x:
【🚨 高频陷阱】① 选项D"合并申报限于两家公司"是彻底错误的编造——只要每一层的从属关系都满足80%双重测试，合并申报集团可以包含任意多家公司，形成多层级的公司集团结构（母公司→子公司→孙公司层层嵌套，只要每一层都过80%即可一路合并进来）；② TCP 筹划视角常追问"Apex 应如何调整对 Nova 的持股比例，才能让 Nova 也加入合并申报集团"——标准答案是"从外部投资者手中再收购至少5%的股权，使总持股达到80%以上"，这正是合并申报资格测试在实务并购/重组筹划中的直接应用。

【第一步：合并申报集团（Affiliated Group）资格的法定门槛】

  • 能够共同提交合并申报的"关联集团"，要求集团内每一家成员公司，都必须被集团内其他一家或多家成员公司合计持有其已发行股票 至少80%的表决权 且 至少80%的价值（Sec.1504(a)），这是一条必须同时满足两个80%的硬性数字门槛，不是简单的"过半数"即可（选项A的"任何超过50%"是错误简化）。
【第二步：逐一核实 Nova 和 Zenith 是否达标】
  • Nova：Apex 持有其 75% 表决权 + 75% 价值 → 未达到 80% 门槛（无论是表决权还是价值都差5个百分点）→ 不符合加入合并申报集团的资格。
  • Zenith：Apex 持有其 90% 表决权 + 90% 价值 → 均超过80%门槛 → 符合资格。
【第三步：结论与后续申报安排】
  • Apex（母公司）与 Zenith（达标子公司）可以共同提交合并申报表。
  • Nova 由于未达 80% 门槛，必须独立申报自己的 Form 1120，不能并入 Apex-Zenith 的合并申报集团（即使 Apex 对 Nova 仍拥有多数控制权、财务上可能仍需按权益法或成本法合并列报，但税务申报层面二者是完全分离的）。
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：合并申报资格是"逐一测试每个成员是否达到80%双重门槛"，不是整个集团"一荣俱荣、一损俱损"，未达标的成员被排除在外，但不影响其他达标成员之间正常合并申报。
qs.tp: T05.10.1 附属集团资格 Affiliated-Group-Eligibility

qs.s: Parent Corp has $200,000 of taxable income; its 100%-owned Sub has a $100,000 loss this year. Compare separate returns versus a consolidated return for the current year.
o: Separate returns are always better because each member keeps its own NOL.
Same result either way: Parent taxed on $200,000.
Separate: Parent taxed on $200,000 and Sub carries forward a $100,000 NOL; Consolidated: group taxed on $100,000 because Sub's current loss offsets Parent's income.
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题考资格（80% 双测试）；本题考收益。

【合并申报的主要好处】

  • 成员之间当年损益互抵（Sub 亏损抵 Parent 利润）→ 合并应税所得 $100,000
  • 集团内股息消除、公司间交易递延
【代价】一旦选择，需 IRS 同意才能退出；成员 SRLY（单独亏损年度）规则限制并入前亏损的使用
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：Separate: Parent taxed on $200,000 and Sub carries forward a $100,000 NOL; Consolidated: group taxed on $100,000 because Sub's current loss offsets Parent's income.
qs.tp: T05.10 合并纳税申报 Consolidated-Tax-Returns

qs.s:
• Grove Corp reports current-year taxable income of $500,000. In computing taxable income, Grove claimed $80,000 of Sec. 179 expensing on newly purchased equipment
  • for E&P purposes, Sec. 312(k)(3)(B) requires the Sec. 179 amount to be deducted ratably over 5 years ($16,000 this year). Grove also received $40,000 of municipal bond interest, properly excluded from taxable income. In addition, Grove sold investment securities at a $25,000 net capital loss
  • because a corporation cannot deduct net capital losses, none of this loss was deducted in arriving at the $500,000 taxable income. Ignore federal income taxes. What is Grove Corp's current Earnings & Profits (E&P) for the year?
o: $579,000 — add back the $64,000 of Sec. 179 expensing in excess of the $16,000 allowed for E&P, add the $40,000 of tax-exempt interest, and subtract the $25,000 nondeductible net capital loss (a real economic loss that reduces E&P in the year incurred).
$500,000 — E&P always equals taxable income; no adjustments are required.
$604,000 — add back the $64,000 Sec. 179 excess and the $40,000 tax-exempt interest; the capital loss is ignored because it was never deducted for taxable income.
$540,000 — add back only the $40,000 of municipal bond interest; Sec. 179 needs no E&P adjustment because it is a permitted deduction for both purposes.
qs.x:
【🚨 高频陷阱】E&P 调整分两个方向：① "税表扣了但经济上没流出/流出更慢"（Sec.179、加速折旧、DRD、NOL 结转）→ 加回；② "税表不让扣但经济上确实流出"（联邦所得税、超限慈善捐赠、罚款、不可扣除的资本损失）→ 减去；免税但真实收到的收入（市政债利息、人寿保险理赔）→ 加上。

【第一步：E&P 与 Taxable Income 是两套独立的计算体系】

  • E&P 衡量公司"真实经济上的分红能力"，必须从 Taxable Income 出发逐项调整（选项B"两者永远相等"错误）。
【第二步：Sec.179 的 E&P 调整（Sec.312(k)(3)(B)）】
  • 计算 E&P 时，Sec.179 费用化金额须在 5 年内平均扣除：$80,000 ÷ 5 = $16,000（本年允许）。
  • 加回 = 税表已扣 $80,000 − E&P 允许 $16,000 = $64,000（选项D认为无需调整，错误）。
【第三步：免税市政债利息 → 加回 $40,000】
  • 虽免所得税，但属于公司真实收到的经济收益，增加分红能力。
【第四步：不可扣除的净资本损失 → 减去 $25,000】
  • 公司的净资本损失不能在当年应税所得中扣除（只能结转），但它是真实发生的经济损失，因此在发生当年减少 E&P；日后该损失结转到应税所得中使用时，E&P 不再重复扣减。
  • 选项C忽略了这一减项——"税表没扣"不等于"E&P 不减"。口诀："税表不让扣但钱确实亏了/花了" → E&P 减。
【第五步：汇总】
  • E&P = $500,000 + $64,000 + $40,000 − $25,000 = $579,000。
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：E&P = $500,000 + Sec.179 超额加回 $64,000 + 免税利息 $40,000 − 不可扣除净资本损失 $25,000 = $579,000。
qs.tp: T05.3.1 盈余利润调整 Earnings-Profits-Adjustments

qs.s: Grove Corp has taxable income of $500,000. It paid $105,000 of federal income tax, claimed a $50,000 dividends-received deduction, had $30,000 of charitable contributions that exceeded the 10% limit (not deductible this year), and paid $10,000 of nondeductible government fines. What is current E&P?
o: $405,000 ($500,000 + $50,000 DRD − $105,000 federal tax − $30,000 excess charitable − $10,000 fines)
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题考"加回项"（179 超额、免税利息）；本题考"减项"。

【从 Taxable Income 出发】
+ DRD $50,000（DRD 不是真实经济支出，加回）
− 联邦所得税 $105,000（真实现金流出，税表不可扣，E&P 要减）
− 超限慈善捐赠 $30,000（已真实支付）
− 罚款 $10,000（已真实支付）
= $405,000

【口诀】"税表不让扣但钱确实花了" → E&P 减；"税表扣了但钱没真正流出"或"免税但真收到" → E&P 加。
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：$405,000 ($500,000 + $50,000 DRD − $105,000 federal tax − $30,000 excess charitable − $10,000 fines)
qs.tp: T05.3.1 盈余利润调整 Earnings-Profits-Adjustments

qs.s: Ridge Corp is a closely held C corporation. Four individuals (unrelated to each other) own 90% of Ridge's stock in total, and the remaining 10% is held by roughly 40 unrelated smaller shareholders. This year, 65% of Ridge's adjusted ordinary gross income came from passive dividends and interest on investments the company holds; the company has not distributed any dividends and has accumulated substantial earnings with no clearly documented business need for the funds. Which special corporate-level tax(es) potentially apply to Ridge this year, and how are they distinguished procedurally?
o: Both AET and PHC tax will definitely apply simultaneously and be added together, since both taxes are triggered by the same underlying facts in this scenario.
Neither tax applies because Ridge has over 40 shareholders total, which automatically disqualifies it from being treated as 'closely held' for either purpose.
Only the Accumulated Earnings Tax (AET) could apply, since PHC tax requires an IPO-level number of shareholders (at least 100) before it can ever apply.

Ridge meets BOTH the PHC ownership test (≤5 individuals own >50% — here 4 individuals own 90%, comfortably over 50%) and the passive income test (65% ≥ the 60% threshold), so PHC tax applies and is self-assessed by Ridge on Schedule PH without any IRS audit trigger required; AET, by contrast, requires an IRS determination that earnings were accumulated beyond reasonable business needs — the two taxes cannot both be assessed on the same corporation for the same year, and given Ridge affirmatively meets the objective PHC tests, PHC tax (not AET) is the more likely and more mechanically certain exposure here.
qs.x:
【🚨 高频陷阱】TCP 筹划题常问"作为顾问，应如何建议 Ridge 规避 PHC 税风险"——由于 PHC 测试是纯客观数字测试，筹划空间集中在改变股权结构（引入更多股东、稀释前5大股东的集中度使其≤50%）或改变收入结构（增加营业性收入占比、降低被动收入占比至60%以下），而不是像应对AET那样去"证明有合理商业需求"（那是AET的抗辩思路，对PHC税无效——PHC税一旦客观测试达标，没有"合理需求"这个豁免通道）。

【第一步：逐一核对 PHC（个人控股公司税）两大客观测试】

  • 持股集中度测试：≤5名个人合计持股>50%——本题4人合计持股90%，远超门槛 → 满足。
  • 被动收入占比测试：调整后普通总收入中被动收入占比≥60%——本题65%≥60% → 满足。
  • 两项客观测试同时满足 → Ridge 构成 PHC，注意：股东总人数（本题约44人，含10%由40名小股东持有）不影响 PHC 测试——选项B、C都错误地引入了"股东总人数"这一与PHC客观测试无关的干扰因素，PHC测试只看"前5大个人持股是否集中过半"，不管公司整体股东总数有多少。
【第二步：PHC 税的课征方式 —— 自动课征、自行申报】
  • 一旦客观满足两项测试，PHC 税自动触发，公司须主动在 Schedule PH 上自行申报并缴纳这笔额外的 20% 惩罚性税款，不需要等待 IRS 审计认定。
【第三步：AET 的课征方式 —— 需 IRS 主观审计认定】
  • AET 则完全不同：需要 IRS 通过审计，主观认定公司"缺乏合理商业需求却囤积利润"，才会启动课征程序——这不是一个自动、客观、可以自我判定的税种。
【第四步：两税互斥关系】
  • 税法明确：同一公司、同一纳税年度，不会同时被课征 AET 和 PHC 税（两者是"二选一"的关系，如果客观满足PHC测试，通常直接适用PHC税，不再叠加考虑AET）。
  • 本题 Ridge 已经客观、确定地满足 PHC 两项测试，因此 PHC 税是这个案例里更明确、更具确定性的税务风险（不依赖IRS主观判断），而 AET 则需要额外等待IRS审计程序介入，两者不会同时叠加对Ridge课税。
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：PHC 税与 AET 税互斥且程序不同，PHC 税为申报表自核自缴，AET 则由 IRS 审计认定。
qs.tp: T05.9.3 个人控股公司税 Personal-Holding-Company-Tax

qs.s: Ridge Corp has 10 unrelated shareholders, each owning exactly 10%. 65% of its adjusted ordinary gross income is passive. It has accumulated large earnings without distributing them. Which statement is correct?
o: Ridge is subject to both PHC tax and AET.
Ridge is a PHC because passive income exceeds 60%.
Ridge is exempt from both taxes because it has 10 shareholders.

Ridge is NOT a PHC: the 5 largest individual shareholders own exactly 50%, which is not MORE than 50%; however, Ridge may still face the accumulated earnings tax if the IRS finds its accumulations exceed reasonable business needs.
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题 4 人持股 90% → PHC；本题恰好 50% 边界 → 不是 PHC。家族归属会改变结论（若 10 人是一家人，则视同 1 人持股 100%）。

【PHC 持股测试】前 5 大个人持股 >50%（含归属）

  • 5 × 10% = 50% → 不超过 50% → 不构成 PHC（即使被动收入 65% 满足第二项测试）
【AET】不看股权结构，只看是否超额累积 → 仍有风险；抗辩：合理商业需求（营运资金 Bardahl 公式、扩张计划、偿债等）
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：Ridge is NOT a PHC: the 5 largest individual shareholders own exactly 50%, which is not MORE than 50%; however, Ridge may still face the accumulated earnings tax if the IRS finds its accumulations exceed reasonable business needs.
qs.tp: T05.9.3 个人控股公司税 Personal-Holding-Company-Tax

qs.s: X Corp has 100 shares outstanding: Ann owns 60 and Bo (unrelated) owns 40. X redeems 30 of Ann's shares for $200,000; her basis in those shares is $100,000. X has ample E&P. How is the redemption treated?
o: $200,000 dividend, because X has sufficient E&P.

Sale or exchange: after the redemption Ann owns 30/70 = 42.9%, which is less than 50% and less than 80% of her prior 60% (48%), so it is substantially disproportionate; she recognizes a $100,000 capital gain.
Sale or exchange with a $200,000 capital gain.
Dividend, because she still owns stock after the redemption.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】比例的分母是赎回后的流通股数（70），不是 100；持股须计入 Sec.318 归属。

【Sec.302(b)(2) 三项测试（须同时满足）】
① 赎回后持有表决权股比例 < 50%
② 赎回后比例 < 赎回前比例的 80%
③（普通股）同样满足 80% 测试

  • 赎回前 60%；赎回后 30 ÷ 70 = 42.9%
  • 42.9% < 50% ✔；42.9% < 80% × 60% = 48% ✔ → 按出售处理
  • Gain = $200,000 − Basis $100,000 = $100,000 资本利得
【其他出售待遇路径】302(b)(1) 实质上不等同于股息（有意义的持股减少）；302(b)(3) 完全终止；302(b)(4) 非公司股东的部分清算
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：Sale or exchange: after the redemption Ann owns 30/70 = 42.9%, which is less than 50% and less than 80% of her prior 60% (48%), so it is substantially disproportionate; she recognizes a $100,000 capital gain.
qs.tp: T05.4.1 不成比例赎回 Disproportionate-Redemption-Tests

qs.s: Mom owns 60 shares and her son owns 40 shares of a family C corporation (100 shares total, ample E&P). The corporation redeems all 60 of Mom's shares. Mom will have no further involvement. Which statement is correct?
o: Family attribution never applies between parent and child.
It is automatically a complete termination because Mom no longer actually owns any shares.

Under Sec. 318 Mom constructively owns her son's 40 shares (100% after the redemption), so it is not a complete termination unless Mom waives family attribution under Sec. 302(c)(2): she must have no interest (other than as a creditor) for 10 years, including as an officer, director, or employee, and file an agreement to notify the IRS. With a valid waiver it is a sale; without one, it is a dividend to the extent of E&P.
The redemption is a dividend regardless of any waiver.
qs.x:
【🚨 后果对比】放弃成功 → 出售（资本利得、先回收 Basis）；失败 → 在 E&P 范围内按股息，Mom 已赎回股份的 Basis 转移到儿子的股份上。

【Sec.318 家族归属】个人视同拥有配偶、子女、孙子女、父母的持股（不含兄弟姐妹、祖父母——与 267 不同！）

  • Mom 赎回后实际 0 股，但推定拥有儿子 40 股 → 40 ÷ 40 = 100% → 不满足完全终止
【302(c)(2) 放弃家族归属】

① 赎回后 10 年内不得持有任何权益（债权人除外），不得担任高管、董事、员工
② 向 IRS 提交协议，若 10 年内取得权益须通知
③ 赎回前 10 年内未从关联方取得股份（以避税为主要目的）

  • 放弃仅针对家族归属，不适用于实体归属（个人股东）
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：Under Sec. 318 Mom constructively owns her son's 40 shares (100% after the redemption), so it is not a complete termination unless Mom waives family attribution under Sec. 302(c)(2): she must have no interest (other than as a creditor) for 10 years, including as an officer, director, or employee, and file an agreement to notify the IRS. With a valid waiver it is a sale; without one, it is a dividend to the extent of E&P.
qs.tp: T05.4.3 完全终止与家族放弃 Termination-Family-Attribution-Waiver

qs.s: A sole shareholder (100 shares, total basis $100,000) has the corporation redeem 30 shares for $200,000. The corporation has $500,000 of E&P. What are the results?
o: The redemption fails every Sec. 302(b) test (she still owns 100%), so the $200,000 is a dividend; the $30,000 of basis in the redeemed shares is not lost but shifts to her remaining 70 shares (total basis remains $100,000).
Return of capital of $100,000 and capital gain of $100,000.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】股息待遇下不能先回收 Basis；这正是出售待遇（先扣 Basis、按资本利得）与股息待遇的核心差异。

【唯一股东赎回】赎回前后持股比例均为 100% → 所有 302(b) 测试失败 → 按 Sec.301 分配

  • E&P $500,000 ≥ $200,000 → 全部为股息（个人按合格股息税率）
  • 被赎回股份的 Basis $30,000 不消失，转移到剩余 70 股 → 剩余股份 Basis $100,000
  • 若股东为 C 公司，股息可享 DRD（注意 1059 非常规股息规则）
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：The redemption fails every Sec. 302(b) test (she still owns 100%), so the $200,000 is a dividend; the $30,000 of basis in the redeemed shares is not lost but shifts to her remaining 70 shares (total basis remains $100,000).
qs.tp: T05.4 股票赎回判别 Stock-Redemption-Classification

qs.s: Ray died owning closely held stock worth $1,000,000, which is 60% of his adjusted gross estate. His estate owes $150,000 of state estate taxes and $50,000 of funeral and administration expenses. The corporation redeems $200,000 of stock from the estate. What is the treatment?
o: Sec. 303 limits the redemption to estate taxes only ($150,000); the excess $50,000 is a dividend.
Dividend of $200,000 because the estate still owns stock.

Sale or exchange under Sec. 303: the stock exceeds 35% of the adjusted gross estate, and the redemption does not exceed the death taxes plus funeral and administration expenses ($200,000). Because the stock's basis was stepped up to FMV at death, little or no gain results.
Sec. 303 applies only if the estate's entire interest is redeemed.
qs.x:
【🚨 筹划】闭锁公司股东的流动性工具：由公司出资赎回，而不必把股票卖给外人；股东生前可提前规划公司资金或公司持有的人寿保单。

【Sec.303 要件】
① 该公司股票价值 > 调整后总遗产（总遗产 − 可扣除费用、债务、损失）的 35% → 60% ✔
② 出售待遇的金额上限 = 遗产税（含 GST、州遗产税）+ 丧葬费 + 遗产管理费 = $150,000 + $50,000 = $200,000 ✔
③ 在一定期限内赎回（一般为申报遗产税后 3 年 90 天内）

  • 无需满足 302(b) 测试
  • 股票已在死亡时 Step-up 至 FMV → Gain ≈ $0
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：Sale or exchange under Sec. 303: the stock exceeds 35% of the adjusted gross estate, and the redemption does not exceed the death taxes plus funeral and administration expenses ($200,000). Because the stock's basis was stepped up to FMV at death, little or no gain results.
qs.tp: T05.4.5 遗产税赎回 Estate-Tax-Redemptions

qs.s: Lee owns 100% of both X Corp and Y Corp, each with substantial E&P. Lee sells 20% of his X stock (basis $30,000) to Y Corp for $200,000 cash. How is this treated?
o: A sale of X stock: $170,000 capital gain.

Under Sec. 304, a sale of stock to a commonly controlled (brother-sister) corporation is treated as a redemption by the acquiring corporation (Y); tested under Sec. 302 with reference to X, Lee's interest in X is unchanged (he still owns 100% directly and through Y), so the $200,000 is a dividend to the extent of Y's and then X's E&P.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】母子公司情形（子公司收购母公司股票）同样适用 304。

【Sec.304 反滥用】股东把一家受控公司的股票"卖"给另一家同受其控制（≥50%）的公司 → 视为赎回，不是普通出售

  • 302 测试按"被卖出股票的发行公司"（X）来衡量：Lee 卖出后直接 80% + 通过 Y 间接 20% = 仍为 100% → 所有测试失败
  • 视同股息：先按 Y（收购方） 的 E&P，再按 X（发行方） 的 E&P
  • 否则股东可以用"卖股票"把公司利润以资本利得（且先扣 Basis）的形式取出
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：Under Sec. 304, a sale of stock to a commonly controlled (brother-sister) corporation is treated as a redemption by the acquiring corporation (Y); tested under Sec. 302 with reference to X, Lee's interest in X is unchanged (he still owns 100% directly and through Y), so the $200,000 is a dividend to the extent of Y's and then X's E&P.
qs.tp: T05.4.6 受控公司间售股 Related-Corporation-Stock-Sales

qs.s: On audit, the IRS determines that $200,000 of the $500,000 salary a C corporation paid to its 100% shareholder-CEO exceeds reasonable compensation. The corporation has ample E&P. What is the effect?
o: The $200,000 remains deductible salary; only payroll taxes are adjusted.

The $200,000 is recharacterized as a constructive dividend: the corporation loses its compensation deduction for that amount, and the shareholder reports it as a (qualified) dividend rather than wages.
The $200,000 is treated as a loan to the shareholder.
qs.x:
【🚨 C 与 S 方向相反】C 公司风险是薪酬过高（推定股息）；S 公司风险是薪酬过低（分配被重新定性为工资，补缴 FICA）。

【推定股息】名义上不是股息、实质上是向股东转移利润：

  • 不合理的高薪（C 公司）、股东无偿/低价使用公司资产、公司为股东支付个人费用、以低于市价向股东出售资产、无意偿还的"股东借款"
【后果】
  • 公司：失去 $200,000 薪酬扣除 → 公司税增加
  • 股东：工资 → 股息（税率可能更低，也不再缴 FICA），但整体因双重课税通常更贵
  • Payback 协议：约定超额部分须退还公司，可让股东在退还当年取得扣除
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：The $200,000 is recharacterized as a constructive dividend: the corporation loses its compensation deduction for that amount, and the shareholder reports it as a (qualified) dividend rather than wages.
qs.tp: T05.3.4 推定股息与薪酬 Constructive-Dividends-Compensation

qs.s: Which stock distribution is TAXABLE to shareholders?
o: A pro rata distribution of common stock to holders of common stock when the corporation has no E&P.
A pro rata distribution of common stock on common stock, with no cash option.
A 2-for-1 stock split of common stock.

A distribution in which each shareholder may elect to receive either cash or additional common stock — it is taxable to ALL shareholders at FMV (as a Sec. 301 distribution), including those who elect stock.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】股票拆分本质上等同于免税股票股利。

【Sec.305(a) 一般规则】股票股利免税；原 Basis 按 FMV 比例在新旧股票间分摊，持有期承继

【305(b) 应税例外】

① 股东可选择现金或股票（选择股票的人同样应税）
② 部分股东得现金、部分股东持股比例上升（不成比例分配）
③ 普通股与优先股混合分配（部分股东得普通股、部分得优先股）
④ 优先股上的股利（反稀释调整除外）
⑤ 可转换优先股的分配（除非不导致不成比例）

  • 应税时按 FMV 作为 301 分配（在 E&P 范围内为股息），新股 Basis = FMV
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：A distribution in which each shareholder may elect to receive either cash or additional common stock — it is taxable to ALL shareholders at FMV (as a Sec. 301 distribution), including those who elect stock.
qs.tp: T05.3.5 股票股利与拆股 Stock-Dividends-Splits

qs.s: Corp A receives $100,000 of dividends from a 25%-owned domestic corporation (65% DRD). Case 1: Corp A's taxable income before the DRD is $90,000. Case 2: its taxable income before the DRD is $60,000. What is the DRD in each case?
o: Case 1: $58,500 (limited to 65% of $90,000 taxable income, because the full $65,000 DRD would not create an NOL); Case 2: $65,000 (the full DRD creates a $5,000 NOL, so the taxable income limitation does not apply).
qs.x:
【🚨 反直觉】应税所得更低的 Case 2 反而拿到更多 DRD —— 考试最爱考的"悬崖效应"。

【DRD 应税所得限制（Sec.246(b)）】DRD 不超过：DRD% × 应税所得（DRD、NOL、资本损失回溯等之前）

【NOL 例外】若按全额 DRD 计算会产生或增加 NOL，则不适用上述限制
  • Case 1：全额 $65,000 → $90,000 − $65,000 = $25,000 > 0 → 不产生 NOL → 适用限制 → 65% × $90,000 = $58,500
  • Case 2：全额 $65,000 → $60,000 − $65,000 = −$5,000 → 产生 NOL → 全额 $65,000
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：Case 1: $58,500 (limited to 65% of $90,000 taxable income, because the full $65,000 DRD would not create an NOL); Case 2: $65,000 (the full DRD creates a $5,000 NOL, so the taxable income limitation does not apply).
qs.tp: T05.5.1 股息扣除与亏损例外 DRD-Limits-NOL-Exception

qs.s: Which fact would reduce or eliminate a corporation's dividends-received deduction on a dividend from a 10%-owned domestic corporation?
o: The corporation held the stock for only 30 days during the 91-day period beginning 45 days before the ex-dividend date (no DRD at all), OR the stock was purchased with borrowed funds (debt-financed portfolio stock), which reduces the DRD by the average indebtedness percentage.
The dividend was paid in cash rather than property.
The corporation held the stock for 60 days during the 121-day period around the ex-dividend date.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】"股息套利"（除息前买入、除息后卖出）正是持有期规则要防止的。

【DRD 限制】
① 持有期（Sec.246(c)）：普通股须在除息日前 45 天开始的 91 天内持有 超过 45 天（优先股：181 天内超过 90 天）→ 不满足则 无 DRD
② 债务融资组合股票（Sec.246A）：持股 <50% 且用借款购入 → DRD 比例 × (1 − 平均负债比例)
③ 非常规股息（Sec.1059）：持有 ≤2 年且股息超过门槛 → 股票 Basis 减去 DRD 未课税部分

【比例】<20%：50%；20%–<80%：65%；≥80%（同一关联集团）：100%
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：The corporation held the stock for only 30 days during the 91-day period beginning 45 days before the ex-dividend date (no DRD at all), OR the stock was purchased with borrowed funds (debt-financed portfolio stock), which reduces the DRD by the average indebtedness percentage.
qs.tp: T05.5.2 持有期与债务融资 DRD-Holding-Debt-Financing

qs.s: A calendar-year accrual-basis C corporation's board authorizes a $40,000 charitable contribution on December 20, Year 1, and pays it on March 20, Year 2. The corporation also has a $10,000 contribution carryover from a prior year. Which statement is correct?
o: Accrued charitable contributions are never deductible by corporations.

The corporation may elect to deduct the $40,000 in Year 1 because the board authorized it during Year 1 and it was paid within 3½ months after year-end; in applying the 10%-of-taxable-income limit, current-year contributions are deducted before carryovers, and any excess carries forward 5 years.
Carryovers are always deducted before current-year contributions.
The $40,000 is deductible only in Year 2, when paid.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】个人纳税人不适用"授权 + 事后支付"规则——个人只能在实际支付当年扣除。

【权责发生制公司的特殊时点规则】董事会在年内授权 + 次年 3½ 个月内（日历年公司为 4 月 15 日前）支付 → 可选择在授权年度扣除

【10% 限额】应税所得（扣除慈善、DRD、NOL 回溯（carryback）、资本损失回溯之前；NOL 向后结转仍需扣除）× 10%
【顺序】先扣当年捐赠，再扣以前年度结转（FIFO）；超额结转 5 年
【OBBBA】自 2026 年起，公司慈善扣除另设 1% 应税所得下限（低于下限部分不可扣除），题目会给出适用口径
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：The corporation may elect to deduct the $40,000 in Year 1 because the board authorized it during Year 1 and it was paid within 3½ months after year-end; in applying the 10%-of-taxable-income limit, current-year contributions are deducted before carryovers, and any excess carries forward 5 years.
qs.tp: T05.5.3 慈善限额与扣除时点 Charity-Limits-Timing

qs.s: In 2026, a calendar-year C corporation incurs $100,000 of domestic research and experimental (R&E) expenditures and $30,000 of foreign R&E expenditures. Under current law, which treatment is correct?
o: The $100,000 of domestic R&E may be deducted currently (restored by OBBBA for tax years beginning after 2024); the $30,000 of foreign R&E must still be capitalized and amortized over 15 years using a midpoint convention (year-one amortization $1,000).
Both amounts must be capitalized and amortized over 5 years.
Domestic R&E is amortized over 15 years; foreign R&E is deductible currently.
qs.x:
【🚨 提示】这是 2026 年考期新近可测的 OBBBA 内容，关注"国内 vs 国外"的不对称。

【Sec.174 的变迁】

期间国内 R&E国外 R&E
2022–2024（TCJA）5 年摊销15 年摊销
2025 起（OBBBA，Sec.174A）可当期扣除（也可选择资本化 60 个月以上摊销）仍 15 年摊销
  • 国外 R&E 首年摊销（年中惯例）= $30,000 ÷ 15 × ½ = $1,000
【过渡】小企业（平均总收入不超过门槛）可选择追溯修改 2022–2024 年申报以费用化；其余纳税人可选择在 2025（或 2025–2026）年加速扣除 2022–2024 年尚未摊销的国内 R&E 余额
  • 软件开发费用视为 R&E
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：The $100,000 of domestic R&E may be deducted currently (restored by OBBBA for tax years beginning after 2024); the $30,000 of foreign R&E must still be capitalized and amortized over 15 years using a midpoint convention (year-one amortization $1,000).
qs.tp: T05.6.1 研发费用与抵免 Research-Expenses-Credits

qs.s:
• A C corporation (not a small business taxpayer) has operating income before R&E, depreciation, and interest of $500,000
  • deductible domestic R&E of $100,000
  • depreciation of $30,000
  • and business interest expense of $200,000. It has no business interest income. Under current law (tax years after 2024), how much interest is deductible?
o: $120,000 — ATI adds back depreciation: taxable income before interest $370,000 + depreciation $30,000 = $400,000; 30% × $400,000 = $120,000; $80,000 carries forward indefinitely.
qs.x:
【🚨 合伙企业】超额业务利息在合伙人层面结转（Excess Business Interest Expense），且会减少 Outside Basis。

【Sec.163(j) 限额】= 业务利息收入 + 30% × ATI + 车辆库存融资利息

【ATI】= 应税所得（不含业务利息、NOL、199A）加回折旧、摊销、耗减（OBBBA 对 2024 年后的纳税年度永久恢复 EBITDA 口径）
  • 利息前应税所得 = $500,000 − $100,000 − $30,000 = $370,000
  • ATI = $370,000 + $30,000 = $400,000
  • 限额 = 30% × $400,000 = $120,000；超额 $80,000 无限期结转
  • 2022–2024 的 EBIT 口径：30% × $370,000 = $111,000（选项A，为旧法）
【豁免】过去 3 年平均总收入不超过门槛的小企业（避税型企业除外）；可选择的不动产/农业企业（须改用 ADS 折旧）
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：$120,000 — ATI adds back depreciation: taxable income before interest $370,000 + depreciation $30,000 = $400,000; 30% × $400,000 = $120,000; $80,000 carries forward indefinitely.
qs.tp: T05.6.2 经营利息限额 Business-Interest-Limitation

qs.s: A C corporation using the cash method finds that its average annual gross receipts for the prior 3 years now exceed the small business threshold, so it must change to the accrual method. The change produces a net positive (income-increasing) Sec. 481(a) adjustment of $80,000. How is the adjustment reported? What if the adjustment had been negative?
o: Positive: generally spread ratably over 4 years ($20,000 per year) for an IRS-approved (automatic) change; Negative: deducted entirely in the year of change.
Positive: $80,000 in the year of change. Negative: spread over 4 years.
No adjustment is required when a change is mandatory.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】正向与负向的处理不对称 —— 国会给纳税人的"缓冲"。

【Sec.481(a)】会计方法变更时，为避免收入/费用重复或遗漏而做的"追补调整"

  • 正向（增加收入）：一般分 4 年平均确认 → 每年 $20,000（有利于纳税人）
  • 负向（减少收入）：变更当年一次性扣除
  • 小于 $50,000 的正向调整可选择一年确认
【现金制资格（Sec.448）】C 公司、有 C 公司合伙人的合伙企业：过去 3 年平均总收入不超过门槛（按年调整，题目会给出）才可用现金制；避税型企业（Tax Shelter）一律不可

【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：Positive: generally spread ratably over 4 years ($20,000 per year) for an IRS-approved (automatic) change; Negative: deducted entirely in the year of change.

Only S corporations qualify for these exceptions.
None — manufacturers must always use accrual accounting, full UNICAP, and the percentage-of-completion method.

It may use the cash method, is exempt from the Sec. 263A UNICAP rules, may treat inventory as non-incidental materials and supplies or follow its financial statement method, and may use the completed-contract method for small construction contracts expected to finish within 2 years.

【满足 448(c) 总收入测试的小企业可享受】
① 现金制（即使有存货）
② UNICAP（Sec.263A）豁免：不必把间接成本资本化进存货

qs.s: Five unrelated individuals each own 20% of both Alpha Corp and Beta Corp (identical ownership). Which statement is correct?
o: Alpha and Beta are treated as completely separate taxpayers for all purposes.
Brother-sister groups exist only if one corporation owns the other.

They are a brother-sister controlled group (5 or fewer individuals own at least 80% and more than 50% on an identical-ownership basis). Members must share certain limits and aggregate certain tests — e.g., the Sec. 179 dollar limit, the accumulated earnings credit, and gross receipts for the small business (cash method, 163(j), UNICAP) tests.
They must file a consolidated return.
qs.x:
【🚨 目的】防止把一个企业拆成多家公司来重复享受限额。

【受控集团类型】

  • 母子：母公司持有子公司 ≥80% 表决权或价值
  • 兄弟姐妹：≤5 名个人/遗产/信托 ① 合计持有 ≥80% ② 相同持股部分 >50%
  • 本题：每人在两家公司相同持股 20% × 5 = 100% ✔
【后果】共享/汇总：179 限额、AET 抵免额（$250,000/$150,000）、小企业总收入测试、部分退休计划覆盖测试
  • 与合并申报不同：兄弟姐妹集团不能合并申报（合并申报需要公司之间的 80% 持股链）
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：They are a brother-sister controlled group (5 or fewer individuals own at least 80% and more than 50% on an identical-ownership basis). Members must share certain limits and aggregate certain tests — e.g., the Sec. 179 dollar limit, the accumulated earnings credit, and gross receipts for the small business (cash method, 163(j), UNICAP) tests.

qs.s: Which corporation is most likely subject to the corporate alternative minimum tax enacted by the Inflation Reduction Act?
o: Any S corporation with more than 100 shareholders.
A closely held C corporation with $50 million of annual taxable income.
Every C corporation that uses bonus depreciation.

A C corporation whose average annual adjusted financial statement income (AFSI) over the prior 3 years exceeds $1 billion; it pays 15% of AFSI (less CAMT foreign tax credits) to the extent that exceeds its regular tax plus BEAT, and the excess generates a credit carryforward.
qs.x:
【🚨 TCP 考法】多为定性判断（谁适用），S 公司不适用，AFSI 未达门槛的闭锁 C 公司不适用。

【CAMT（Sec.55，2023 年起）】

  • 适用：过去 3 年平均 AFSI（调整后财务报表收入）> $10 亿 的"适用公司"（外国母公司集团另有较低门槛）
  • 税额 = 15% × AFSI − CAMT 外国税收抵免；超过常规税（+ BEAT）的部分为应缴 CAMT
  • 已缴 CAMT → 最低税抵免，可无限期结转抵减未来常规税
  • 与 TCJA 自 2018 年起废除的旧公司 AMT 不同：以财务报表收入为基础（折旧等有特定调整）
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：A C corporation whose average annual adjusted financial statement income (AFSI) over the prior 3 years exceeds $1 billion; it pays 15% of AFSI (less CAMT foreign tax credits) to the extent that exceeds its regular tax plus BEAT, and the excess generates a credit carryforward.

qs.s: A calendar-year corporation elects out of bonus depreciation and does not claim Sec. 179. In 2026 it places in service: 7-year machinery costing $100,000 in February, 7-year equipment costing $150,000 in November, and a $1,000,000 nonresidential building in December. What is its 2026 MACRS depreciation on the machinery and equipment? (7-year mid-quarter rates: Q1 25.00%, Q4 3.57%; half-year rate 14.29%.)
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】不动产不参与 40% 测试；在年末集中采购设备是触发 MQ 的典型场景（使用 bonus 时影响通常很小）。

【Step 1：40% 测试】只计算动产（剔除不动产及已按 179 扣除的部分）

  • 第 4 季度投入 $150,000 ÷ 动产合计 $250,000 = 60% > 40% → 全部动产适用年中季度惯例
【Step 2：计算】
  • 2 月机器：$100,000 × 25.00% = $25,000
  • 11 月设备：$150,000 × 3.57% = $5,355
  • 合计 $30,355（建筑按 39 年年中月惯例单独计算，不影响测试）
【干扰项】选项A 用半年惯例（14.29% × $250,000）；选项C 只算了机器；选项D 把 Q1 费率套用到全部资产
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：第 4 季度投入的动产占 60%，触发年中季度惯例：$25,000 + $5,355 = $30,355。

qs.s: In 2026 Beta LLC places in service $4,300,000 of Sec. 179 property. The 2026 Sec. 179 dollar limit is $2,560,000 and the investment phase-out threshold is $4,090,000. Beta's taxable income from active trades or businesses (before Sec. 179) is $1,500,000. If Beta elects the maximum Sec. 179 amount, what is its 2026 Sec. 179 deduction and carryforward?
o: Deduction $1,500,000; the remaining $850,000 is permanently lost.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】合伙企业/S 公司的 179 限额在实体与所有者两个层面都要测试；2026 年限额 $2,560,000 / $4,090,000（Rev. Proc. 2025-32）。

【Step 1：投资额递减】$4,300,000 − $4,090,000 = $210,000 → 限额降至 $2,560,000 − $210,000 = $2,350,000

  • 被递减掉的 $210,000 不能结转（但该资产仍可用 bonus/MACRS 回收）
【Step 2：营业收入限制】179 扣除不得超过当年积极营业应税所得 $1,500,000 → 当年扣 $1,500,000
【Step 3】已选择但因收入限制未扣的 $850,000 无限期结转
【干扰项】选项A 忽略递减与收入限制；选项B 忽略收入限制；选项D 把可结转部分当成永久丧失
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：限额先递减至 $2,350,000，再受营业收入 $1,500,000 限制，其余 $850,000 结转。
qs.tp: T05.7.2 即期费用化限额 Section-179-Limits

qs.s: Under OBBBA, which statement about bonus depreciation for 2025–2026 is correct?
o: Property acquired after January 19, 2025 (with no binding written contract entered into before January 20, 2025) qualifies for 100% bonus depreciation permanently; property acquired under a binding contract entered into before January 20, 2025 but placed in service in 2025 is limited to 40%.
Bonus depreciation phases down to 20% in 2026 under the TCJA schedule.
Bonus depreciation is available only for new (not used) property.
Bonus depreciation, like Sec. 179, is limited to business taxable income.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】判断看"取得日（有约束力合同签署日）"，不是投入使用日。

【OBBBA Sec.168(k) 变化】

  • 2025/1/19 之后取得的合格财产 → 永久 100%（TCJA 递减表对其不再适用，选项B错）
  • 2025/1/20 前已签署有约束力合同取得的财产 → 仍按旧表（2025 年投入使用为 40%）
  • 二手财产：纳税人此前未使用、且非从关联方取得 → 同样合格（选项C错）
  • 不受营业收入限制，可产生或扩大 NOL（选项D错）；可按资产类别选择不适用
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：2025/1/19 之后取得的财产永久适用 100% bonus；此前签约取得的财产按 40% 计算。
qs.tp: T05.7.3 百分百加速折旧 Bonus-Depreciation-Acquisition

qs.s: A startup S corporation has a 2026 business loss before depreciation and buys $300,000 of new equipment. The owners want the largest 2026 deduction, and business use will remain above 50%. Which approach is best?
o: Sec. 179, because it can create a loss that passes through to the shareholders.
Regular MACRS only, because both expensing methods are unavailable in loss years.
Sec. 179 for all $300,000, with nothing carried forward.

100% bonus depreciation: unlike Sec. 179, bonus is not limited by business taxable income and can create or increase a loss (subject to shareholder basis, at-risk, PAL, and EBL limits); a Sec. 179 deduction in excess of business income would merely carry forward.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】S 公司穿透的亏损在股东层面仍须通过 Basis → At-Risk → PAL → EBL 四层测试。

【Bonus vs 179】

BonusSec.179
营业收入限制无 → 可产生亏损有 → 超额结转
美元上限/投资递减无有
选择方式默认适用，可按类别退出逐项资产选择
业务使用 ≤50% 回收列名财产适用适用
  • 亏损年度用 179 只会形成结转（选项A、C错）；两者在亏损年度都并非不可用（选项B错）
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：亏损年度应使用 bonus：它不受营业收入限制，可直接形成亏损穿透给股东。

qs.s: In 2027 Mfg Corp places in service a new factory (construction began in March 2025) used in manufacturing; 15% of the floor space is administrative offices. Which statement about the OBBBA qualified production property (QPP) election under Sec. 168(n) is correct?
o: The entire building cost may be deducted 100% because the building is nonresidential real property.
QPP applies only to equipment used in manufacturing.

If elected, the 85% of the building used as an integral part of a qualified production activity may be deducted 100% in the placed-in-service year; the office portion is depreciated over 39 years; and if the property ceases to be used in a qualified production activity within 10 years, recapture as ordinary income applies.
QPP treatment is available only for buildings acquired from related parties.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】出租给他人使用的建筑物一般不合格——须由纳税人自己用于生产。

【Sec.168(n) 合格生产用房产】

  • 非住宅不动产中作为合格生产活动（制造、生产、精炼有形动产）组成部分的部分 → 可选择 100% 首年扣除
  • 时间：2025/1/19 之后、2029 年之前开工；2031 年之前投入使用；须由纳税人首次使用
  • 排除部分：办公、行政、住宿、停车、销售、研发、软件开发、工程设计 → 仍按 39 年直线法（选项A错）
  • 10 年内停止用于合格生产 → 回收为普通收入
  • 适用对象是建筑物，不是设备（设备适用 bonus，选项B错）；关联方取得反而通常不合格（选项D错）
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：只有用于合格生产活动的 85% 部分可 100% 扣除，办公部分 39 年折旧，10 年内改变用途须回收。

qs.s: An individual buys a residential rental property for $350,000 ($75,000 of which is allocable to land) and places it in service on July 10, 2026. What is the 2026 depreciation deduction?
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】土地永不折旧；住宅出租 27.5 年、非住宅 39 年，均为直线法 + 年中月惯例，不适用 bonus（合格改良除外）。

【Step 1】可折旧 Basis = $350,000 − 土地 $75,000 = $275,000

【Step 2】年折旧 = $275,000 ÷ 27.5 = $10,000
【Step 3：年中月惯例】7 月投入 → 当年 5.5 个月 → $10,000 × 5.5/12 = $4,583（按公式；IRS 表 A-6 7 月费率 1.667% 为 $4,584）
【干扰项】选项A 按整年；选项C 按 6 个月（忽略年中月惯例）；选项D 把土地也计入折旧
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：扣除土地后 $275,000 ÷ 27.5 = $10,000/年，按年中月惯例 5.5 个月得 $4,583。
qs.tp: T05.7.1 年中季与不动产惯例 Depreciation-Conventions-Tests

qs.s: Newco, a calendar-year corporation, incurs $53,000 of start-up expenditures and begins business on July 1, 2026. What is the maximum 2026 deduction for these start-up costs?
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】摊销从"开始营业"的月份起算，不是从发生费用或成立公司的月份起算。

【Sec.195】

  • 当期扣除 = $5,000 − (总额 $53,000 − $50,000) = $2,000
  • 剩余 $51,000 ÷ 180 个月 × 6 个月（7–12 月）= $1,700
  • 合计 $3,700
【干扰项】选项B 未做 $5,000 递减（$5,000 + $48,000 ÷ 180 × 6）；选项C 漏了摊销；选项D 只写了未递减的当期额
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：当期扣除递减为 $2,000，其余 $51,000 按 180 个月从开业月起摊销 6 个月 $1,700，合计 $3,700。

qs.s: Which cost of a newly formed corporation is an organizational expenditure under Sec. 248?
o: Commissions paid to an underwriter to sell the corporation's stock.
Salaries paid to train employees before the business opens.
Legal fees for drafting the corporate charter and bylaws, and state incorporation fees.
The cost of acquiring the building the corporation will operate from.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】股票发行成本是最常见的陷阱：它既不是组建费，也不能在清算时扣除。

【分类】

  • 组建费（Sec.248）：章程/细则起草律师费、州注册费、组建会议、临时董事会费用 → 选项C
  • 开办费（Sec.195）：开业前培训、市场调研、开业广告 → 选项B
  • 股票发行成本：承销佣金、印刷招股书 → 永不扣除或摊销，冲减实收资本 → 选项A
  • 资产购置成本 → 资本化计入资产并折旧 → 选项D
  • 组建费与开办费各自享有 $5,000 当期扣除 / $50,000 递减 / 180 个月摊销
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：起草章程细则的律师费与州注册费属于 Sec.248 组建费。
qs.tp: T05.8.2 组建费与发行成本 Organization-Issuance-Costs

qs.s: A partnership incurs $12,000 of organizational costs, $40,000 of start-up costs, and $25,000 of costs to market and sell partnership interests to investors (syndication costs). How are the syndication costs treated?
o: Deducted immediately up to $5,000, with the rest amortized over 180 months.
Amortized over 15 years as a Sec. 197 intangible.
Deducted when the partnership liquidates, like unamortized organizational costs.
They are never deductible or amortizable, even on liquidation, and are simply capitalized; the organizational and start-up costs are each eligible for the separate $5,000/180-month rules.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】与公司的股票发行成本一样，合伙企业的"融资成本"都不能扣除。

【Sec.709】

  • 组建费 $12,000 → $5,000 当期 + $7,000 按 180 个月摊销
  • 开办费 $40,000 → $5,000 当期 + $35,000 按 180 个月摊销
  • 辛迪加费用（募集、销售合伙权益的成本）→ 永不扣除或摊销（选项A、B错）
  • 合伙企业在摊销完毕前清算：未摊销的组建费/开办费可在最终年度扣除，但辛迪加费用仍不可扣（选项C错）
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：辛迪加费用永远不能扣除或摊销，即使清算也不行；组建费与开办费各自适用 $5,000/180 个月规则。
qs.tp: T05.8.2 组建费与发行成本 Organization-Issuance-Costs

qs.s: A corporation incurs $60,000 of start-up expenditures and begins business on October 1, 2026 (calendar year). What is its 2026 deduction?
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】$50,000 递减是"一元对一元"：$55,000 以上的开办费没有任何当期扣除。

【Step 1】当期扣除 = $5,000 − ($60,000 − $50,000) = $5,000 − $10,000 → $0（总额 ≥ $55,000 时完全消失）

【Step 2】全部 $60,000 ÷ 180 × 3 个月（10–12 月）= $1,000
【干扰项】选项A 忽略递减；选项C 未做递减（$5,000 + $55,000 ÷ 180 × 3）；选项D 按 12 个月摊销
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：总额超过 $55,000，当期扣除为 $0，只能从 10 月起摊销 3 个月：$1,000。

qs.s: Large Corp (taxable income over $1 million in each of the past three years) had a 2025 tax liability of $800,000 and expects 2026 tax of $1,200,000 (calendar year). What are the minimum required first and second 2026 estimated tax installments to avoid the underpayment penalty (no annualization)?
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】公司没有个人的"90%/110%"规则——当年安全港是 100%；年化法和季节性收入法可降低早期分期。

【公司预估税安全港（Sec.6655）】

  • 一般公司：100% × 当年税额，或 100% × 上年税额（上年须为 12 个月且有税额）
  • 大公司（前 3 年任一年应税所得 ≥ $1,000,000）：上年安全港只能用于第 1 期
  • 第 1 期 = 25% × $800,000 = $200,000
  • 第 2 期须补齐：25% × $1,200,000 × 2 − $200,000 = $400,000；之后每期 $300,000
  • 日历年公司缴款日：4/15、6/15、9/15、12/15
【干扰项】选项B 把上年安全港用于全部 4 期；选项C、D 未利用第 1 期的上年安全港
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：大公司第 1 期可按上年税额的 25% 缴 $200,000，第 2 期须补缴差额，共 $400,000。

【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：C 公司 4/15（延至 10/15），合伙与 S 公司 3/15（延至 9/15），1041 为 4/15（延至 9/30），990 为 5/15（延至 11/15）。

qs.s: Which statement about Schedules L, M-1, M-2, and M-3 of Form 1120 is correct?
o: Every corporation must file Schedule M-3 regardless of size.
Schedule M-1 reconciles beginning and ending retained earnings.
A corporation with total assets of $12 million at year-end files Schedule M-1 and may skip Schedule M-3.

A corporation with total assets of $10 million or more at year-end must file Schedule M-3 instead of Schedule M-1; Schedule M-2 analyzes unappropriated retained earnings; and corporations with total receipts and total assets under $250,000 need not complete Schedules L, M-1, and M-2.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】M-1 从账面净利润出发、终点是应税所得；M-2 从期初未分配留存收益出发，加账面净利润、减分配与其他减少，终点是期末未分配留存收益。

【各附表作用】

  • Schedule L：账面资产负债表
  • M-1：账面净利润 → 应税所得的调节
  • M-2：未分配留存收益的变动分析（选项B把 M-1 与 M-2 弄混了）
  • M-3：年末总资产 ≥ $10,000,000 的公司以 M-3 代替 M-1（更详细地区分永久/暂时差异）；资产 $10M–$50M 的公司须填 M-3 Part I，可用 M-1 代替 Part II/III → 选项A、C错
  • 总收入与总资产均 < $250,000 的公司可不填 L、M-1、M-2
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：总资产 $10,000,000 以上以 M-3 代替 M-1；M-2 分析留存收益；小公司可免填 L/M-1/M-2。
qs.tp: T05.1.3 附表门槛与功能 Schedules-Filing-Thresholds

qs.s:
• Gamma Corp's unappropriated retained earnings per books were $500,000 at the beginning of 2026. During 2026: net income per books $392,000
  • cash dividends $150,000
  • a stock dividend recorded at $50,000
  • an appropriation of retained earnings for plant expansion $40,000
  • and a refund of prior-year federal income tax credited directly to retained earnings $10,000. What is ending unappropriated retained earnings on Schedule M-2?
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】拨定（appropriation）会减少"未分配"留存收益，虽然总留存收益不变——M-2 只追踪未分配部分。

【M-2 滚动】

项目金额
期初未分配留存收益500,000
+ 账面净利润392,000
+ 其他增加：以前年度税款退回10,000
− 现金股利(150,000)
− 股票股利(50,000)
− 其他减少：留存收益拨定（扩建储备）(40,000)
期末662,000
【干扰项】选项A 漏了拨定；选项B 漏了股票股利；选项D 漏了税款退回
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：$500,000 + $392,000 + $10,000 − $150,000 − $50,000 − $40,000 = $662,000。
qs.tp: T05.1.4 留存收益滚动 Retained-Earnings-Rollforward

qs.s: Newer Corp had a net operating loss (and $0 of tax) in 2025, its first full 12-month year, and expects 2026 tax of $400,000. Its taxable income has never reached $1 million. What is the minimum 2026 estimated tax required to avoid the underpayment penalty (ignoring annualization)?
o: $400,000 — the prior-year safe harbor is unavailable when the prior year showed no tax liability (or was a short year), so 100% of current-year tax is required, paid in four $100,000 installments.
$360,000 — 90% of current-year tax, as for individuals.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】新设公司的第一个纳税年度通常是短年度，第二年同样不能使用上年安全港。

【上年安全港的前提】上年须为 12 个月纳税年度，且申报表显示正数税额

  • 2025 年税额为 $0 → 上年安全港不可用（选项A错）
  • 只能用当年 100%（公司没有 90% 或 110% 规则，选项C、D错）→ $400,000，每期 $100,000
  • 年化收入法或季节性收入法可降低早期分期
  • 应纳税额低于 $500 的公司无须预缴
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：上年税额为 $0 时不能用上年安全港，须按当年税额 100% 预缴 $400,000。
qs.tp: T05.9.1 公司预估税安全港 Corporate-Estimated-Tax-Safe-Harbors

qs.s: Pat owns 0.0010% of the stock of a widely held public corporation and has no control over its affairs. In a tender offer, the corporation redeems some of Pat's shares, reducing his interest to 0.0009%. The corporation has ample E&P. How is the redemption treated?
o: A dividend, because the redemption fails the substantially disproportionate test.
A dividend, because redemptions by public corporations are always dividends.
An exchange, because it is a complete termination of Pat's interest.

An exchange under Sec. 302(b)(1): although it fails Sec. 302(b)(2) (0.0009% is 90% of his prior interest, not less than 80%), any reduction in the interest of a small minority shareholder with no control is a 'meaningful reduction' and is not essentially equivalent to a dividend.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】(b)(1) 是兜底测试：闭锁公司中若赎回后仍保持控制（含 318 归属），几乎不可能通过；上市公司小股东则通常能通过。

【302(b)(2) 测试】赎回后比例 0.0009% ÷ 赎回前 0.0010% = 90% → 不低于 80% → 失败

【302(b)(1)"实质上不等同于股息"】须有持股比例的有意义减少（Davis 案）
  • Rev. Rul. 76-385：上市公司中持股极少、无控制权的少数股东，任何比例下降都属于有意义减少 → 出售待遇
  • 考虑因素：投票权、分红权、清算权的变化；是否失去或接近失去控制
【干扰项】选项A 只看 (b)(2)；选项B 上市公司没有这种一律规则；选项C Pat 仍持有股票，不是完全终止
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：未通过 (b)(2) 的 80% 测试，但对无控制权的小股东而言任何比例下降都是有意义的减少，依 (b)(1) 按出售处理。
qs.tp: T05.4.2 有意义持股减少 Meaningful-Ownership-Reduction

qs.s:
X Corp has 100 shares outstanding:

  • Alice owns 40
  • ABC Partnership (in which Alice is a 50% partner) owns 20
  • Y Corp (in which Alice owns 40% of the stock) owns 20
  • and unrelated persons own 20. Alice also holds an option to buy 5 shares from an unrelated shareholder. For Sec. 318 purposes, how many X shares does Alice own (actually and constructively)?
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】向下归属（所有者 → 实体）规则不同：合伙企业从合伙人处取得合伙人全部持股；公司只从持股 ≥50% 的股东处取得其全部持股。

【Sec.318 实体归属（向上：实体 → 所有者）】

  • 合伙企业 → 合伙人：按比例 → 50% × 20 = 10
  • 公司 → 股东：只有持股 ≥ 50%（按价值）才按比例归属 → Alice 仅 40% → 0
  • 遗产/信托 → 受益人：按精算比例
【期权归属（318(a)(4)）】持有购股期权视同拥有该股票 → 5
【合计】40 + 10 + 0 + 5 = 55
【干扰项】选项A 把 Y Corp 的 40% 也归属（+8）；选项C 忽略期权；选项D 把合伙企业持股全部归属给 Alice
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：实际 40 股 + 合伙企业按比例 10 股 + 期权 5 股 = 55 股；Alice 持有 Y Corp 不足 50%，不从 Y Corp 归属。
qs.tp: T05.4.4 实体家族期权归属 Stock-Attribution-Rules

qs.s: Lee owns 100% of P Corp, and P owns 100% of S Corp; both corporations have substantial E&P. Lee sells 10% of his P stock (basis $30,000) to S for $100,000 cash. How is the transaction treated?
o: A sale of P stock producing a $70,000 capital gain.

A distribution in redemption of the P stock that is tested under Sec. 302 with respect to P; Lee still owns 100% of P (90% directly and 10% through S by attribution), so it fails all Sec. 302(b) tests and the $100,000 is a dividend, sourced first from S's E&P and then from P's E&P.
A dividend to the extent of P's E&P only.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】304 同时适用于兄弟姐妹公司（(a)(1)）和母子公司（(a)(2)），股息来源规则相同：先收购公司、后发行公司。

【Sec.304(a)(2) 母子公司情形】子公司用财产收购母公司股票 → 视为母公司（发行公司）赎回其股票

【302 测试（以 P 为准）】
  • 交易前：Lee 持 P 100%
  • 交易后：直接 90% + 通过 S 间接 10%（S 持有的 P 股票按 318 向上归属 → Lee 持 S 100%）= 100% → 所有 302(b) 测试失败
【股息来源（304(b)(2)）】先按收购公司（S）的 E&P，再按发行公司（P）的 E&P
【干扰项】选项A 按出售处理；选项C 304 优先于 351；选项D 忽略先用 S 的 E&P
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：Sec.304(a)(2) 下视为 P 赎回，Lee 仍拥有 100%，按股息处理，先出自 S 的 E&P、再出自 P 的 E&P。
qs.tp: T05.4.6 受控公司间售股 Related-Corporation-Stock-Sales

qs.s: NewTech, a 2-year-old C corporation with $2 million of gross receipts this year, has a $300,000 research credit under Sec. 41 but no income tax liability. Which statement is correct?
o: The credit is lost because the corporation has no income tax.

As a qualified small business (gross receipts under $5 million and no gross receipts before the 5-year period ending with this year), NewTech may elect on a timely filed return to apply up to $500,000 of the credit against its employer payroll taxes (up to $250,000 against the employer's Social Security tax and up to $250,000 against the employer's Medicare tax); an elected amount exceeding a quarter's payroll tax carries to the next quarter, and any credit not elected for the payroll offset remains a general business credit (1-year carryback, 20-year carryforward).
The credit is refundable in cash immediately.
The credit can offset only the employees' share of FICA taxes.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】初创公司常年亏损、没有所得税可抵——工资税抵减是让研发抵免"变现"的关键筹划点。

【Sec.41(h) 合格小企业工资税抵减】

  • 条件：当年总收入 < $5,000,000，且在截至当年的 5 个纳税年度之前没有总收入
  • 每年最多 $500,000：其中最多 $250,000 抵雇主社保税，2023 年起新增的 $250,000 只能抵雇主 Medicare 税 → 选项D错
  • 选择用于工资税的抵免超过当季工资税时，结转至下一季度
  • 须在及时提交（含延期）的申报表上以 Form 6765 选择
【一般商业抵免（Sec.39）】未用部分前溯 1 年、后转 20 年（选项A错）；并非现金退还（选项C错）
【与 Sec.174A 协调】研发费用扣除须按 280C(c) 减去抵免额，或选择减少的抵免额
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：合格小企业可选择以研发抵免抵减最多 $500,000 的雇主工资税（社保、Medicare 各最多 $250,000）；未选择用于工资税的部分仍为一般商业抵免，前溯 1 年、后转 20 年。
qs.tp: T05.6.1 研发费用与抵免 Research-Expenses-Credits

qs.s:
• In 2026 a calendar-year C corporation pays: $10,000 for business meals with clients
  • $6,000 for baseball tickets to entertain clients
  • $8,000 for a holiday party for all employees
  • $20,000 for meals in an on-premises cafeteria provided for the employer's convenience
  • and $3,000 for meals treated as taxable compensation on employees' W-2s. What is the total deduction for these items?
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】2026 年起雇主为便利提供的场内餐饮与员工餐厅费用完全不可扣除（OBBBA 对少数行业有例外）；娱乐自 2018 年起就不可扣。

【Sec.274 分类】

项目2026 年可扣比例可扣
与客户的商务餐50%5,000
招待客户的娱乐（球票）0%0
全员节日派对（员工娱乐）100%8,000

【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：商务餐 50%、娱乐 0%、全员派对 100%、2026 年起场内便利餐饮 0%、计入工资的餐费 100%，合计 $16,000。
