qs.s: A partnership agreement allocates 90% of tax losses to Partner A (a high-bracket individual) and only 10% to Partner B, even though A and B otherwise share all partnership profits, losses, and capital 50/50 under every other provision of the agreement. The agreement does NOT require partners to restore any deficit capital account balance upon liquidation, and losses allocated to A are projected to drive his capital account deeply negative with no realistic mechanism to require him to fund that deficit. For this special loss allocation to Partner A to be respected for tax purposes (rather than reallocated by the IRS according to the partners' overall interests in the partnership), what must be true?
o: The allocation is automatically valid as long as it is disclosed to the IRS in a required annual filing, regardless of capital account mechanics.
Special allocations of losses (as opposed to special allocations of income) are never permitted under any circumstances; losses must always follow the partners' general profit-sharing ratios.

The allocation must have 'Substantial Economic Effect' under Sec. 704(b) — generally requiring that capital accounts are maintained properly, liquidating distributions follow positive capital account balances, AND partners are obligated to restore any deficit capital account balance upon liquidation (a 'deficit restoration obligation'), OR the agreement contains a 'qualified income offset' provision combined with reasonable expectation that the allocation will not create or increase a capital account deficit beyond what the partner is obligated/expected to restore.
Special allocations are always automatically respected as written in the partnership agreement, regardless of economic substance, as long as all partners sign the agreement.
qs.x:
【🚨 高频陷阱】TCP 筹划题常问"如果本题的特殊分配被IRS依据PIP重新分配，对Partner A意味着什么"——通常意味着A原本想拿到的90%亏损抵税额度会被削减、按接近50%的"真实经济利益比例"重新计算，这正是"税务筹划设计不当、被IRS事后否定"的典型风险案例，提醒顾问在设计任何偏离出资比例的特殊分配条款时，必须同步确保资本账户机制和DRO/QIO条款的完整配套，不能只在协议文字上"随便写写"。

【第一步：为什么"合伙协议怎么写就怎么算"这个直觉是错的】

  • 合伙税法允许合伙人之间不按出资比例、自由约定损益分配方式（这是Partnership相对Corporation最大的筹划灵活性优势之一），但这种自由不是无限制的——如果一项特殊分配纯粹是为了转移税务属性（比如把亏损集中分给最高边际税率的合伙人以最大化避税效果），而与该合伙人的真实经济利益承担完全脱节，IRS有权依据"合伙人整体经济利益比例（Partners' Interests in the Partnership, PIP）"重新分配，不承认协议上写的比例（选项A、D都错误地认为"写了/披露了就算数"）。
【第二步：Substantial Economic Effect（实质经济效果）测试的两大支柱】
  • ① Economic Effect（经济效果）要件，一般需满足：
  • 合伙企业为每位合伙人正确维护资本账户（Capital Account）（按税法规定的方法记录出资、分配份额的利润/亏损、实际分配等）；
  • 清算分配须严格按照资本账户余额分配（正资本账户余额多的人分得多）；
  • 最关键的一点：若某合伙人的资本账户因为分配到大额亏损而变为负数，该合伙人必须承担"赤字恢复义务"（Deficit Restoration Obligation, DRO）——即在合伙企业清算时，必须实际拿出真金白银把自己的负资本账户补平（偿还给合伙企业用于清偿债权人/其他合伙人）。
  • 本题 Partner A 被分配了远超其经济利益比例的90%巨额亏损，若协议没有要求他承担DRO，这种分配就没有真实的经济风险在背后支撑（A即使账面上"亏"了很多，也不需要真金白银承担后果）→ 不满足经济效果要件。
【第三步：替代路径 —— Qualified Income Offset（合格收入抵销条款）】
  • 若协议不设DRO，也可以通过约定"合格收入抵销条款"（一旦某合伙人资本账户出现意外负数，未来优先用该合伙人应得的收入/利得份额尽快把负数拉平）+ 合理预期该分配不会导致资本账户产生"超出预期、且无法及时用未来收入抵消"的赤字，来间接满足要求，但本题背景明确指出"没有现实机制能让A补足赤字"，进一步印证了这项分配存在被重新定性的重大风险。
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：特殊分配必须具备实质经济效果（SEET），满足资本账户维护、清算分配与赤字恢复等核心要件。
qs.tp: T07.3.1 实质经济效果 Substantial-Economic-Effect

qs.s: Same partnership as before (90% of losses allocated to Partner A, 50/50 otherwise), EXCEPT the agreement requires capital accounts to be maintained under the Sec. 704(b) regulations, liquidating distributions to follow positive capital account balances, and each partner to restore any deficit capital account balance on liquidation. Will the 90% loss allocation to A generally be respected?
o: No — loss allocations must always follow ownership percentages.

Yes — the three 'economic effect' requirements (proper capital accounts, liquidation per capital accounts, and an unconditional deficit restoration obligation) are met, so A bears the economic burden of the losses; the allocation is respected if the economic effect is also substantial (not merely tax-motivated shifting with offsetting allocations).
No — a deficit restoration obligation is never enough.
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题无 DRO → 很可能被按 PIP 重新分配；本题有 DRO → 原则上被尊重。

【Economic Effect 三要件】① 按 704(b) 维护资本账户 ② 清算按正资本账户分配 ③ 无条件赤字恢复义务（DRO）→ 本题全部满足

【Substantiality】还需"实质性"：若分配只是在短期内被反向分配抵消（Transitory allocations）或纯为降低合伙人整体税负而不改变经济结果，仍会被否定（因此选项A"自动被尊重、不论实质性"是错的）
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：Yes — the three 'economic effect' requirements (proper capital accounts, liquidation per capital accounts, and an unconditional deficit restoration obligation) are met, so A bears the economic burden of the losses; the allocation is respected if the economic effect is also substantial (not merely tax-motivated shifting with offsetting allocations).
qs.tp: T07.3.1 实质经济效果 Substantial-Economic-Effect

qs.s: Partner X contributes land to a partnership with an adjusted basis of $100,000 and FMV of $150,000 at contribution (a $50,000 built-in gain). The partnership later sells the land for $170,000. Total TAX gain = $170,000 - $100,000 = $70,000, while BOOK gain (post-contribution appreciation only) = $170,000 - $150,000 = $20,000. Under Sec. 704(c), the $50,000 pre-contribution built-in gain must be allocated to X, and the $20,000 post-contribution book gain is shared per the partnership agreement's general ratio (assume 50/50 with Partner Y). If the partnership uses the Traditional Method (no curative or remedial allocations), how is the total $70,000 TAX gain allocated between X and Y?
o: Y is allocated the full $50,000 built-in gain (as compensation for not having contributed appreciated property), and X and Y split the $20,000 post-contribution gain 50/50.
X is allocated the full $50,000 built-in gain PLUS 50% of the $20,000 post-contribution gain ($10,000), for a total of $60,000; Y is allocated the remaining 50% of post-contribution gain, $10,000.
X is allocated the entire $70,000 gain because all built-in AND post-contribution gain on contributed property always goes entirely to the contributing partner under the Traditional Method.
X and Y simply split the entire $70,000 gain 50/50 ($35,000 each), since Sec. 704(c) allocations are optional and the Traditional Method ignores pre-contribution built-in gain entirely.
qs.x:
【🚨 高频陷阱】① 本题特意区分了"税务口径总利得$70,000"与"账面口径新增利得$20,000"两个数字——很多考生会混淆"总利得该怎么分"和"新增利得该怎么分"，必须先做这个概念切割，再分别应用"强制内置增值全归贡献人"+"新增部分按比例分享"两条规则；② Traditional Method 存在"Ceiling Rule天花板"缺陷（例如出资的内置增值可折旧资产税基偏低，税务折旧不足以按账面折旧分配给非贡献合伙人；或内置亏损资产出售时税务损失不足）——本题若要进一步追问"如果触发了天花板规则扭曲，该用Curative还是Remedial方法解决"，则需要调用另一层知识（Remedial创设名义抵消项目、Curative挪用其他真实项目去抵消），这是与本题配套的进阶追问方向。

【第一步：Sec.704(c) 的核心强制要求】

  • 合伙人出资财产存在"内置增值"（Built-in Gain，出资日 FMV > 出资日 Tax Basis）时，这部分内置增值必须强制、100%分配给原贡献合伙人（本题为X），不能按合伙协议的一般利润分享比例分给其他合伙人——这是为了防止合伙人通过"出资增值资产、再把处置利得分给低税率的其他合伙人"来转移税务属性（选项A"分给Y"和选项D"平分不管内置增值"都违反了这一强制规则）。
【第二步：切分本题的两段利得】
  • 内置增值（Pre-contribution Built-in Gain） = 出资日 FMV $150,000 − 出资日 Tax Basis $100,000 = $50,000 → 强制全部分配给 X。
  • 出资后新增利得（Post-contribution Gain） = 出售价 $170,000 − 出资日 FMV $150,000 = $20,000 → 这部分是合伙企业持有期间新产生的经济增值，按合伙协议的一般利润分享比例（本题50/50）在全体合伙人间正常分配。
【第三步：Traditional Method 下的完整分配】
  • X：$50,000（强制内置增值） + $20,000 × 50%（出资后新增利得的一半） = $50,000 + $10,000 = $60,000。
  • Y：$20,000 × 50% = $10,000（Y只分享出资后新增的部分，完全不涉及X出资前就已存在的内置增值）。
  • 合计 $60,000 + $10,000 = $70,000，与总税务利得吻合。
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：出资财产内置增值（$50,000）必须 100% 分配给原贡献合伙人 X，出资后增值（$20,000）才按约定比例对半分摊。
qs.tp: T07.3.2 内置增值分配 Built-In-Gain-Allocation

qs.s:
• Partner X contributes equipment with FMV (book value) $200,000 and tax basis $30,000
  • Partner Y contributes $200,000 cash
  • they share 50/50. Assume (simplified) the equipment is depreciated straight-line over the same 5 remaining years for both book and tax: book depreciation $40,000/year, tax depreciation $6,000/year. Under the Traditional Method, how is tax depreciation allocated each year, and what would the Remedial Method do?
o: Traditional: all $6,000 to X because X contributed the property.
Traditional: X $3,000, Y $3,000. Remedial: no change.

Traditional: Y (noncontributing) should get tax depreciation equal to his $20,000 book share, but only $6,000 of tax depreciation exists, so the ceiling rule limits Y to $6,000 and X gets $0. Remedial: Y receives an additional $14,000 notional tax deduction, and X is allocated an offsetting $14,000 of notional ordinary income.
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题（PART-02）是出售土地，内置增值直接归 X；本题是折旧资产 → 天花板规则扭曲 → 三种方法差异显现。

【Traditional Method】非贡献合伙人（Y）应得税务折旧 = 其账面份额 50% × $40,000 = $20,000

  • 可分配的税务折旧总额只有 $6,000（Ceiling Rule）→ Y 得 $6,000，X 得 $0
  • 扭曲：Y 每年少得 $14,000 税务扣除，X 未来出售时反而承担更少 Gain
【Remedial Method】创设名义项目：Y 额外 $14,000 扣除，X 对应 $14,000 普通收入 → 税务与账面一致，合伙企业总应税所得不变
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：Traditional: Y (noncontributing) should get tax depreciation equal to his $20,000 book share, but only $6,000 of tax depreciation exists, so the ceiling rule limits Y to $6,000 and X gets $0. Remedial: Y receives an additional $14,000 notional tax deduction, and X is allocated an offsetting $14,000 of notional ordinary income.
qs.tp: T07.3.3 折旧天花板 Depreciation-Ceiling-Rule

qs.s: Partnership ABC has a valid Sec. 754 election in effect. Partner C sells her 1/3 partnership interest to incoming Partner D for $150,000 cash (fair value). At the time of sale, C's outside basis in the partnership interest was $90,000, and C's proportionate share of the partnership's total inside basis in its assets was $90,000 as well (i.e., no pre-existing basis disparity before this sale). After the sale, how is the Sec. 743(b) basis adjustment computed and applied, and who benefits from it?
o: The $60,000 adjustment permanently increases the SELLING partner's (C's) basis retroactively, benefiting C rather than the incoming partner D.

The Sec. 743(b) adjustment equals $60,000 ($150,000 - $90,000), but this adjustment is a special, partner-specific basis increase available ONLY to incoming Partner D on the partnership's books — it has no effect on the OTHER continuing partners' shares of inside basis, and typically no effect on D's own additional depreciation/gain calculations for the OTHER partners either; it exists solely to align D's own share of inside basis with what D actually paid, eliminating any built-in gain/loss D would otherwise inherit purely from a historical basis disparity unrelated to D's own purchase price.
No basis adjustment is available at all unless the partnership terminates and reforms, since Sec. 754 elections only apply to distributions, not to sales of partnership interests between partners.

The Sec. 743(b) adjustment equals $60,000 ($150,000 purchase price - $90,000 share of inside basis), and this adjustment increases the partnership's common inside basis in its assets for ALL partners equally, including the two partners who did not sell their interests.
qs.x:
【🚨 高频陷阱】① 不要把743(b)（权益转让触发，调整额专属买方个人）和734(b)（财产分配触发，调整额影响的是合伙企业对剩余留任合伙人的共同Inside Basis）搞混——两者虽然同属754选择的产物，但调整对象（专属个人 vs 共同基础）和触发场景（买卖 vs 分配）完全不同；② 选项A"调整归属于卖方C"是彻底错误的——C在出售时已经就"售价−自身Outside Basis"的差额确认了自己的资本利得（本题C出售价$150,000-其Outside Basis$90,000=$60,000 Gain，C已经就此纳税了），743(b)调整是买方D这边为了避免"重复承担"这笔已经被C纳过税的增值而设计的对称性配套机制，两者是交易的两端，不可混淆归属方。

【第一步：Sec.754选择涵盖的两种触发场景】

  • Sec.754选择一旦生效，会同时激活两套独立的基础调整机制：Sec.743(b)（针对合伙权益转让/继承场景）和 Sec.734(b)（针对合伙企业向合伙人分配财产场景）——本题属于前者（选项C"只适用于分配"是错误的）。
【第二步：计算 743(b) 调整额】
  • 调整额 = 新合伙人D实际支付的购买价（其取得的 Outside Basis）− D 按其新持股比例分摊到的合伙企业现有 Inside Basis份额。
  • 本题：D 支付 $150,000 购买C的1/3权益，而D据此分摊到的Inside Basis份额（承继C原有的那部分）= $90,000。
  • 743(b)调整额 = $150,000 − $90,000 = $60,000。
【第三步：743(b)调整的"专属性"—— 只属于买方新合伙人一人，不影响其他合伙人】
  • 这是本题的核心考点：743(b)调整不会改变合伙企业账簿上对全体合伙人公示的"共同Inside Basis"（选项D错误地把它当成了对所有合伙人一视同仁的普遍性调整）。
  • 该 $60,000 调整是一项只记在D一个人名下的、专属于D的"影子基础"（Special Basis Adjustment）——仅用于计算D自己未来从合伙企业分得的折旧扣除额、或D未来在合伙企业出售资产时应分摊的Gain/Loss，使这些计算结果精确反映"D自己实际支付了$150,000购买这份权益"这一事实，而不会让D被迫承担C（原合伙人）遗留下来的历史基础差异所带来的不公平税务后果。
  • 其余原有合伙人（未参与本次交易的第三位合伙人）的Inside Basis份额和相关税务计算，完全不受这次D的购买价影响。
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：准确刻画了743(b)调整"专属于新进合伙人个人、不扩散给其他合伙人"这一关键特性。
qs.tp: T07.8.1 受让人专属调整 Transferee-Special-Basis

qs.s: The partnership has a Sec. 754 election in effect. It distributes land (inside basis $100,000) to Pia in a nonliquidating distribution; because her remaining outside basis is only $70,000, her basis in the land is limited to $70,000. What Sec. 734(b) adjustment results?
o: None, because 734(b) applies only to sales of partnership interests.
The partnership INCREASES the basis of its remaining property by $30,000 (the basis 'lost' on the distribution), benefiting the continuing partners.
The partnership DECREASES the basis of its remaining property by $30,000.
Pia's land basis is increased to $100,000.
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题（PART-03）是转让权益 → 743(b)；本题是分配 → 734(b)。

【734(b) 触发】分配导致合伙人取得财产的 Basis 低于合伙企业原 Inside Basis（或合伙人确认了 Gain）

  • 被"压掉"的 $30,000 → 合伙企业对剩余资产普遍调增 $30,000
  • 受益者：所有留任合伙人（与 743(b) "专属于买方个人"不同）
【强制调整】即使无 754 选举：734 若"实质 Basis 减少" >$250,000，743 若合伙企业"实质内含亏损" >$250,000，均强制调整
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：The partnership INCREASES the basis of its remaining property by $30,000 (the basis 'lost' on the distribution), benefiting the continuing partners.
qs.tp: T07.8.2 分配后共同调整 Distribution-Common-Basis

qs.s: General Partner Gary is retiring from a service partnership (a law firm structured as a partnership, where capital is not a material income-producing factor). As part of his retirement package, the partnership agrees to pay him $500,000 total: $300,000 explicitly allocated in the partnership agreement as his share of the FMV of the partnership's tangible property (his 'property payments'), and $200,000 explicitly allocated as compensation for the firm's goodwill, which is NOT provided for in the partnership agreement as a payment for partnership property. How are the $300,000 and $200,000 payments respectively characterized under Sec. 736?
o: The $300,000 property payment is a Sec. 736(b) distribution (generally capital gain/loss treatment to Gary, reducing his outside basis); the $200,000 goodwill payment, because it is NOT provided for as a payment for partnership property under the partnership agreement (and this is a service partnership where capital is not a material income-producing factor), is treated under Sec. 736(a) as a guaranteed payment (or as a distributive share, depending on how computed) taxed to Gary as ORDINARY INCOME, and is deductible by the continuing partnership as a business expense.

Both payments are treated as Sec. 736(a) guaranteed payments taxed entirely as ordinary income to Gary, since Gary is a general partner and general partners never receive capital gain treatment on retirement payments.

Both the $300,000 and $200,000 are characterized identically as Sec. 736(b) liquidating distributions for partnership property, taxed to Gary as capital gain/loss (to the extent they exceed his outside basis).

The characterization depends solely on whether Gary was a general partner or limited partner at the time of the agreement's drafting, not on how the partnership agreement itself allocates the payments between property and goodwill.
qs.x:
【🚨 高频陷阱】① 选项D"完全看是普通合伙人还是有限合伙人"是错误的过度简化——合伙人身份只是法定三要件之一：依 Sec.736(b)(2)–(3)，须同时满足①服务型合伙企业（资本非重要创收因素）②退伙人为普通合伙人③合伙协议未约定商誉支付，商誉款才转入736(a)；有限合伙人退伙时的商誉款依法一律属于736(b)（法定规则，而非实务惯例）；② 这是TCP筹划题里常考"如何在退伙协议起草阶段，帮客户合理分配736(a)/(b)款项比例"的经典应用场景——对收款的退休合伙人而言，通常更偏好把款项定性为736(b)（享受较低的资本利得税率）；而对继续经营的合伙企业/留任合伙人而言，则更偏好把款项定性为736(a)（可以当期费用化扣除，降低留任合伙人自己的应税所得）——这种"退休人vs留任人"的利益天平在草拟协议条款时构成了典型的税务谈判焦点。

【第一步：区分 Sec.736(a) 与 Sec.736(b) 两类退伙合伙人款项】

  • Sec.736(b) —— "对合伙财产的支付"：视同该合伙人出售/清算处置其在合伙企业财产中的权益份额，通常按资本利得/损失处理（超过其Outside Basis的部分才是Gain）。
  • Sec.736(a) —— "超出财产份额之外的支付"：本质上被视为该退伙合伙人未来不再工作但仍从合伙企业获得的类似"薪酬/利润分配"性质的款项，对收款合伙人而言是普通收入（视同 Guaranteed Payment 或 分配份额，需缴纳自雇税），对继续经营的合伙企业而言则可作为营业费用直接扣除。
【第二步：Goodwill（商誉）款项归类的关键判断标准】
  • 商誉支付默认属于736(b)（视为财产的一部分）——除非同时满足三个条件（Sec.736(b)(2)–(3)）：① 该合伙企业是服务性合伙企业（资本不是重要创收因素）；② 退伙人是普通合伙人；③ 合伙协议未规定对商誉的支付（即未把商誉款约定为对合伙财产的支付）。
  • 本题恰好同时满足这三个条件（律所属于典型的服务性合伙企业 + Gary 为普通合伙人 + 协议未将商誉款约定为财产支付）→ 这 $200,000 商誉款项转为适用 Sec.736(a)，按普通收入处理。
【第三步：本题两笔款项的最终归类】
  • $300,000（对合伙有形财产份额的支付）→ Sec.736(b)，Gary 按资本利得/损失处理（超过其Outside Basis部分为Gain）。
  • $200,000（协议未约定为财产支付的商誉款）→ Sec.736(a)，Gary 按普通收入申报（并需缴纳自雇税），继续经营的合伙企业可将这笔支出作为营业费用扣除，降低合伙企业本身的应税所得。
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：合伙协议未明确保留商誉支付且属于服务型合伙企业时，针对商誉的支付作为 Sec. 736(a) 普通收入处理。
qs.tp: T07.6.4 退伙与商誉款 Retirement-Goodwill-Payments

qs.s: Same retirement package as Gary's ($300,000 for tangible property; $200,000 for goodwill not provided for in the agreement), EXCEPT the partnership is a manufacturing business in which capital is a material income-producing factor. How is the $200,000 goodwill payment treated?
o: Sec. 736(b): a payment for partnership property (capital gain treatment to Gary to the extent it exceeds basis), NOT deductible by the partnership — the special 736(a) rule for unstated goodwill applies only to service partnerships where capital is not material.
Treated as a gift to Gary.
Sec. 736(a): ordinary income to Gary, deductible by the partnership.
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】同样的协议条款，只因行业不同，定性完全相反。

【Sec.736(b)(3) 特殊规则适用条件】① 资本不是重要创收要素（服务型）② 退伙人为普通合伙人 → 未约定的商誉付款才转 736(a)

  • 本题是制造业，资本是重要创收要素 → 特殊规则不适用 → 商誉付款一律 736(b)
  • 结果：Gary 享受资本利得；合伙企业不能扣除
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：Sec. 736(b): a payment for partnership property (capital gain treatment to Gary to the extent it exceeds basis), NOT deductible by the partnership — the special 736(a) rule for unstated goodwill applies only to service partnerships where capital is not material.
qs.tp: T07.6.4 退伙与商誉款 Retirement-Goodwill-Payments

qs.s: Xia contributes land (FMV $200,000, basis $100,000) to a partnership. One year later the partnership distributes $100,000 cash to her; the distribution is not a guaranteed payment, preferred return, or operating cash flow distribution. What is the likely tax result?
o: The transfers are presumed a disguised sale (Sec. 707(a)(2)(B)): she is treated as selling 50% of the land ($100,000 / $200,000) for $100,000 with allocated basis of $50,000, recognizing a $50,000 gain; the other 50% is a contribution.
She recognizes $100,000 of ordinary income as a guaranteed payment.
No gain; the cash reduces her outside basis.
qs.x:
【🚨 披露】2 年内的分配若主张不是出售，须在申报表披露。

【Sec.707(a)(2)(B)】出资 + 相关的分配 → 实质为"出售"

  • 2 年内的出资与分配 → 推定为出售（纳税人可反证）；超过 2 年 → 推定不是
  • 例外：保证报酬、合理优先回报、经营现金流分配、偿还资本支出
【计算】出售比例 = $100,000 ÷ $200,000 = 50% → 分摊 Basis $50,000 → Gain $50,000；另 50% 仍按 721 出资
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：The transfers are presumed a disguised sale (Sec. 707(a)(2)(B)): she is treated as selling 50% of the land ($100,000 / $200,000) for $100,000 with allocated basis of $50,000, recognizing a $50,000 gain; the other 50% is a contribution.
qs.tp: T07.4.1 变相出售推定 Disguised-Sale-Presumption

qs.s: Three years ago, Yan contributed land (FMV $200,000, basis $100,000) to a partnership. This year the partnership distributes that land to another partner, Zoe. What is the effect on Yan? The land's FMV at the time of the distribution is still at least $200,000.
o: Because the contributed property is distributed to another partner within 7 years, Yan recognizes her remaining $100,000 precontribution gain as if the partnership sold the land for FMV; her outside basis and the partnership's basis in the land are increased by the gain before the distribution.
Yan recognizes the gain only if Zoe later sells the land.
No effect; only Zoe is affected.
The partnership recognizes $100,000 of gain allocated to all partners equally.
qs.x:
【🚨 对比】分配回原出资人本人 → 不触发 704(c)(1)(B)。

【Mixing Bowl（Sec.704(c)(1)(B)）】出资财产在出资后 7 年内分配给其他合伙人 → 出资人确认剩余内置增值

  • Yan 确认 $100,000（性质按视同出售判断）
  • Yan Outside Basis +$100,000；土地 Inside Basis +$100,000（再分配给 Zoe，按 732 确定 Zoe 的 Basis）
【目的】防止出资人借合伙"交换"掉增值资产而不纳税
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：Because the contributed property is distributed to another partner within 7 years, Yan recognizes her remaining $100,000 precontribution gain as if the partnership sold the land for FMV; her outside basis and the partnership's basis in the land are increased by the gain before the distribution.
qs.tp: T07.4.2 原物分给他人 Contributed-Property-Distribution

qs.s: Four years ago Yan contributed land (FMV $200,000, basis $100,000); her net precontribution gain is still $100,000. This year, in a nonliquidating distribution, the partnership distributes to her other property (FMV $150,000, basis $150,000) and no cash. Her outside basis immediately before the distribution is $100,000. What gain does she recognize under Sec. 737, and what is her basis in the property?
o: $50,000 gain — the lesser of (1) the excess of the property's FMV ($150,000) over her outside basis ($100,000) = $50,000 or (2) her net precontribution gain ($100,000); her outside basis increases to $150,000, so she takes the property at $150,000 basis and her outside basis becomes $0.
qs.x:
【🚨 两条规则分工】704(c)(1)(B)：出资财产给了别人；737：出资人拿到别的财产。

【Sec.737】出资人在出资后 7 年内收到其他财产 → 确认 Gain =
Lesser of：① 分配财产 FMV − 出资人 Outside Basis（先扣现金）= 150,000 − 100,000 = 50,000；② 净出资前增值 100,000

  • Gain $50,000 → Outside Basis 100,000 + 50,000 = 150,000
  • 财产 Basis = Carryover 150,000（不超过 Outside Basis）→ Outside Basis 0
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：$50,000 gain — the lesser of (1) the excess of the property's FMV ($150,000) over her outside basis ($100,000) = $50,000 or (2) her net precontribution gain ($100,000); her outside basis increases to $150,000, so she takes the property at $150,000 basis and her outside basis becomes $0.
qs.tp: T07.4.3 出资人收到异物 Other-Property-Receipt

qs.s: A limited partnership has one general partner (G, 20% profits) and two limited partners (40% each). The LPs have no obligation to contribute more capital and have not guaranteed any debt. The partnership has $300,000 of recourse debt. How is the debt allocated for outside basis purposes?
o: None of it — recourse debt does not increase basis.
$300,000 to G, because under the constructive liquidation test only G bears the economic risk of loss.
$60,000 to G and $120,000 to each LP, by profit shares.
qs.x:
【🚨 对比】非追索负债按三层规则分摊（下题）。

【Sec.752 追索负债】按经济损失风险（Economic Risk of Loss）分摊 —— 假设合伙企业全部资产价值归零、负债到期，谁最终须掏钱？

  • LP 无出资/担保义务 → 不承担 → $0
  • G 负无限责任 → $300,000
  • 若某 LP 个人担保了部分负债 → 该部分分给该 LP
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：$300,000 to G, because under the constructive liquidation test only G bears the economic risk of loss.
qs.tp: T07.2.1 追索与担保风险 Recourse-Economic-Risk

qs.s: In what order is partnership nonrecourse debt allocated among partners?
o: (1) Each partner's share of partnership minimum gain; (2) the Sec. 704(c) minimum gain — the built-in gain a partner would be allocated if contributed property subject to nonrecourse debt were disposed of for no consideration other than debt relief; (3) the remaining 'excess' nonrecourse debt, generally by profit-sharing ratios (or other permitted methods).
Equally among all partners regardless of interests.
qs.x:
【🚨 意义】非追索负债由所有合伙人（含 LP）按层分摊 → 增加 LP 的 Outside Basis（但不进 At-Risk，除非是合格不动产非追索融资）。

【非追索负债三层（Reg. §1.752-3）】
① 合伙最低利得份额（非追索扣除累计形成的最低利得）
② 704(c) 最低利得：出资财产所负非追索负债 > 其税务 Basis 的部分，归出资人（防止出资时因负债解除而确认 Gain）
③ 超额非追索负债：一般按利润分享比例（也可按 704(c) 剩余增值或非追索扣除的预期分配方式）

【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：(1) Each partner's share of partnership minimum gain; (2) the Sec. 704(c) minimum gain — the built-in gain a partner would be allocated if contributed property subject to nonrecourse debt were disposed of for no consideration other than debt relief; (3) the remaining 'excess' nonrecourse debt, generally by profit-sharing ratios (or other permitted methods).
qs.tp: T07.2.2 非追索三层分摊 Nonrecourse-Three-Tiers

qs.s: Kai joins a partnership in exchange for services. Case 1: he receives a 10% capital interest when the partnership's net assets (at liquidation value) are $1,000,000. Case 2: he receives only a 10% interest in future profits and appreciation (a profits interest), with no share of existing capital. The partnership is not publicly traded, its income is not substantially certain and predictable, and Kai holds the interest for more than 2 years. What does Kai recognize on receipt?
o: Case 1: $100,000 ordinary income (and the partnership generally deducts it); Case 2: $0 under Rev. Proc. 93-27, because a profits interest has zero liquidation value at grant.
qs.x:
【🚨 附加】基金管理人的 Carried Interest 受 Sec.1061：持有期须 >3 年 才能按 LTCG，否则转为短期。

【资本权益】按清算价值 10% × $1,000,000 = $100,000 普通收入；合伙企业可扣除（或资本化），并视为按比例出售资产的一部分（可能确认损益）

【利润权益（Rev. Proc. 93-27 / 2001-43）】授予时若立即清算，服务合伙人分不到任何东西 → 价值 0 → 不课税
  • 例外：收入流可预测（如高评级债券）、2 年内处置、公开交易合伙权益
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：Case 1: $100,000 ordinary income (and the partnership generally deducts it); Case 2: $0 under Rev. Proc. 93-27, because a profits interest has zero liquidation value at grant.
qs.tp: T07.5.3 服务换取权益 Service-Interest-Taxation

qs.s: A private equity fund manager holds a carried interest (an applicable partnership interest). The fund sells a portfolio company held for 2 years and allocates $1,000,000 of capital gain to the manager's carried interest. How is it taxed?
o: $1,000,000 short-term capital gain — under Sec. 1061, gains allocated to an applicable partnership interest must have a holding period of more than 3 years to be long-term.
Ordinary income subject to self-employment tax.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】这是持有期规则，不改变所得性质为普通收入，也不征 SE 税。

【Sec.1061】对"适用合伙权益"（为投资管理服务取得的合伙利润权益）：

  • 资本资产持有期须 >3 年 才享受 LTCG 税率；1–3 年之间 → 重新定性为 STCG
  • 不适用于：资本投入对应的回报部分、1231 资产与合格股息（依规定）
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：$1,000,000 short-term capital gain — under Sec. 1061, gains allocated to an applicable partnership interest must have a holding period of more than 3 years to be long-term.
qs.tp: T07.5.4 附带权益持有期 Carried-Interest-Holding-Period

qs.s:
A new partnership has three partners:

  • Corp A (fiscal year ending June 30) owns 55%
  • Individual B (calendar year) owns 25%
  • Individual C (calendar year) owns 20%. What taxable year must the partnership adopt (absent a business-purpose or Sec. 444 election)?
o: The year producing the least aggregate deferral, computed first.
Calendar year, because two of the three partners use it.
June 30 — the majority-interest taxable year, because partners owning more than 50% of profits and capital (Corp A, 55%) share that year.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】按人数计算（选项B）是错误的——按持股比例。

【Sec.706(b) 顺序】
① 多数权益年度：持有 >50% 利润与资本的合伙人共同的纳税年度 → Corp A 55% → 6/30
② 若无，则主要合伙人（≥5%）共同的年度
③ 若仍无，则最小累计递延年度

【例外】商业目的（自然营业年度：连续 3 年最后 2 个月总收入占 ≥25%）；Sec.444 选择（递延 ≤3 个月，需作要求付款）
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：June 30 — the majority-interest taxable year, because partners owning more than 50% of profits and capital (Corp A, 55%) share that year.
qs.tp: T07.9.1 必须采用的税年 Required-Partnership-Tax-Year

qs.s: Under the Bipartisan Budget Act (BBA) partnership audit rules, which statement is correct?
o: Each partner is audited separately and pays any tax on their own return for the reviewed year.

The partnership designates a partnership representative (with substantial U.S. presence) who binds all partners; adjustments generally produce an 'imputed underpayment' paid by the partnership in the adjustment year at the highest rate, unless it makes a push-out election (within 45 days of the final notice) to push adjustments to reviewed-year partners, who pay with interest at a rate 2 points higher. Partnerships with 100 or fewer eligible partners (e.g., individuals, C/S corporations, estates of deceased partners — not partnerships, trusts, or disregarded entities) may elect out annually.
The partnership representative must be a partner.
Any partnership may elect out regardless of its partners.
qs.x:
【🚨 筹划】合伙协议应明确 PR 人选、Push-Out 条件与合伙人补偿条款。

【BBA 集中审计】

  • 合伙代表（PR）：可以不是合伙人，须在美国有实质存在；其决定约束全部合伙人
  • Imputed Underpayment：审计调整在调整年度由合伙企业按最高税率缴纳（经济负担落在现任合伙人身上）
  • Push-Out 选择（Sec.6226）：最终通知后 45 天内 → 由审查年度的合伙人自行补税，利率 +2%
  • Modification：审查年度合伙人修改申报/证明免税合伙人等，可降低 Imputed Underpayment
  • Elect-Out（Sec.6221(b)）：≤100 名合格合伙人（个人、C 公司、S 公司、外国实体、已故合伙人遗产）→ 每年在申报表上选择；有合伙企业/信托合伙人 → 不可
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：The partnership designates a partnership representative (with substantial U.S. presence) who binds all partners; adjustments generally produce an 'imputed underpayment' paid by the partnership in the adjustment year at the highest rate, unless it makes a push-out election (within 45 days of the final notice) to push adjustments to reviewed-year partners, who pay with interest at a rate 2 points higher. Partnerships with 100 or fewer eligible partners (e.g., individuals, C/S corporations, estates of deceased partners — not partnerships, trusts, or disregarded entities) may elect out annually.
qs.tp: T07.9.3 集中审计制度 Centralized-Partnership-Audit

qs.s: A partner dies owning a 1/3 interest with an outside basis of $100,000 and an FMV of $200,000. The partnership has no Sec. 736(a) payments or IRD items. Which statement is correct?
o: The partnership terminates upon a partner's death.
The successor's outside basis carries over at $100,000.
The partnership automatically steps up all inside basis for all partners.

The successor's outside basis steps up to $200,000 (Sec. 1014), and the partnership's tax year closes with respect to the deceased partner; the partnership's inside basis is adjusted (Sec. 743(b), +$100,000 for the successor only) only if a Sec. 754 election is in effect or a substantial built-in loss exists.
qs.x:
【🚨 筹划】高增值合伙资产 + 合伙人去世 → 754 选择是继承人获得折旧/出售利益的关键。

【合伙人死亡】

  • 继承人 Outside Basis = FMV $200,000（减去 IRD 部分，如 736(a) 款项、热资产中的未实现应收）
  • 合伙纳税年度对死者关闭（死者最后一年的份额计入其最终申报）
  • 内部 Basis 不会自动调整 → 需 754 选择（或存在 >$250,000 的实质内含亏损）→ 743(b) 仅对继承人 +$100,000
  • 合伙企业不因合伙人死亡而终止（除非无人继续经营）
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：The successor's outside basis steps up to $200,000 (Sec. 1014), and the partnership's tax year closes with respect to the deceased partner; the partnership's inside basis is adjusted (Sec. 743(b), +$100,000 for the successor only) only if a Sec. 754 election is in effect or a substantial built-in loss exists.
qs.tp: T07.8.4 死亡与继承基数 Death-Inherited-Interest

qs.s: Partnership AB (value $600,000) merges with Partnership CD (value $400,000) to form Partnership ABCD. After the merger, AB's former partners own 60% and CD's former partners own 40% of ABCD. Which partnership is treated as continuing?
o: AB — in a merger, the resulting partnership is a continuation of the merging partnership whose partners own more than 50% of the resulting partnership's capital and profits; CD is treated as terminated (generally under the 'assets-over' form).
Both partnerships terminate; ABCD is a new partnership.
CD, because it is the smaller partnership.
qs.x:
【🚨 TCJA 后】"技术性终止"（12 个月内转让 ≥50% 权益）已废除，合伙企业只因停止经营或合并/分立而终止。

【Sec.708(b)(2)(A) 合并】结果合伙企业是其原合伙人持有 >50% 的那个合伙企业的延续 → AB（60%）继续，CD 终止

  • 若有多个合并方的原合伙人均持有 >50%（合伙人重叠时可能出现），以贡献资产净值最大者为延续；若没有任何一方的原合伙人持有 >50%，则所有合并方均终止，形成新合伙企业
  • 默认形式：Assets-Over（终止合伙把资产投入延续合伙换取权益，再分配给其合伙人）
【分立（708(b)(2)(B)）】分立后合伙企业的合伙人若在原合伙企业中持有 >50% 资本与利润权益，该合伙企业视为原合伙企业的延续
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：AB — in a merger, the resulting partnership is a continuation of the merging partnership whose partners own more than 50% of the resulting partnership's capital and profits; CD is treated as terminated (generally under the 'assets-over' form).
qs.tp: T07.9.4 合并分立与终止 Merger-Division-Termination

qs.s:
• PQR Partnership has three equal partners, each with an outside basis of $60,000. Its only assets are cash $120,000
  • inventory with a basis of $30,000 and FMV of $90,000
  • and land (a capital asset held for many years) with a basis of $30,000 and FMV of $90,000. There are no liabilities and no Sec. 754 election. In complete liquidation of his interest, P receives $100,000 of cash. What are P's ordinary income and capital gain?
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】751(a) 管出售合伙权益，751(b) 管不成比例分配；751(b) 中存货须"实质增值"（>120%），751(a) 则不需要。

【Step 1：存货是否"实质增值"（751(b) 的前提）】FMV $90,000 > 120% × Basis $30,000 = $36,000 → ✔ 热资产

【Step 2：P 放弃了什么】P 的份额 = 现金 $40,000 + 存货 $30,000（Basis $10,000）+ 土地 $30,000；实际只收到现金 → 用其存货份额"换"了现金
【Step 3：751(b) 视同交易（现行法规）】
  • 先视为 P 收到自己那份存货（Basis $10,000）→ Outside Basis $60,000 → $50,000
  • 再把这份存货以 $30,000 卖回合伙企业 → $20,000 普通收入
【Step 4：其余分配按 731】剩余现金 $70,000 − 剩余 Outside Basis $50,000 = $20,000 资本利得
【验算】总利得 $100,000 − $60,000 = $40,000 = 普通 $20,000 + 资本 $20,000 ✔
【合伙企业】视为以 $30,000 购入 P 的存货份额 → 存货 Basis 调增 $20,000
【干扰项】选项A 忽略 751(b)；选项C 把全部利得当普通收入；选项D 未扣除已视同分配的存货 Basis
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：P 以存货份额换取现金，按 751(b) 视同出售存货份额确认 $20,000 普通收入，其余 $70,000 现金超过剩余 Basis $50,000 的部分为 $20,000 资本利得。
qs.tp: T07.7.3 超额现金分配例 Excess-Cash-Distribution-Example

qs.s:
• PQR Partnership has three equal partners, each with an outside basis of $60,000. Its only assets are cash $120,000
  • inventory with a basis of $30,000 and FMV of $90,000
  • and land (a capital asset held for many years) with a basis of $30,000 and FMV of $90,000. There are no liabilities and no Sec. 754 election. In complete liquidation of his interest, P instead receives ALL of the inventory ($90,000 FMV) plus $10,000 of cash. Under the current Sec. 751(b) regulations, who recognizes ordinary income, and how much gain does P recognize?
o: P recognizes $40,000 of ordinary income; the partnership recognizes nothing.
No one recognizes anything, because partnership distributions are tax-free.
P recognizes $60,000 of ordinary income on the excess inventory.

The partnership recognizes $40,000 of ordinary income (allocated to Q and R) on the $60,000 of inventory it is deemed to sell to P; P recognizes a $20,000 capital gain on his share of the land that he is deemed to sell to the partnership.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】751(b) 的核心是防止普通收入在合伙人之间转移：谁放弃了热资产，谁（或合伙企业中的其他合伙人）就要确认那部分普通收入。2014 年拟议法规尚未最终定稿，考试以现行法规为准。

【方向相反：P 多拿热资产、放弃冷资产】P 的份额中有现金 $40,000、土地 $30,000；实际只拿 $10,000 现金 → 放弃了现金 $30,000 + 土地 $30,000，换取超额存货 $60,000

【视同交易】

① 先视为 P 收到被放弃的冷资产：现金 $30,000、土地份额（Basis $10,000）→ Outside Basis $60,000 → $20,000
② P 把这些冷资产卖给合伙企业换取 $60,000 存货：

  • 现金无利得；土地份额 $30,000 − $10,000 = $20,000 资本利得（P）
  • 合伙企业视为卖出 $60,000 存货（Basis $20,000）→ $40,000 普通收入，分配给 Q、R

③ 其余按 732：P 收到自己那份存货（Basis $10,000）与 $10,000 现金 → Outside Basis 用尽

【P 的存货 Basis】购入部分 $60,000 + 自身份额 $10,000 = $70,000 → 未来出售时再实现 $20,000 普通收入
【干扰项】选项A、C 把普通收入放在 P 身上；选项B 忽略 751(b)
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：P 超额取得存货时，由合伙企业（Q、R）就视同出售的 $60,000 存货确认 $40,000 普通收入，P 就视同出售的土地份额确认 $20,000 资本利得。
qs.tp: T07.7.4 超额存货分配例 Excess-Inventory-Distribution-Example

qs.s:
• At the beginning of the year, Ana's outside basis in a partnership is $20,000. For the year, her distributive share includes a $50,000 ordinary loss and $5,000 of tax-exempt interest
  • her share of partnership liabilities increases by $15,000
  • and she receives a $10,000 cash distribution. How much of the loss may she deduct this year (before at-risk and passive activity limits)?
o: $50,000; the loss is fully deductible because liabilities increased.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】704(d) 之后还有 At-Risk、PAL、EBL 三层；负债份额增加提高 Basis，但非追索负债不一定提高 At-Risk。

【Sec.704(d) 与 Reg. §1.704-1(d)(2) 顺序】
① 增加项：免税收入 +$5,000、负债份额增加 +$15,000（视同现金出资）
② 减去分配 −$10,000（分配先于亏损）
③ 最后才扣亏损

  • 可用 Basis = $20,000 + $5,000 + $15,000 − $10,000 = $30,000 → 允许 $30,000
  • 超出部分 $20,000 无限期结转，待 Outside Basis 增加时使用
【2018 年后】慈善捐赠与外国税的份额同样计入 704(d) 限额
【干扰项】选项B 把分配放在亏损之后；选项C 忽略当年增加项；选项D 忽略 704(d)
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：按"增加 → 分配 → 亏损"顺序，可用 Basis 为 $30,000，允许扣除 $30,000，其余 $20,000 结转。
qs.tp: T07.1.1 亏损四层限制 Loss-Limitation-Ordering

qs.s: Kim, a 40% partner, sells her entire interest on June 30 (treat as exactly half the year). The partnership earns $20,000 of ordinary income from January to June and $180,000 from July to December. How much income is allocated to Kim?
o: Proration is the default ($40,000); the partners may elect an interim closing of the books ($8,000).
The interim closing of the books is the default ($8,000); the partners may instead agree to use the proration method ($40,000). Either way, the partnership's tax year closes for Kim on the sale date.
$8,000, and no other method may be used.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】合伙企业默认"结账"、S 公司默认"按日"——这一反差是高频对比考点。

【Sec.706(d) 与 Reg. §1.706-4】合伙人权益在年内变动时：

  • 默认：中期结账法（Interim Closing） → 按实际发生期间分配：40% × $20,000 = $8,000
  • 合伙人可协议采用按日比例法（Proration） → 40% × $200,000 × ½ = $40,000
  • 现金制合伙的"可分配现金制项目"（利息、税、服务费、租金）须按日分摊，防止年末突击支付转移扣除
【纳税年度】出售全部权益 → 合伙纳税年度对 Kim 结束（706(c)(2)(A)），其份额计入她当年申报
【🔁 对比 S 公司】S 公司默认是按股按日分摊，结账法需所有受影响股东同意选举 —— 与合伙企业的默认正好相反
【干扰项】选项A 把默认方法说反；选项C、D 只承认一种方法
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：合伙企业默认按中期结账法分配 $8,000，合伙人可协议改用按日比例法分配 $40,000。
qs.tp: T07.9.2 权益变动收入分配 Varying-Interest-Income-Allocation

qs.s: X contributes land (basis $100,000; FMV $60,000) and Y contributes $60,000 cash to form a 50/50 partnership. Two years later the partnership sells the land for $50,000. How is the $50,000 tax loss allocated, and what happens to the built-in loss if X sells her interest before the land is sold?
o: $25,000 to each partner; the built-in loss follows the interest to any buyer.
$50,000 to X; on a sale of her interest, the buyer inherits the built-in loss.

X $45,000 and Y $5,000; if X had sold her interest before the land sale, the $40,000 built-in loss could not be used by the buyer (or any other partner), because for all partners other than X the land's basis is treated as its $60,000 FMV at contribution.
X $40,000 and Y $10,000; the built-in loss is never allowed.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】增值与减值的规则不对称：内置增值随权益转给受让人（Reg. §1.704-3(a)(7)），内置亏损只属于出资人本人（704(c)(1)(C)）。

【Sec.704(c)(1)(C)（2004 年起）】出资内置亏损资产：
① 内置亏损只能分配给出资合伙人
② 对其他合伙人而言，资产 Basis 视为出资时的 FMV

【本题】
  • 内置亏损 = $100,000 − $60,000 = $40,000 → 全部归 X
  • 出资后亏损 = $60,000 − $50,000 = $10,000 → 50/50：X $5,000、Y $5,000
  • 合计：X $45,000；Y $5,000
【出资人退出】若 X 在出售土地前转让权益，受让人不能承继那 $40,000 内置亏损 → 实际上消失
【🔁 对比公司】公司出资适用 Sec.362(e)(2)：内置亏损资产的公司 Basis 压到 FMV（或选择压低股东股票 Basis）
【干扰项】选项A、B 允许内置亏损转移；选项D 未把出资后亏损分给 X
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：内置亏损 $40,000 只归 X，出资后亏损 $10,000 按 50/50 分配；X 若先转让权益，内置亏损对受让人消失。
qs.tp: T07.3.4 内置亏损专属 Built-In-Loss-Restriction

qs.s: Lee is a limited partner in LP and, separately, a 50% shareholder in an S corporation. Each entity borrows $100,000 of recourse debt from a bank, and Lee personally guarantees the entire loan in each case (Lee has no right of reimbursement from the general partner or the partnership — she waived subrogation). What is the effect on Lee's basis?
o: The S corporation guarantee increases debt basis by $50,000; the partnership guarantee has no effect.

The partnership debt is allocated to Lee because she bears the economic risk of loss, increasing her outside basis (and amount at risk) by $100,000; the S corporation guarantee creates no stock or debt basis unless and until she pays on it.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】负债计入所有者 Basis 是合伙相对 S 公司的最大优势之一，尤其对杠杆投资（房地产）影响巨大。

【合伙企业（Sec.752）】追索负债按经济损失风险分摊：假设合伙资产归零，谁最终掏钱？

  • Lee 个人担保且对 GP 无追偿安排 → 由 Lee 承担 → 负债分给 Lee → Outside Basis +$100,000，At-Risk 也增加
【S 公司】股东担保不产生 Debt Basis；只有实际代偿后，公司对股东的债务才产生 Debt Basis
【干扰项】选项A 忽略 752；选项B 忽略 S 公司规则；选项C 两个方向都错
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：合伙追索负债按经济损失风险分给担保的 Lee，增加 Outside Basis；S 公司股东担保在代偿前不产生任何 Basis。
qs.tp: T07.2.1 追索与担保风险 Recourse-Economic-Risk

qs.s: Which statement about a partner's capital account reported on Schedule K-1 (Item L) is correct?
o: Partnerships may report capital accounts on a GAAP, Sec. 704(b), or tax basis at their choice.
The tax-basis capital account equals the partner's outside basis.

Partnerships generally must report each partner's capital account on the tax basis using the transactional approach; tax capital generally equals outside basis minus the partner's share of partnership liabilities, and a negative tax capital account must still be reported.
Item L is optional for partnerships with fewer than 10 partners.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】负税务资本账户在合伙人退出或清算时往往意味着需确认利得（负债解除视同现金分配）。

【Item L（2020 年起）】

  • 须以税务口径（tax basis）报告合伙人资本账户，采用交易法（期初 + 出资 + 收入 − 亏损/扣除 − 分配 ± 其他）→ 选项A错
  • 税务资本 ≈ Outside Basis − 负债份额（Outside Basis 含负债，税务资本不含 → 选项B错）
  • 负的税务资本账户同样须报告，常提示非追索负债超过 Basis 等风险
  • 豁免与合伙人人数无关（选项D错）：满足 Schedule B 第 4 题四项条件（总收入 < $250K、总资产 < $1M、按时提供 K-1、无须填 M-3）的合伙可免填 Schedule L、M-1、M-2 及 K-1 Item L
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：K-1 Item L 须以税务口径、按交易法报告合伙人资本账户；税务资本约等于 Outside Basis 减负债份额，负数也须报告。
qs.tp: T07.1.3 税务资本账户 Tax-Capital-Reporting

qs.s: A calendar-year partnership with four individual partners (all U.S. citizens) that share every item in proportion to capital files its 2025 Form 1065 on June 25, 2026 without an extension. Using the $255 monthly penalty per partner for returns due in 2026, what is the penalty, and can it be abated?
o: $255, because the penalty is per return, not per partner.
$3,060; relief is available only with a private letter ruling.

$4,080 ($255 × 4 partners × 4 months, since any part of a month counts); a small partnership (10 or fewer partners, all individuals or estates, with each partner sharing every item in the same proportion) whose partners fully reported their shares on timely returns may request reasonable-cause relief under Rev. Proc. 84-35 (first-time abatement may also be available).
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】合伙企业与 S 公司即使没有应纳税额也会被罚——按人头、按月计算，人数多的实体罚款惊人。

【Sec.6698（合伙）/ Sec.6699（S 公司）】罚款 = 每名合伙人/股东 × 每月（不足一月按一月） × 基数（2026 年到期的申报表为 $255），最多 12 个月

  • 截止日 3/16/2026（3/15 为周日）→ 6/25 迟交 3 个月又 10 天 → 4 个月
  • $255 × 4 × 4 = $4,080
【救济】
  • Rev. Proc. 84-35 小型合伙：≤10 名合伙人、均为个人（非 NRA）或遗产、各合伙人对每一项目分享比例相同、所有合伙人已在及时的申报表中完整报告份额 → 推定有合理原因
  • 首次违规减免（FTA）
【干扰项】选项A、C 月数或人数错误；选项B 罚款按人计算
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：迟交 4 个月（不足一月按一月）× 4 名合伙人 × $255 = $4,080；符合 Rev. Proc. 84-35 条件的小型合伙可申请合理原因减免。

qs.s: Partner P contributed $1,000,000 to a partnership. Alternative 1: the agreement pays P $60,000 each year for the use of his capital regardless of partnership income. Alternative 2: the agreement allocates to P the first $60,000 of partnership income each year (a preferred return), paid only if the partnership has income. The partnership's income consists of long-term capital gains and qualified dividends. Which statement is correct?
o: Under Alternative 1, P has $60,000 of ordinary income (a guaranteed payment for capital) and the partnership generally deducts or capitalizes it; under Alternative 2, P receives a $60,000 distributive share that retains the character of the partnership's income (capital gain and qualified dividends) and is not deductible by the partnership.
Both alternatives produce identical tax results.
Under Alternative 1, the payment is a tax-free return of capital.
Under Alternative 2, P has $60,000 of ordinary income subject to self-employment tax.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】起草协议时"保证支付"与"优先分配"只差几个字，税务性质却完全不同——TCP 常考这类条款解读。

【保证支付（Sec.707(c)）——资本回报】不论合伙收入多少都须支付

  • 对 P：普通收入；SE：按 Form 1065 SE 工作表，一般合伙人的全部保证支付（含资本回报）通常计入 SE 收益；有限合伙人只有服务性保证支付才计入
  • 对合伙：可扣除（或按性质资本化）→ 减少其他合伙人的份额
【优先回报（Preferred Return）】从合伙收入中优先分配给 P
  • 属于分配份额（704(b)）→ 保持合伙收入的性质（本题为长期资本利得、合格股息）
  • 合伙不能扣除
【干扰项】选项B 两者性质不同；选项C 保证支付是收入；选项D 优先回报性质取决于合伙收入，且资本性收入不计 SE
【筹划】合伙收入以资本利得为主时，优先回报对 P 更有利（优惠税率）
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：资本保证支付对 P 是普通收入、合伙可扣除；优先回报是保留合伙收入性质的分配份额，合伙不能扣除。
qs.tp: T07.5.2 资本报酬与优先回报 Capital-Payment-Preferred-Return

qs.s: A partnership's Sec. 163(j) limitation disallows $30,000 of business interest expense allocable to partner Ria. Which statement is correct?
o: The $30,000 is excess business interest expense (EBIE) carried forward at Ria's level (not the partnership's); it reduces her outside basis immediately, becomes deductible only when the same partnership later allocates excess taxable income or excess business interest income to her, and if she disposes of her interest, her basis is increased by any remaining EBIE immediately before the disposition.
The $30,000 is carried forward by the partnership and deducted in the next year.
Ria may deduct the $30,000 against income from any other business.
EBIE does not affect Ria's outside basis until it is deducted.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】"合伙人结转、S 公司实体结转"——163(j) 在两类穿透实体中的处理方式正好相反。

【合伙企业的 163(j)（Sec.163(j)(4)）】限额在合伙企业层面计算

  • 超额业务利息费用（EBIE）分配给合伙人，在合伙人层面结转（选项B错）
  • 立即减少 Outside Basis（选项D错）
  • 只能在同一合伙企业以后年度分配给该合伙人"超额应税所得"或"超额业务利息收入"时扣除（不能抵其他业务，选项C错）
  • 处置合伙权益 → 处置前把剩余未用 EBIE 加回 Basis（减少利得），但该 EBIE 本身不可扣除
【🔁 对比 S 公司】S 公司的不允许利息在公司层面结转
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：EBIE 在合伙人层面结转并立即减少 Outside Basis，只在同一合伙企业分配超额应税所得时扣除，处置权益前剩余 EBIE 加回 Basis。

qs.s: A partnership and an S corporation each have $100,000 of debt canceled. Neither is in bankruptcy. At what level is insolvency tested for the Sec. 108 exclusion in each case?
o: At the partner or shareholder level for both entities.
At the entity level for both entities.
Partnership: at the partner level; S corporation: at the corporate level.
Partnership: at the entity level; S corporation: at the shareholder level.

【🚨 陷阱】同一笔合伙企业债务免除，资不抵债的合伙人可以排除，有偿付能力的合伙人必须计入。

【合伙企业 Sec.108(d)(6)】COD 收入先按份额穿透 → 每位合伙人按自身情况测试资不抵债/破产

  • 合伙企业本身是否资不抵债无关
  • 债务免除同时减少合伙人的负债份额 → 752(b) 视同现金分配
【S 公司 Sec.108(d)(7)】在公司层面测试
  • 公司资不抵债时，被排除的 COD 不穿透、不增加股东 Basis
  • 股东因 Basis 不足而挂起的亏损（1366(d)）视为公司的 NOL，在属性削减中被优先削减
【干扰项】选项ABD 规则混淆或颠倒
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：合伙企业在合伙人层面测试资不抵债，S 公司在公司层面测试。

qs.s: A partnership holds inventory with a basis of $100,000 and an FMV of $110,000, and it has no unrealized receivables. For which purposes is the inventory a hot asset?
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】1997 年起 751(a) 不再要求存货显著增值——120% 测试只留在 751(b)。
热资产751(a) 出售权益751(b) 分配
未实现应收款（含潜在 1245/1250 回收）✔✔
存货✔ 全部存货仅显著增值存货（FMV > 120% × Basis）
  • 本题 110,000 ÷ 100,000 = 110% ≤ 120% → 出售权益时是热资产，分配时不是
【干扰项】选项A 忽略 751(a) 对全部存货的适用；选项B 忽略 120% 测试；选项C 规则颠倒
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：出售权益时（751(a)）全部存货都是热资产；分配时（751(b)）只有 FMV 超过 Basis 120% 的存货才是，110% 不满足。

qs.s: Rae sells her one-third partnership interest. The partnership's only appreciated asset is equipment with an original cost of $130,000, adjusted basis of $100,000, and FMV of $200,000; it has no other hot assets. How much of Rae's gain is ordinary income under Sec. 751(a)?

【🚨 陷阱】出售合伙权益时要"穿透"检查设备等 1231 资产的潜在折旧回收——它们也是热资产。

【Sec.751(c)】"未实现应收款"包括合伙企业若按 FMV 出售资产会产生的 1245/1250 普通收入回收

  • 设备潜在 1245 回收 = Min(利得 100,000, 累计折旧 30,000) = 30,000
  • Rae 份额 1/3 → 10,000 普通收入；其余利得为资本利得

【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：设备的潜在 1245 回收 $30,000 属于未实现应收款，Rae 的 1/3 份额 $10,000 为普通收入。
