qs.s: A trust document requires that ALL trust accounting income be distributed to the sole income beneficiary each year, and the trust makes no charitable contributions and distributes no trust principal/corpus during the year in question. This year, however, the trust sold a long-term investment and realized a capital gain, which under both the trust document and applicable state law is allocated to PRINCIPAL (corpus), not to accounting income, and that capital gain was NOT distributed (it stayed in the trust, added to corpus). Is this trust a Simple Trust or a Complex Trust for this tax year?
o: Complex Trust, solely because the trust generated a capital gain during the year, regardless of any other facts.
This is automatically a Grantor Trust rather than either a Simple or Complex Trust, because a portion of its income was retained.
The classification depends entirely on the trust's total asset value, with a specific dollar threshold separating simple from complex trusts.

Simple Trust, because the trust document requires full distribution of all accounting income annually, does not permit charitable contributions, and did not distribute principal (the retained capital gain, allocated to principal under the trust instrument and state law, does not disqualify Simple Trust status since retention of PRINCIPAL, as opposed to retention of accounting INCOME, is what matters for this test).
qs.x:
【第三步：本题的"陷阱"—— 资本利得的会计归属，不等于"违反第③项本金测试"】
  • 关键辨析点：这笔资本利得依据信托文件和州法被划归为本金（Principal/Corpus）性质，而非"信托会计收入"——这是信托会计里非常标准的处理惯例（多数州信托法和信托文件都把资本利得归为本金，而非常规意义上的"收入"）。
  • 该资本利得留在信托内、并未实际分配出去——既然它属于"本金"，而"本金留在信托内没有分配出去"恰恰是满足（而非违反）第③项测试的正确状态（第③项要求的是"未分配本金"，本题正是如此）。
  • 选项A的错误在于，简单地把"有资本利得"和"必然构成复杂信托"划等号——这是一个常见但不成立的过度简化联想；真正决定分类的，是"信托文件的强制分配要求+是否捐赠+是否分配本金"这三项测试，与"是否产生了资本利得"这件事本身没有直接因果关系。
【🚨 高频陷阱】① 只要有任何一年信托未能满足三项条件中的任意一项（比如某年份信托文件允许积累部分收入不分配、或做了慈善捐赠、或分配了本金），该信托当年就自动降级为 Complex Trust——信托分类是逐年判定的，同一个信托完全可能今年是Simple、明年因为情况变化就变成Complex；② 选项B把"保留了部分收益"和"Grantor Trust"混为一谈是错误的——Grantor Trust的判定标准是委托人对信托是否保留了特定控制权/利益（如撤销权、向自己或配偶分配的权力等），与信托当年是Simple还是Complex是完全独立的两套分类体系，一个信托甚至可能同时具有Grantor Trust属性（就某部分收入而言）。

【第一步：Simple Trust（简单信托）的三项法定资格条件（须同时满足）】

  • ① 信托文件要求每年全部分配"信托会计口径的收入（Trust Accounting Income）"给受益人（不能只是"可以"分配，必须是强制性要求）；
  • ② 信托文件不允许向慈善机构捐赠；
  • ③ 信托当年未实际分配任何本金（Corpus/Principal）给受益人。
【第二步：逐项核对本题事实】
  • ① 信托文件强制要求全部会计收入分配给唯一受益人 → 满足。
  • ② 未做任何慈善捐赠 → 满足。
  • ③ 本金层面：信托当年没有向受益人分配任何本金 → 满足。
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：信托当年强制分配全部会计收入、无慈善捐赠且未动用本金，留存资本利得归入本金不影响 Simple Trust 性质。
qs.tp: T08.1.1 简单与复杂逐年分类 Simple-Complex-Annual-Classification

qs.s: Same trust as before (must distribute all accounting income; no charitable contributions permitted), EXCEPT this year the trustee also exercises discretion under the trust instrument to distribute $20,000 of principal to the beneficiary. How is the trust classified this year?
o: Complex trust for this year, because it distributed principal; classification is determined year by year.
It becomes a complex trust permanently.
Simple trust — the income distribution requirement is what matters.
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题"资本利得留在本金" → 仍是 Simple；本题"本金分配出去" → Complex。

【Simple Trust 三要件】① 必须分配全部会计收入 ② 不做慈善 ③ 当年不分配本金

  • 本年分配本金 $20,000 → 第③项失败 → 本年为 Complex Trust（免税额 $100 而非 $300）
  • 分类逐年判定，下一年若恢复三要件仍可为 Simple（选项C"永久变为复杂信托"错）
  • 信托终止年度因分配全部本金，也必然为 Complex
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：Complex trust for this year, because it distributed principal; classification is determined year by year.
qs.tp: T08.1.1 简单与复杂逐年分类 Simple-Complex-Annual-Classification

qs.s: A complex trust has the following items for the year: $40,000 of taxable interest and dividend income, $10,000 of tax-exempt municipal bond interest, and $6,000 of trustee/administrative fees allocable to the taxable income (properly deductible in computing trust taxable income before the distribution deduction). The trust distributed $30,000 cash to its sole beneficiary during the year. Compute the trust's Distributable Net Income (DNI), and determine how much of the $30,000 distribution is taxable to the beneficiary versus treated as a tax-free return of trust corpus.
o: DNI = $40,000 taxable interest/dividends + $10,000 tax-exempt interest - $6,000 fees = $44,000; the $30,000 distribution is fully covered by DNI (since $30,000 < $44,000), so the beneficiary is taxed on the full $30,000, with the K-1 required to show the proportionate split between taxable and tax-exempt character (roughly 77% taxable-source, 23% tax-exempt-source, based on DNI's composition), meaning the beneficiary reports about $23,182 as taxable and about $6,818 as tax-exempt interest.
The $6,000 in fees must be allocated first against the tax-exempt interest, not the taxable interest, since fees always offset tax-exempt income first under a mandatory ordering rule.
DNI = $50,000 total income (ignoring both the tax-exempt character and the fee deduction); the beneficiary is taxed on the full $30,000 distributed as ordinary income.
DNI = $40,000 (ignoring tax-exempt interest and fees entirely); the beneficiary is taxed on $30,000 fully as ordinary taxable income with no tax-exempt component.
qs.x:
【🚨 高频陷阱】

① 分配扣除 ≠ 分配额，要扣除免税部分；
② 若费用是间接费用（未指定归属），应按应税/免税收入比例分摊（本题已指定归属于应税收入）；
③ 信托税率在很低的应税所得就达到 37%，筹划上通常尽量分配 DNI。

【Step 1：DNI】
题目说明 $6,000 费用"可归属于应税收入"，全部冲减应税部分：

  • 应税部分 = $40,000 − $6,000 = $34,000
  • 免税部分 = $10,000
  • DNI = $44,000（DNI 包含免税利息）
【Step 2：受益人按 DNI 构成比例承担性质】
  • 分配 $30,000 < DNI $44,000 → 全部属于 DNI 分配
  • 应税比例 = 34/44 ≈ 77.27% → $23,182 应税
  • 免税比例 = 10/44 ≈ 22.73% → $6,818 免税利息（性质穿透）
【Step 3：信托的分配扣除（Sec.661(c)）】
  • 扣除额 = Lesser of（分配额, DNI）减去其中的免税部分
  • = $30,000 − $6,818 = $23,182（免税部分不得扣除，否则就是"免税收入对应的扣除"）
【Step 4：信托留存】
  • 信托自身应税所得 = $34,000 − $23,182 − 个人免税额 $100 = $10,718，按信托压缩税率表课税
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：DNI 为 $44,000，分配的 $30,000 完全由 DNI 覆盖，受益人按比例确认应税与免税收入。
qs.tp: T08.3.2 分配扣除与免税比例 Distribution-Deduction-Allocation

qs.s: Same trust as before (DNI $44,000 consisting of $34,000 net taxable income and $10,000 tax-exempt interest), EXCEPT the trust distributes $60,000 to the beneficiary. What is the beneficiary's taxable amount, and what is the trust's distribution deduction?
o: Beneficiary is taxed only up to DNI: $34,000 taxable and $10,000 tax-exempt; the remaining $16,000 is a tax-free distribution of corpus. Trust deduction = $34,000 (DNI less the tax-exempt portion).
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题分配 < DNI → 按比例拆分；本题分配 > DNI → DNI 封顶，超额部分免税。

【DNI = 双向上限】

  • 受益人应税上限 = DNI；超过 DNI 的 $16,000 视为本金分配 → 免税
  • 性质按 DNI 构成：$34,000 应税 + $10,000 免税
  • 信托分配扣除 = Lesser of（$60,000, DNI $44,000）− 免税部分 $10,000 = $34,000
  • 信托应税所得 = $34,000 − $34,000 − $100 → $0
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：Beneficiary is taxed only up to DNI: $34,000 taxable and $10,000 tax-exempt; the remaining $16,000 is a tax-free distribution of corpus. Trust deduction = $34,000 (DNI less the tax-exempt portion).
qs.tp: T08.3.2 分配扣除与免税比例 Distribution-Deduction-Allocation

qs.s: Warren establishes an irrevocable trust for the benefit of his children, but retains the power to substitute trust assets with other assets of equivalent value at any time (a common 'swap power' used intentionally in estate planning), which under IRC grantor trust rules causes the trust to be treated as a 'Grantor Trust' for income tax purposes, even though the trust is irrevocable and successfully removes the assets from Warren's taxable ESTATE for estate tax purposes. How is the trust's income taxed during Warren's lifetime, and why do estate planners intentionally use this structure?
o: The trust's income is taxed to the trust itself at compressed trust tax rates, exactly like any other complex trust, since the trust is irrevocable.
The trust's income is split 50/50 between Warren and the trust's beneficiaries for income tax purposes, mirroring the estate tax treatment exactly.

Because the trust successfully removes assets from Warren's estate, the income must also be taxed to the beneficiaries directly, never to Warren, since estate tax and income tax treatment are always mirror images of each other.

All of the trust's income, deductions, and credits are reported directly on WARREN's own individual Form 1040 (as if the trust did not exist for income tax purposes), even though the trust assets and future appreciation are successfully excluded from Warren's taxable estate for ESTATE tax purposes. Estate planners intentionally use this structure because Warren paying the income tax personally (out of his own other assets, not from the trust) acts as an additional, tax-free 'gift' to the trust beneficiaries each year, further depleting Warren's own taxable estate without using any additional gift tax exemption.
qs.x:
【🚨 高频陷阱】① 千万不要假设"移出遗产=移出所得税范围"，这是本考点被设置陷阱最多的认知误区；② 常见的触发Grantor Trust规则的条款除了本题的"资产置换权"外，还包括：委托人保留向自己/配偶借款的权力、保留控制受益人身份的权力（在特定限制下）、委托人或配偶被赋予可用于自身利益的收入分配权等——TCP常在题目里给出各种具体的信托条款描述，要求考生判断是否触发Grantor Trust规则，需要熟悉§671-679项下的具体触发条款清单。

【第一步：理解"授予人信托（Grantor Trust）"规则的独特之处 —— 所得税与遗产税"脱钩"】

  • 很多考生直觉认为：信托如果成功地把资产转移出了委托人的应税遗产（遗产税层面"成功"），那么在所得税层面也应该"随之"不再算委托人自己的收入——本题恰恰要打破这种直觉。
  • Grantor Trust 规则（IRC §671-679）的判定，看的是委托人是否保留了特定的控制权或利益（本题的"资产置换权 Swap Power"就是法律列举的典型触发条件之一），这套判定标准与"该信托是否成功移出遗产税应税范围"是完全独立、互不挂钩的两套规则体系。
  • 因此完全可能出现本题的情形：一个信托，遗产税层面已经"离开"了委托人的应税遗产（设计目标达成），但所得税层面，由于触发了Grantor Trust规则的某个条款，其全部收入依然要"归入"委托人自己的Form 1040申报（选项C"两者必须镜像对应"是错误的）。
【第二步：Grantor Trust 收入的申报方式】
  • 信托本身在所得税上被"无视"（Disregarded），其全部收入、扣除、抵免项目，全部像是委托人自己直接持有这些资产一样，直接并入Warren个人的Form 1040申报（选项A"按信托自身税率"和选项B"对半分割"都是错误的）。
【第三步：为什么遗产规划师会"故意"设计这种看似"吃亏"的结构（本题真正的筹划价值所在）】
  • 表面上看，Warren每年要为一笔"已经不属于自己"的信托资产的收益个人缴税，似乎是"额外负担"。
  • 但这恰恰是精妙的筹划设计：Warren是用自己信托之外的其他财产（他自己个人账户里的钱）去支付这笔所得税，相当于每年都在为受益人"免费"多支付一笔税款——这笔税款本可以（如果信托是非Grantor Trust）由信托自己的资产来支付，从而侵蚀信托资产本身；现在由Warren个人财产买单，等于变相地、且完全不消耗任何赠与税年度免税额或终身统一抵免额度，持续地把更多财富从Warren的应税遗产中转移到信托（受益人）一方，是一种"隐形的、免税的额外赠与"。
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：故意保留所得税 Grantor 属性可使委托人承担信托所得税，从而实现对受益人免赠与税的额外财富转移。
qs.tp: T08.1.2 授予人归属触发权利 Grantor-Ownership-Powers

qs.s: Compare Warren's IDGT (irrevocable trust with a swap power) with a revocable living trust in which Warren keeps the power to revoke. Which statement is correct about the revocable trust?
o: It is a grantor trust for income tax, but its assets are excluded from Warren's estate.
It is a grantor trust for income tax AND its assets are included in Warren's gross estate (Sec. 2038), so it provides probate avoidance but no estate tax reduction.
It removes assets from both income and estate taxation.
It is taxed as a separate complex trust.
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】两者都是 Grantor Trust，但遗产税结果相反 → 再次证明所得税与遗产税规则相互独立。

【两种信托对比】

IDGT（有资产置换权的不可撤销信托）可撤销生前信托
所得税Grantor Trust（委托人申报）Grantor Trust（委托人申报）
遗产税排除在遗产外计入遗产（2038 撤销权）
用途遗产税筹划 + 委托人代缴税"额外赠与"避免遗嘱认证（Probate）、隐私、失能管理
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：It is a grantor trust for income tax AND its assets are included in Warren's gross estate (Sec. 2038), so it provides probate avoidance but no estate tax reduction.
qs.tp: T08.1.3 可撤销信托与死亡 Revocable-Trust-Death

qs.s: A complex trust has DNI of $50,000 (all taxable; no charitable contributions). The trust instrument requires $40,000 of income to be paid to A each year (first tier). The trustee also makes a discretionary $30,000 distribution to B (second tier). How much is taxable to A and to B?
o: A $40,000; B $10,000 — first-tier distributions absorb DNI first; only the remaining $10,000 of DNI is carried out to second-tier beneficiaries, and the rest of B's distribution is a tax-free distribution of corpus.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】不是按分配额比例分摊 DNI（选项B）；若第一层超过 DNI，则第一层受益人之间按比例分摊，第二层为 0。

【分层系统（Sec.662(a)）】

  • 第一层：必须分配的收入（Required Income） → 先吸收 DNI
  • 第二层：其他分配（酌情分配、本金分配） → 只能吸收剩余 DNI（按第二层受益人之间比例）
【计算】A 40,000 ≤ DNI 50,000 → A 应税 40,000；剩余 DNI 10,000 → B 应税 10,000；B 另 20,000 为本金 → 免税
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：A $40,000; B $10,000 — first-tier distributions absorb DNI first; only the remaining $10,000 of DNI is carried out to second-tier beneficiaries, and the rest of B's distribution is a tax-free distribution of corpus.
qs.tp: T08.4 分层与分配顺序 Distribution-Tiers-Ordering

qs.s: A single trust is administered as two substantially separate and independent shares, one for each of two siblings. This year the trustee distributes only from Sibling 1's share, in an amount larger than that share's income, while Sibling 2's share accumulates its income. Under the separate share rule, what is the result?
o: The distribution to Sibling 1 carries out the DNI of the entire trust, including Sibling 2's share.
Each share must file a separate Form 1041.

DNI is computed separately for each share; the distribution to Sibling 1 carries out only the DNI of Sibling 1's share, and Sibling 2's accumulated income remains taxable to the trust (or later to Sibling 2), preventing one beneficiary from being taxed on income that belongs to another.
The separate share rule applies only to estates.
qs.x:
【🚨 结果】Sibling 1 的应税额以其份额的 DNI 为限，超出部分视为本金分配。

【Sec.663(c) 独立份额规则】同一信托内存在实质独立的份额（经济利益互不影响） → 各份额单独计算 DNI

  • 目的：防止 A 份额的分配"带出"B 份额的收入，让 A 替 B 纳税
  • 遗产同样适用（如遗嘱规定的分份额遗赠）
  • 仍只申报一份 Form 1041
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：DNI is computed separately for each share; the distribution to Sibling 1 carries out only the DNI of Sibling 1's share, and Sibling 2's accumulated income remains taxable to the trust (or later to Sibling 2), preventing one beneficiary from being taxed on income that belongs to another.
qs.tp: T08.4.1 独立份额隔离DNI Separate-Share-Rule

qs.s: A complex trust has $90,000 of taxable interest and $10,000 of tax-exempt interest. Under the trust instrument (which is silent on the source of charitable payments), it pays $20,000 to a public charity. What is the trust's charitable deduction?
o: $18,000 — the payment is deemed made proportionately from each class of income, so the 10% attributable to tax-exempt income ($2,000) is not deductible; there is no percentage-of-AGI limit for trusts.
$20,000 — trusts deduct charitable payments without limit.
qs.x:
【🚨 联动】慈善扣除在分层系统中先于第二层分配减少 DNI（见 TBS）。

【Sec.642(c)】信托/遗产的慈善扣除：

  • 须依据信托文件、从总收入中支付（本金支付不可扣）
  • 无 AGI 百分比限额（与个人不同）
  • 遗产（及做 645 选择的信托）可扣"为慈善预留"的金额；一般信托须实际支付
  • 可选择把次年支付的金额视为本年支付
【比例分摊】文件未指定来源 → 按收入构成比例 → 免税部分 10% × $20,000 = $2,000 不可扣除 → $18,000
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：$18,000 — the payment is deemed made proportionately from each class of income, so the 10% attributable to tax-exempt income ($2,000) is not deductible; there is no percentage-of-AGI limit for trusts.
qs.tp: T08.4.2 慈善支付与预留扣除 Charitable-Income-Deduction

qs.s: An estate's final year has deductions exceeding its gross income by $30,000, and it also has an unused $20,000 capital loss carryover. What happens to these items?
o: They pass through to the beneficiaries succeeding to the estate's property: the excess deductions retain their character (e.g., Sec. 67(e) administration costs are deductible by the beneficiary in arriving at AGI; other items as itemized deductions), and the capital loss (and any NOL) carryover is available to the beneficiaries.
They are lost when the estate terminates.
Only the capital loss passes through.
They can be carried back to the estate's prior years only.
qs.x:
【🚨 筹划】预计终止年度有大额费用 → 规划在终止年度支付，把扣除转给高税率受益人。

【Sec.642(h) 终止年度】

  • 超额扣除：终止年度扣除超过收入 → 转给承继财产的受益人
  • 信托/遗产特有的管理费用（67(e)）→ 受益人计算 AGI 时扣除（不受杂项扣除取消影响，依 2020 年最终法规）
  • 其他项目保留原性质
  • 未用完的资本损失、NOL 结转 → 受益人可继续使用
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：They pass through to the beneficiaries succeeding to the estate's property: the excess deductions retain their character (e.g., Sec. 67(e) administration costs are deductible by the beneficiary in arriving at AGI; other items as itemized deductions), and the capital loss (and any NOL) carryover is available to the beneficiaries.
qs.tp: T08.6 终止年度扣除结转 Final-Year-Carryovers

qs.s: After Ann's death, her revocable living trust (which holds most of her assets) and her small probate estate must file income tax returns. What is a benefit of the executor and trustee making a Sec. 645 election?
o: The trust becomes exempt from income tax.
It eliminates estate tax on the trust assets.
It permits the trust to use the individual's standard deduction.

The trust is treated as part of the estate for income tax purposes during the election period, allowing a single return with a fiscal year, the estate's charitable set-aside deduction, the $600 exemption, and estate-specific relief (e.g., the 2-year active participation rule for rental real estate and holding S stock without QSST/ESBT elections for the period).
qs.x:
【🚨 程序】Form 8855，在第一份遗产所得税申报截止日前提交。

【Sec.645 选举】合格可撤销信托（委托人死亡后变为不可撤销）视为遗产的一部分：

  • 可选财政年度（信托本需日历年）
  • 适用遗产的 $600 免税额、慈善预留扣除（642(c)(2)）
  • 出租房地产的 2 年"积极参与"延续（$25,000 宽免额）
  • 持有 S 公司股票的宽限（遗产本就是合格股东）
  • 期限：一般至死亡后 2 年（需报遗产税者为死亡后 2 年与遗产税最终确定后 6 个月孰晚）
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：The trust is treated as part of the estate for income tax purposes during the election period, allowing a single return with a fiscal year, the estate's charitable set-aside deduction, the $600 exemption, and estate-specific relief (e.g., the 2-year active participation rule for rental real estate and holding S stock without QSST/ESBT elections for the period).
qs.tp: T08.5.2 可撤销信托并入遗产 Qualified-Trust-Estate-Election

qs.s: A complex trust has undistributed net investment income of $40,000 and adjusted gross income of $60,000. Assume the NIIT threshold for trusts (the dollar amount at which the highest trust bracket begins) is $16,000. What is the trust's NIIT, and how could it be reduced?
o: $1,520 = 3.8% × the lesser of undistributed NII ($40,000) or AGI over the threshold ($44,000); distributing NII to beneficiaries (whose thresholds are $200,000/$250,000) shifts it out of the trust.
qs.x:
【🚨 豁免】慈善剩余信托、Grantor Trust 本身、免税信托不适用。

【Sec.1411(a)(2) 信托/遗产 NIIT】= 3.8% × Lesser of（未分配 NII，AGI − 最高税率级距起点）

  • 门槛极低（约 $16,000 左右，按年调整，题目会给出）vs 个人 $200,000/$250,000
  • Lesser of（40,000, 60,000 − 16,000 = 44,000）= 40,000 × 3.8% = $1,520
【筹划】把 NII 分配给受益人 → 在受益人层面测试高得多的门槛；Grantor Trust 由委托人按个人门槛
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：$1,520 = 3.8% × the lesser of undistributed NII ($40,000) or AGI over the threshold ($44,000); distributing NII to beneficiaries (whose thresholds are $200,000/$250,000) shifts it out of the trust.
qs.tp: T08.7 压缩税率与投资税 Compressed-Rates-NIIT

qs.s: Which statement about Form 1041 filing and estimated tax is correct?
o: A trust must file Form 1041 only if its gross income is $10,000 or more.
Both estates and trusts must make estimated tax payments from their first year.
An estate may choose any tax year, but a trust may choose a fiscal year as long as it is not a grantor trust.

An estate must file if its gross income is $600 or more, and a trust must file if it has any taxable income, gross income of $600 or more, or a nonresident alien beneficiary; estates (and certain trusts receiving the residue of a will) are exempt from estimated tax for tax years ending within 2 years after the decedent's death, while other trusts must pay estimated tax.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】遗产可选财政年度并享 2 年预估税豁免——这也是 645 选择把可撤销信托并入遗产的主要好处之一。

【Form 1041 申报门槛】

  • 遗产：年总收入 ≥ $600
  • 信托：有任何应税所得，或总收入 ≥ $600，或有非居民外国人受益人（选项A错）
【截止日】纳税年度结束后第 4 个月 15 日；延期 5½ 个月（Form 7004）
【纳税年度】遗产可选财政年度；信托一般须用日历年（做 645 选择并入遗产的除外）→ 选项C错
【预估税（Sec.6654(l)）】遗产以及接收遗嘱剩余财产的 Grantor Trust：死亡后 2 年内结束的纳税年度豁免；其他信托须缴纳（选项B错）
【65 天规则】复杂信托与遗产可把次年前 65 天的分配视为本年分配（663(b)）
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：遗产 $600 总收入即须申报；信托有应税所得或 $600 总收入即须申报；遗产在死亡后 2 年内免缴预估税，一般信托不免。
qs.tp: T08.5 年度申报与预估税 Filing-Estimated-Taxes

qs.s: A simple trust receives $20,000 of dividends, $10,000 of taxable interest, and a $30,000 capital gain, and pays a $4,000 trustee fee. The trust instrument is silent, and state law follows the Uniform Principal and Income Act. How much trust accounting income must be distributed to the income beneficiary?
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】"会计收入"（信托法）与"DNI"（税法）是两套口径；简单/复杂信托的判定看的是会计收入是否须全部分配。

【UPIA 默认分配】

项目归属
股息、利息、租金收入
资本利得本金
受托人年费一半收入、一半本金
出售资产的交易费用、资本改良本金
  • 会计收入 = $20,000 + $10,000 − $4,000 × ½ = $28,000
  • 简单信托须分配全部会计收入 → $28,000
【税务影响】会计收入决定分配额；DNI 另按税法计算（资本利得归本金且未分配 → 不进 DNI，由信托自己纳税）
【干扰项】选项B 把资本利得计入收入；选项C 把受托人费用全部计入收入；选项D 忽略受托人费用
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：股息和利息归收入，资本利得归本金，受托人费用一半由收入负担：$30,000 − $2,000 = $28,000。
qs.tp: T08.2 会计收入与本金归属 Accounting-Income-Corpus

qs.s: Victor is the sole grantor and sole owner of a revocable living trust. Which reporting method is permitted?
o: The trust must file a full Form 1041 and pay tax at trust rates.

The trustee may furnish Victor's name and SSN to payers so that income is reported directly to him (no Form 1041 required), or may file a Form 1041 showing no income items with an attached grantor statement, or may use the optional Form 1099 method; in every case Victor reports all trust income on his own Form 1040.
The trust income is reported by the remainder beneficiaries.
The trust must obtain its own EIN and file Form 1041 with Schedule K-1s to Victor.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】可撤销生前信托在委托人在世期间通常不需要单独 EIN——死亡时才"诞生"为独立纳税人。

【Grantor Trust 申报方法（Reg. §1.671-4）】
① 一般方法：以信托 EIN 提交 Form 1041，表中不填收入项目，附授予人声明列示各项收支 → 由授予人申报
② 可选方法一（单一授予人且为唯一所有人）：向付款方提供授予人的姓名与 SSN，1099 直接发给授予人 → 无需 1041
③ 可选方法二：以信托 EIN 收款，受托人再向授予人出具 1099

  • 无论哪种方法，全部收入、扣除与抵免都在授予人个人 1040 中申报
【授予人死亡后】信托成为不可撤销的非授予人信托，须取得 EIN；可考虑 645 选举并入遗产
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：可使用可选方法（向付款方提供授予人 SSN，不需 1041）、或提交附授予人声明的空白 1041、或 1099 方法；收入一律由授予人申报。
qs.tp: T08.1.4 授予人信托申报 Grantor-Trust-Reporting

qs.s: A family trust has elected ESBT status and holds S corporation stock. Its share of the S corporation's items is $100,000 of ordinary business income and $20,000 of long-term capital gain. The trustee distributes $80,000 to beneficiaries from S-related cash. Ignoring NIIT, any exemption, and the Sec. 199A deduction, what is the federal income tax on the S portion?
o: $0, because the distribution carries the income out to the beneficiaries.
$41,000 — the S portion is taxed at the trust level at the highest individual rates (37% × $100,000 + 20% × $20,000), with no distribution deduction for the S portion.
$11,000 — only the undistributed $40,000 is taxed at the trust level.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】ESBT 灵活（可多受益人、可累积收入）但税负最重；受益人税率低时 QSST 往往更划算。

【ESBT（Sec.641(c)）】信托分为 S 部分与非 S 部分，分别计税

  • S 部分：按最高个人税率课税（普通 37%、LTCG 20%），没有分配扣除——分配给受益人也不"带出"S 公司收入（选项A、D错）
  • 37% × 100,000 + 20% × 20,000 = 37,000 + 4,000 = 41,000（资本利得仍适用优惠税率 → 选项C错）
  • S 部分实际上可享 Sec.199A 扣除（Reg. §1.199A-6(d)(3)），本题题干要求忽略
  • 非 S 部分：按一般信托规则（DNI、分配扣除）
  • S 部分可扣除与 S 收入相关的州税、管理费；慈善扣除按个人规则
【🔁 对比 QSST】受益人选举、收入须全部分配、由受益人按个人税率纳税
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：ESBT 的 S 部分在信托层面按最高个人税率课税、无分配扣除：37% × $100,000 + 20% × $20,000 = $41,000。
qs.tp: T08.8 持有S股的信托税制 S-Stock-Trust-Taxation

qs.s: A complex trust (not in its final year) has a $10,000 net capital loss and $50,000 of interest income, all of which it distributes. Which statement is correct?
o: The capital loss passes through to the beneficiary in proportion to distributions.
The capital loss reduces DNI, so the beneficiary is taxed on $40,000.
The capital loss expires if the trust cannot use it this year.
The capital loss stays at the trust level (deductible against trust income up to $3,000, with the excess carried forward); it passes to the beneficiaries only in the trust's final year.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】资本损失不减 DNI → 受益人照样按全部利息纳税，信托的资本损失可能长期用不上。

【信托资本损失】

  • 资本损益一般归本金，不进 DNI（资本损失不减少 DNI）
  • 信托层面按 1211(b)：净资本损失可抵普通所得 $3,000，其余结转
  • 终止年度：未用完的资本损失结转与多余扣除转给承继财产的受益人（642(h)）
【本题】受益人按 DNI 50,000 纳税；资本损失留在信托
【干扰项】选项AB 资本损失不随分配流出；选项C 信托资本损失无限期结转
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：资本损失留在信托层面（$3,000 抵减、余额结转），只在终止年度转给受益人。
qs.tp: T08.3.1 资本损益与DNI Capital-Gains-Losses

qs.s: A trust owns a rental building with $20,000 of depreciation. The trust instrument is silent on a depreciation reserve. This year 60% of trust income is distributed to the beneficiaries and 40% is accumulated. How is the depreciation deduction allocated?
o: $12,000 to the beneficiaries and $8,000 to the trust, in proportion to the trust income allocable to each.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】遗产的折旧按收入分配比例在遗产与继承人/受益人之间分配（Reg. 1.167(h)-1(c)）。

【Sec.167(d) 与 Reg. 1.167(h)-1(b)】信托的折旧在受托人与受益人之间按各自分得的信托收入比例分配

  • 60% × 20,000 = 12,000 给受益人（K-1 单独列示），40% = 8,000 留在信托
  • 若信托文件要求（或当地法律要求）从收入中提取折旧准备，则信托先分得与准备金相当的折旧
  • 折旧不作为信托的扣除项目进入 DNI 计算后再分配——而是直接分配
【干扰项】选项ACD 忽略按收入比例分配的规则
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：文件未规定准备金时，折旧按信托收入分配比例分配：受益人 $12,000、信托 $8,000。
qs.tp: T08.2.1 折旧直接分配与准备 Depreciation-Allocation-Reserve

qs.s: The trustee of a calendar-year complex trust pays a beneficiary $20,000 on February 20, 2027 and wants the payment treated as a 2026 distribution. Which statement is correct?
o: It is not possible; distributions are taken into account only in the year paid.
The election is available only to estates.

The trustee may elect under Sec. 663(b) on a timely filed 2026 Form 1041 to treat distributions made within the first 65 days of 2027 as made on December 31, 2026, up to the greater of 2026 fiduciary accounting income or DNI, reduced by other 2026 distributions.
The election must be made by December 31, 2026.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】信托税率级距极度压缩（约 $16,000 即达最高税率），65 天规则是年终规划的关键工具。

【Sec.663(b) 65 天规则】复杂信托（及遗产）可选择把次年前 65 天内的分配视为上一年最后一天分配

  • 2027 年 1 月 31 天 + 2 月 28 天 + 3 月 6 天 = 65 天 → 截至 2027/3/6
  • 在上一年度的 Form 1041（含延期）上选择，不可撤销
  • 上限：该年度 FAI 与 DNI 中较大者，减去该年度已作的分配
【筹划】年终确认信托收入后再决定分配，把收入从高税率的信托转给低税率受益人
【干扰项】选项A 忽略 663(b)；选项B 信托也可用；选项D 选择在申报时作出
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：复杂信托可依 663(b) 在按时申报的 2026 年 Form 1041 上选择，把 2027 年前 65 天的分配视为 2026 年分配。
qs.tp: T08.5.3 六十五天回溯分配 Sixty-Five-Day-Election

qs.s: In 2026 an estate with $80,000 of DNI distributes (1) a painting worth $50,000 to a niece as a specific bequest under the will, paid in one installment, and (2) $100,000 of cash from the residue to the decedent's son. How much income does each beneficiary report?
o: Niece $0; son $80,000 — the specific bequest is excluded from the distribution rules, so all DNI is carried out by the residuary distribution.
Niece $26,667 and son $53,333 (pro rata by amounts distributed).
Neither beneficiary reports income because the distributor is an estate.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】只有"特定"遗赠免于 DNI——按公式或从剩余遗产中支付的遗赠照样带出收入。

【Sec.663(a)(1)】按遗嘱规定的特定金额或特定财产的赠与，若一次或不超过 3 次分期支付 → 不视为分配，不携带 DNI

  • 侄女的画：特定遗赠 → 免税，Basis 按遗产的 Basis（通常为死亡时 FMV）
  • 儿子：剩余遗产分配 100,000 > DNI 80,000 → 按 80,000 纳税
【对比】剩余遗产、金额按公式计算的遗赠（例如"用完免除额的金额"）不适用 663(a)(1)
【干扰项】选项B 错误地按比例分摊；选项C 特定遗赠不是收入；选项D 遗产分配同样携带 DNI
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：特定遗赠依 663(a)(1) 不携带 DNI，全部 $80,000 DNI 由儿子的剩余遗产分配带出。
qs.tp: T08.4.3 特定遗赠排除 Specific-Bequest-Exclusion

qs.s: Which statement about the tax year of an estate and a trust is correct?
o: Both must use the calendar year.

An estate may choose any fiscal year; a trust (other than a tax-exempt or wholly charitable trust) must use the calendar year, although a revocable trust with a Sec. 645 election is treated as part of the estate and may use the estate's fiscal year.
Both may choose any fiscal year.
A trust may choose a fiscal year, but an estate must use the calendar year.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】遗产的财年选择是递延工具——第一年财年结束越晚，受益人纳税越晚。

【Sec.644】信托（免税信托、慈善信托除外）必须使用日历年

【遗产】可选择任何财年（首个申报表确定），常用于递延：受益人按其包含遗产年度结束日的年度申报 K-1 收入
【Sec.645 选择】合格可撤销信托可视为遗产的一部分 → 可用遗产的财年、适用遗产的其他优惠（如 642(c) 预留慈善扣除、$600 豁免）
【干扰项】选项ACD 规则颠倒或过宽
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：遗产可选任何财年，信托须用日历年；做了 645 选择的可撤销信托可随遗产使用财年。
qs.tp: T08.5.1 纳税年度与包含时点 Tax-Year-Inclusion-Timing

qs.s: A complex trust with $100,000 of DNI distributes stock (trust basis $20,000; FMV $50,000) to a beneficiary; there are no other distributions. Which statement is correct?
o: The distribution is always taken into account at FMV ($50,000), and the beneficiary's basis is $50,000.
The trust must always recognize the $30,000 of gain.
The beneficiary's basis is $50,000 and the trust recognizes no gain.

Without an election, the distribution is taken into account at $20,000 (the lesser of basis or FMV), the trust recognizes no gain, and the beneficiary's basis is $20,000; with a Sec. 643(e) election, the trust recognizes $30,000 of gain, the distribution is $50,000, and the beneficiary's basis is $50,000.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】643(e) 选择适用于当年全部实物分配，不能挑选个别资产。

【Sec.643(e) 实物分配】

  • 不选择：分配额 = Min(信托 Basis, FMV) = 20,000（带出 20,000 DNI）；信托不确认利得；受益人 Basis = 20,000
  • 选择（该年度所有实物分配一并适用）：信托按 FMV 视同出售 → 确认 30,000 利得；分配额 50,000；受益人 Basis 50,000
【注意】履行金额义务（如以财产支付 $50,000 的现金遗赠）是视同出售，必须确认利得（Kenan 规则），与 643(e) 无关
【干扰项】选项ABC 都混淆了选择与不选择的结果
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：不选择时按 Min(Basis, FMV) = $20,000 计算、信托不确认利得、受益人 Basis $20,000；选择 643(e) 则按 FMV 并确认 $30,000 利得。
qs.tp: T08.4.4 实物分配选择 Property-In-Kind-Election

qs.s: Two organizations both qualify for federal income tax exemption under Sec. 501(c)(3). Organization Alpha receives the vast majority of its funding from a broad base of small individual donations and government grants spread across thousands of unrelated donors, none of whom contributes a disproportionately large share. Organization Beta is funded almost entirely by a single wealthy family's ongoing contributions, with no meaningful broad public support. Both are otherwise identical in their charitable mission. How does the classification of each organization (public charity vs. private foundation) affect their respective regulatory and tax burden?
o: Beta automatically loses its Sec. 501(c)(3) exemption entirely because private foundations are not permitted to be tax-exempt under any circumstances.
There is no meaningful distinction; all Sec. 501(c)(3) organizations are treated identically regardless of their funding sources.
The public support test only matters for determining eligibility for state-level tax exemption, not federal tax-exempt status or its regulatory consequences.

Alpha (broad public support) qualifies as a PUBLIC CHARITY, which is subject to relatively lighter regulatory burdens and allows donors more generous charitable deduction limits; Beta (narrow, family-dominated funding) is classified as a PRIVATE FOUNDATION, which faces stricter regulation including mandatory minimum annual distribution requirements, excise taxes on net investment income, strict self-dealing prohibitions with 'disqualified persons' (like the funding family), and generally lower donor deduction limits/valuation rules for certain contributed property.
qs.x:
【🚨 高频陷阱】① 很多考生误以为"私人基金会"是某种"更差"或"不合规"的免税组织类型，实际上它是完全合法、被广泛使用的慈善工具（尤其常见于家族慈善规划），只是监管强度显著更高；② TCP 筹划题常问"客户想设立家族慈善实体，应建议 Private Foundation 还是 Donor-Advised Fund（捐赠人建议基金，通常依托某个大型公共慈善机构设立子账户）"——DAF 通常能让捐赠人享受Public Charity级别的更优惠扣除待遇、同时规避私人基金会繁琐的年度分配和自我交易限制，是近年来越来越受欢迎的替代方案，这是本考点常见的进阶筹划延伸问法。

【第一步：Public Charity 与 Private Foundation 的核心区分标准 —— 公众支持测试】

  • 两者都依法享有501(c)(3)联邦所得税免税资格（选项A"Private Foundation不能免税"是彻底错误的——私人基金会同样是合法的免税组织类型，只是监管更严格），区分的关键在于资金来源的广泛程度：
  • Public Charity（公共慈善组织）：资金来源广泛，来自公众、政府或多个不相关捐赠人，没有任何单一或少数捐赠人占据支配地位（本题Alpha符合）。
  • Private Foundation（私人基金会）：资金来源高度集中，通常源自单一个人、家族或公司（本题Beta符合）。
【第二步：Private Foundation 面临的额外监管负担（本题考点核心）】
  • 强制最低年度分配要求：私人基金会必须每年将其投资资产公允价值的一定比例（通常约5%）用于慈善分配，否则面临惩罚性消费税。
  • 净投资收益消费税：私人基金会须就其净投资收益缴纳一定比例的消费税（例如常见比例为1.39%）。
  • 严格的自我交易（Self-Dealing）禁令：基金会与"受限人员"（Disqualified Persons，通常包括主要捐赠人、基金会管理人及其近亲家庭成员，如本题的资助家族）之间的绝大多数直接交易（买卖、租赁、借贷等）一律被禁止，无论条款是否公平合理，违反将招致高额惩罚性消费税。
  • 捐赠人扣除限制相对更低：向私人基金会捐赠现金的AGI扣除限额，通常低于向公共慈善机构捐赠的限额；捐赠增值财产给私人基金会时，扣除基础的计算规则也往往比捐给公共慈善机构更为不利（某些情形下限于扣除Basis而非FMV）。
【第三步：Public Charity 享有的相对宽松待遇】
  • 无需满足强制年度最低分配要求；无自我交易的绝对禁令（虽然仍受一般不当得利/过度利益交易规则约束，但严格程度远低于私人基金会）；捐赠人享有更高的AGI扣除限额（现金60%、增值财产30%）。
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：公共慈善机构与私人基金会在公众支持度、自我交易惩罚及捐赠扣除限额等方面存在系统性差异。
qs.tp: T09.3 慈善组织分类 Charity-Foundation-Classification

qs.s: A private foundation leases office space from its founder (a disqualified person) at 50% of fair market rent. The founder argues the arrangement benefits the foundation. Is this self-dealing?
o: Only if the founder is also a foundation manager.
No, because the terms favor the foundation.
No, because rent is less than market.

Yes — a lease of property between a private foundation and a disqualified person is self-dealing regardless of fairness; the only exception for leases from a disqualified person to the foundation is when the use is provided entirely without charge.
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题考两类组织的监管差异；本题考私人基金会"绝对禁止"的严格程度。

【自我交易（Sec.4941）】基金会与受限人员之间的租赁、买卖、借贷等一律禁止，无论条款是否公平、是否对基金会有利

  • 唯一例外：受限人员将财产完全免费提供给基金会使用（半价仍需付费 → 违规）
  • 后果：对受限人员征收首轮消费税，未纠正再征更高额消费税；批准的基金会管理人也可能被征税
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：Yes — a lease of property between a private foundation and a disqualified person is self-dealing regardless of fairness; the only exception for leases from a disqualified person to the foundation is when the use is provided entirely without charge.
qs.tp: T09.4.1 基金会自我交易 Foundation-Self-Dealing

qs.s: A tax-exempt university museum operates a gift shop that sells two categories of items: (1) reproductions of artwork and books directly related to the museum's own permanent art collection and educational mission, and (2) general souvenir items completely unrelated to art or the museum's collection (like generic mugs, t-shirts, and snacks) that could be sold at any typical tourist gift shop. The gift shop is staffed by paid employees (not volunteers) and operates regularly throughout the year (not just occasionally). Which portion, if any, of the gift shop's net income is subject to Unrelated Business Income Tax (UBIT)?
o: UBIT never applies to museums specifically, regardless of what is sold, due to a blanket statutory exemption for all museum gift shop sales.

The income from selling art-related reproductions and books IS substantially related to the museum's exempt educational purpose and is NOT subject to UBIT; the income from selling the unrelated general souvenir items (mugs, t-shirts, snacks with no connection to the museum's mission) fails the 'substantially related' test and IS subject to UBIT (assuming the trade/business, regularly-carried-on, and unrelated tests are all met, and no other exception like a volunteer-labor exception applies since paid staff run the shop).
All gift shop income is automatically subject to UBIT because gift shops are inherently commercial in nature regardless of what they sell.
None of the gift shop's income is subject to UBIT, because it is operated by the tax-exempt museum itself and all proceeds support the museum's charitable mission.
qs.x:
【🚨 高频陷阱】① 选项D"只要是免税组织自己经营、且收益用于慈善宗旨就全部免税"是最常见的错误认知——UBIT规则的设计初衷正是为了防止免税组织利用其免税身份，在普通商业竞争领域对营利性企业形成不公平的税负优势，因此收益的最终用途（哪怕100%用于慈善）不能豁免UBIT，真正决定是否豁免的是该项具体业务活动本身与免税宗旨是否实质相关；② 若组织当年不相关业务总收入（gross income）≥ $1,000，则必须提交Form 990-T并按公司税率纳税，这是常与本考点搭配出现的申报门槛延伸问法。

【第一步：UBIT 三项构成要件回顾】

  • 某项收入要被课征UBIT，须同时满足：① 源自贸易或业务（Trade or Business）活动；② 经常性（Regularly Carried On）开展（本题"常年运营，非偶发性质"满足）；③ 与该组织的免税宗旨无实质关联（Not Substantially Related）。
  • 本题①②两项条件在两类商品销售上都满足（都是常年、有偿雇员经营的商业销售活动），真正的分水岭在于第③项"与免税宗旨是否实质相关"。
【第二步：逐类判断"实质相关性"】
  • 艺术复制品/相关书籍：这类商品直接服务于博物馆的教育宗旨——延伸、传播博物馆自身馆藏的艺术教育价值，属于博物馆履行其免税使命的自然延伸，因此被认定为与免税宗旨"实质相关"，不构成UBI，其收入不缴纳UBIT。
  • 普通纪念品（马克杯、T恤、零食等）：这类商品与博物馆的艺术/教育宗旨没有内在联系，换成任何一家普通旅游纪念品商店都能卖这些东西——这部分收入的产生逻辑纯粹是"利用博物馆的人流量做普通零售生意"，与教育宗旨"不实质相关"→ 构成UBI，需要缴纳UBIT（按公司税率，通过Form 990-T申报）。
【第三步：为什么"雇员经营"这一细节在题目里被特意点出】
  • UBI 有若干法定排除项，其中之一是"志愿者劳动力"排除（若该项业务全部或绝大部分由不领薪的志愿者运营，即使不相关，也可豁免UBIT）。
  • 本题特意说明礼品店由有薪雇员运营（而非志愿者），意味着不适用志愿者劳动力这一豁免路径，因此不相关部分的销售收入依然要正常缴纳UBIT——这是本题用来测试考生"是否会误以为只要是免税组织自己经营就自动豁免"的关键细节设计。
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：同一个礼品店的收入需要按商品性质"拆分"处理，相关部分免税，不相关部分需缴UBIT。
qs.tp: T09.6.1 业务收入分类 Activity-Income-Classification

qs.s: A tax-exempt museum owns an investment office building (unrelated to its mission) that it acquired partly with a mortgage. Average acquisition indebtedness is 40% of the building's average adjusted basis for the year. Net rental income is $100,000. How much is UBTI (before the $1,000 specific deduction)?
o: $0 — rents from real property are always excluded from UBTI.
$40,000 — rents from real property are generally excluded, but income from debt-financed property is included in UBTI in proportion to the debt (40%).
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题考"实质相关"测试；本题考被动收入排除的例外。

【被动收入排除】股息、利息、特许权使用费、不动产租金一般不属于 UBTI

【例外：债务融资财产（Sec.514）】用借款购置的与宗旨无关的财产 → 收入按 平均购置债务 ÷ 平均调整 Basis 比例计入 UBTI
  • $100,000 × 40% = $40,000
  • 另有 $1,000 特定扣除；UBI ≥ $1,000 需报 990-T
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：$40,000 — rents from real property are generally excluded, but income from debt-financed property is included in UBTI in proportion to the debt (40%).
qs.tp: T09.6.5 债务融资所得 Debt-Financed-Income

qs.s: A private nonoperating foundation's average fair market value of assets not used for charitable purposes is $10,000,000. Its net investment income is $200,000 (Sec. 4940 tax rate 1.39%). It makes $300,000 of qualifying distributions by the end of the following year. What is the Sec. 4942 initial tax?
o: $59,166 — distributable amount = 5% × $10,000,000 − the $2,780 Sec. 4940 tax = $497,220; undistributed income = $197,220; initial tax 30%.
qs.x:
【🚨 例外】私人运营基金会不适用 4942（须自行开展慈善活动）。

【Sec.4940】净投资收益 × 1.39% = 200,000 × 1.39% = $2,780

【Sec.4942 最低分配额】
  • Minimum Investment Return = 5% × 非慈善用途资产平均 FMV = $500,000
  • 可分配额 = 500,000 − 4940 税 2,780（及 UBIT）= $497,220
  • 须在次年年末前以合格分配（资助、慈善直接支出、合理管理费等）完成
  • 未分配额 = 497,220 − 300,000 = 197,220 × 30% = $59,166；再不纠正 → 100%
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：$59,166 — distributable amount = 5% × $10,000,000 − the $2,780 Sec. 4940 tax = $497,220; undistributed income = $197,220; initial tax 30%.
qs.tp: T09.4.2 最低慈善分配 Minimum-Qualifying-Distributions

qs.s: Which private foundation action most clearly triggers the Sec. 4945 taxable expenditure tax?
o: Making a program-related investment in a low-income housing project.
Holding 15% of a company's voting stock when disqualified persons hold none.
Investing a modest portion of assets in a diversified stock index fund.
Paying for a campaign to influence legislation (lobbying), or making a grant to a non-charity without exercising expenditure responsibility.
qs.x:
【🚨 未纠正】二轮税大幅提高（4942：100%；4945：100%）。

【私人基金会消费税一览】

条款内容首轮税（基金会）管理人
4940净投资收益1.39%—
4941自我交易10%（由自我交易人承担）5%

4945应税支出：游说、竞选、对个人资助无 IRS 批准程序、对非公共慈善机构资助未履行支出责任20%5%
  • B：15% < 20% → 不构成超额持股；选项A：PRI 属于 4944 的例外

qs.s: A public charity pays its CEO (a disqualified person) $500,000; comparable compensation is $300,000. Board members knowingly approved it. What excise taxes apply?
o: The charity loses its exemption immediately; no excise tax applies.

Excess benefit of $200,000: the CEO owes a 25% first-tier tax ($50,000) and must correct (repay) the excess; if not corrected, a 200% second-tier tax ($400,000) applies; approving managers owe 10% ($20,000, capped at $20,000 per transaction). A rebuttable presumption of reasonableness is available if an independent board relies on comparability data and documents its decision.
Only the board members are taxed.
qs.x:
【🚨 对比】私人基金会适用更严格的 4941 自我交易（公平交易也禁止）。

【中间制裁（适用于公共慈善与 501(c)(4)/(29)）】—— 比撤销免税资格更温和的惩罚

  • 超额利益 = $500,000 − $300,000 = $200,000
  • 受限人员：25% → $50,000；未纠正 → 200% → $400,000
  • 明知而批准的组织管理人：10%，每笔交易上限 $20,000 → $20,000
  • 组织本身不缴税
【可反驳的合理性推定】① 由无利益冲突的机构批准 ② 依据可比数据 ③ 同期书面记录
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：Excess benefit of $200,000: the CEO owes a 25% first-tier tax ($50,000) and must correct (repay) the excess; if not corrected, a 200% second-tier tax ($400,000) applies; approving managers owe 10% ($20,000, capped at $20,000 per transaction). A rebuttable presumption of reasonableness is available if an independent board relies on comparability data and documents its decision.

qs.s: A public charity that has made the Sec. 501(h) election has total exempt purpose expenditures of $400,000, which include $100,000 spent on lobbying. Under the sliding scale, its lobbying nontaxable amount is 20% of the first $500,000 of exempt purpose expenditures. What is the result? Separately, what if it endorses a candidate for public office?
o: The charity immediately loses its exemption for exceeding the lobbying limit.
No consequence for lobbying; endorsing a candidate is permitted if disclosed.
501(h)-electing charities may spend unlimited amounts on lobbying.

Nontaxable amount = 20% × $400,000 = $80,000; excess lobbying of $20,000 incurs a 25% excise tax ($5,000) (exemption is at risk only if lobbying normally exceeds 150% of the limit over 4 years). Endorsing a candidate is absolutely prohibited political campaign intervention — it can cause loss of exemption plus a Sec. 4955 excise tax.
qs.x:
【🚨 私人基金会】任何游说支出均为 4945 应税支出。

【501(h) 支出测试（Sec.4911）】

  • 游说免税额（滑动比例）：首 $500,000 的 20%；以上逐级 15%/10%/5%，上限 $1,000,000
  • 草根游说上限 = 免税额的 25%
  • 本题：20% × 400,000 = 80,000；超额 20,000 × 25% = $5,000
  • 4 年平均超过 150% → 失去免税资格
  • 未选择 501(h) → 适用模糊的"实质部分"测试；教会不能选择 501(h)
【政治竞选】绝对禁止支持或反对候选人 → 撤销免税 + 4955 消费税（组织 10%、管理人 2.5%）
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：Nontaxable amount = 20% × $400,000 = $80,000; excess lobbying of $20,000 incurs a 25% excise tax ($5,000) (exemption is at risk only if lobbying normally exceeds 150% of the limit over 4 years). Endorsing a candidate is absolutely prohibited political campaign intervention — it can cause loss of exemption plus a Sec. 4955 excise tax.

qs.s: A tax-exempt hospital pays a covered employee $1,500,000 of compensation (none of it for medical services performed as a licensed physician). Which statement is correct?
o: No tax applies to exempt organizations.

The ORGANIZATION pays a 21% excise tax on remuneration over $1,000,000 paid to a covered employee: 21% × $500,000 = $105,000 (and on any excess parachute payments); the employee is not liable for this tax.
The employee pays 21% on the excess.
The tax applies only to compensation above $5,000,000.
qs.x:
【🚨 对比】营利公司对应规则：Sec.162(m)（扣除限制）与 Sec.280G/4999（降落伞）。

【Sec.4960】适用免税组织（ATEO）对"受涵盖员工"支付的薪酬 > $1,000,000 的部分 → 组织缴纳 21% 消费税（对应公司税率）

  • 21% × (1,500,000 − 1,000,000) = $105,000
  • 同时适用于超额降落伞付款（离职款 ≥ 3 倍基数）
  • 持证医护人员提供医疗服务的报酬排除
  • OBBBA 自 2026 年起扩大了受涵盖员工范围，题目会给出适用口径
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：The ORGANIZATION pays a 21% excise tax on remuneration over $1,000,000 paid to a covered employee: 21% × $500,000 = $105,000 (and on any excess parachute payments); the employee is not liable for this tax.

qs.s: A public charity's annual fundraising run receives $50,000 from a corporate sponsor. Case 1: the charity displays the sponsor's logo and slogan ('Proud supporter of the run'). Case 2: the charity's materials state 'Buy Brand X shoes — 20% off for runners, the best shoes in town.' How is the payment treated for UBIT purposes?
o: Neither is UBTI because the event is charitable.

Case 1 is a qualified sponsorship payment (mere acknowledgment — logo, name, value-neutral description) and is not UBTI; Case 2 is advertising (qualitative/comparative language, price information, inducement to buy) and is UBTI.
Case 1 is UBTI; Case 2 is not.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】"为慈善活动带来收入"不能豁免 UBIT；看的是对价性质。

【Sec.513(i) 合格赞助付款】赞助方没有获得"实质回报"，仅获致谢 → 不属于 UBTI

  • 允许：名称、Logo、地址、电话、网址、中性的产品线描述
  • 不允许（构成广告 → UBTI）：比较性或定性语言、价格信息、背书、购买诱导
  • 期刊（杂志）中的广告收入 → UBTI（按期刊广告专门规则计算，可减去读者成本）
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：Case 1 is a qualified sponsorship payment (mere acknowledgment — logo, name, value-neutral description) and is not UBTI; Case 2 is advertising (qualitative/comparative language, price information, inducement to buy) and is UBTI.

qs.s: Which activity of a Sec. 501(c)(3) organization produces unrelated business taxable income?
o: A gift shop staffed entirely by volunteers.
A campus cafeteria operated for the convenience of students and employees.
A thrift shop selling donated clothing.
A public parking lot operated by the organization for the general public near a stadium (not for its members or visitors), producing regular fee income from paid staff.
qs.x:
【🚨 申报】UBTI 总额 ≥ $1,000 → Form 990-T；多项 UBI 活动须逐项计算（Sec.512(a)(6)，亏损不能跨活动抵消）。

【Sec.513(a) 法定例外（不属于 UBI）】
① 志愿者提供全部（实质全部）劳动
② 为成员、学生、患者、员工的便利而经营（如校园食堂、医院礼品店）
③ 出售捐赠物品（慈善二手店）
④ 合格的会议/展会、公共娱乐活动、宾果游戏（合法且非商业普遍经营）
⑤ 被动收入：股息、利息、特许权使用费、不动产租金（债务融资除外）

【选项D】面向公众的停车场：服务收入（非不动产租金排除），与宗旨无关、经常开展、有薪员工 → UBTI
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：A public parking lot operated by the organization for the general public near a stadium (not for its members or visitors), producing regular fee income from paid staff.

qs.s: Which statement about annual information returns of exempt organizations is correct?
o: An organization whose gross receipts are normally $50,000 or less must file the full Form 990.
A private foundation with only $30,000 of gross receipts may file Form 990-N.
Churches must file Form 990-EZ if their gross receipts exceed $50,000.
A public charity with $180,000 of gross receipts but $600,000 of total assets must file the full Form 990, because Form 990-EZ requires gross receipts under $200,000 AND total assets under $500,000.

表格条件

990-EZ总收入 < $200,000 且 年末总资产 < $500,000

qs.s: Hope Inc. was organized on March 1, Year 1 to operate as a Sec. 501(c)(3) public charity. It expects gross receipts of about $400,000 per year. It files Form 1023 on August 1, Year 3. Which statement is correct?
o: Because Form 1023 was filed more than 27 months after formation, exemption generally is recognized only from the date of filing (absent relief); Hope cannot use Form 1023-EZ because its projected gross receipts exceed $50,000; and if it later fails to file its required annual return for 3 consecutive years, its exemption is automatically revoked.
Exemption is always retroactive to the date of formation regardless of when Form 1023 is filed.
Hope may file the streamlined Form 1023-EZ because it is a public charity.
Automatic revocation occurs after 1 year of failing to file.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】27 个月的追溯期直接影响捐赠人：未获追溯的期间，捐款可能不能作为 501(c)(3) 慈善捐赠扣除。

【Form 1023 的 27 个月规则】组织成立后 27 个月内提交 → 免税资格追溯至成立日；逾期 → 一般自提交日起（除非获得 Reg. §301.9100 救济）→ 选项B错

【Form 1023-EZ 条件】预计未来 3 年每年总收入 ≤ $50,000，且总资产 ≤ $250,000（及其他排除情形）→ Hope 不符（选项C错）
【自动撤销（Sec.6033(j)）】连续 3 年未提交应交的 990 系列申报 → 自动撤销，自第三份申报截止日起生效；须重新申请（选项D错）
【其他】教会与年收入通常 ≤ $5,000 的公共慈善无须申请 501(c)(3) 认可
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：逾期超过 27 个月提交 1023，免税一般自提交日起；预计收入超过 $50,000 不能用 1023-EZ；连续 3 年未申报则自动撤销。

Contributions to a Sec. 501(c)(6) trade association are deductible as charitable contributions.
A Sec. 501(c)(7) social club is taxed on its net investment income and on income from nonmembers, while member dues and fees for member services are exempt.
A Sec. 501(c)(7) social club may earn unlimited income from nonmembers without affecting its exemption.

501(c)(4) 社会福利501(c)(6) 商会/行业协会501(c)(7) 社交俱乐部

捐款可否作慈善扣除否否（会费可能作营业费用扣除，选项B错）否
UBTI 特别规则一般规则一般规则Sec.512(a)(3)：投资收入与非会员收入全部应税

qs.s: Over its 5-year computation period, a Sec. 501(c)(3) organization's total support is $1,000,000: $300,000 of gifts from its founder, $150,000 from many small donors (none exceeding $20,000), $250,000 of government grants, and $300,000 of investment income. Under the Sec. 170(b)(1)(A)(vi) public support test, what is its public support percentage, and what is its status?
o: 42% — public charity, because public support is at least 33⅓% of total support.
45% — public charity only if it also meets the 10% facts-and-circumstances test.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】政府补助与来自其他公共慈善的拨款全额计入公众支持，不受 2% 限制；大额创始人捐赠是把组织推向私人基金会的主要原因。

【公众支持测试（5 年合计）】

  • 总支持 = 捐赠 + 政府补助 + 投资收入等 = $1,000,000（相关业务的服务收入不计入此测试的总支持）
  • 2% 上限：任何单一个人/私人捐赠人的捐赠，只有不超过总支持 2%（$20,000）的部分计入公众支持
  • 公众支持 = 创始人 $20,000（上限）+ 小额捐赠 $150,000 + 政府补助 $250,000（全额）= $420,000
  • 比例 = 42% ≥ 33⅓% → 公共慈善
【未达 33⅓% 时】若 ≥ 10% 且满足"事实与情况"测试（持续吸引公众支持等）→ 仍可为公共慈善
【另一测试 509(a)(2)】收入型组织：来自捐赠 + 相关业务收入的支持 > 1/3，且投资收入 + UBTI ≤ 1/3
【干扰项】选项A 忽略 2% 上限；选项C 漏算政府补助；选项D 数字错误且误加条件
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：单一捐赠人只计入总支持的 2%（$20,000），公众支持 $420,000 占 42%，超过 33⅓%，为公共慈善。

qs.s: Which statement about a private OPERATING foundation (such as a foundation-run museum) is correct?
o: It is exempt from the Sec. 4940 excise tax on net investment income and from the self-dealing rules.
Donors are limited to deducting cash gifts up to 30% of AGI, as with nonoperating foundations.
It is treated as a public charity for all purposes.

It must spend substantially all (85%) of the lesser of its adjusted net income or minimum investment return directly on the active conduct of its exempt activities and meet an assets, endowment, or support test; in return, donors receive public-charity deduction limits (e.g., 60% for cash) and the foundation is not subject to the Sec. 4942 minimum distribution tax, although the other private foundation excise taxes still apply.

【🚨 陷阱】家族想亲自经营慈善项目（博物馆、图书馆）时，运营基金会兼顾控制权与更高的捐赠扣除限额。

【私人运营基金会要件】
① 收入测试：将调整后净收入与最低投资回报孰低者的 85% 直接用于自身免税活动
② 另满足资产、捐赠基金或支持三项测试之一

【好处】
  • 捐赠人适用公共慈善的扣除限额（现金 60%、增值资产按 FMV 30%）→ 选项B错
  • 不适用 4942 最低分配税
【仍受约束】4940 净投资收益税、4941 自我交易、4943、4944、4945 → 选项A错
  • 仍是私人基金会，不是公共慈善（选项C错），申报 990-PF
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：私人运营基金会须满足 85% 收入测试及资产/捐赠基金/支持测试之一，捐赠人适用公共慈善限额、免 4942，但其他私人基金会消费税仍适用。

qs.s: Which statement about donor-advised funds (DAFs) is correct?
o: A DAF may make grants directly to individuals for any charitable purpose without penalty.
Contributions to a DAF may be made as qualified charitable distributions from an IRA.

A donor who receives more than an incidental benefit from a DAF grant (for example, benefit-dinner tickets purchased with DAF funds) owes a 125% excise tax on the benefit under Sec. 4967; a taxable distribution (such as a grant to an individual) triggers a 20% tax on the sponsoring organization under Sec. 4966 (plus 5% on approving managers); and the Sec. 4943 excess business holdings rules apply to DAFs.
DAFs are subject to the Sec. 4942 minimum distribution requirement.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】用 DAF 支付慈善晚宴门票、学费等有对价的款项是最常见的违规——那部分应由捐赠人个人支付。

【DAF 相关消费税】

  • 4966 应税分配：向个人拨款，或向非慈善目的/未履行支出责任的组织拨款 → 发起组织 20%；明知批准的管理人 5%（选项A错）
  • 4967 禁止利益：捐赠人/顾问或关联人因 DAF 拨款获得超过附带性的利益 → 125% × 利益（明知同意的管理人 10%）
  • 4958：对捐赠人/顾问的某些付款视为超额利益交易
  • 4943 超额企业持股规则适用于 DAF
  • 不适用 4942 最低分配（选项D错）；DAF 不能接收 QCD（选项B错）
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：捐赠人从 DAF 拨款获得超过附带性的利益须缴 125% 消费税（4967），应税分配由发起组织缴 20%（4966），4943 也适用于 DAF。

qs.s: A Sec. 501(c)(3) organization has two unrelated trades or businesses in 2026: magazine advertising with $50,000 of net income and a public parking lot with a $20,000 net loss. It has no pre-2018 NOLs. What is its UBTI?
o: $30,000 — losses from one unrelated business offset income from another.
$0 — the parking loss eliminates the advertising income.

$49,000 — UBTI is computed separately for each unrelated trade or business (silos), so the parking loss cannot offset advertising income; the $20,000 loss is carried forward for use only against future parking income, and the $1,000 specific deduction applies once.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】免税组织选择不相关业务时，要预期每个活动都能单独盈利——亏损活动的亏损只能自己消化。

【Sec.512(a)(6)（2018 年起）】UBTI 按每项不相关营业分别计算（按 NAICS 前两位代码分类）

  • 广告 +50,000；停车场 (20,000) → 不能互抵
  • UBTI = 50,000 − 特定扣除 1,000 = 49,000
  • 停车场亏损形成该"筒仓"的 NOL，只能抵减同一活动未来的收入
  • 2018 年前的 NOL 仍可抵减合计 UBTI
  • 投资活动（如持有 ≤2% 的合伙权益）可合并为一项
【干扰项】选项A、B 允许互抵；选项C 错误
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：UBTI 按每项不相关营业分别计算，停车场亏损不能抵减广告收入：$50,000 − $1,000 = $49,000。

qs.s: Ava transfers land (FMV $200,000, adjusted basis $100,000) to newly formed Z Corp in exchange for 100% of Z's stock worth $170,000 plus $30,000 cash. The transfer qualifies under Sec. 351. What are Ava's recognized gain, Ava's basis in the Z stock, and Z Corp's basis in the land?
o: Recognized gain $0; Ava's stock basis $70,000; Z's land basis $100,000.
Recognized gain $30,000; Ava's stock basis $130,000; Z's land basis $100,000.

qs.s: Ben owns a building with FMV $200,000 and adjusted basis $100,000, subject to a $130,000 mortgage. Scenario 1: He transfers it to newly formed B Corp for 100% of the stock (Sec. 351), and B Corp assumes the mortgage. Scenario 2: Instead, he transfers it to a newly formed partnership for a 50% interest, and the partnership assumes the mortgage (assume the mortgage is shared 50/50 among the partners after contribution). What is Ben's recognized gain in each scenario?
o: Both scenarios: $30,000, because liabilities in excess of basis always trigger gain regardless of entity type.

【🚨 高频陷阱 —— TCP 最爱的"实体类比陷阱"】
  • Corp：比的是"总负债 vs 财产 Basis"，且不考虑股东是否仍对该负债间接承担
  • Partnership：比的是"净负债解除 vs Outside Basis"，合伙人会分摊回一部分负债
  • 若把 Scenario 2 改成 Ben 只拿 10% 权益：净解除 = $130,000 − $13,000 = $117,000 > $100,000 → Gain $17,000，Outside Basis 归零。

  • 公司承担负债 $130,000 > 出资财产 Basis $100,000

  • Stock Basis = $100,000 + Gain $30,000 − 负债解除 $130,000 = $0
  • Corp 资产 Basis = $100,000 + $30,000 = $130,000
【Scenario 2：Partnership 出资 — Sec.752 负债视同现金】
  • 负债解除（视同现金分配）= $130,000
  • 出资后 Ben 分摊回来的负债（视同现金出资）= $130,000 × 50% = $65,000
  • 净负债解除 = $130,000 − $65,000 = $65,000
  • Outside Basis = $100,000 − $65,000 = $35,000（仍为正数）
  • 只有净负债解除 超过 Outside Basis 时，超出部分才按 Sec.731 确认 Gain → 本题 $65,000 < $100,000 → Gain $0
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）。

Carl recognizes $100,000 gain because the transferors of PROPERTY own only 70% (less than 80%) — Dana's service-for-stock does not count toward control — so Sec. 351 fails for Carl; Dana recognizes $86,000 ordinary income in either case.

qs.s: Loss Corp has a $300,000 NOL carryforward. New investors acquire 60% of Loss Corp's stock this year (an 'ownership change' — more than 50 percentage points within a 3-year testing period). Immediately before the change, Loss Corp's equity value is $2,000,000, and the applicable long-term tax-exempt rate is 4%. Loss Corp continues its business. After the change, Loss Corp earns $200,000 of taxable income in the first full post-change year. How much of the pre-change NOL can be used that year?

$160,000 — 80% of taxable income, since only the Sec. 172 80% limit applies.

【🚨 筹划视角】收购方评估"买壳用亏损"时，NOL 的真实价值 = 年度 382 限额 × 可用年数的现值，而非 NOL 账面总额 —— 这是 TCP 在并购筹划题里的核心 Analysis 点。

【Step 1：是否发生 Ownership Change？】

  • 5% 股东在 3 年测试期内持股合计上升 >50 个百分点 → 本题 60% → 是
【Step 2：Sec.382 年度限额】
  • = 变更前 Loss Corp 股权价值 × 长期免税利率 = $2,000,000 × 4% = $80,000/年
【Step 3：与 80% 规则叠加 —— 取更严者】
  • Sec.172 80% 上限 = $200,000 × 80% = $160,000
  • Sec.382 上限 = $80,000
  • 实际可用 = $80,000（两道限制同时适用，取较小）
  • 剩余 $220,000 继续结转；当年未用完的 382 额度可累积到下一年
【Step 4：何时 NOL 直接归零？】
  • 若变更后 2 年内未继续原有业务（Continuity of Business Enterprise 失败），年度限额为 $0（选项C描述的只是这一特殊情形，非一般规则）
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：股权变更触发 Sec. 382 限制，当年 NOL 使用上限为公司净值乘以长期免税利率（$2,000,000 × 4% = $80,000）。

qs.s: Buyer Corp purchases 100% of the stock of Target, an S corporation owned by two individuals, for $200,000. Target's aggregate inside basis in its assets is $100,000. Buyer and the Target shareholders jointly make a valid Sec. 338(h)(10) election. What is the effect of the election?

The election is unavailable because Target is an S corporation; Sec. 338(h)(10) applies only to members of consolidated C-corporation groups.
Buyer recognizes $100,000 gain and Target's shareholders recognize nothing.
The transaction is treated as a stock sale only: the shareholders recognize $100,000 capital gain on their stock, and Buyer takes a carryover inside basis of $100,000 in Target's assets.

【🚨 筹划权衡】

① 视同 Target（旧公司）按 $200,000 出售全部资产 → Gain $100,000，逐项资产定性（折旧回收部分为普通收入、1231 资产部分为 1231 Gain 等），穿透到 S 股东 K-1
② 视同 Target 随后清算分配给股东 —— 股东的"卖股票"交易本身被忽略（因为 Gain 已经通过穿透确认并增加了股票 Basis）

【Step 3：买方收益】
  • 资产 Basis Step-up 至 $200,000（新公司），未来可多提折旧/摊销（商誉 15 年摊销）

qs.s: Investors will buy a commercial building for $200,000 (financed partly with a nonrecourse mortgage) and expect that, after it appreciates, they will refinance and distribute $30,000 of loan proceeds to the owners. They also want flexibility to allocate depreciation disproportionately to one investor. Comparing an LLC taxed as a partnership versus an S corporation, which is more favorable and why?
o: The S corporation, because entity-level debt increases each shareholder's stock basis, allowing tax-free distribution of refinancing proceeds and flexible special allocations.

The LLC taxed as a partnership: entity-level debt (including nonrecourse debt) is allocated to members and increases their outside basis, so refinancing proceeds can be distributed tax-free up to basis; and special allocations are allowed if they have substantial economic effect. An S corporation cannot count entity debt in shareholder basis and must allocate all items strictly pro rata (single class of stock).
They are equivalent; both allow entity debt in owner basis and both require pro rata allocations.
A C corporation is best, because distributions of loan proceeds are never taxable to C corporation shareholders.

【🚨 实体选择速查】
  • 房地产、需杠杆分配、需特殊分配 → Partnership/LLC
  • 盈利稳定、想节省 SE 税（合理薪酬+分红） → S-Corp
  • 计划融资/上市、想用 QSBS（Sec.1202）免税退出、利润留存再投资 → C-Corp

【对比维度 1：实体负债能否进入所有者 Basis】

  • Partnership/LLC：Sec.752 —— 追索、非追索负债都分摊给合伙人，增加 Outside Basis
  • S-Corp：实体负债不增加 Stock Basis，只有股东直接借给公司才有 Debt Basis

→ 再融资后分配 $30,000：合伙人 Basis 充足可免税收取；S 股东若 Basis 不足则超出部分为 Capital Gain

【对比维度 2：损益分配灵活性】
  • Partnership：可做 Special Allocations（需满足 704(b) 实质经济效果）
  • S-Corp：一类股票，必须按持股比例逐日分配，无法特殊分配
【对比维度 3：C-Corp（选项D）】
  • 公司借钱再分配给股东，若有 E&P 就是应税股息，并且有双重征税 → 最差
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：持有房地产通常首选合伙/LLC 架构。

qs.s: A founder acquired original-issue C corporation stock in September 2025 (qualified small business; gross assets under $75 million at issuance; qualified active business). She sells it after holding it for 4 years, realizing a $2,000,000 gain, well under the per-issuer cap. How much of the gain is excluded under Sec. 1202?
o: $0 — QSBS requires a 5-year holding period in all cases.
$1,500,000 (75%) — for stock issued after July 4, 2025, the exclusion is 50% after 3 years, 75% after 4 years, and 100% after 5 years; the remaining $500,000 is taxable.
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题是实体选择定性；本题落到 QSBS 分层计算。

【OBBBA 分层（2025/7/4 之后发行的股票）】

持有期排除比例
3 年50%
4 年75%
5 年+100%
  • 本题 4 年 → $2,000,000 × 75% = $1,500,000 免税；$500,000 应税
  • 其他要件：C 公司原始发行、发行时总资产 ≤ $75M、合格主动业务（排除健康、法律、咨询等服务业等）、每发行人上限（$15M 或 10× Basis 孰高）
  • 2025/7/4 前发行的股票仍适用旧规则：满 5 年才能排除，上限 $10M
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：$1,500,000 (75%) — for stock issued after July 4, 2025, the exclusion is 50% after 3 years, 75% after 4 years, and 100% after 5 years; the remaining $500,000 is taxable.

qs.s: In a qualifying Type A statutory merger, target shareholder Tia surrenders target stock (basis $100,000) and receives acquiring-corporation stock worth $170,000 plus $30,000 cash. Assume the boot is treated as capital gain (not dividend-equivalent under Sec. 356(a)(2)). What is Tia's recognized gain and her basis in the acquiring-corporation stock?
qs.x:
【🚨 重组类型速记（常与本题捆绑考）】
  • Type A（法定合并）：对价最灵活，允许较多现金，只需满足 Continuity of Interest（实务约 40% 以上股票对价）
  • Type B（股换股）：Solely voting stock，一分钱现金都不行，交易后须控制 target ≥80% → 本题若为 B 型，$30,000 现金直接导致重组失败、全额应税
  • Type C（股换资产）：取得 target "实质全部"资产，Boot 不超过所取得资产 FMV 的 20%（仅当另付其他 Boot 时，承担的负债才计入该 20% 限额；无其他 Boot 时，承担负债不破坏"solely voting stock"要求），target 须清算
  • Boot 是股息还是资本利得：看 Sec.356(a)(2) —— 若效果等同分红（按 302 测试比例未显著下降），在 E&P 范围内按 Dividend。

【Step 1】Realized = ($170,000 + $30,000) − $100,000 = $100,000

【Step 2】Recognized = Lesser of (Realized $100,000, Boot $30,000) = $30,000（Sec.356）
【Step 3】新股 Basis（Sec.358）= 旧股 Basis $100,000 + 确认 Gain $30,000 − Boot $30,000 = $100,000

（验算：FMV $170,000 − 递延 $70,000 ✔）

【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：公式结构与 Sec.351 完全一致，可一并记忆。
qs.tp: T10.7.2 股东补价金额与性质 Shareholder-Boot-Character

qs.s: In a Type E recapitalization, Tia (sole shareholder, stock basis $100,000) exchanges her old stock for new stock worth $170,000 plus $30,000 cash. The corporation has $500,000 of E&P. How is the boot taxed?
o: $30,000 dividend — because Tia still owns 100% after the exchange, the boot has the effect of a dividend under Sec. 356(a)(2); recognized gain is still limited to the lesser of realized gain ($100,000) or boot ($30,000).
No tax, because recapitalizations are always fully tax-free.
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题假设非股息等价 → 资本利得；本题展示股息等价的典型情形。合并重组中则用 Clark 案方法：假设先收取全部收购方股票、再赎回相当于现金部分的股票，判断比例下降程度。

【Sec.356(a)(2)】Boot 若"具有分配股息的效果"，在股东应占 E&P 范围内按股息处理

  • 判断标准：参照 Sec.302 赎回测试 —— 股东持股比例是否显著下降
  • 唯一股东前后都持有 100% → 无任何比例变化 → 股息
  • 确认金额仍 = Lesser of（Realized $100,000, Boot $30,000）= $30,000
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：$30,000 dividend — because Tia still owns 100% after the exchange, the boot has the effect of a dividend under Sec. 356(a)(2); recognized gain is still limited to the lesser of realized gain ($100,000) or boot ($30,000).

qs.s: Distributing Corp (D) wants to distribute the stock of its wholly owned subsidiary (C) to D's shareholders tax-free under Sec. 355. Which set of requirements must be satisfied?
o: Only a business purpose is required.
The subsidiary must be newly formed.

D must distribute stock constituting control (at least 80% of voting power and 80% of each class of nonvoting stock); both D and C must be engaged in an active trade or business that has been conducted for at least 5 years and was not acquired in a taxable transaction during that period; the transaction must not be used principally as a device to distribute earnings and profits; there must be a valid corporate business purpose; and continuity of interest and of business enterprise must be preserved.
Only that D owns at least 50% of C.
qs.x:
【🚨 与 Sec.351/368 的关系】分立通常同时构成 D 型重组。

【Sec.355 五大要件】
① 控制权分配：分配的股票须达 80% 表决权 + 80% 各类无表决权股
② 5 年积极营业：D 与 C 双方在分配前 5 年内持续经营，且该业务不是在 5 年内以应税方式收购取得
③ 非避税工具（Device Test）：不得主要用于分配 E&P（分配后不久出售股票是不利因素）
④ 商业目的：如满足监管要求、解决股东纠纷、便于融资等（省税本身不算）
⑤ 权益连续性 + 业务连续性

【结果】符合要件 → 公司与股东均不确认损益；股东按相对 FMV 在 D 与 C 股票之间分摊原 Basis，持有期承继
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：D must distribute stock constituting control (at least 80% of voting power and 80% of each class of nonvoting stock); both D and C must be engaged in an active trade or business that has been conducted for at least 5 years and was not acquired in a taxable transaction during that period; the transaction must not be used principally as a device to distribute earnings and profits; there must be a valid corporate business purpose; and continuity of interest and of business enterprise must be preserved.
qs.tp: T10.8.1 免税分立资格条件 Tax-Free-Division-Requirements

qs.s: Which description is correct?
o: A split-up leaves the parent in existence holding one business.
In a split-off, shareholders receive subsidiary stock without surrendering any of their parent stock.
Boot is never taxable in a Sec. 355 transaction.

Spin-off: subsidiary stock is distributed pro rata and shareholders surrender nothing. Split-off: shareholders surrender some parent stock in exchange for subsidiary stock. Split-up: the parent distributes the stock of two or more subsidiaries in complete liquidation and ceases to exist. If boot (e.g., cash) is received, the shareholder recognizes the lesser of realized gain or boot, and the distributing corporation recognizes gain on distributed appreciated boot property.
qs.x:
【🚨 提示】Split-off 可用于股东"分家"：一方拿走子公司、退出母公司。
形式股东是否交回母公司股票母公司是否存续
Spin-off否（按比例分配）是
Split-off是（换取子公司股票，可不按比例）是
Split-up是（全部交回）否（完全清算）
【Boot】股东确认 = Lesser of（Realized Gain, Boot）；分配增值的 Boot 财产时 D 确认 Gain
【"Hot Stock"】分配前 5 年内应税取得的 C 股票视为 Boot
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：Spin-off: subsidiary stock is distributed pro rata and shareholders surrender nothing. Split-off: shareholders surrender some parent stock in exchange for subsidiary stock. Split-up: the parent distributes the stock of two or more subsidiaries in complete liquidation and ceases to exist. If boot (e.g., cash) is received, the shareholder recognizes the lesser of realized gain or boot, and the distributing corporation recognizes gain on distributed appreciated boot property.

qs.s: Immediately after a valid Sec. 355 spin-off, an unrelated acquirer purchases 55% of Distributing Corp's stock as part of a plan that included the spin-off. What is the consequence?
o: Nothing — Sec. 355 protection is permanent once the distribution qualifies.

Sec. 355(e) applies: because a 50%-or-greater interest in the distributing (or controlled) corporation is acquired as part of a plan within the 2-year window, the DISTRIBUTING corporation recognizes gain as if it had sold the distributed stock at FMV; the shareholders generally remain tax-free.
The shareholders recognize gain but the corporation does not.
The spin-off is retroactively treated as a dividend to all shareholders.
qs.x:
【🚨 实务】分立后 2 年内的重大股权变动需做 355(e) 分析；可通过时间间隔与证据反驳"同一计划"。

【Sec.355(e)「反 Morris Trust」】分立与"50% 以上股权被收购"属于同一计划（分配前后各 2 年内的收购推定属于同一计划，可反证）→ D 公司按 FMV 视同出售被分配股票确认 Gain

  • 股东层面通常仍免税
  • 目的：防止用分立把一项业务"免税"地卖给收购方
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：Sec. 355(e) applies: because a 50%-or-greater interest in the distributing (or controlled) corporation is acquired as part of a plan within the 2-year window, the DISTRIBUTING corporation recognizes gain as if it had sold the distributed stock at FMV; the shareholders generally remain tax-free.

qs.s: A C corporation has operated two separate businesses for more than 5 years. It terminates one business and distributes the proceeds pro rata to its shareholders (both individuals and corporations). One individual shareholder receives $200,000 for shares with a basis of $50,000. How is the distribution treated for the individual, and for a corporate shareholder?
o: Exchange treatment for all shareholders, corporate and individual alike.
Dividend to all shareholders to the extent of E&P.

For the noncorporate shareholder it is a partial liquidation qualifying for exchange treatment (tested at the CORPORATE level — a genuine contraction or termination of a qualified 5-year active business — not by the shareholder's percentage change): $150,000 capital gain. A corporate shareholder does not get partial liquidation treatment and applies the normal Sec. 301/302 rules.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】按比例分配通常会让 302(b)(2) 失败，但部分清算允许按比例分配。

【Sec.302(b)(4) 部分清算】

  • 判断标准在公司层面（"真实收缩"或终止一项持续 5 年的积极业务），而不是看股东持股比例是否下降 —— 这是它与 302(b)(1)–(3) 的根本区别
  • 仅非公司股东可享出售待遇 → Gain = 200,000 − 50,000 = 150,000
  • 公司股东按普通 301/302 规则（通常为股息，可享 DRD）
  • 公司层面：分配增值财产仍按 311(b) 确认 Gain
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：For the noncorporate shareholder it is a partial liquidation qualifying for exchange treatment (tested at the CORPORATE level — a genuine contraction or termination of a qualified 5-year active business — not by the shareholder's percentage change): $150,000 capital gain. A corporate shareholder does not get partial liquidation treatment and applies the normal Sec. 301/302 rules.
qs.tp: T10.8.4 部分清算交换待遇 Partial-Liquidation-Treatment

qs.s: An LLC taxed as a partnership converts to a corporation (by state-law conversion or by checking the box). Which statement is correct?
o: The conversion is generally treated as a Sec. 351 transaction. The regulations provide default treatment (assets-over: the partnership contributes assets for stock and then distributes the stock in liquidation); assets-up and interests-over forms produce the same general nonrecognition but can differ in basis and holding period results. Liabilities in excess of basis can still trigger Sec. 357(c) gain.
The conversion is always fully taxable.
A check-the-box election may be changed every year at will.
Converting a corporation to a partnership (or checking the box to be a partnership) is also tax-free.
qs.x:
【🚨 方向不对称】"进公司"便宜，"出公司"昂贵 —— 实体选择要一开始就想清楚。

【合伙 → 公司】视为 Sec.351（Rev. Rul. 84-111 三种形式：Assets-Over 为默认、Assets-Up、Interests-Over）→ 一般不确认损益

  • 仍须注意 357(c)：负债超过资产 Basis → 确认 Gain
【公司 → 合伙/被忽略实体】视为公司完全清算（336/331）→ 应税（公司按 FMV 确认 Gain、股东按清算确认 Gain）→ 代价极高（选项D错）
【Check-the-Box】变更分类后 60 个月内不得再变更（所有权变动 >50% 等情形除外）
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：The conversion is generally treated as a Sec. 351 transaction. The regulations provide default treatment (assets-over: the partnership contributes assets for stock and then distributes the stock in liquidation); assets-up and interests-over forms produce the same general nonrecognition but can differ in basis and holding period results. Liabilities in excess of basis can still trigger Sec. 357(c) gain.

qs.s: A and B each own 50% of a C corporation worth $400,000; each has a $50,000 stock basis. B dies and the agreement is funded with life insurance. Compare the survivor's basis under an entity redemption versus a cross-purchase.
o: Entity redemption gives A the higher basis.

Cross-purchase: A buys B's shares for $200,000 with insurance proceeds he receives, so A's basis becomes $50,000 + $200,000 = $250,000. Entity redemption: the corporation receives the proceeds and redeems B's shares, so A now owns 100% but his basis remains $50,000 — a major difference if A later sells.
Basis is irrelevant because of the step-up at B's death.

【🚨 混合方案】"Wait-and-See" 买卖协议：先给公司赎回机会，再由股东购买，兼顾灵活性。
Cross-PurchaseEntity Redemption
保单持有人股东之间互保公司
在世股东 Basis提高（$250,000）不变（$50,000）
保单数量（n 名股东）n(n−1)（5 人 → 20 张）n（5 人 → 5 张）
风险保单多、管理复杂；股东间转让保单可能触发 Transfer-for-Value公司持有现金价值可能引发 AET 问题；理赔计入 AMT/CAMT（如适用）
【死者一方】股票在死亡时 Step-up → 出售/赎回几乎无 Gain

Entity redemption: the corporation receives the proceeds and redeems B's shares, so A now owns 100% but his basis remains $50,000 — a major difference if A later sells.

qs.s: In converting from an entity redemption to a cross-purchase arrangement, the corporation transfers its existing policies on each shareholder to the other shareholders for their cash surrender value. What are the key tax concerns?
o: The transfer is fine because the insured is a shareholder of the corporation.
Transfer-for-value rules do not apply to buy-sell agreements.
None — transfers between a corporation and its shareholders are always tax-free.

Transferring a policy to a co-shareholder for value is a transfer for value that is NOT within the statutory exceptions, so the death benefit becomes taxable except for the transferee's investment; also, a redemption from a family shareholder must satisfy Sec. 302 (with Sec. 318 attribution) or it is a dividend rather than an exchange.
qs.x:
【🚨 提示】公司持有的保单现金价值会增加公司价值，从而提高遗产估值。

【Transfer-for-Value 豁免清单】被保险人本人 / 被保险人的合伙人 / 被保险人所在合伙企业 / 被保险人为股东或高管的公司

  • 共同股东之间不在豁免之列 → 理赔金仅可免税至受让人投入额，其余应税
  • 补救：股东之间另设真实合伙企业；或改由被保险人本人先取得保单
【赎回测试】家族企业赎回股票时，318 归属可能导致 302 测试失败 → 变成股息（而非出售），需考虑 302(c)(2) 放弃或 303
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：Transferring a policy to a co-shareholder for value is a transfer for value that is NOT within the statutory exceptions, so the death benefit becomes taxable except for the transferee's investment; also, a redemption from a family shareholder must satisfy Sec. 302 (with Sec. 318 attribution) or it is a dividend rather than an exchange.

qs.s: A shareholder capitalizes a new corporation with $50,000 of stock and $450,000 of 'loans' with no fixed maturity, interest payable only if profitable, and subordinated to all other creditors. What is the likely result?
o: Interest is deductible by the corporation and is ordinary income to the shareholder.
The shareholder may deduct a bad debt loss if the corporation fails, regardless of recharacterization.

The IRS will likely recharacterize the debt as equity (thin capitalization; Sec. 385 factors such as a high debt-to-equity ratio, no fixed maturity, contingent interest, subordination, and proportionality to stock holdings): 'interest' becomes a nondeductible dividend, and 'repayments of principal' become distributions taxed under Sec. 301.
The arrangement is respected because it is documented as debt.
qs.x:
【🚨 筹划】保持合理的债股比例、书面票据、固定到期与利率、实际按期付息、不与持股比例完全成比例。

【Sec.385 债权 vs 股权因素】书面无条件还款承诺、固定到期日、固定利率、债务/股本比率、是否从属于其他债权人、是否与持股比例成比例、公司能否从外部取得同等融资

【重新定性后果】
  • 公司：利息扣除被否决 → 视为股息（不可扣除）
  • 股东：本金"偿还"→ 301 分配（E&P 范围内为股息）
  • 若公司失败：本应是坏账损失 → 变为股票损失（可能适用 1244 或资本损失）
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：The IRS will likely recharacterize the debt as equity (thin capitalization; Sec. 385 factors such as a high debt-to-equity ratio, no fixed maturity, contingent interest, subordination, and proportionality to stock holdings): 'interest' becomes a nondeductible dividend, and 'repayments of principal' become distributions taxed under Sec. 301.

qs.s: A married couple filing jointly sells qualifying Sec. 1244 stock (original issue, purchased for cash from a qualifying small business corporation) at a $120,000 loss. How is the loss treated?
o: The entire $120,000 is a capital loss.
$100,000 is an ordinary loss (the MFJ annual limit; $50,000 for others) and the remaining $20,000 is a capital loss subject to the normal capital loss rules.
$3,000 ordinary loss; the rest is a capital loss carryforward.
The entire $120,000 is an ordinary loss.
qs.x:
【🚨 价值】普通损失可抵普通收入、无 $3,000 限制，还可能产生 NOL；Gain 则仍按普通资本利得（可能适用 1202）。

【Sec.1244 要件】

  • 国内 C 或 S 公司，发行股票时实收资本不超过 $1,000,000
  • 原始发行、以现金或财产（非服务、非证券）取得
  • 持有人须为个人或合伙企业（不能是公司、信托，也不能是二级市场受让人）
  • 发生损失前最近 5 个纳税年度，公司 >50% 总收入来自经营（非被动）
【额度】每年普通损失上限 $50,000（MFJ $100,000）→ 超出部分为资本损失
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：$100,000 is an ordinary loss (the MFJ annual limit; $50,000 for others) and the remaining $20,000 is a capital loss subject to the normal capital loss rules.
