qs.s: Which statement correctly contrasts the compensation risk in C and S corporations?
o: Reasonable compensation applies only to publicly traded corporations.

C corporation: the risk is compensation that is too HIGH — the excess is recharacterized as a nondeductible constructive dividend. S corporation: the risk is compensation that is too LOW — distributions are recharacterized as wages, generating payroll taxes, interest, and penalties.
Both face the same risk of compensation being too low.
C corporations risk low compensation; S corporations risk high compensation.
qs.x:
【🚨 相关】Sec.162(m) 对上市公司高管 $1,000,000 扣除限制；免税组织见 Sec.4960。

【动机决定方向】

  • C 公司：薪酬可扣除、股息不可扣除 → 股东倾向把利润包装成薪酬 → IRS 盯"过高" → 超额部分为推定股息（公司失去扣除）
  • S 公司：薪酬要缴 FICA、分配不缴 → 股东倾向少发工资多分配 → IRS 盯"过低" → 分配重新定性为工资
【合理性因素】职责与工时、能力与经验、同行业同规模可比薪酬、公司盈利与规模、与持股比例是否高度一致、分红历史
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：C corporation: the risk is compensation that is too HIGH — the excess is recharacterized as a nondeductible constructive dividend. S corporation: the risk is compensation that is too LOW — distributions are recharacterized as wages, generating payroll taxes, interest, and penalties.
qs.tp: T10.9.2 合理薪酬风险方向 Reasonable-Compensation-Risks

qs.s: An accrual-basis C corporation accrues a $30,000 bonus on December 31 payable to its 60% shareholder-employee, who is a cash-basis taxpayer. The bonus is paid the following October. When may the corporation deduct it?
o: Not until the year the shareholder includes it in income (the year of payment) — Sec. 267(a)(2) matches the deduction to the related cash-basis payee's inclusion.
In the accrual year, under the general all-events test.
qs.x:
【🚨 S 公司更严】即使只持股 1%，也适用配比规则。

【Sec.267(a)(2) 配比规则】权责发生制付款方欠关联方（现金制）的费用 → 扣除推迟到收款方计入收入的年度

  • 关联判定：C 公司与持股 >50% 的股东；S 公司与任何股东；个人服务公司与其股东雇员（无持股比例门槛）
  • 本题 60% > 50% → 次年 10 月支付时才可扣除
【对比：非关联员工的年终奖】2½ 个月规则（年末计提、次年 2½ 个月内支付）可在计提年度扣除
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：Not until the year the shareholder includes it in income (the year of payment) — Sec. 267(a)(2) matches the deduction to the related cash-basis payee's inclusion.
qs.tp: T10.9.3 关联现金制收款配比 Related-Payee-Deduction-Timing

qs.s: A C corporation sells its assets for a $200,000 installment note (basis $100,000) and completely liquidates within 12 months, distributing the note to its sole shareholder. What does Sec. 453(h) allow?
o: Both the corporation and the shareholder defer all gain until collection.

The shareholder may report the gain on the shares as payments on the note are collected, rather than recognizing the entire gain at liquidation; the corporation still recognizes its own gain on the asset sale (accelerated when the note is distributed in liquidation — Secs. 453B(a) and 336).
Sec. 453(h) applies only to S corporations.
The corporation avoids all gain on the asset sale.
qs.x:
【🚨 与 338(h)(10)/S 公司比较】S 公司资产出售 + 分期收款 + 清算 → 单层课税 + 分期递延，效果最佳。

【Sec.453(h)】公司在资产出售后 12 个月内完全清算并把分期票据分配给股东：

  • 股东：不必在清算当年就其全部股票 Gain 纳税，可随票据收款分期确认（把公司层面的分期特性"传导"到股东层面）
  • 公司：仍须就资产出售确认 Gain（票据分配一般加速确认）→ C 公司双层课税依旧存在
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：The shareholder may report the gain on the shares as payments on the note are collected, rather than recognizing the entire gain at liquidation; the corporation still recognizes its own gain on the asset sale (accelerated when the note is distributed in liquidation — Secs. 453B(a) and 336).
qs.tp: T10.11.4 分期票据清算分配 Installment-Note-Liquidation

qs.s: A founder sells qualified small business stock held for 2 years at a $500,000 gain — too short for the Sec. 1202 exclusion. What planning option is available?
o: Use Sec. 1031 to exchange the stock for other stock.

Sec. 1045: roll the proceeds into other QSBS within 60 days of the sale and defer the gain; the replacement stock takes a reduced basis and the original holding period tacks for purposes of the Sec. 1202 holding period.
None; the gain is fully taxable.
Elect installment reporting to defer the gain indefinitely.
qs.x:
【🚨 对比】Sec.1031 不适用于股票（选项A错）；分期法对公开交易股票不可用。

【Sec.1045】出售持有 >6 个月的 QSBS → 60 天内再投资于其他 QSBS → 递延 Gain

  • 替换股票 Basis 相应减少；原持有期承继，有助于日后凑满 1202 的持有期（OBBBA 后为 3/4/5 年分层）
  • 合伙企业层面也可适用
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：Sec. 1045: roll the proceeds into other QSBS within 60 days of the sale and defer the gain; the replacement stock takes a reduced basis and the original holding period tacks for purposes of the Sec. 1202 holding period.
qs.tp: T10.10.2 QSBS六十日滚存 QSBS-Replacement-Rollover

qs.s: A father gifts limited partnership interests in his capital-intensive manufacturing partnership to his children, who perform no services. He continues to manage the business and takes no salary. How is income allocated?
o: Family members can never be partners.
Entirely to the children, as the partnership agreement provides.

The children are recognized as partners because capital is a material income-producing factor and they actually own the interests; however, the donor must first be allocated reasonable compensation for services he renders, and the remaining income must be allocated in proportion to capital — income cannot be shifted disproportionately to the donees.
Entirely to the father, because he manages the business.
qs.x:
【🚨 目的】防止把高税率家长的经营所得"分流"给低税率子女（与 Kiddie Tax 立法目的一致）。

【Sec.704(e) 家族合伙】

  • 受赠人被承认为合伙人的前提：资本是重要创收要素，且受赠人真正拥有该权益（有处分权，不受赠与人控制）
  • 若资本不是重要创收要素（服务型），赠与权益一般不被承认
【分配限制】

① 先给赠与人（提供服务者）合理报酬
② 其余按资本比例分配 —— 受赠人分得的份额不得与其资本比例不成比例

【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：The children are recognized as partners because capital is a material income-producing factor and they actually own the interests; however, the donor must first be allocated reasonable compensation for services he renders, and the remaining income must be allocated in proportion to capital — income cannot be shifted disproportionately to the donees.
qs.tp: T10.3.7 家族合伙所得归属 Family-Partnership-Income

qs.s: A profitable C corporation with appreciated assets, LIFO inventory, and accumulated E&P is considering an S election. Which combination of consequences should the planner model?
o: (1) LIFO recapture income in the final C year, with tax payable in 4 installments; (2) built-in gains tax on pre-conversion appreciation recognized within the 5-year recognition period; (3) AAA starts at zero, and the C-era AEP remains, exposing the company to the excess net passive income tax and to termination if passive income exceeds 25% of gross receipts for 3 consecutive years — often addressed by distributing AEP (bypass election); (4) shareholders must take reasonable compensation.
Only the change in tax rates.
qs.x:
【🚨 提醒】S 身份终止后 5 年内不得重新选择；转换前应先完成资产估值（确定 NUBIG）。

【C → S 转换筹划清单】

项目影响应对
LIFO 回收（1363(d)）最后一个 C 年度确认，4 期缴转换前评估储备规模
BIG 税（1374）5 年内处置内置增值资产，21%推迟出售、评估转换日 FMV
AEP 留存1375 超额净被动收入税；连续 3 年被动收入 >25% 终止身份Bypass 选举分配清 AEP
AAA 从 0 开始分配先出自 AAA，AEP 在其后规划分配顺序
合理薪酬工资过低的 FICA 风险设定可比薪酬
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：(1) LIFO recapture income in the final C year, with tax payable in 4 installments; (2) built-in gains tax on pre-conversion appreciation recognized within the 5-year recognition period; (3) AAA starts at zero, and the C-era AEP remains, exposing the company to the excess net passive income tax and to termination if passive income exceeds 25% of gross receipts for 3 consecutive years — often addressed by distributing AEP (bypass election); (4) shareholders must take reasonable compensation.
qs.tp: T10.4.5 LIFO与被动收入税 LIFO-Passive-Transition-Taxes

qs.s: Three years ago, in an unrelated transaction, Acquirer bought 10% of Target's stock for cash. This year, in a single transaction, Acquirer acquires another 85% of Target's stock from Target's shareholders solely in exchange for Acquirer voting stock. Which statement is correct?
o: The acquisition fails as a Type B reorganization because Acquirer previously bought Target stock for cash.
It qualifies only if Acquirer ends up with 100% of Target.

It qualifies as a Type B reorganization; Target's shareholders recognize no gain and take their old Target basis in the Acquirer stock; Acquirer's basis in the newly acquired Target stock equals the Target shareholders' aggregate basis in that stock; and Target remains a subsidiary with its asset basis and tax attributes unchanged.
It qualifies, and Acquirer's basis in the Target stock equals the fair market value of the Acquirer stock it issued.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】B 型中收购方要取得目标股东的 Basis 数据往往很困难（上市公司尤甚），是 B 型在实务中较少使用的原因之一。

【Type B 要件】以唯一对价（solely）有表决权股换取目标公司股票，交易后收购方控制目标公司（≥80% 表决权 + 各类无表决权股的 80%）

  • "唯一对价"只针对本次重组交易；3 年前、与本计划无关的现金收购（"old and cold"）不影响 → 本次后持有 95% ✔（选项A错）
  • 不要求 100%（选项B错）
【税务后果】
  • 目标股东：不确认，新股 Basis = 旧股 Basis（Sec.358）
  • 收购方对目标股票的 Basis = 目标股东原 Basis（Sec.362(b) 结转，不是新股 FMV → 选项D错）—— 这是 B 型特有的"双重结转"
  • 目标公司作为子公司继续存在：资产 Basis、NOL、E&P 不变（NOL 受 382 限制）
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：与计划无关的旧现金收购不影响"唯一对价"，交易后持有 95% 符合 B 型；收购方对目标股票 Basis 结转自目标股东的原 Basis。
qs.tp: T10.7.3 B型股换股重组 Type-B-Stock-Exchange

qs.s: Acquirer acquires all of Target's assets (FMV $1,000,000; Target's basis $400,000; no liabilities) for Acquirer voting stock worth $900,000 and $100,000 cash. Target immediately distributes the stock and cash to its sole shareholder, Sue (stock basis $300,000), in complete liquidation. Assume the boot is not dividend-equivalent. Which result is correct?
o: The transaction qualifies as a Type C reorganization; Target recognizes no gain; Sue recognizes $100,000 of gain and takes a $300,000 basis in the Acquirer stock; Acquirer takes a $400,000 carryover basis in the assets.
The transaction fails as a Type C reorganization because any cash disqualifies it.
It qualifies, but Target recognizes $60,000 of gain on the cash it received.
It qualifies, but Sue recognizes her entire $700,000 realized gain.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】C 型中承担的负债只有在同时支付其他 Boot 时才计入 20% 测试；股东的 Boot 若具股息效果，按 Sec.356(a)(2) 在 E&P 范围内按股息课税。

【Type C 要件】以有表决权股取得目标公司实质全部资产；目标公司须按重组计划清算分配

【Boot 放宽规则（368(a)(2)(B)）】非股票对价（现金 + 若有其他 Boot 时连同承担的负债）≤ 目标全部资产 FMV 的 20% → 现金 $100,000 ≤ $200,000 ✔（选项B错）
【目标公司】Sec.361(b)：收到的 Boot 按计划分配给股东 → 不确认（选项C错）
【Sue】Realized = $1,000,000 − $300,000 = $700,000；Recognized = Min($700,000, Boot $100,000) = $100,000（选项D错）
  • 新股 Basis = $300,000 + $100,000 − $100,000 = $300,000
【收购方】资产 Basis = 目标公司 Basis $400,000（Sec.362(b)）；目标的 NOL、E&P 按 Sec.381 转移
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：现金未超过 20% 放宽上限，符合 C 型；目标公司不确认，Sue 按 Boot 确认 $100,000，新股 Basis $300,000，收购方资产 Basis 结转 $400,000。
qs.tp: T10.7.4 C型资产收购重组 Type-C-Asset-Acquisition

qs.s: Mom owns 100% of X Corp, which has large E&P. She liquidates X, receiving all of its assets (operating assets worth $900,000 and $300,000 of cash), reports a capital gain, and claims a stepped-up basis in the assets. Two months later she contributes the operating assets to newly formed Y Corp, which continues X's business, and keeps the cash. How is the IRS most likely to characterize these steps?
o: As a Sec. 351 contribution only; the liquidation is respected as a separate taxable transaction.

As an acquisitive Type D reorganization (a liquidation-reincorporation): X is treated as transferring its operating assets to Y, which Mom controls; Y takes a carryover basis (no step-up), and the $300,000 of cash Mom kept is boot that is likely taxed as a dividend.
As a Type F reorganization, with no consequences at all.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】收购型 D 的控制标准是 50%（借用 304(c)），分立型 D（配合 355）才要求 80%。

【清算—再设立（Liquidation-Reincorporation）】股东清算公司（想要资本利得 + 资产 Step-up）后迅速把经营资产重新投入由同一股东控制的新公司 → 实质上是公司持续经营

【收购型 Type D】转让方公司把资产转给其股东控制的公司（收购型 D 适用 50% 控制标准，Sec.368(a)(2)(H) 引用 304(c)），并按 354/356 分配
  • 结果：不是应税清算 → 无 Step-up，Y 承继 X 的资产 Basis 与 E&P
  • Mom 留下的现金 $300,000 = Boot，在 E&P 范围内很可能按股息（356(a)(2)）
  • 同一股东控制的兄弟姐妹公司合并也常构成收购型 D（包括"全现金 D"）
【干扰项】选项A 忽略步骤合并；选项C F 型仅限单一公司的形式变更，本题有现金被抽出；选项D B 型是股换股
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：清算后迅速再设立并由同一股东控制，按收购型 D 重组处理：无 Step-up，股东保留的现金作为 Boot，通常按股息课税。
qs.tp: T10.7.6 D型收购与分立 Type-D-Control-Distinctions

qs.s: Distributing Corp transfers the assets of Business 2 (basis $100,000; FMV $500,000; subject to $150,000 of liabilities assumed by the transferee) to newly formed Controlled Corp for all of Controlled's stock, then distributes the Controlled stock to its shareholders in a spin-off that meets all Sec. 355 requirements. What gain does Distributing recognize on the transfer?
o: $0, because a qualifying Sec. 355 distribution makes the entire transaction tax-free.
$400,000, the built-in gain in the transferred assets.
$50,000 under Sec. 357(c), because the liabilities assumed ($150,000) exceed the basis of the assets transferred ($100,000) in a Type D reorganization followed by a Sec. 355 distribution.
$150,000, the full amount of the liabilities assumed.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】357(c) 在 351 与分立型 D 中适用，在其他收购型重组中通常不适用——这一差异是高频细节。

【分立型 Type D】D 把部分资产转给新设 C 换取 C 股票，随即按 355 分配 C 股票 → 368(a)(1)(D) 重组（须 80% 控制）

【Sec.357(c)(1)(B)】在配合 355 分配的 D 型重组中，承担的负债超过转让资产 Basis 的部分仍须确认 → $150,000 − $100,000 = $50,000
  • 其他 D 型/非分立重组中，357(c) 一般不适用（负债按 357(a) 不视为 Boot）
【相关规则】C 若支付现金给 D，D 须把现金分配给股东或债权人才能不确认；分配给债权人的金额超过转让资产 Basis 的部分仍确认（Sec.361(b)(3)）
【干扰项】选项A 忽略 357(c)；选项B 把全部内置增值当确认额；选项D 把全部负债当确认额
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：分立型 D 重组适用 Sec.357(c)，负债超过资产 Basis 的 $50,000 必须确认。
qs.tp: T10.7.6 D型收购与分立 Type-D-Control-Distinctions

qs.s: The shareholders of Oldco, an S corporation, plan to sell the business to a buyer who wants a basis step-up in the assets, while the shareholders want to roll over 20% of their equity tax-free. The advisor proposes a pre-sale F reorganization. Which description is correct?
o: An F reorganization requires that new investors acquire at least 80% of the corporation.
The F reorganization terminates Oldco's S election and starts a new 5-year built-in gains period.

The shareholders form Newco and contribute all Oldco stock to it; Newco makes a QSub election for Oldco, and Oldco converts to a single-member LLC (disregarded). The S election continues in Newco; the buyer then purchases the LLC interests and is treated as buying assets (basis step-up), while the shareholders can keep equity in Newco without triggering gain on that portion.
An F reorganization is taxable to the shareholders on any appreciation in their stock.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】F 重组要求所有权与资产几乎完全不变——这正是它能"延续"S 选举与 EIN 以外其他属性的原因。

【Type F】单一公司"身份、形式或组织地的单纯变更"（368(a)(1)(F)）→ 股东与公司均不确认；纳税年度不结束；税务属性延续

【S 公司出售前的 F 重组（Rev. Rul. 2008-18）】

① 股东设立 Newco，把 Oldco 股票全部投入 Newco
② Newco 对 Oldco 做 QSub 选择 → Oldco 被忽略
③ Oldco 按州法转为单一成员 LLC
→ 整体构成 F 重组，Oldco 的 S 选举由 Newco 延续（选项B错）
④ 买方购买 LLC 权益 = 视为购买资产 → Step-up

【相对 338(h)(10) 的优势】降低 S 选举历史上可能无效所带来的风险；股东可在 Newco 层面保留股权（滚存），不必对该部分确认
【干扰项】选项A 没有所有权变化的要求（恰恰要求所有权不变）；选项D F 重组本身免税
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：S 公司出售前的 F 重组：设 Newco、QSub 选择、转为 LLC，S 选举延续，买方购买 LLC 权益视为买资产，股东可保留部分股权。
qs.tp: T10.6.2 出售前F型重组 Presale-F-Reorganization

qs.s: Debtor Corp, in a Title 11 bankruptcy case, transfers its assets to Newco under a court-approved plan; its historic unsecured creditors receive most of Newco's stock and Debtor's shareholders receive a small amount. Debtor has large NOLs, and $5,000,000 of its debt is discharged. Which statement is correct?
o: The transaction can qualify as a Type G reorganization; stock received by historic creditors can count toward continuity of interest; the $5,000,000 of discharged debt is excluded from income under Sec. 108(a)(1)(A) but reduces tax attributes such as NOLs; and Sec. 382(l)(5) may exempt the ownership change from the annual limitation if pre-change shareholders and qualified creditors own at least 50% of Newco.
Type G reorganizations are unavailable to corporations with NOLs.
The $5,000,000 of discharged debt is fully taxable because the debtor is a corporation.
Creditors who receive stock can never be counted toward continuity of interest.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】108 排除与属性削减是"递延"而非永久免税；G 型与 108 常在同一道题里联动出现。

【Type G】Title 11 等司法程序中，债务人按法院批准的计划把资产转给另一公司，并按 354/355/356 分配股票或证券

【权益连续性】破产情形下，历史债权人取得的股票可视为所有者权益（Reg. §1.368-1(e)(6)）→ 选项D错
【债务免除】破产中免除的债务 → Sec.108(a)(1)(A) 排除，代价是按顺序削减税务属性（NOL 首当其冲）→ 选项C错
【Sec.382(l)(5)】破产所有权变更后，若原股东与"合格债权人"合计持有 ≥50%，可不适用年度限额（但 NOL 须扣减近 3 年已扣的债转股相关利息；2 年内再次变更则限额为 0）；否则可选 382(l)(6)（按变更后价值计算限额）
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：破产计划下可构成 G 型重组，历史债权人的股票计入权益连续性，免除的债务按 108 排除并削减属性，382(l)(5) 可能免除年度限额。
qs.tp: T10.7.8 G型破产与债务豁免 Type-G-Bankruptcy-Reorganization

qs.s: Acquirer wants to acquire Target through a merger with Acquirer's subsidiary, paying Target's shareholders 70% Acquirer voting stock and 30% cash. Target holds valuable nonassignable licenses, so Acquirer would prefer that Target survive. Which statement is correct?
o: A reverse triangular merger (subsidiary merges into Target) with 30% cash qualifies because Type A rules allow substantial boot.

A reverse triangular merger fails with 30% cash, because Target's shareholders must exchange stock constituting control (at least 80%) for Acquirer voting stock; a forward triangular merger (Target merges into the subsidiary) can qualify with 30% cash under Type A continuity rules, but Target does not survive.
Any triangular merger requires solely voting stock as consideration.
A Type B reorganization allows up to 30% cash.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】需要目标公司存续（保留执照、合同）时选反向三角合并，但对价中的现金受 80% 表决权股要求限制。

【正向三角合并 368(a)(2)(D)】Target 并入收购方子公司 S，对价为收购方（母公司）股票

  • 须取得 Target"实质全部"资产；若直接并入母公司本可构成 A 型；不能使用 S 的股票
  • 对价灵活（A 型权益连续性，约 40% 股票即可）→ 30% 现金 ✔；但 Target 消失
【反向三角合并 368(a)(2)(E)】S 并入 Target，Target 存续为收购方子公司
  • Target 股东须以构成控制权（≥80%）的 Target 股票换取收购方有表决权股 → 最多约 20% 现金
  • 合并后 Target 须持有其自身及 S 的实质全部资产

→ 本题 30% 现金 → 反向三角合并不合格（选项A错）

【干扰项】选项C 正向三角合并不要求唯一有表决权股；选项D B 型不能有任何现金
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：反向三角合并要求至少 80% 以有表决权股换取，30% 现金不合格；正向三角合并可接受 30% 现金，但 Target 不存续。
qs.tp: T10.7.9 正向与反向三角合并 Forward-Reverse-Triangular-Mergers

qs.s: In a Type C reorganization, Target transfers assets (FMV $900,000; basis $500,000) to Acquirer for Acquirer voting stock worth $800,000 and $100,000 cash. Target retained a parcel of land (FMV $100,000; basis $40,000), and in liquidation distributes the Acquirer stock, the cash, and the land to its shareholders. What gain does Target recognize?
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】目标公司留下资产再分配给股东会产生公司层面的利得——这也是 C 型要求"实质全部"资产的原因之一。

【Sec.361 目标公司层面】

  • (a) 以资产换取收购方股票 → 不确认
  • (b) 收到的 Boot（现金 $100,000）按计划分配给股东 → 不确认
  • (c)(2) 分配合格财产以外的增值财产（本题保留的土地）→ 视同按 FMV 出售 → $100,000 − $40,000 = $60,000
  • 分配收购方股票（合格财产）→ 不确认
【重组仍合格？】转让资产占 $900,000 / $1,000,000 = 90% → 满足"实质全部"；现金 $100,000 ≤ 20% × $1,000,000 → Boot 放宽规则 ✔
【收购方】资产 Basis 结转 $500,000（362(b)）；Target 的 NOL、E&P、会计方法按 381 转移
【干扰项】选项A 忽略 361(c)(2)；选项B 把现金也算作确认；选项C 把整笔资产转让的内置增值算作确认
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：目标公司只就分配的保留土地按 Sec.361(c)(2) 确认 $60,000；收到并分配出去的现金与收购方股票均不确认。
qs.tp: T10.7.5 目标确认与收购方承继 Target-Gain-Attribute-Carryover

qs.s: Target merges into Acquirer under state law; Target's shareholders receive 45% Acquirer stock and 55% cash. One year later, without any prearranged plan, several former Target shareholders sell their Acquirer stock on the stock exchange to unrelated buyers. Acquirer continues Target's historic business. Does the merger qualify as a Type A reorganization?
o: Yes — 45% stock consideration generally preserves continuity of interest (the regulations treat 40% as sufficient), later unplanned sales to unrelated persons are disregarded, and continuity of business enterprise is met because Acquirer continues Target's historic business.
No — continuity of interest requires at least 80% stock consideration.
No — the later sales of Acquirer stock break continuity of interest.
No — a Type A merger may not include any cash.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】COI 只看目标股东收到的对价中有多少是收购方股票；80% 的门槛是 B 型、C 型与反向三角合并的要求，不是 A 型。

【权益连续性（COI）】目标股东须以收购方股票形式保留实质比例的权益

  • Reg. §1.368-1(e)(2)(v) 示例：40% 股票对价即可保持 COI → 45% ✔（选项B错）
  • 重组后股东把收购方股票卖给无关人士（非事先安排）→ 不影响 COI（选项C错）
  • 若事先安排由收购方或其关联方回购 → 视为现金对价，可能破坏 COI
【业务连续性（COBE）】收购方须继续目标的历史业务，或在业务中使用目标的重要部分历史资产
【A 型】法定合并允许相当比例的现金（选项D错）
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：45% 股票对价满足 COI（40% 即可），重组后无预先安排卖给无关人士不影响，收购方继续经营满足 COBE，构成 A 型。
qs.tp: T10.7.1 A型与两种连续性 Type-A-Continuity

qs.s: Existing partners in a large operating partnership admit Dee, who contributes appreciated land (basis $100,000; FMV $300,000) for a 10% interest; no one else contributes property at that time, and the partnership is not an investment company. What is Dee's recognized gain, and would the result differ if the entity were a corporation issuing her 10% of its stock?
o: No gain under Sec. 721, which has no control requirement; if the entity were a corporation, Sec. 351 would not apply because the transferor group (Dee alone) would own only 10%, not at least 80%, so she would recognize the $200,000 gain.
No gain as a corporation; $200,000 gain as a partnership.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】后加入的出资人是 351 与 721 差异最大的场景：向成熟公司出资通常应税，向合伙出资通常免税。

【Sec.721】向合伙企业出资换取权益 → 不确认，没有控制权门槛

  • 例外：721(b) 投资公司（分散化规则）、伪装销售（707(a)(2)(B)）、负债净解除超过 Basis
【Sec.351】要求出资集团交易后立即拥有 ≥80% 控制权
  • Dee 单独出资、只拿 10% → 351 不适用 → 全额确认 $200,000
  • 补救：让现有股东同时出资（不低于其已持股价值约 10% 的财产）以计入出资集团
【Basis】合伙：Outside Basis $100,000、Inside Basis 结转 $100,000（704(c) 内置增值 $200,000 归 Dee）；公司（应税时）：股票 Basis $300,000
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：合伙出资适用 Sec.721 不设控制权门槛，不确认利得；公司情形下 Dee 只取得 10%，Sec.351 不适用，须确认 $200,000。
qs.tp: T10.3 合伙出资与负债 Partnership-Contribution-Liabilities

qs.s: Owen owns 100% of Alpha Inc. (5 employees: Owen and 4 highly paid managers) and 100% of Beta Inc. (40 rank-and-file employees). He wants a generous 401(k) profit-sharing plan in Alpha only. Which statement is correct?
o: Each company is tested separately, so Alpha's plan need cover only Alpha's employees.

Alpha and Beta are a brother-sister controlled group of corporations under Sec. 414(b) (by reference to Sec. 1563), so all employees of both companies are treated as employed by a single employer for coverage and nondiscrimination testing; a plan covering only Alpha's employees will likely fail the Sec. 410(b) coverage test.
Controlled group rules apply only to parent-subsidiary groups.
Coverage testing can be avoided by making the plan a SEP.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】"再开一家公司专给老板做退休计划"的做法通常行不通——受控集团与关联服务集团规则就是为此设计的。

【Sec.414(b)/(c)】414(b) 管公司受控集团（引用 1563），414(c) 管非公司的共同控制营业（合伙、独资）；受控集团（母子、兄弟姐妹、组合）的所有员工视为同一雇主的员工，用于：

  • 410(b) 覆盖测试、401(a)(4) 非歧视测试、415 限额、最低参与
  • 同一人 100% 拥有两家公司 → 兄弟姐妹受控集团（选项C错）
【本题】Alpha 计划只覆盖少数高薪员工，把 Beta 的 40 名普通员工计入测试后 → 很可能不满足 410(b)（如 70% 比例测试）→ 须扩大覆盖或给予可比福利（选项A错）
【SEP】同样须覆盖受控集团内满足条件的员工（选项D错）
【相关规则】414(m) 关联服务集团；414(o) 反规避；家族归属（配偶、未成年子女）适用 1563 归属
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：两家公司构成兄弟姐妹受控集团，员工视为同一雇主，只覆盖 Alpha 的计划很可能无法通过 410(b) 覆盖测试。
qs.tp: T10.9.4 受控集团退休覆盖 Controlled-Group-Plan-Coverage

qs.s: In a Sec. 351 exchange, Ann transfers land held as an investment for 5 years (basis $40,000; FMV $100,000) and inventory (basis $20,000; FMV $50,000) for 150 shares of stock worth $150,000. What is the holding period of Ann's shares?
o: All 150 shares include the 5-year holding period of the land.
All 150 shares have a new holding period beginning the day after the exchange.
Split: each share's holding period is divided by relative FMV — 100/150 of each share includes the land's 5-year holding period and 50/150 begins the day after the exchange.
The shares are split by relative basis: 40/60 of the shares tack the land's holding period.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】持有期接续只适用于资本资产与 1231 资产；分配按 FMV，而 Basis 的分配也按 FMV。

【Sec.1223(1)】换入股票的持有期可接续换出资产的持有期，但仅限换出资产为资本资产或 1231 资产

  • 存货不是资本资产 → 对应部分股票持有期从交换次日起算
  • 分配按相对 FMV：每一股的持有期按 100/150 接续、50/150 新起算（Rev. Rul. 85-164）
【干扰项】选项A 忽略存货；选项B 忽略接续规则；选项D 用 Basis 比例分配（应按 FMV）
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：按相对 FMV 拆分每一股的持有期：100/150 接续土地的 5 年，50/150 从交换次日起算。
qs.tp: T10.2.8 混合资产股票持有期 Split-Stock-Holding-Period

qs.s: A week before incorporating, Bo borrows $80,000 secured by his building (basis $100,000; FMV $300,000) and uses the cash for a family vacation and personal debts. He then transfers the building, subject to the $80,000 mortgage, to his new corporation for all of its stock (FMV $220,000). What gain does Bo recognize?
o: $80,000 — because the liability has no bona fide business purpose, all liabilities assumed are treated as money received (Sec. 357(b)); recognized gain is the lesser of $200,000 realized gain or $80,000.
$0 — liabilities assumed in a Sec. 351 exchange are not boot, and they do not exceed the building's basis.
$200,000 — the entire realized gain is recognized because of the tax-avoidance purpose.
$0, but his stock basis is reduced to $20,000 and the gain is deferred.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】357(b) 是"全有或全无"：一笔负债有问题，全部负债都视为 Boot；357(c) 只看负债超过 Basis 的部分。

【一般规则 Sec.357(a)】公司承担负债不视为 Boot

【例外 1 Sec.357(b)】承担负债的主要目的是避税，或没有真实商业目的 → 全部承担负债视为现金
  • 本题：转让前一周借款用于个人消费 → 357(b) 适用
  • 实现利得 = 220,000 + 80,000 − 100,000 = 200,000；确认 = Min(200,000, 80,000) = 80,000
  • 股票 Basis = 100,000 − 80,000（负债）+ 80,000（确认利得）= 100,000
【例外 2 Sec.357(c)】负债超过 Basis 的部分确认利得（本题 80,000 < 100,000，不适用）
【干扰项】选项B 只想到 357(c)；选项C 夸大了 357(b)（仍以实现利得与"视同现金"较小者为限）；选项D 编造了递延方式
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：无商业目的的负债使全部承担负债视为现金，确认利得 = Min(实现利得 $200,000, $80,000) = $80,000。
qs.tp: T10.2.6 避税负债与可扣应付 Abusive-Deductible-Liabilities

qs.s: Cara, a cash-method sole proprietor, incorporates her business under Sec. 351. She transfers assets with a total adjusted basis of $50,000 (including accounts receivable with a $0 basis). The corporation assumes $70,000 of accounts payable (deductible when paid) and a $30,000 bank loan used to buy equipment. What gain does Cara recognize?
o: $50,000 — total liabilities of $100,000 exceed the $50,000 basis.
$20,000 — the $70,000 of payables exceeds the $50,000 basis.
$30,000 — the bank loan is treated as boot.
$0 — accounts payable that would give rise to a deduction when paid are not counted under Sec. 357(c)(3); only the $30,000 bank loan counts, and it does not exceed the $50,000 basis.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】现金制独资企业公司化是 357(c)(3) 的典型场景——应收账款 Basis 为 0，若把应付账款计入负债会产生虚假利得。

【Sec.357(c)】承担负债总额超过转让资产总 Basis → 超额部分确认利得

【Sec.357(c)(3) 例外】若负债支付时可扣除（现金制下的应付账款、应付费用），在计算 357(c) 时不计入负债
  • 计入负债只有银行贷款 30,000 < Basis 50,000 → 无利得
  • 若不排除：100,000 − 50,000 = 50,000 利得（选项A）
  • 同理，股票 Basis 计算时也不扣减这些应付账款（Sec.358(d)(2)）
【干扰项】选项B 只看应付账款；选项C 把一般负债当作 Boot
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：现金制应付账款依 357(c)(3) 不计入，计入的 $30,000 贷款未超过 $50,000 Basis，不确认利得。
qs.tp: T10.2.6 避税负债与可扣应付 Abusive-Deductible-Liabilities

qs.s: Sue owns all 100 shares (FMV $100,000) of Old Co. Tom, unrelated, transfers appreciated land to Old Co. for 300 new shares. To help Tom qualify under Sec. 351, Sue simultaneously transfers $2,000 cash for 2 more shares. Which statement is correct?
o: Sue's transfer counts, so the transferors together own 100% and Tom recognizes no gain.

Sue's transfer is of relatively small value (less than 10% of the value of the stock she already owns, the IRS ruling guideline) and is disregarded; Tom alone owns 75%, fails the 80% control test, and recognizes gain on the land.
Tom qualifies because he acquires more than 50% of the corporation.
Sue recognizes gain because her transfer is an accommodation transfer.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】现有股东"凑数"出资必须有实质价值（IRS 指引 ≥10%），否则控制测试仍只看新转让人。

【控制测试】转让人作为一个群体，交换后须持有 ≥80% 表决权与其他各类股票

  • Tom：300 / 402 ≈ 75% → 单独不满足
【已有股东的通融转让（accommodation transfer）】为帮助新转让人满足控制而象征性地出资，若财产价值相对其已持有股票"很小"，则其全部股票不计入控制群体（Reg. 1.351-1(a)(1)(ii)）
  • IRS 裁定指引（Rev. Proc. 77-37）：出资 ≥ 已持有股票价值的 10% 才计入
  • 2,000 < 10% × 100,000 = 10,000 → 不计入 → Tom 确认土地利得
【筹划】Sue 出资 ≥ $10,000，则 Sue + Tom 合计 100% 控制 → 整体适用 351
【干扰项】选项A 忽略通融转让规则；选项C 用错门槛；选项D Sue 以现金换股不产生利得
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：Sue 的出资低于其已持有股票价值的 10%，被视为通融转让而不计入；Tom 单独 75% 不满足 80% 控制，需确认利得。
qs.tp: T10.2.2 现有股东通融出资 Accommodation-Transfer-Control

qs.s: In a Sec. 351 exchange, Fay transfers property (basis $60,000; FMV $200,000) for common stock worth $150,000 and preferred stock worth $50,000 that she can require the corporation to redeem within 5 years. What gain does Fay recognize?
o: $0 — all consideration is stock of the transferee corporation.

$50,000 — the preferred stock is nonqualified preferred stock (holder redemption right), which is treated as other property (boot) under Sec. 351(g); gain is the lesser of $140,000 realized or $50,000.
$140,000 — the preferred stock disqualifies the exchange under Sec. 351.
$0, but the preferred stock takes a zero basis.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】"优先股"不一定是股票——考题出现赎回权/回售权时要想到 351(g)。

【Sec.351(g) 非合格优先股（NQPS）】视为"其他财产"（Boot），满足下列之一的优先股：

  • 持有人可要求发行人赎回或购买
  • 发行人被要求（或很可能）在 20 年内赎回
  • 股息随利率、商品价格等变动
【本题】持有人 5 年内可要求赎回 → NQPS → Boot 50,000
  • 实现利得 200,000 − 60,000 = 140,000；确认 = Min(140,000, 50,000) = 50,000
  • NQPS Basis = FMV 50,000；普通股 Basis = 60,000 + 50,000 − 50,000 = 60,000
【干扰项】选项A 忽略 351(g)；选项C 夸大后果——交换仍适用 351；选项D Boot 的 Basis 为 FMV
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：持有人可要求赎回的优先股属于非合格优先股，依 351(g) 视为 Boot，确认 Min($140,000, $50,000) = $50,000。
qs.tp: T10.2.7 非合格优先股补价 Nonqualified-Preferred-Stock

qs.s: Gil contributes $1,000,000 of a single stock (basis $100,000) and Hal contributes $1,000,000 of a different single stock (basis $200,000) to a new partnership whose assets will be more than 80% marketable securities. Each receives a 50% interest. What are the consequences?
o: No gain — Sec. 721 has no control requirement and no exceptions for contributions of property.
The partnership recognizes the gains when the partners contribute the stock.
Gain is deferred until the partnership sells the contributed stock, and then allocated under Sec. 704(c).
Gil and Hal each recognize gain ($900,000 and $800,000) under Sec. 721(b), because the transfers diversify their holdings in a partnership that would be an investment company.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】"交换基金"式的合伙（集中持股换分散组合）不能用 721 递延——721 并非毫无例外。

【Sec.721(a)】合伙出资一般不确认损益，且无控制要求

【例外 Sec.721(b)】若合伙企业为"投资公司"（>80% 资产为可交易证券等，参照 351(e)）且出资导致分散化，出资人确认利得（亏损不确认）
  • Gil、Hal 各以单一股票换得分散组合的一半权益 → 分散化 → Gil 确认 900,000、Hal 确认 800,000
  • 若出资人投入的本已是分散组合（符合 25/50 测试），则不视为分散化
【对比】351(e) 对公司适用同样的投资公司例外
【干扰项】选项A 忽略 721(b)；选项B 纳税主体错误；选项C 是没有 721(b) 时的 704(c) 处理
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：出资给投资公司型合伙并导致分散化，依 721(b) 出资人确认利得：Gil $900,000、Hal $800,000。
qs.tp: T10.3.5 投资组合分散化例外 Investment-Partnership-Diversification

qs.s: Jo receives a 20% capital interest in an existing partnership (net assets FMV $500,000) in exchange for services she will provide. The interest is fully vested. What are Jo's consequences?
o: $100,000 of ordinary compensation income (FMV of the capital interest), and an outside basis of $100,000.
No income — interests received for services qualify for the profits-interest safe harbor of Rev. Proc. 93-27.
$100,000 of capital gain, and an outside basis of $0.
No income until the partnership liquidates, and then ordinary income equal to her liquidation proceeds.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】考题关键词："capital interest" → 立即纳税；"profits interest" → 一般不纳税。

【资本权益 vs 利润权益】

  • 资本权益（立即清算可分得资产）换取服务 → 按 FMV 确认普通收入（Sec.83），Basis = 已确认收入
  • 利润权益（只分享未来利润/增值）→ 一般不确认收入（Rev. Proc. 93-27 安全港，排除可预期收入流、2 年内处置、上市合伙）
【本题】20% × 500,000 = 100,000 普通收入；Outside Basis 100,000
  • 合伙层面：视同以部分资产支付报酬，可能扣除或资本化，并就视同转让的资产确认损益
【干扰项】选项B 混淆资本权益与利润权益；选项C 性质错误；选项D 递延无依据
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：以服务换取的已归属资本权益按 FMV $100,000 确认普通收入，Outside Basis 为 $100,000。

qs.s: On July 1, 2026, Kyle transfers equipment (5-year MACRS property placed in service in 2024; adjusted basis $30,000) to his wholly owned corporation in a Sec. 351 exchange with no boot. How does the corporation depreciate the equipment?
o: It starts a new 5-year recovery period in 2026 with the half-year convention.
It may claim 100% bonus depreciation on the $30,000 carryover basis.
It continues Kyle's remaining recovery period and method on the carryover basis, and the 2026 deduction is allocated between Kyle and the corporation by the number of months each held the property.
It cannot depreciate the equipment until 2027.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】351/721 转入资产不能重新开始折旧，也不能对结转 Basis 适用 bonus。

【Sec.168(i)(7)】351、721、合伙分配等不确认交易中，受让人对结转 Basis 部分"接替"转让人的折旧：沿用剩余回收期与方法

  • 转让年度的折旧按月在转让人与受让人之间分配
  • 受让人若因确认利得而增加 Basis，增加部分视为新购资产另行折旧
【Bonus】从关联方或以结转 Basis 取得的资产不符合 bonus 的"取得"要求 → 选项B错
【干扰项】选项A 重新计算回收期错误；选项D 无依据
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：受让公司对结转 Basis 接续转让人的剩余回收期与方法，转让年度折旧按持有月份分配。
