qs.s: E Corp (a C corporation) completely liquidates and distributes land (FMV $200,000, basis $100,000) to its sole shareholder, Eli, whose stock basis is $30,000. Ignoring any liabilities, what are the tax results to E Corp and to Eli, and what is Eli's basis in the land?
o: E Corp: $0 gain; Eli: $200,000 dividend income; land basis $200,000.
E Corp: $100,000 gain; Eli: $0 gain because the corporation already paid tax; land basis $100,000.
E Corp: $0 gain; Eli: $170,000 capital gain; Eli's land basis $100,000.
E Corp: $100,000 gain (Sec. 336, as if sold at FMV); Eli: $170,000 capital gain ($200,000 − $30,000 stock basis, Sec. 331); Eli's land basis = FMV $200,000.
qs.x:
【🚨 高频陷阱】

① 清算分配对股东是 Capital Gain（Sec.331），非清算分配才走 E&P → Dividend；
② 若公司有负债由股东承担，公司 Gain 计算中 FMV 不低于负债额；股东的 Amount Realized = FMV − 承担负债；
③ 若是母公司持股 ≥80% 的子公司清算 → 改用 Sec.332/337，公司和母公司都不确认损益（见下一题）。

【公司层面 — Sec.336】

  • 清算分配视同按 FMV 出售：$200,000 − $100,000 = $100,000 Gain（清算时增值、减值均确认，减值受 336(d) 关联方限制）
【股东层面 — Sec.331】
  • 清算分配视同"出售股票"：收到 FMV $200,000 − Stock Basis $30,000 = $170,000 资本利得（不是股息！非清算分配才看 E&P 按股息）
【股东取得资产 Basis — Sec.334(a)】
  • = FMV $200,000
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：C 公司完全清算面临双重征税，公司层面按资产 FMV 确认损益，股东层面按收回净额与股票基数确认资本损益。
qs.tp: T11.1 公司普通清算 Corporate-Complete-Liquidation

qs.s: E Corp liquidates and distributes land (FMV $200,000, basis $100,000) to its sole shareholder, who takes the land subject to a $250,000 nonrecourse mortgage. What gain does E Corp recognize?
o: $0 because the shareholder assumed the liability
$150,000 — under Sec. 336(b), FMV is treated as not less than the liability ($250,000), so gain = $250,000 − $100,000
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题无负债 → Gain = FMV − Basis；本题负债 > FMV → 以负债额计算。

【Sec.336(b)】分配财产附带负债时，视同 FMV 不低于负债额

  • 视同售价 = Max($200,000, $250,000) = $250,000
  • 公司 Gain = $250,000 − $100,000 = $150,000

（非清算分配 Sec.311(b)/(c) 同样适用此规则）

【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：$150,000 — under Sec. 336(b), FMV is treated as not less than the liability ($250,000), so gain = $250,000 − $100,000
qs.tp: T11.1.1 公司视同出售与负债下限 Deemed-Sale-Liability-Floor

qs.s:
• P Corp owns 80% of S Corp (a C corporation)
  • unrelated individual Mia owns 20%. S completely liquidates, distributing Asset 1 (FMV $200,000, basis $100,000) to P, and Asset 2 (FMV $50,000, basis $80,000 — a loss asset) to Mia. P's basis in its S stock is $30,000
  • Mia's basis in her S stock is $30,000. Which statement is correct?
o: S recognizes no gain on the distribution to P (Sec. 337); P recognizes no gain and takes carryover basis of $100,000 in Asset 1 (Sec. 332/334(b)), and S's tax attributes (e.g., NOLs, E&P) carry over to P. On the distribution to the MINORITY shareholder, S recognizes gain on appreciated property but CANNOT recognize loss (Sec. 336(d)(3)), so S's $30,000 loss on Asset 2 is disallowed; Mia recognizes a $20,000 capital gain ($50,000 − $30,000) and takes a $50,000 FMV basis.
All parties, including Mia, get nonrecognition and carryover basis because the liquidation as a whole qualifies under Sec. 332.
S recognizes $100,000 gain on the distribution to P and a $30,000 loss on the distribution to Mia; P recognizes $170,000 gain.
Because P owns only 80% (not 100%), Sec. 332 does not apply, and the entire liquidation is taxable to everyone.
qs.x:
【🚨 高频陷阱】

① 332 门槛是 80%（与合并申报 1504(a) 相同的双80%），不是 100%（选项D错）；
② 332 只保护母公司这条线；少数股东永远按 331/336 应税处理（选项B错）；
③ 对少数股东：Gain 要认、Loss 不认 —— "单向不利"规则，是 TCP 高频考点。

【Step 1：母公司 P（持股 ≥80% 表决权及价值 → 332 适用）】

  • 子公司 S 对 P 分配：不确认 Gain/Loss（Sec.337）
  • P 收到资产：不确认 Gain/Loss（Sec.332）
  • P 取得资产 Basis = Carryover $100,000（Sec.334(b)），持有期承继
  • S 的 NOL、E&P 等税务属性转移给 P（Sec.381）
【Step 2：少数股东 Mia（20%）—— 仍适用普通清算规则】
  • S 对 Mia 分配：增值资产要确认 Gain；减值资产的 Loss 不得确认（Sec.336(d)(3)：在 332 清算中对少数股东分配的损失不予承认）→ S 的 $30,000 Loss 被否决
  • Mia：Sec.331 → $50,000 − $30,000 = $20,000 资本利得；Basis = FMV $50,000
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：母子公司清算对母公司免税并结转基数（Sec. 332/337），对小股东分配增值资产征税但亏损不得确认（Sec. 336(d)(3)）。
qs.tp: T11.2.3 少数股东单独计税 Minority-Shareholder-Separate-Taxation

qs.s: K Corp (owned 60% by Kim and 40% by Lee, unrelated individuals) completely liquidates. It distributes a loss asset (FMV $70,000, basis $100,000, held for many years) entirely to Kim, and distributes cash of equal value to Lee. Can K Corp recognize the $30,000 loss?
o: No — the loss asset is distributed to a related person (Kim owns more than 50%) in a non-pro rata distribution, so Sec. 336(d)(1) disallows the loss.
Yes — losses are always recognized in a complete liquidation.
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题 332 下对少数股东 → 336(d)(3)；本题一般清算下对多数股东 → 336(d)(1)。

【Sec.336(d)(1)】清算中向关联方（持股 >50%）分配减值资产，若 ① 非按比例分配，或 ② 属"不合格财产"（5 年内通过 351/出资取得），则 Loss 不得确认

  • Kim 60% → 关联方；资产全部给 Kim → 非按比例 → 禁止
  • 若按 60/40 比例分配且非不合格财产 → 可确认
  • 332 仅适用于公司母公司持股 ≥80%，本题股东均为个人
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：No — the loss asset is distributed to a related person (Kim owns more than 50%) in a non-pro rata distribution, so Sec. 336(d)(1) disallows the loss.
qs.tp: T11.3.1 关联方非比例与五年财产 Related-Party-Disqualified-Property

qs.s: Partner Pia has an outside basis of $100,000. In a NONLIQUIDATING distribution, the partnership distributes to her $30,000 cash and land with an inside basis of $100,000 and FMV of $200,000. No hot assets (Sec. 751) are involved. What gain does Pia recognize, what is her basis in the land, and what is her remaining outside basis?
o: Gain $30,000; land basis $100,000; remaining outside basis $0.
Gain $100,000; land basis $200,000; remaining outside basis $0.
Gain $0; land basis $100,000; remaining outside basis $0, with a $30,000 suspended basis carryforward.
Gain $0; land basis $70,000; remaining outside basis $0.
qs.x:
【🚨 与公司分配对比（必背）】
  • C/S-Corp 分配增值土地：公司确认 $100,000 Gain；股东取得 Basis = FMV $200,000
  • Partnership：无人确认 Gain；合伙人 Basis = Carryover（受 Outside Basis 限制）$70,000
  • 被压掉的 $30,000 Basis 在 754 选择下可通过 734(b) 调增合伙企业剩余资产 Basis（筹划延伸点）。

【Step 1：现金优先】

  • Outside Basis $100,000 − 现金 $30,000 = $70,000（现金 ≤ Basis → 无 Gain）
【Step 2：财产 Carryover Basis，但以剩余 Outside Basis 为上限（Sec.732(a)(2)）】
  • 土地 Inside Basis $100,000 > 剩余 Outside Basis $70,000 → 土地 Basis 被压到 $70,000
  • Outside Basis → $0
【Step 3：Gain？】
  • 非清算分配只有"现金 > Outside Basis"才确认 Gain（Sec.731(a)）；分配财产本身永远不触发 Gain → $0
  • 合伙企业层面也不确认任何损益（FMV $200,000 不影响）
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：非清算分配下先抵扣现金，土地基数下调至剩余 Outside Basis（$70,000），确认利得 $0，期末 Basis 为 $0。
qs.tp: T11.5.1 非清算现金优先与财产上限 Nonliquidating-Cash-Property-Limits

qs.s: Pia's outside basis is only $20,000. In a nonliquidating distribution she receives $30,000 cash and land (inside basis $100,000). What are the results?
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题现金 < Basis → 无 Gain、土地 Basis 被压低；本题现金 > Basis → 现金部分确认 Gain，土地 Basis 归零。
  • 现金优先：$30,000 > Basis $20,000 → $10,000 资本利得（Sec.731(a)(1)）
  • Basis 已为 0 → 土地 Basis $0
  • 分配财产本身仍不触发 Gain
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：Gain $10,000; land basis $0; outside basis $0
qs.tp: T11.5.1 非清算现金优先与财产上限 Nonliquidating-Cash-Property-Limits

qs.s: Partner Quinn's outside basis is $100,000. In complete liquidation of his interest, he receives $30,000 cash and inventory with an inside basis of $20,000 (FMV $25,000). Nothing else is distributed. Alternatively, suppose he instead received $30,000 cash, the same inventory, AND a parcel of land (inside basis $10,000). What are the results in each case?
o: Both cases: $50,000 capital loss; land basis $10,000.
Case 1: no loss; inventory basis steps up to $70,000. Case 2: $40,000 capital loss.
Case 1: $50,000 capital loss recognized; inventory basis $20,000. Case 2: no loss; inventory basis $20,000 and land takes the remaining $50,000 basis.
Case 1: $50,000 ordinary loss; Case 2: $40,000 ordinary loss.
qs.x:
【🚨 高频陷阱】

① 存货/应收款 Basis 不能调高（防止把资本损失转化为普通损失）；其他财产可以调高/调低以耗尽 Outside Basis；
② Loss 性质是 Capital（选项D错）；
③ 筹划视角：想确认 Loss 的合伙人应"只拿现金/应收/存货"；想递延的则多拿一项其他资产。

【规则：清算分配 Loss 的唯一触发条件（Sec.731(a)(2)）】
合伙人只收到 ① 现金 ② 未实现应收款 ③ 存货，且其合计 Basis < Outside Basis → 差额确认为 Capital Loss

【Case 1：只收现金 + 存货】
  • $100,000 − 现金 $30,000 = $70,000
  • 存货 Basis 不得"放大"——永远 Carryover，最高为 Inside Basis → $20,000
  • 剩余 $50,000 无处安放 → 确认 $50,000 Capital Loss
【Case 2：多收了一块土地（非现金/应收/存货）】
  • 现金 $30,000 → 剩余 $70,000
  • 存货 Carryover $20,000 → 剩余 $50,000
  • 土地吸收全部剩余 Basis → 土地 Basis = $50,000（即使 Inside Basis 仅 $10,000，也要"放大"以耗尽 Outside Basis）
  • 无 Loss
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：仅分配现金与存货且金额不足时确认清算损失；若分配其他财产则不确认损失，由该财产吸收剩余基数。
qs.tp: T11.6.1 清算损失的限定资产 Liquidating-Loss-Eligible-Assets

qs.s: Quinn's outside basis is $100,000. In complete liquidation he receives $30,000 cash and inventory with an inside basis of $90,000 (FMV $95,000). Nothing else. What are his gain/loss and inventory basis?
o: No gain or loss; inventory basis $90,000
No gain or loss; inventory basis decreased to $70,000
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题存货 Basis 小 → 剩余 Basis 无处去 → Loss；本题存货 Basis 大 → 被压低 → 无 Loss。
  • $100,000 − 现金 $30,000 = $70,000
  • 存货 Carryover $90,000 > $70,000 → 存货 Basis 调低至 $70,000（可以调低，不能调高）
  • 没有 Loss（Basis 没有"剩余"）；也没有 Gain（现金 < Basis）
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：No gain or loss; inventory basis decreased to $70,000
qs.tp: T11.6.2 应收款与存货基数上限 Receivables-Inventory-Basis-Cap

qs.s: An S corporation (no built-in gains tax exposure) completely liquidates by distributing its only asset, land held as a Sec. 1231 asset (FMV $200,000; basis $100,000), to its sole shareholder, whose stock basis is $100,000. What are the results?
o: The corporation pays tax on the $100,000 gain, and the shareholder has a $100,000 capital gain on the stock — two levels of tax, as for a C corporation.
No gain at any level, as for a partnership liquidation; the shareholder's land basis is $100,000.
The shareholder recognizes a $200,000 capital gain.

The corporation's $100,000 Sec. 336 gain passes through to the shareholder and increases her stock basis to $200,000; the $200,000 liquidating distribution then produces no further gain under Sec. 331; her basis in the land is $200,000.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】S 公司清算的"单层课税"会因性质错配打折扣：穿透的是普通收入，而股东层面的对冲却是资本损失。

【S 公司清算 = 336 + 穿透 + 331】
① 公司层面 Sec.336：视同按 FMV 出售 → $100,000 Gain（1231 性质）→ 穿透给股东（S 公司一般不缴公司税，BIG 除外）
② 股东 Stock Basis：$100,000 + $100,000 = $200,000
③ Sec.331：收到 FMV $200,000 − Basis $200,000 = $0
④ 股东土地 Basis = FMV $200,000（334(a)）

【🔁 三类实体对比】
公司层面股东层面取得资产 Basis
C 公司清算336 Gain 纳税331 再纳税FMV
S 公司清算336 Gain 穿透331 通常无额外 GainFMV
合伙清算不确认731 一般不确认结转/调整（732）
【性质错配】若资产为存货等普通资产 → 穿透普通收入，同时股东可能出现资本损失（Basis 调增后）
【干扰项】选项A 当成 C 公司；选项B 当成合伙；选项C 忽略 Basis 调增
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：S 公司清算时公司层面的 Sec.336 利得穿透并调增 Stock Basis，股东依 Sec.331 不再有额外利得，土地 Basis 为 FMV $200,000。
qs.tp: T11.4 S公司完全清算 S-Corporation-Complete-Liquidation

qs.s: A 30% shareholder contributed land (basis $200,000; FMV $120,000) to X Corp as a capital contribution. Eleven months later X adopts a plan of complete liquidation and sells the land to an unrelated buyer for $100,000. There is no clear business reason for the contribution. What loss may X recognize?
o: $20,000 — Sec. 336(d)(2) reduces the land's basis by the $80,000 built-in loss at contribution, so only the post-contribution decline is recognized.
$100,000 — the sale is to an unrelated party, so Sec. 336(d) does not apply.
$0 — all losses on contributed property are disallowed in a liquidation.
$80,000 — only the built-in loss at contribution is recognized.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】336(d)(1) 看"关联方"，336(d)(2) 看"出资时点与目的"——后者对无关联方也适用。

【Sec.336(d)(2) 反"塞亏损"规则】以 351 或出资方式取得的内置亏损资产，若主要目的是在清算中确认亏损，则计算亏损时 Basis 减去出资时的内置亏损

  • 清算计划通过前 2 年内取得 → 推定具有该目的（无明确商业理由时）
  • 适用于出售、交换或分配，即使受让人与公司无关联
【本题】调整后 Basis = 200,000 − (200,000 − 120,000) = 120,000 → 亏损 120,000 − 100,000 = 20,000
【对比 336(d)(1)】分配给关联股东（>50%）的非按比例分配或"不合格财产"，亏损全部不允许
【注意】出资时 362(e)(2) 通常已将 Basis 降为 FMV 120,000（除非选择 362(e)(2)(C)），结果同为 20,000
【干扰项】选项B 误以为只有关联方才受限；选项C 过度；选项D 恰好相反
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：336(d)(2) 把 Basis 减去出资时的内置亏损 $80,000，只允许出资后的贬值 $20,000。
qs.tp: T11.3.2 两年内置亏损反塞入 Builtin-Loss-Antistuffing-Rule

qs.s: In a complete liquidation under Sec. 331, Lu (stock basis $200,000) receives a building (FMV $500,000) subject to a $100,000 mortgage that she assumes, plus $50,000 cash. What is Lu's recognized gain and her basis in the building?
o: Gain $250,000; basis $400,000 (FMV net of the mortgage).
No gain until she sells the building; basis $200,000.
Gain $250,000 ($500,000 − $100,000 + $50,000 − $200,000); basis in the building $500,000 (FMV) with a new holding period.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】股东承担的负债减少实现额，但不减少取得财产的 Basis（Basis 始终为 FMV）。

【股东层面 Sec.331】按出售处理：实现额 = 现金 + 财产 FMV − 股东承担的负债

  • 500,000 − 100,000 + 50,000 = 450,000 − 200,000 = 250,000 资本利得
【取得财产 Basis Sec.334(a)】= 分配时 FMV 500,000（负债已在实现额中扣除，不再从 Basis 扣）；持有期重新起算
【公司层面 Sec.336】按 FMV 视同出售确认损益
【干扰项】选项A 未扣负债；选项B Basis 误减负债；选项C 清算分配不能递延
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：实现额 $450,000 减股票 Basis $200,000 = $250,000 利得；建筑 Basis 为 FMV $500,000。
qs.tp: T11.1.2 股东净实现额与新基数 Shareholder-Proceeds-Property-Basis

qs.s: P Corp owned 85% of S Corp when S adopted a plan of complete liquidation in March 2026. In June, P sold 10% of S's stock to an unrelated party. S distributed all its assets in December 2026. What are the consequences?
o: Sec. 332 applies because P owned 80% when the plan was adopted.
Sec. 332 applies because all distributions were made within one tax year.

Sec. 332 does not apply because P did not own at least 80% from the plan's adoption through the final distribution; P recognizes gain or loss under Sec. 331, and S recognizes gain or loss on distributions to P under Sec. 336.
Sec. 332 applies to P, and only the minority shareholders are taxed.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】反过来：母公司若想确认子公司股票亏损，可在清算前把持股降到 80% 以下——考题常考这一筹划。

【Sec.332 要求】
① 母公司持有子公司 ≥80% 表决权与价值（1504(a)(2)），且从清算计划通过日至收到最后一次分配始终满足
② 在一个纳税年度内完成全部分配，或在第一次分配年度结束后 3 年内完成

【本题】6 月降至 75% → 332 不适用 → 普通清算：
  • P：331 按出售确认损益
  • S：对 P 的分配也适用 336（无 337 豁免）
【干扰项】选项A 只看通过日；选项B 时间要求满足但持股要求不满足；选项D 332 无法部分适用
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：母公司必须从计划通过到最后分配始终持有 ≥80%；中途降到 75% → 332 不适用，按 331/336 课税。
qs.tp: T11.2.1 持股期间与分配期限 Ownership-Continuity-Timing-Tests

qs.s: In a liquidating distribution, Mo receives partnership inventory items (basis $30,000). Mo holds them as an investment and sells them 4 years later for $50,000. What is the character of Mo's $20,000 gain?
o: Long-term capital gain, because Mo holds the items as a capital asset.
Ordinary income — distributed inventory items keep their ordinary character if sold within 5 years of the distribution (Sec. 735(a)(2)).
Sec. 1231 gain, because Mo held the items for more than one year.
Long-term capital gain, because Mo's holding period includes the partnership's.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】应收款永久普通、存货 5 年普通——防止把合伙的普通收入转换为合伙人的资本利得。

【Sec.735(a) 分配资产的性质"污点"】

  • 未实现应收款：分配后出售 → 永远是普通收入
  • 存货项目：分配后 5 年内出售 → 普通收入；5 年后按合伙人手中的性质
【本题】4 年内出售 → 20,000 普通收入
【持有期】分配财产的持有期包括合伙的持有期（735(b)），但不能改变 735(a) 的性质
【干扰项】选项ACD 都忽略 5 年污点规则
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：分配的存货在 5 年内出售，依 735(a)(2) 为普通收入。
qs.tp: T11.6.4 分配后出售的所得性质 Distributed-Assets-Character-Taint

qs.s: Ned (outside basis $40,000) receives marketable securities (partnership basis $60,000; FMV $100,000) in a nonliquidating distribution. He did not contribute them, and the partnership is not an investment partnership. Ignoring the Sec. 731(c)(3)(B) reduction, what is Ned's gain and his basis in the securities?
o: No gain; basis in the securities $40,000.
Gain $60,000 (the securities are treated as money of $100,000, exceeding his $40,000 basis); basis in the securities $100,000 ($40,000 Sec. 732 basis + $60,000 gain recognized).
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】合伙分配"通常不确认利得"——但可交易证券是现金的替身，是考试常见例外。

【Sec.731(c)】可交易证券按 FMV 视同现金分配

  • 视同现金 100,000 > Outside Basis 40,000 → 利得 60,000
【Basis Sec.731(c)(4)】= 732 下的 Basis + 731(c) 确认的利得
  • 732：Min(合伙 Basis 60,000, Outside Basis 40,000) = 40,000 → + 60,000 = 100,000
【例外】分配给原出资人的证券、投资合伙企业等；731(c)(3)(B) 可按合伙人对证券净增值的份额减少视同现金额
【干扰项】选项A 当作一般财产；选项BC 利得或 Basis 算错
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：证券按 FMV $100,000 视同现金，确认 $60,000 利得；Basis = $40,000 + $60,000 = $100,000。
qs.tp: T11.5.3 可交易证券的现金例外 Marketable-Securities-Deemed-Money

qs.s: In 2026, partners holding 60% of the capital and profits interests of the Maple Partnership sell their interests to new investors within 12 months. The business continues. Which statement is correct?
o: The partnership does not terminate — technical terminations were repealed for years after 2017; it continues with the same tax year, elections, and depreciation, although the selling partners' tax years close with respect to their interests.
The partnership terminates because 50% or more of its interests were sold within 12 months.
A new partnership is formed that must restart depreciation for all assets.
The partnership's tax year closes for all partners on the date the 50% threshold is crossed.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】旧教材仍有"12 个月 50%"规则——2018 年后已不适用。

【Sec.708(b)(1)】2018 年起只有在任何合伙人都不再以合伙形式继续经营任何部分业务时，合伙才终止

  • 原"12 个月内出售或交换 ≥50% 权益即技术性终止"的规则（旧 708(b)(1)(B)）已被 TCJA 废除
【影响】合伙继续：纳税年度、会计方法、754 选择、折旧均延续
【出售合伙人】其纳税年度就被出售的权益结束（706(c)(2)）；若有 754 选择，买方可取得 743(b) 调整
【干扰项】选项BCD 都是旧技术性终止规则下的结果
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：技术性终止已被废除，合伙继续存续，纳税年度与各项选择不变；仅出售方的纳税年度就其权益结束。
qs.tp: T11.7.4 技术性终止废除与真实终止 Technical-Termination-Repeal-Rule

qs.s: Rae exchanges an investment building (FMV $200,000, adjusted basis $100,000, subject to a $50,000 mortgage) for another investment building (FMV $180,000, subject to a $30,000 mortgage). Each party assumes the other's mortgage; no cash changes hands. What are Rae's realized gain, recognized gain, and basis in the new building?
qs.x:
【🚨 Boot 抵销规则（极高频）】
  • 承担负债 可以抵销 解除负债
  • 支付现金 可以抵销 解除负债
  • 承担负债 不能抵销 收到的现金 → 收到现金永远是 Boot
  • 1031 仅限不动产（2018 年后），且需 45 天内指定、180 天内完成置换。

【Step 1：Amount Realized】
= FMV 换入 $180,000 + 对方承担的负债 $50,000 − 己方承担的新负债 $30,000 = $200,000
Realized Gain = $200,000 − $100,000 = $100,000

【Step 2：Net Boot（负债可以互相抵销）】
  • 负债解除 $50,000 − 承担负债 $30,000 = 净负债解除 $20,000 → 视为收到 Boot

Recognized = Min($100,000, $20,000) = $20,000

【Step 3：新 Basis】

= 旧 Basis $100,000 + 确认 Gain $20,000 + 承担负债 $30,000 − 解除负债 $50,000 = $100,000
（验算：新资产 FMV $180,000 − 递延 Gain $80,000 = $100,000 ✔）

【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：净负债减轻视为 Boot 确认利得 $20,000，实现利得 $100,000，新置换房产基数为 $100,000。
qs.tp: T12.2.1 现金负债与替代基础 Cash-Debt-Boot-Basis

qs.s: Rae exchanges a building (FMV $200,000, basis $100,000, subject to a $50,000 mortgage assumed by the other party) for a building worth $180,000 with no mortgage, and she pays $30,000 cash. What are her recognized gain and new basis?
o: Recognized $20,000 (liability relief of $50,000 is offset by the $30,000 cash she paid); basis $100,000
qs.x:
【🚨 抵销规则】支付现金或承担负债 → 可抵销解除的负债；但收到的现金不能被任何东西抵销（见 TBS-A4-01）。
  • Amount Realized = $180,000 + 解除负债 $50,000 − 支付现金 $30,000 = $200,000 → Realized $100,000
  • 净 Boot = 负债解除 $50,000 − 支付现金 $30,000（可抵销）= $20,000 → Recognized $20,000
  • Basis = $100,000 + $20,000 + 支付现金 $30,000 − 解除负债 $50,000 = $100,000（验算：$180,000 − 递延 $80,000）
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：Recognized $20,000 (liability relief of $50,000 is offset by the $30,000 cash she paid); basis $100,000
qs.tp: T12.2.1 现金负债与替代基础 Cash-Debt-Boot-Basis

qs.s: Sam exchanges land (FMV $200,000, basis $100,000) with his brother for the brother's land (FMV $200,000, basis $170,000) in a valid like-kind exchange; no boot. Eighteen months later, the brother sells the land he received from Sam to an unrelated buyer. What is the effect on Sam?
o: No effect; Sam's deferred gain remains deferred because Sam himself did not sell anything.
Sam's brother must recognize Sam's $100,000 deferred gain in addition to his own gain.
Because a related party disposed of the exchanged property within 2 years, Sam's previously deferred $100,000 gain is triggered and recognized in the year of the brother's sale (Sec. 1031(f)).
Sam recognizes the gain retroactively in the year of the original exchange by amending his return.
qs.x:
【🚨 例外】死亡、非自愿转换（1033）、或证明交易无避税主要目的时不触发。

【规则 Sec.1031(f)：关联方置换反滥用】

  • 关联方（家庭成员：配偶、兄弟姐妹、祖先、直系后代等 Sec.267(b) 定义）之间做 1031 置换
  • 任一方在最后一次转让后 2 年内处置换得的资产 → 原本递延的 Gain 在处置当年确认（不是回溯修改原年度，选项D错）
【本题】
  • 兄弟 18 个月（< 2 年）后出售 → Sam 原递延 Gain $100,000 在兄弟出售当年被确认
  • 兄弟自己按其 Basis 另行计算自身 Gain，不承担 Sam 的部分（选项B错）
【为何设此规则？】

防止"高 Basis 关联方先换入低 Basis 资产、再对外出售"来转移增值——本题兄弟的 Basis $170,000 远高于 Sam 的 $100,000，兄弟卖出几乎不交税，家庭整体就把 $100,000 增值"洗掉"了。

【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：关联方在同类交换后 2 年内处置置换资产，触发 Sec. 1031(f) 惩罚，纳税人须在处置当年确认原递延利得。
qs.tp: T12.2.4 关联方交换锁定期 Related-Exchange-Holding-Period

qs.s: A business exchanges old equipment (original cost $130,000; accumulated depreciation $30,000; basis $100,000; FMV $200,000) for new equipment worth $200,000. What are the recognized gain, its character, and the basis of the new equipment?
o: $100,000 gain — Sec. 1031 applies only to real property after 2017; $30,000 is Sec. 1245 ordinary income and $70,000 is Sec. 1231 gain; new equipment basis $200,000 (eligible for Sec. 179/bonus depreciation)
qs.x:
【🚨 筹划】虽然 Gain 要确认，但新设备可以立即 100% Bonus 折旧，往往能抵消当年大部分 Gain 的影响。
  • TCJA 后 1031 只适用于不动产 → 设备互换 = 应税出售 + 购买
  • Gain $100,000：1245 回收 $30,000 普通；$70,000 Sec.1231
  • 新设备 Basis = FMV $200,000（成本），可用 179/Bonus
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：$100,000 gain — Sec. 1031 applies only to real property after 2017; $30,000 is Sec. 1245 ordinary income and $70,000 is Sec. 1231 gain; new equipment basis $200,000 (eligible for Sec. 179/bonus depreciation)
qs.tp: T12.2 同类不动产交换 Like-Kind-Real-Estate

qs.s: Tina's business warehouse (adjusted basis $100,000) is destroyed by fire. She receives $200,000 of insurance proceeds. Within the replacement period she buys a replacement warehouse for $170,000 and elects Sec. 1033 deferral. What is her recognized gain and her basis in the replacement warehouse?
qs.x:
【Step 1】Realized Gain = 保险金 $200,000 − Basis $100,000 = $100,000

【Step 2：Recognized = Lesser of（Realized Gain, 未再投资金额）】
  • 未再投资 = $200,000 − $170,000 = $30,000
  • Recognized = Min($100,000, $30,000) = $30,000
【Step 3：替代资产 Basis】

= 替代资产成本 $170,000 − 递延 Gain $70,000 = $100,000

【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：非自愿征用下未再投资的补偿金视同 Boot 确认利得，新购资产基数等于重置成本扣除递延利得。
【🚨 1033 vs 1031 必背对比】
10331031
触发火灾、盗窃、征收等非自愿自愿交换
资产范围动产、不动产均可仅不动产
替代标准"Similar or related in service or use"（更严）；被征收的营业/投资不动产可用较宽的 like-kind 标准Like-kind
期限实现 Gain 当年末起 2 年；被征收营业/投资不动产 3 年45 天指定 / 180 天完成
递延用现金再买→可选择；直接换成类似财产→强制强制
Loss正常确认，不递延不确认
qs.tp: T12.3.1 再投资与替代基础 Reinvestment-Replacement-Basis

qs.s: Tina's warehouse (basis $100,000) burns; insurance pays $200,000. She buys a replacement warehouse for $230,000 within the replacement period and elects Sec. 1033. What are her recognized gain and replacement basis?
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题再投资不足 → 差额确认；本题超额再投资 → 全额递延。另注意：若直接获得类似财产（而非现金）→ 递延为强制。
  • 再投资 $230,000 ≥ 收到 $200,000 → Recognized $0
  • 递延 Gain $100,000 → Basis = $230,000 − $100,000 = $130,000（多出的 $30,000 自有资金正常计入 Basis）
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：Gain $0; basis $130,000
qs.tp: T12.3.1 再投资与替代基础 Reinvestment-Replacement-Basis

qs.s: The state condemns (takes by eminent domain) Uma's investment land (basis $100,000) and pays her $200,000 in Year 1. Uma wants to defer the gain. Which statement is correct?
o: Uma must buy replacement property within 180 days, and it must be similar or related in service or use.
Condemnation gains can never be deferred; only casualty gains qualify for Sec. 1033.

Because this is a condemnation of real property held for investment, Uma may replace it with any like-kind real property (e.g., a rental building), and she has until the end of Year 4 (3 years after the close of the first tax year in which gain is realized) to reinvest; if she reinvests at least $200,000, no gain is recognized.
Uma may replace with any property at all, including stock, as long as she reinvests the full $200,000 within 2 years.
qs.x:
【🚨 附注】个人主要住所被毁损/征收时，可先适用 Sec.121 排除，剩余 Gain 再适用 1033 递延（两条可叠加）。

【特殊规则：营业/投资用不动产被征收（Condemnation）】
① 替代标准放宽：从一般的"Similar or related in service or use"放宽为 like-kind（不动产换不动产即可）→ 投资用空地换出租楼房 ✔
② 期限延长：一般 2 年 → 3 年（自实现 Gain 的第一个纳税年度结束起算）→ Year 1 实现，截止 Year 4 年末

【本题】
  • 再投资 ≥ $200,000 → Recognized Gain $0，替代资产 Basis = 成本 − 递延 $100,000
【干扰项分析】
  • A：180 天是 1031 的期限；
  • B：征收是 1033 的典型适用情形；
  • D：股票不是合格替代财产（控股公司股票特殊情形除外）。
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：投资性不动产遭政府征用适用 3 年重置期宽限，且允许置换为同类（Like-kind）不动产。
qs.tp: T12.3.2 替代期限及用途 Replacement-Period-Use-Tests

qs.s: Uma's rental apartment building (basis $100,000) is destroyed by fire (not condemnation). She receives $200,000 of insurance and uses it all within 2 years to buy raw land held for investment. Does she qualify for Sec. 1033 deferral?
o: Yes — real property for real property is always like-kind.
Yes, because she reinvested the full proceeds.

No — for involuntary conversions other than condemnations of business/investment real property, the replacement must be 'similar or related in service or use'; for an owner-lessor, the replacement must bear a similar relationship of services and risks, which raw land does not. She recognizes the $100,000 gain.
Only 50% of the gain is deferred.
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题（1033-02）是征收 → 放宽标准 → 合格；本题同样的替代选择，因原因是火灾而不合格。

【两套替代标准】

  • 一般 1033（火灾、盗窃、意外等）："Similar or related in service or use" —— 出租人适用"服务与风险关系相似"测试：出租楼 → 另一出租楼 ✔；出租楼 → 空地 ✘
  • 被征收的营业/投资不动产：放宽为 like-kind（空地 ↔ 出租楼 ✔）
  • 本题是火灾 → 适用严格标准 → 不合格 → 确认 $100,000
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：No — for involuntary conversions other than condemnations of business/investment real property, the replacement must be 'similar or related in service or use'; for an owner-lessor, the replacement must bear a similar relationship of services and risks, which raw land does not. She recognizes the $100,000 gain.
qs.tp: T12.3.2 替代期限及用途 Replacement-Period-Use-Tests

qs.s: This year, Victor has a net Sec. 1231 gain of $70,000 (after all recapture). In the prior five years, he had one net Sec. 1231 loss of $30,000 (four years ago), which was deducted as an ordinary loss and has not previously been recaptured. He had no Sec. 1231 transactions in any of the other prior years. How is this year's $70,000 net 1231 gain characterized?
o: $30,000 ordinary income and $40,000 long-term capital gain.
$40,000 ordinary income and $30,000 long-term capital gain.
qs.x:
【🚨 顺序陷阱】完整流程：① 先做 1245/1250/291 回收 → ② 意外损失（Casualty）单独 netting → ③ 1231 Hotchpot netting → ④ 净 Gain 才做 5 年回溯。回溯只针对 net gain，不影响净损失年度。

【Sec.1231 的"最优待遇"与其对价】

  • Net 1231 Loss → 全额 普通损失（无 $3,000 限制，抵普通收入）
  • Net 1231 Gain → LTCG（优惠税率）
  • 为防止纳税人"亏损年用普通损失、盈利年用资本利得"反复套利 → 5 年回溯规则（Sec.1231(c)）
【本题】
  • 前 5 年未回收的 Net 1231 Loss = $30,000
  • 本年 Net 1231 Gain $70,000 中，先有 $30,000 转为普通收入（"偿还"过去的普通损失待遇）
  • 剩余 $40,000 LTCG
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：前 5 年未回溯的 Sec. 1231 净亏损（$30,000）优先将本期利得转为普通收入，剩余 $40,000 适用长期资本利得。
qs.tp: T12.6.1 五年损失回溯 Five-Year-Loss-Lookback

qs.s: This year Victor has a net Sec. 1231 LOSS of $30,000 and no other capital transactions. What is its treatment, and what is the future consequence?
o: $30,000 ordinary loss, fully deductible against ordinary income (no $3,000 limit); if Victor has net Sec. 1231 gains in any of the next 5 years, up to $30,000 of those gains will be recharacterized as ordinary income.
$30,000 ordinary loss with no future effect.
qs.x:
【🚨 筹划】若预计明年有大额 1231 Gain，可考虑把本年的 1231 Loss 与 Gain 安排在同一年实现，避免"今年按普通损失扣、明年又被回溯转为普通收入"——净效果需按边际税率比较。
  • 净 1231 Loss → 全额 普通损失（1231 最优待遇的一半）
  • 该损失进入"未回收净 1231 损失"账户 → 未来 5 年内出现净 1231 Gain 时，需先把相应金额转为普通收入（1231(c)）
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：$30,000 ordinary loss, fully deductible against ordinary income (no $3,000 limit); if Victor has net Sec. 1231 gains in any of the next 5 years, up to $30,000 of those gains will be recharacterized as ordinary income.
qs.tp: T12.6.1 五年损失回溯 Five-Year-Loss-Lookback

qs.s: Ada gifts stock to her son when her adjusted basis is $100,000 and FMV is $70,000 (no gift tax paid). What gain or loss does the son recognize if he later sells it for (1) $200,000, (2) $90,000, or (3) $60,000?
o: (1) $100,000 gain; (2) no gain or loss; (3) $10,000 loss.
qs.x:
【🚨 对比记忆】
  • 本题结果与"Sec.267 关联方出售"题（TCP-NEW-A4-RP-01）数字完全一样 —— 两种机制殊途同归：赠与人/卖方的 $30,000 内含亏损不能转移给下一手去扣除
  • 继承资产完全不同：Basis = 死亡日 FMV（Step-up 或 Step-down），持有期自动长期
  • 筹划建议：减值资产不宜赠与 —— 应由持有人自己卖掉确认 Loss，再赠与现金。

【Dual Basis 规则（赠与时 FMV < 赠与人 Basis）】

  • 算 Gain 用：赠与人 Basis $100,000
  • 算 Loss 用：赠与日 FMV $70,000
【逐一套用】

(1) $200,000 > $100,000 → Gain = $200,000 − $100,000 = $100,000
(2) $90,000 介于 $70,000 与 $100,000 之间 → 用 $100,000 算是 Loss，用 $70,000 算是 Gain → 不确认损益
(3) $60,000 < $70,000 → Loss = $60,000 − $70,000 = $(10,000)

【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）。
qs.tp: T12.1.1 赠与双重基础 Gift-Dual-Basis

qs.s: Sam gives stock (his basis $100,000; FMV $200,000) to his terminally ill mother. She dies 8 months later, leaving the stock back to Sam; FMV at her death is $210,000. What is Sam's basis in the stock?
o: $210,000 — inherited property always receives a step-up to FMV at death.
$200,000 — FMV at the date of the gift.
$155,000 — the average of basis and FMV.

$100,000 — under Sec. 1014(e), appreciated property acquired by the decedent by gift within 1 year of death that passes back to the donor (or the donor's spouse) takes the decedent's adjusted basis immediately before death, not a step-up.
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题考赠与的 Dual Basis；本题考"先赠与再继承回来"刷 Basis 的筹划被法律封堵。

【Sec.1014(e) 反滥用】
条件：① 增值财产 ② 死者在死亡前 1 年内通过赠与取得 ③ 死后回到原赠与人（或其配偶）
→ Basis = 死者死亡前一刻的调整后 Basis = Carryover $100,000（无 Step-up）

  • 若超过 1 年才死亡，或留给赠与人以外的人 → 正常 Step-up 至 $210,000
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：$100,000 — under Sec. 1014(e), appreciated property acquired by the decedent by gift within 1 year of death that passes back to the donor (or the donor's spouse) takes the decedent's adjusted basis immediately before death, not a step-up.
qs.tp: T12.1.2 继承基础与回赠 Inheritance-Returned-Gifts

qs.s: Zack lends $100,000 interest-free to his adult daughter to help buy a home. This is his only loan outstanding to her. The applicable federal rate would imply $4,000 of foregone interest for the year. The daughter's net investment income for the year is $800. Tax avoidance is not a principal purpose. How much interest is imputed to Zack as income?
o: $0, because any loan used to purchase a principal residence is fully exempt from Sec. 7872.
$800, equal to the daughter's net investment income.
$4,000, because all below-market loans between family members impute interest at the AFR.
$0 — for gift loans totaling $100,000 or less, imputed interest is limited to the borrower's net investment income, and if that NII is $1,000 or less, it is treated as zero.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】

① 选项B：NII 上限只有在 NII >$1,000 时才生效（本题 NII $800 ≤ $1,000 → 视为 $0）；选项C忽视了 $100,000 以下赠与贷款的 NII 上限；
② 选项A：购房用途本身不是豁免条件（题目只是背景）；
③ 若贷款变成 $100,001，则 NII 限制失效，要按 AFR 推定全部 $4,000（门槛效应）；
④ 公司-股东、雇主-员工的低息贷款，推定利息分别视为股息/薪酬，而非赠与。

【一般规则（Sec.7872）】
低息/无息赠与贷款：视同 ① 出借人把"应收利息"（按 AFR）赠与借款人 → ② 借款人再把利息付回出借人 → 出借人确认利息收入，并视为做了等额赠与。

【豁免/限制梯度】
  • 贷款余额 ≤ $10,000：完全不适用（用于购买生息资产的除外）
  • 贷款余额 ≤ $100,000：推定利息 上限 = 借款人的净投资收益（NII）；若 NII ≤ $1,000，视为 $0（避税为主要目的者除外）
  • > $100,000：按 AFR 全额推定
【本题】
  • 贷款恰好 $100,000（≤$100,000 ✔）
  • 女儿 NII $800 ≤ $1,000 → 推定利息 $0
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：$100,000 及以下无息赠与贷款视借款人净投资收益推算利息，借款人净投资收益不超过 $1,000 则计为 $0。
qs.tp: T12.10.1 礼物贷款与净投资 Gift-Loan-Net-Investment

qs.s: Same $100,000 interest-free gift loan from Zack to his daughter (foregone interest $4,000; no tax-avoidance purpose), EXCEPT the daughter's net investment income is $2,500. How much interest is imputed to Zack?
o: $2,500 — for gift loans of $100,000 or less, imputed interest is limited to the borrower's net investment income when NII exceeds $1,000
qs.x:
【🚨 三档对比】NII ≤ $1,000 → $0；$1,000 < NII < 放弃利息 → NII；贷款 > $100,000 → 全额 AFR。
  • 余额 ≤ $100,000 → 推定利息 = Lesser of（AFR 下的放弃利息 $4,000, 借款人 NII $2,500）
  • NII $2,500 > $1,000 → 不适用"视为 0"的门槛 → 推定 $2,500
  • Zack：利息收入 $2,500；视同赠与 $2,500
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：$2,500 — for gift loans of $100,000 or less, imputed interest is limited to the borrower's net investment income when NII exceeds $1,000
qs.tp: T12.10.1 礼物贷款与净投资 Gift-Loan-Net-Investment

qs.s: Wendy sells business equipment (original cost $130,000, accumulated depreciation $30,000, adjusted basis $100,000) for $200,000, receiving $50,000 in the year of sale and $50,000 in each of the next three years (adequate interest is charged separately). How much gain does Wendy recognize in the year of sale, and of what character?
o: $100,000 total: installment reporting is not available for depreciable equipment.

$47,500 total: $30,000 Sec.1245 ordinary income recognized in full in the year of sale regardless of payments, plus $17,500 Sec.1231 gain ($50,000 × 35% gross profit percentage, where the remaining $70,000 gain ÷ $200,000 contract price = 35%).
$30,000 total: only the recapture, with all Sec.1231 gain deferred until the final payment.
$25,000 total: $50,000 × 50% gross profit ratio, all Sec. 1231 gain.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】

① 选项D忽略了回收"当年全额确认"规则，直接用 50% 毛利率（$100,000/$200,000）；选项A误以为折旧资产完全不能用分期法；
② 分期法不适用于：存货销售、证券交易所上市证券、以及亏损交易；
③ 关联方分期销售后 2 年内关联方转售 → 触发加速确认（Sec.453(e)）。

【Step 1：总 Gain】$200,000 − $100,000 = $100,000

【Step 2：折旧回收必须销售当年全额确认（Sec.453(i)）】
  • Sec.1245 回收 = Min($100,000, $30,000) = $30,000 普通收入 → Year 1 全额确认，不能分期
【Step 3：剩余 Gain 分期 —— 回收额先加进 Basis】
  • 剩余 Gain = $100,000 − $30,000 = $70,000
  • Gross Profit % = $70,000 ÷ 合同价 $200,000 = 35%
  • Year 1 收款 $50,000 × 35% = $17,500 Sec.1231 Gain
【Step 4：Year 1 合计】$30,000 + $17,500 = $47,500

（Year 2–4 每年 $17,500 Sec.1231 Gain；合计 $30,000 + $70,000 = $100,000 ✔）

【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）。
qs.tp: T12.8.2 分期中的回收及税率 Installment-Recapture-Rate-Ordering

qs.s: Walt sells land (basis $100,000) to his son for $200,000: $50,000 down and the $150,000 balance in later years. Walt reports on the installment method. In Year 2, the son resells the land to an unrelated buyer for $200,000 cash. What does Walt recognize in Year 1 and Year 2?
o: Year 1: $25,000 ($50,000 × 50% gross profit); Year 2: $75,000 — under Sec. 453(e), the son's resale within 2 years treats Walt as receiving the son's amount realized ($200,000) less payments already received ($50,000), i.e., $150,000 × 50%.
Year 1: $25,000; Year 2: $25,000 (only as the son pays).
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题考折旧回收必须当年确认；本题考关联方转售导致加速确认。
  • 毛利率 = $100,000 / $200,000 = 50%；Year 1 收款 $50,000 → $25,000
  • Sec.453(e)：出售给关联方（家庭成员等），关联方在 2 年内转售 → 原卖方视同收到"关联方转售所得 − 已收款项"
  • Year 2 视同收款 = $200,000 − $50,000 = $150,000 × 50% = $75,000（全部剩余 Gain 加速）
  • 此后儿子实际付款不再重复确认
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：Year 1: $25,000 ($50,000 × 50% gross profit); Year 2: $75,000 — under Sec. 453(e), the son's resale within 2 years treats Walt as receiving the son's amount realized ($200,000) less payments already received ($50,000), i.e., $150,000 × 50%.
qs.tp: T12.8.3 关联分期加速确认 Related-Installment-Acceleration

qs.s: An asset with original cost $130,000 and accumulated depreciation of $30,000 (all straight-line; adjusted basis $100,000), held more than one year and used in a trade or business, is sold for $200,000. Compare the character of the $100,000 gain if the asset is (1) equipment sold by an individual, (2) a commercial building sold by an individual, or (3) a commercial building sold by a C corporation.
o: (1) $30,000 ordinary (Sec.1245) + $70,000 Sec.1231; (2) $30,000 unrecaptured Sec.1250 gain (max 25% rate) + $70,000 Sec.1231, no ordinary income; (3) $6,000 ordinary (Sec.291: 20% × $30,000) + $94,000 Sec.1231.
qs.x:
【🚨 口诀】动产全回收（1245）；个人不动产不回收但 25%（Unrecaptured 1250）；公司不动产回收 20%（291）。

共同起点：Gain = $200,000 − $100,000 = $100,000；累计折旧 $30,000

【(1) 设备 × 个人 — Sec.1245】
  • 回收 = Min(Gain, 累计折旧) = $30,000 普通收入
  • 其余 $70,000 Sec.1231 Gain
【(2) 商业建筑 × 个人 — Sec.1250】
  • 直线法无"超额折旧" → Sec.1250 普通收入回收 = $0
  • 但直线折旧部分 $30,000 = Unrecaptured §1250 Gain，属 1231/LTCG 性质，最高税率 25%
  • 其余 $70,000 Sec.1231 Gain（适用 0/15/20%）
【(3) 商业建筑 × C-Corp — Sec.291】
  • 20% × Min(Gain, 累计折旧) = 20% × $30,000 = $6,000 普通收入
  • 其余 $94,000 Sec.1231 Gain

（C-Corp 没有"25% 税率"的概念，一律 21%，但普通收入 vs 1231 的性质区分仍影响资本损失能否抵消）

【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）。
qs.tp: T12.5.2 不动产与公司回收 Real-Estate-Corporate-Recapture

qs.s: Same asset facts (cost $130,000; accumulated straight-line depreciation $30,000; basis $100,000; held more than 1 year), EXCEPT it is sold for $120,000 (gain $20,000). What is the character if it is (1) equipment of an individual, (2) a commercial building of an individual, (3) a commercial building of a C corporation?
o: (1) $20,000 ordinary; (2) $20,000 unrecaptured Sec. 1250 gain (max 25%); (3) $4,000 ordinary (Sec. 291) + $16,000 Sec. 1231
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题 Gain > 折旧 → 回收以折旧为上限；本题 Gain < 折旧 → 回收以 Gain 为上限。

回收额 = Lesser of（Gain, 累计折旧）= Min($20,000, $30,000) = $20,000

  • (1) 1245 → 全部 $20,000 普通，无 1231
  • (2) 个人直线折旧不动产 → 无普通回收；$20,000 全部为 Unrecaptured 1250（25%）
  • (3) Sec.291 → 20% × $20,000 = $4,000 普通；其余 $16,000 1231
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：(1) $20,000 ordinary; (2) $20,000 unrecaptured Sec. 1250 gain (max 25%); (3) $4,000 ordinary (Sec. 291) + $16,000 Sec. 1231
qs.tp: T12.5.2 不动产与公司回收 Real-Estate-Corporate-Recapture

qs.s: Xena sells land (basis $100,000) to her brother for $70,000, its FMV. Later, the brother sells the land to an unrelated party. What does the brother recognize if he sells it for (1) $200,000, (2) $90,000, or (3) $60,000?
qs.x:
【🚨 关联方定义】家庭：配偶、兄弟姐妹（含半血缘）、祖先、直系后代 ✔；姻亲、叔伯姑姨、表亲 ✘；实体：持股 >50%（直接+归属）。

【Step 1：Xena 的 Loss 被禁止（Sec.267(a)(1)）】

  • Loss = $70,000 − $100,000 = $(30,000) → 兄弟姐妹属关联方 → 不得扣除
  • 兄弟 Basis = 实际买价 $70,000（不是 Xena 的 $100,000，选项A错）
【Step 2：兄弟日后出售 —— 被禁 Loss 只能"抵减 Gain"，不能创造 Loss（Sec.267(d)）】

(1) 售价 $200,000：Gain $130,000 − 可抵 $30,000 = $100,000
(2) 售价 $90,000：Gain $20,000 − 可抵 $20,000（上限为 Gain） = $0（剩余 $10,000 永久浪费）
(3) 售价 $60,000：Loss $10,000（按其 $70,000 Basis）→ 正常确认 $10,000 Loss；Xena 的 $30,000 完全浪费

【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：关联方交易被否认亏损（$30,000）可用于冲减后续转让收益，售价 $200,000 确认收益 $100,000；售价 $90,000 损益为 $0；售价 $60,000 确认损失 $10,000。
qs.tp: T12.9.2 禁止亏损及后续转售 Disallowed-Loss-Subsequent-Sale

qs.s: Xena sells land (basis $100,000) to her husband's brother for $70,000, its FMV. Can Xena deduct the $30,000 loss?
o: No — in-laws are related through spousal attribution.

Yes — Sec. 267(b) family includes only spouse, siblings, ancestors, and lineal descendants; a brother-in-law is not a related party (and his brother's ownership is not attributed to her), so the $30,000 capital loss is deductible (subject to normal capital loss limits).
No — all family members are related parties.
Only $3,000 of the loss is recognized; the rest is disallowed.
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题卖给亲兄弟 → 禁止；本题卖给小叔子 → 允许。

【Sec.267 家庭范围】配偶、兄弟姐妹（含半血缘）、祖先、直系后代 ✔
✘ 姻亲（岳父母、小叔子、女婿）、叔伯姑姨、侄甥、表亲、继亲

  • 丈夫的兄弟是丈夫的关联方，但不是 Xena 的；家族归属不做"二次传递"
  • Loss $30,000 可扣除（个人资本损失当年最多抵 $3,000 普通收入，其余结转 —— 这是资本损失限额，不是 267 禁止，选项D混淆了两者）
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：Yes — Sec. 267(b) family includes only spouse, siblings, ancestors, and lineal descendants; a brother-in-law is not a related party (and his brother's ownership is not attributed to her), so the $30,000 capital loss is deductible (subject to normal capital loss limits).
qs.tp: T12.9.2 禁止亏损及后续转售 Disallowed-Loss-Subsequent-Sale

qs.s: Yan owns 60% of Y Corp. She sells Y Corp a building she held for investment (basis $100,000, FMV $200,000) for $200,000; Y Corp will depreciate the building in its business. What is the character of Yan's $100,000 gain?
o: $100,000 ordinary income under Sec. 1239, because the property is depreciable in the hands of a related buyer (Yan owns more than 50% of Y Corp).
The gain is disallowed entirely under Sec. 267 because the parties are related.
$100,000 long-term capital gain, since Yan held the building for investment.
qs.x:
【Sec.1239 的触发条件】
① 卖方与买方为关联方（个人与其持股 >50% 的公司/合伙，或受控实体之间）
② 资产在买方手中可折旧
→ 卖方的全部 Gain 转为 普通收入

【本题】60% > 50% ✔，Y Corp 将折旧该建筑 ✔ → $100,000 全部普通收入
【为何设此规则？】

防止"卖方以资本利得税率确认 Gain，而受控买方以 Step-up Basis 按普通税率计提折旧抵税"的套利。

【区分 Sec.267】
  • 267 管Loss（禁止扣除）
  • 1239 管Gain（强制转普通）
  • 选项C混淆了两者 —— Gain 不会被"禁止"。
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：控股股东（>50%）向关联企业出售可折旧财产，依 Sec. 1239 规定全部利得强制按普通收入课税。
qs.tp: T12.9.3 关联利得与费用配比 Related-Gain-Expense-Matching

qs.s: Yan owns exactly 50% of Y Corp (the other 50% is owned by an unrelated person). She sells Y Corp an investment building (basis $100,000) for $200,000; Y Corp will depreciate it. What is the character of her gain?
o: The gain is disallowed under Sec. 267.
$100,000 capital gain (long-term if held more than 1 year) — Sec. 1239 requires MORE THAN 50% ownership, so it does not apply.
qs.x:
【🚨 与原题对比】原题 60% → 全部普通收入；本题 50% → 资本利得。考试常用 50% 边界设陷阱。
  • Sec.1239 与 Sec.267 的实体门槛都是 >50%（严格大于）
  • 恰好 50% → 不构成关联方 → 按资产本身性质：投资用建筑 → 资本利得
  • 267 本来就只管 Loss，不会"禁止" Gain（选项C错）
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：$100,000 capital gain (long-term if held more than 1 year) — Sec. 1239 requires MORE THAN 50% ownership, so it does not apply.
qs.tp: T12.9.3 关联利得与费用配比 Related-Gain-Expense-Matching

qs.s: A buyer purchases the assets of a business for a lump sum. How is the purchase price allocated among the assets?
o: Under the Sec. 1060 residual method, in order: Class I cash; Class II actively traded securities/CDs; Class III accounts receivable and debt instruments; Class IV inventory; Class V all other assets (equipment, land, buildings); Class VI Sec. 197 intangibles other than goodwill and going concern value (e.g., customer lists, covenants not to compete); Class VII goodwill and going concern value — each class takes FMV, with any remaining amount falling to the next class and the final residual to goodwill. Both buyer and seller file Form 8594.
Pro rata by relative fair market value across all assets.
By the seller's adjusted basis in each asset.
Entirely to goodwill, then to tangible assets.
qs.x:
【🚨 利益冲突】卖方偏好多分给商誉（资本利得）；买方偏好多分给存货/设备（更快扣除）—— 分摊是谈判条款。

【Sec.1060 残值法（Residual Method）】按 Class I → VII 顺序，每一类按 FMV 吸收，剩余额进入下一类，最后全部残值归 商誉（Class VII）

类别内容
I现金及活期存款
II可交易证券、存单、外币
III应收账款、债权工具
IV存货
V其他资产（设备、土地、建筑）
VI商誉以外的 197 无形资产（客户名单、竞业禁止协议等）
VII商誉与持续经营价值
  • 买卖双方须在 Form 8594 上采用一致的分摊（不一致会引来审计）
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：Under the Sec. 1060 residual method, in order: Class I cash; Class II actively traded securities/CDs; Class III accounts receivable and debt instruments; Class IV inventory; Class V all other assets (equipment, land, buildings); Class VI Sec. 197 intangibles other than goodwill and going concern value (e.g., customer lists, covenants not to compete); Class VII goodwill and going concern value — each class takes FMV, with any remaining amount falling to the next class and the final residual to goodwill. Both buyer and seller file Form 8594.
qs.tp: T12.11 整体收购分摊 Business-Acquisition-Allocation

qs.s: In an asset sale, $100,000 is allocated to a 3-year covenant not to compete and $200,000 to goodwill. What are the consequences to the seller and to the buyer?
o: Seller: both capital. Buyer: covenant over 3 years, goodwill over 15 years.
Both are capital gain to the seller and both are amortized over 3 years by the buyer.
Seller: both ordinary. Buyer: both deducted currently.

Seller: the covenant produces ORDINARY income; goodwill produces capital gain (Sec. 1231/capital, basis usually zero). Buyer: BOTH are Sec. 197 intangibles amortized straight-line over 15 years, regardless of the covenant's 3-year term.
qs.x:
【🚨 谈判】卖方希望少分给竞业禁止协议；买方对两者的摊销期相同，因此通常"让步"给卖方多分商誉换取价格。

【卖方】

  • 竞业禁止协议 → 普通收入（本质是对"不竞争"服务的报酬）
  • 商誉 → 资本利得（自创商誉 Basis 通常为 0）
【买方】两者都是 Sec.197 无形资产 → 一律 15 年直线摊销（$100,000 + $200,000 = $300,000 → 每年 $20,000）
  • 即使竞业禁止期只有 3 年，仍摊 15 年
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：Seller: the covenant produces ORDINARY income; goodwill produces capital gain (Sec. 1231/capital, basis usually zero). Buyer: BOTH are Sec. 197 intangibles amortized straight-line over 15 years, regardless of the covenant's 3-year term.
qs.tp: T12.11.1 无形摊销与部分报废 Section-197-Intangibles

qs.s: A buyer acquires several Sec. 197 intangibles in one transaction. Two years later, the customer list becomes worthless while the buyer still holds the goodwill from the same acquisition. What is the result?
o: No loss is allowed on the customer list; its remaining basis is added to the basis of the retained Sec. 197 intangibles from the same transaction and continues to be amortized. Anti-churning rules also deny 15-year amortization for intangibles acquired from a related party that were held before August 10, 1993.
An ordinary loss for the unamortized basis of the customer list.
The buyer may switch to a 3-year amortization period for the remaining intangibles.
A capital loss is allowed immediately.
qs.x:
【🚨 对比】单独出售全部业务的 197 资产时，损失可以确认。

【Sec.197 要点】

  • 收购取得的无形资产（商誉、持续经营价值、客户名单、竞业禁止、特许权、商标）→ 15 年直线摊销，与实际有用年限无关
  • 损失不得确认：同一交易取得的多项 197 资产，其中一项报废/处置 → 其未摊销 Basis 加到仍持有的其他 197 资产上
  • Anti-Churning：从关联方取得、且该无形资产在 1993/8/10 前已被持有 → 不得适用 15 年摊销
  • 自创商誉不适用 197（不可摊销）
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：No loss is allowed on the customer list; its remaining basis is added to the basis of the retained Sec. 197 intangibles from the same transaction and continues to be amortized. Anti-churning rules also deny 15-year amortization for intangibles acquired from a related party that were held before August 10, 1993.
qs.tp: T12.11.1 无形摊销与部分报废 Section-197-Intangibles

qs.s: Two taxpayers sell real estate at a gain. Taxpayer 1 buys, subdivides, advertises, and regularly sells lots to customers. Taxpayer 2 bought one parcel 8 years ago and held it for appreciation, making no improvements. How are the gains characterized?
o: Character depends solely on holding period.

Taxpayer 1's lots are inventory held primarily for sale to customers in the ordinary course of business (Sec. 1221(a)(1)) — ordinary income; Taxpayer 2's parcel is a capital asset — long-term capital gain. Factors include frequency and substantiality of sales, improvements, sales efforts, and holding period.
qs.x:
【🚨 提示】同一纳税人可以同时是某些资产的交易商与另一些资产的投资者，但须分账簿、明确标识投资性资产。

【Sec.1221(a)(1) 排除】"主要为在正常经营中出售给客户而持有"的财产 = 存货 → 普通收入

【交易商 vs 投资者的判断因素】交易频率与数量、是否开发/细分/改良、销售推广力度、持有期长短、主要收入来源、是否设立销售机构
【Sec.1237 安全港】非交易商个人细分土地出售，满足条件（持有 5 年、未做实质改良、同一地块未曾作为存货）→ 所售地块的利得可按资本利得处理；但自出售第 6 块地的年度起，售价的 5%（减销售费用）视为普通收入
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：Taxpayer 1's lots are inventory held primarily for sale to customers in the ordinary course of business (Sec. 1221(a)(1)) — ordinary income; Taxpayer 2's parcel is a capital asset — long-term capital gain. Factors include frequency and substantiality of sales, improvements, sales efforts, and holding period.
qs.tp: T12.4.1 交易商与投资者 Dealer-Investor-Land-Sales

qs.s: Which statement is correct about self-created intangibles?
o: Self-created copyrights, literary/musical/artistic compositions, letters, and (after 2017) patents, inventions, models or designs, and secret formulas are excluded from capital asset status under Sec. 1221(a)(3) — sales produce ordinary income; however, a 'holder' who transfers ALL substantial rights to a patent under Sec. 1235 receives automatic long-term capital gain treatment regardless of holding period or payment form.
A taxpayer may elect capital asset treatment for self-created copyrights only.
All self-created intangibles produce capital gain on sale.
qs.x:
【🚨 冲突化解】1235 是 1221(a)(3) 的特别法：专利符合 1235 时优先适用。

【Sec.1221(a)(3)】自创的版权、文学/音乐/艺术作品、信件备忘录，以及 TCJA 后新增的专利、发明、模型设计、秘密配方 → 不是资本资产 → 出售为普通收入

  • 例外：纳税人可就自创音乐作品选择按资本资产处理
【Sec.1235】"持有人"（发明人，或在成果产生前提供资金的非关联投资人）转让专利的全部实质性权利 → 自动 LTCG，即使：持有不足 1 年、收款按使用量分期、买方为分期付款
  • 但转让给关联方（含持股 ≥25% 的公司）不适用
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：Self-created copyrights, literary/musical/artistic compositions, letters, and (after 2017) patents, inventions, models or designs, and secret formulas are excluded from capital asset status under Sec. 1221(a)(3) — sales produce ordinary income; however, a 'holder' who transfers ALL substantial rights to a patent under Sec. 1235 receives automatic long-term capital gain treatment regardless of holding period or payment form.
qs.tp: T12.4.2 自创作品及专利 Self-Created-Patent-Rights

qs.s: A seller finances a $200,000 business property sale with a note that states no interest, all principal due in 3 years. What are the consequences?
o: Interest must be imputed: the note is recharacterized into principal (present value at the applicable federal rate) and interest, reducing the seller's amount realized (and the buyer's basis) and creating interest income to the seller and interest expense to the buyer. Sec. 1274 (OID, accrual) generally applies to larger deferred-payment sales, while Sec. 483 applies to certain smaller or excepted sales and imputes interest under the parties' accounting methods.
No interest is imputed if both parties agree in writing.
Sec. 7872 applies because there is no stated interest.
The seller reports a $200,000 amount realized and no interest income.
qs.x:
【🚨 与 7872 的区别】7872 管贷款（赠与、公司-股东、雇主-雇员）；483/1274 管销售中的递延付款。

【卖方融资的推定利息】

  • Sec.1274（OID）：多数递延付款的财产出售 → 本金 = 按 AFR 折现的现值；差额为 OID，按权责发生制逐年计入（无论收付实现制）
  • Sec.483：适用于 1274 未覆盖的情形（如部分小额交易、某些土地在亲属间的出售、总价不超过门槛的交易）→ 按双方各自的会计方法确认利息
  • 效果：卖方 Amount Realized ↓（Gain 从资本利得变成部分普通利息收入）；买方 Basis ↓、可扣利息
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：Interest must be imputed: the note is recharacterized into principal (present value at the applicable federal rate) and interest, reducing the seller's amount realized (and the buyer's basis) and creating interest income to the seller and interest expense to the buyer. Sec. 1274 (OID, accrual) generally applies to larger deferred-payment sales, while Sec. 483 applies to certain smaller or excepted sales and imputes interest under the parties' accounting methods.
qs.tp: T12.10.2 卖方融资本金利息 Seller-Financing-Principal-Interest

qs.s: A taxpayer sells nondealer property for a $2,000,000 installment note. Before collecting, he borrows $500,000 using the note as security. What happens, and what other rule applies to large installment obligations?
o: Under the pledging rule (Sec. 453A(d)), the $500,000 of loan proceeds is treated as a payment on the installment obligation, accelerating gain recognition. In addition, if the face amount of nondealer installment obligations outstanding at year-end exceeds $5,000,000, Sec. 453A imposes an interest charge on the deferred tax.
The loan is treated as a payment only if the lender is related.
Nothing — borrowing against a note is not a taxable event.
qs.x:
【🚨 提示】不适用于自住房出售等个人财产的正常分期销售。

【质押规则（Sec.453A(d)）】以分期票据作担保借款 → 借款额视为收到的分期付款（以票据未收回余额为限）→ 加速确认 Gain

  • 目的：防止纳税人"递延纳税却提前拿到现金"
【Sec.453A 利息费用】非交易商的分期债权年末面值总额 > $500 万 → 对递延税款按欠税利率计息（相当于为递延支付"利息"）
  • 适用于售价超过 $150,000 的财产
【其他限制】存货、公开交易证券、交易商分期销售不得使用分期法；折旧回收部分当年全额确认
【结论】正确答案为 A（选项 A 正确）：Under the pledging rule (Sec. 453A(d)), the $500,000 of loan proceeds is treated as a payment on the installment obligation, accelerating gain recognition. In addition, if the face amount of nondealer installment obligations outstanding at year-end exceeds $5,000,000, Sec. 453A imposes an interest charge on the deferred tax.
qs.tp: T12.8.4 质押与大额递延成本 Pledging-Deferred-Tax-Interest

qs.s: A taxpayer sells land at a large gain and receives payments over 5 years. She expects tax rates to rise and has large capital loss carryovers she could absorb this year. What should she consider?
o: The installment method is mandatory for all deferred-payment sales.
She can switch between methods each year as payments are received.

She may elect OUT of the installment method (on a timely filed return, generally irrevocable), recognizing the entire gain in the year of sale — useful to absorb large capital loss carryovers, to use a currently lower rate, or to avoid the Sec. 453A interest charge.
Electing out requires IRS consent in all cases.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】折旧回收部分无论如何都在销售当年确认，不受选择影响。

【分期法是默认，但可选择退出】

  • 在及时申报的当年税表上选择退出 → 当年确认全部 Gain（按收到现金与票据的 FMV 计算）
  • 选择一般不可撤销（撤销需 IRS 同意）
【何时退出更优】

① 当年有大额资本损失结转可吸收（个人资本损失结转无期限，但只能以 $3,000/年抵普通收入）
② 预计未来税率上升
③ 避免 453A 利息费用或质押规则的复杂性
④ 纳税人当年处于低税率区间

【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：She may elect OUT of the installment method (on a timely filed return, generally irrevocable), recognizing the entire gain in the year of sale — useful to absorb large capital loss carryovers, to use a currently lower rate, or to avoid the Sec. 453A interest charge.
qs.tp: T12.8 分期销售选择 Installment-Sale-Election

qs.s: A taxpayer closes the sale of relinquished real property on March 1. What must occur for a valid deferred like-kind exchange?
o: He may take the sale proceeds and buy replacement property within one year.

He must not have actual or constructive receipt of the proceeds (typically a qualified intermediary holds them); he must identify replacement property in writing by day 45 (April 15) and receive it by the earlier of day 180 (about August 28) or the due date of his return including extensions.
A qualified intermediary is prohibited; the taxpayer must hold the funds.
Identification must occur within 180 days and closing within 365 days.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】180 天与申报截止日取孰早 —— 年底附近的交换必须延期申报才能用满 180 天。

【递延交换四要件】
① 不得实际或推定收到价款 → 使用合格中介（QI）、合格托管/信托账户等安全港（QI 不得是纳税人的代理人，如过去 2 年内的会计师、律师、经纪人）
② 45 天内书面指定替换财产
③ 180 天内（或含延期的申报截止日，孰早）完成取得
④ 标的须为持有用于经营或投资的不动产

【反向交换】先买后卖 → 由"交换承接实体（EAT）"暂时持有，同样受 45/180 天限制（Rev. Proc. 2000-37 安全港）
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：He must not have actual or constructive receipt of the proceeds (typically a qualified intermediary holds them); he must identify replacement property in writing by day 45 (April 15) and receive it by the earlier of day 180 (about August 28) or the due date of his return including extensions.
qs.tp: T12.2.2 递延及反向交换期限 Deferred-Reverse-Exchange-Timing

qs.s: Within the 45-day identification period, a taxpayer who sold property worth $1,000,000 identifies four potential replacement properties with a combined fair market value of $1,800,000. Is the identification valid?
o: Yes — although it fails the 3-property rule, it satisfies the 200% rule (the combined FMV of identified properties does not exceed 200% of the relinquished property's value, i.e., $2,000,000).
No — identification must be limited to the single property actually acquired.
No — a taxpayer may never identify more than three properties.
qs.x:
【🚨 陷阱】指定后可在 45 天内撤销并重新指定；45 天后不可更改。

【45 天指定的三选一规则】
① 3 项财产规则：最多指定 3 项，不论价值
② 200% 规则：可指定任意数量，但合计 FMV ≤ 放弃财产价值的 200%
③ 95% 规则：若超过前两项限制，则必须实际取得所指定财产合计 FMV 的 95% 以上

  • 本题：4 项（超过 3 项）但 $1,800,000 ≤ $2,000,000 → 满足 200% 规则 ✔
【形式】书面、签名、明确描述（地址或法律描述），在第 45 天前送达 QI 或交易对方
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：Yes — although it fails the 3-property rule, it satisfies the 200% rule (the combined FMV of identified properties does not exceed 200% of the relinquished property's value, i.e., $2,000,000).
qs.tp: T12.2.3 替代财产指定 Replacement-Property-Identification

qs.s: In Year 1 a taxpayer placed listed property in service with 80% business use and expensed the $40,000 business portion under Sec. 179. In Year 3 business use drops to 40%. Assume ADS straight-line depreciation on the business portion would have been $4,000 in Year 1 and $8,000 in Year 2. What happens in Year 3?
o: Nothing — prior deductions are not revisited.
Only future depreciation changes; no recapture is required.
The taxpayer amends Year 1 to remove the Sec. 179 deduction.

Because business use is now 50% or less, the taxpayer must recapture as ORDINARY income the excess of the depreciation/Sec. 179 actually claimed over what ADS straight-line would have allowed: $40,000 − ($4,000 + $8,000) = $28,000; future depreciation must use ADS straight-line.
qs.x:
【🚨 提示】不追溯修改以前年度申报表，而是在业务使用率下降的当年一次性回收。

【Sec.280F 列名财产】（如乘用车、某些娱乐/休闲财产）

  • 业务使用率 >50% → 可用 MACRS 加速折旧与 Sec.179
  • 任一年度降至 ≤50% → ① 当年起改用 ADS 直线法 ② 回收以前年度"加速部分"，作为普通收入
  • 回收额 = 实际已扣除（含 179） − 按 ADS 本应扣除 = $40,000 − $12,000 = $28,000
  • 回收额增加该资产的 Basis
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：Because business use is now 50% or less, the taxpayer must recapture as ORDINARY income the excess of the depreciation/Sec. 179 actually claimed over what ADS straight-line would have allowed: $40,000 − ($4,000 + $8,000) = $28,000; future depreciation must use ADS straight-line.
qs.tp: T12.5.5 列名财产及汽车 Listed-Property-Auto-Limits

qs.s: A taxpayer buys a $70,000 passenger automobile used 100% for business. Which statement is correct?
o: The full cost may be expensed under Sec. 179 because business use exceeds 50%.

Annual depreciation (including any Sec. 179 and bonus depreciation) is limited by the Sec. 280F luxury auto caps (indexed dollar limits by year), so recovery is spread over many years; a taxpayer who leases a comparable vehicle must add a 'lease inclusion' amount to income to achieve parity.
The caps apply only to vehicles over 6,000 pounds.
qs.x:
【🚨 叠加】列名财产规则（业务使用率 >50%）与豪车上限同时适用。

【Sec.280F 豪车上限】乘用车每年折旧（含 179 与 Bonus）受逐年美元上限约束（按年通胀调整，题目会给出）→ 成本需多年才能回收完，超出部分在恢复期后继续按上限扣除

【例外】总重 >6,000 磅的车辆不受乘用车上限（选项D说反了），但仍受 179 对 SUV 的专门限额约束
【租赁平价】租车者须按 IRS 表把"租赁计入额（Lease Inclusion Amount）"计入收入，防止以租代购规避上限
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：Annual depreciation (including any Sec. 179 and bonus depreciation) is limited by the Sec. 280F luxury auto caps (indexed dollar limits by year), so recovery is spread over many years; a taxpayer who leases a comparable vehicle must add a 'lease inclusion' amount to income to achieve parity.
qs.tp: T12.5.5 列名财产及汽车 Listed-Property-Auto-Limits

qs.s: An investor's stock in a corporation becomes completely worthless in June. She bought it 10 months earlier. How is the loss treated?
o: A short-term capital loss measured in June.

Under Sec. 165(g) the security is treated as sold on the LAST DAY of the taxable year, so her holding period runs to December 31 — more than one year — producing a long-term capital loss (unless Sec. 1244 applies, which would give ordinary loss treatment within its limits).
No deduction until the corporation is formally dissolved.
qs.x:
【🚨 时效】无价值证券的退税申请时效为 7 年（一般为 3 年）。

【Sec.165(g)】证券在当年完全无价值 → 视为在纳税年度最后一日以 $0 出售

  • 本题：购入（上年 8 月）至本年 12/31 约 16–17 个月（>1 年） → 长期资本损失（若按 6 月计算则仅 10 个月，为短期 —— 这正是考点）
  • 必须完全无价值；部分贬值不可扣除
  • 若属 Sec.1244 股票 → 在限额内按普通损失（更优）
  • 母公司持有的 80% 子公司证券无价值 → 可能为普通损失（Sec.165(g)(3)）
【结论】正确答案为 C（选项 C 正确）：Under Sec. 165(g) the security is treated as sold on the LAST DAY of the taxable year, so her holding period runs to December 31 — more than one year — producing a long-term capital loss (unless Sec. 1244 applies, which would give ordinary loss treatment within its limits).
qs.tp: T12.7.3 无价值证券及坏账 Worthless-Securities-Bad-Debts

qs.s: An individual lends money to a friend's business and the loan becomes uncollectible. The individual is not in the business of lending and has no business relationship to the debt. How is the loss treated?
o: Nonbusiness bad debt: deductible only when TOTALLY worthless, and then only as a SHORT-TERM capital loss (regardless of how long it was outstanding). A business bad debt, by contrast, is an ordinary deduction and may be deducted for partial worthlessness.
Short-term capital loss, deductible for partial worthlessness.
qs.x:
【🚨 提示】股东借款给自己的公司：若主要动机是保护投资 → 非营业坏账；若为保护工资/职位 → 可能是营业坏账。
营业坏账非营业坏账
性质普通损失短期资本损失（不论持有多久）
部分无价值可以扣除不可以（必须完全无价值）
典型应收账款、与经营有紧密关系的借款借给亲友的个人借款
  • 须证明确为真实债务（有票据、利息、还款安排），否则视为赠与
  • 税法只认直接注销法（备抵法不可）
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：Nonbusiness bad debt: deductible only when TOTALLY worthless, and then only as a SHORT-TERM capital loss (regardless of how long it was outstanding). A business bad debt, by contrast, is an ordinary deduction and may be deducted for partial worthlessness.
qs.tp: T12.7.3 无价值证券及坏账 Worthless-Securities-Bad-Debts

qs.s: A taxpayer holds appreciated stock and, to lock in the gain without selling, enters into a short sale of identical stock ('short against the box') in November, keeping both positions open into the next year. What is the result?
o: The transaction is a wash sale, and the loss is disallowed.
Gain is recognized only when the stock is sold in a later year.
No gain until the shares are actually delivered.

Sec. 1259 treats the transaction as a constructive sale of the appreciated position, requiring gain recognition at FMV, unless the taxpayer closes the offsetting position within 30 days after year-end and holds the appreciated position unhedged for at least 60 days thereafter.
qs.x:
【🚨 目的】封堵"锁定利得却无限期递延纳税"的传统做法。

【Sec.1259 推定出售】对增值头寸建立实质抵消的仓位（做空同种股票、远期出售合约、某些互换）→ 视同按 FMV 出售并立即重新买入 → 当年确认 Gain

  • 安全港：次年 1 月 30 日前平掉抵消头寸，且之后至少 60 天保持增值头寸未被对冲 → 不视为推定出售
  • 只针对增值头寸；亏损头寸不适用
【相关规则】Wash Sale（亏损，前后 30 天）；跨式持仓（Straddle）的损失递延与持有期中止
【结论】正确答案为 D（选项 D 正确）：Sec. 1259 treats the transaction as a constructive sale of the appreciated position, requiring gain recognition at FMV, unless the taxpayer closes the offsetting position within 30 days after year-end and holds the appreciated position unhedged for at least 60 days thereafter.

qs.s: An investor rolls a capital gain into a qualified opportunity fund (QOF) within 180 days. What are the core benefits?
o: The original gain is permanently excluded immediately.

The original gain is DEFERRED until a set recognition date or earlier disposition of the QOF interest; holding the QOF investment at least 10 years allows the taxpayer to elect a basis step-up to fair market value on sale, so post-investment appreciation escapes tax. (OBBBA made the opportunity zone program permanent with a rolling deferral period and enhanced benefits for rural funds — apply the parameters given in the question.)
The investment must be made within 60 days, like a Sec. 1045 rollover.
Only ordinary income may be rolled into a QOF.
qs.x:
【🚨 对比】1045（QSBS 滚动）为 60 天、须再投资于 QSBS；1031 仅限不动产且需同类交换。

【机会区三层利益】
① 递延：符合条件的资本利得在 180 天内投入 QOF → 递延至法定确认日或提前处置时
② 部分免除：持有达到规定年限可获得 Basis 调增（原递延利得的一部分不再课税）
③ 增值免税：持有满 10 年 → 出售 QOF 权益时可选择把 Basis 调至 FMV → 投资后的增值完全免税

  • OBBBA 已将机会区制度永久化，并采用滚动递延期、对农村基金给予更高的 Basis 调增 —— 具体年限与比例以题目给出的参数为准
【结论】正确答案为 B（选项 B 正确）：The original gain is DEFERRED until a set recognition date or earlier disposition of the QOF interest; holding the QOF investment at least 10 years allows the taxpayer to elect a basis step-up to fair market value on sale, so post-investment appreciation escapes tax. (OBBBA made the opportunity zone program permanent with a rolling deferral period and enhanced benefits for rural funds — apply the parameters given in the question.)
